611.e: The Word of God's Bani, and His Shabad, are the best utterances.

611.g: ਗਾਵਹੁ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਪੜਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਤੂ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
611.t: gaavahu sunahu paRahu nit bhaiee gur poorai too raakhiaa || rahaau ||
611.e: So constantly sing them, listen to them, and read them, O Siblings of Destiny, and the Perfect Guru shall save you. ||Pause||

611.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਮਿਤਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
611.t: saachaa saahib amit vaddaiee bhagat vachhal dhiaalaa ||
611.e: The glorious greatness of the True Lord is immeasurable; the Merciful Lord is the Lover of His devotees.

611.g: ਸੰਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਦਾ ਆਇਆ ਆਦਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥
611.t: sa(n)taa kee paij rakhadhaa aaiaa aadh biradh pratipaalaa ||2||
611.e: He has preserved the honor of His Saints; from the very beginning of time, His Nature is to cherish them. ||2||

611.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਨਿਤ ਭੁੰਚਹੁ ਸਰਬ ਵੇਲਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
611.t: har a(n)mirat naam bhojan nit bhu(n)chahu sarab velaa mukh paavahu ||
611.e: So eat the Ambrosial Name of the Lord as your food; put it into your mouth at all times.

611.g: ਜਰਾ ਮਰਾ ਤਾਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਨਾਠਾ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥੩॥
611.t: jaraa maraa taap sabh naaThaa gun gobi(n)dh nit gaavahu ||3||
611.e: The pains of old age and death shall all depart, when you constantly sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||3||

611.g: ਸੁਣੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
611.t: sunee aradhaas suaamee merai sarab kalaa ban aaiee ||
611.e: My Lord and Master has heard my prayer, and all my affairs have been resolved.

611.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਭਈ ਸਗਲੇ ਜੁਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੧੧॥
611.t: pragaT bhiee sagale jug a(n)tar gur naanak kee vaddiaaiee ||4||11||
611.e: The glorious greatness of Guru Nanak is manifest, throughout all the ages. ||4||11||

611.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ
611.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa chaupadhe
611.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

611.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
611.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
611.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

611.g: ਏਕੁ ਪਿਤਾ ਏਕਸ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਤੂ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰ ਹਾਈ ॥
611.t: ek pitaa ekas ke ham baarik too meraa gur haiee ||
611.e: The One God is our father; we are the children of the One God. You are our Guru.

611.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਦਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
611.t: sun meetaa jeeau hamaaraa bal bal jaasee har dharasan dheh dhikhaiee ||1||
611.e: Listen, friends: my soul is a sacrifice, a sacrifice to You; O Lord, reveal to me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||1||

612.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਧੂਰੀ ਕਉ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
612.t: sun meetaa dhooree kau bal jaiee ||
612.e: Listen, friends: I am a sacrifice to the dust of Your feet.

612.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
612.t: eih man teraa bhaiee || rahaau ||
612.e: This mind is yours, O Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||

612.g: ਪਾਵ ਮਲੋਵਾ ਮਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਧੋਵਾ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੈ ਕੂ ਦੇਸਾ ॥
612.t: paav malovaa mal mal dhovaa ih man tai koo dhesaa ||
612.e: I wash your feet, I massage and clean them; I give this mind to you.

612.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਹਉ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਆਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮਿਲਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥
612.t: sun meetaa hau teree saranaiee aaiaa prabh milau dheh upadhesaa ||2||
612.e: Listen, friends: I have come to Your Sanctuary; teach me, that I might unite with God. ||2||

612.g: ਮਾਨੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਰੀਜੈ ਕਰੈ ਸੁ ਭਲਾ ਮਨਾਈਐ ॥
612.t: maan na keejai saran pareejai karai su bhalaa manaieeaai ||
612.e: Do not be proud; seek His Sanctuary, and accept as good all that He does.

612.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਅਰਪੀਜੈ ਇਉ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
612.t: sun meetaa jeeau pi(n)dd sabh tan arapeejai iau dharasan har jeeau paieeaai ||3||
612.e: Listen, friends: dedicate your soul, body and your whole being to Him; thus you shall receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan. ||3||

612.g: ਭਇਓ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹੈ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
612.t: bhio anugrahu prasaadh sa(n)tan kai har naamaa hai meeThaa ||
612.e: He has shown mercy to me, by the Grace of the Saints; the Lord's Name is sweet to me.

612.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭੁ ਅਕੁਲ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੧੨॥
612.t: jan naanak kau gur kirapaa dhaaree sabh akul nira(n)jan ddeeThaa ||4||1||12||
612.e: The Guru has shown mercy to servant Nanak; I see the casteless, immaculate Lord everywhere. ||4||1||12||

612.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
612.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
612.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

612.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
612.t: koT brahama(n)dd ko Thaakur suaamee sarab jeeaa kaa dhaataa re ||
612.e: God is the Lord and Master of millions of universes; He is the Giver of all beings.

612.g: ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਇਕੁ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਮੂਰਖਿ ਜਾਤਾ ਰੇ ॥੧॥
612.t: pratipaalai nit saar samaalai ik gun nahee moorakh jaataa re ||1||
612.e: He ever cherishes and cares for all beings, but the fool does not appreciate any of His virtues. ||1||

612.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ਰੇ ॥
612.t: har aaraadh na jaanaa re ||
612.e: I do not know how to worship the Lord in adoration.

612.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਰੇ ॥
612.t: har har gur gur karataa re ||
612.e: I can only repeat, ""Lord, Lord, Guru, Guru.""

612.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਰਾਮਦਾਸੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
612.t: har jeeau naam pario raamadhaas || rahaau ||
612.e: O Dear Lord, I go by the name of the Lord's slave. ||Pause||

612.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਸਰਬ ਘਟਾ ਭਰਪੂਰੀ ਰੇ ॥
612.t: dheen dhiaal kirapaal sukh saagar sarab ghaTaa bharapooree re ||
612.e: The Compassionate Lord is Merciful to the meek, the ocean of peace; He fills all hearts.

612.g: ਪੇਖਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸਦਾ ਹੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਜਾਨਿਆ ਦੂਰੀ ਰੇ ॥੨॥
612.t: pekhat sunat sadhaa hai sa(n)ge mai moorakh jaaniaa dhooree re ||2||
612.e: He sees, hears, and is always with me; but I am a fool, and I think that He is far away. ||2||

612.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਅੰਤੁ ਹਉ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਵਰਨਉ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨਾ ਹੋਇ ਕੈਸੋ ਰੇ ॥
612.t: har bia(n)t hau mit kar varanau kiaa jaanaa hoi kaiso re ||
612.e: The Lord is limitless, but I can only describe Him within my limitations; what do I know, about what He is like?

612.g: ਕਰਉ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਦੇਹੁ ਉਪਦੇਸੋ ਰੇ ॥੩॥
612.t: karau benatee satigur apune mai moorakh dheh upadheso re ||3||
612.e: I offer my prayer to my True Guru; I am so foolish - please, teach me! ||3||

612.g: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ ਕੇਤਕ ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧੀ ਤਰਿਆ ਰੇ ॥
612.t: mai moorakh kee ketak baat hai koT paraadhee tariaa re ||
612.e: I am just a fool, but millions of sinners just like me have been saved.

612.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਿਨ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਪੇਖਿਆ ਸੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਗਰਭਾਸਿ ਨ ਪਰਿਆ ਰੇ ॥੪॥੨॥੧੩॥
612.t: gur naanak jin suniaa pekhiaa se fir garabhaas na pariaa re ||4||2||13||
612.e: Those who have heard, and seen Guru Nanak, do not descend into the womb of reincarnation again. ||4||2||13||

612.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
612.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
612.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

612.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਬਾਤ ਕੋ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅੰਦੇਸਰੋ ਤੇ ਮਿਟੇ ਸਭਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
612.t: jinaa baat ko bahut a(n)dhesaro te miTe sabh giaa ||
612.e: Those things, which caused me such anxiety, have all vanished.

612.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੈਨ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਖਮਨ ਨਾਰੀ ਊਧ ਕਮਲ ਬਿਗਸਇਆ ॥੧॥
612.t: sahaj sain ar sukhaman naaree uoodh kamal bigasiaa ||1||
612.e: Now, I sleep in peace and tranquility, and my mind is in a state of deep and profound peace; the inverted lotus of my heart has blossomed forth. ||1||

612.g: ਦੇਖਹੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਭਇਆ ॥
612.t: dhekhahu acharaj bhiaa ||
612.e: Behold, a wondrous miracle has happened!

612.g: ਜਿਹ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਸੁਨਤ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਸੋ ਰਿਦੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
612.t: jeh Thaakur kau sunat agaadh bodh so ridhai gur dhiaa || rahaau ||
612.e: That Lord and Master, whose wisdom is said to be unfathomable, has been enshrined within my heart, by the Guru. ||Pause||

612.g: ਜੋਇ ਦੂਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਸੰਤਾਵਤ ਤੇ ਭਇਆਨਕ ਭਇਆ ॥
612.t: joi dhoot moh bahut sa(n)taavat te bhiaanak bhiaa ||
612.e: The demons which tormented me so much, have themselves become terrified.

612.g: ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਤੇ ਹਮ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਨਇਆ ॥੨॥
612.t: kareh benatee raakh Thaakur te ham teree saraniaa ||2||
612.e: They pray: please, save us from your Lord Master; we seek your protection. ||2||

612.g: ਜਹ ਭੰਡਾਰੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਖੁਲਿਆ ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਹ ਲਇਆ ॥
612.t: jeh bha(n)ddaar gobi(n)dh kaa khuliaa jeh praapat teh liaa ||
612.e: When the treasure of the Lord of the Universe is opened, those who are pre-destined, receive it.

612.g: ਏਕੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਥਿਆ ॥੩॥
612.t: ek ratan mo kau gur dheenaa meraa man tan seetal thiaa ||3||
612.e: The Guru has given me the one jewel, and my mind and body have become peaceful and tranquil. ||3||

612.g: ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਗੁਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਦੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਅਟਲੁ ਅਮਰੁ ਨ ਮੁਆ ॥
612.t: ek boo(n)dh gur a(n)mrit dheeno taa aTal amar na muaa ||
612.e: The Guru has blessed me with the one drop of Ambrosial Nectar, and so I have become stable, unmoving and immortal - I shall not die.

612.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸਉਪੇ ਫਿਰਿ ਲੇਖਾ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਲਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੧੪॥
612.t: bhagat bha(n)ddaar gur naanak kau saupe fir lekhaa mool na liaa ||4||3||14||
612.e: The Lord blessed Guru Nanak with the treasure of devotional worship, and did not call him to account again. ||4||3||14||

612.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
612.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
612.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

612.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਸਿਉ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
612.t: charan kamal siau jaa kaa man leenaa se jan tirapat aghaiee ||
612.e: Those whose minds are attached to the lotus feet of the Lord - those humble beings are satisfied and fulfilled.

612.g: ਗੁਣ ਅਮੋਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਵਸਿਆ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਖਾਈ ॥੧॥
612.t: gun amol jis ridhai na vasiaa te nar tirasan tirakhaiee ||1||
612.e: But those, within whose hearts the priceless virtue does not abide - those men remain thirsty and unsatisfied. ||1||

612.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਅਰੋਗ ਅਨਦਾਈ ॥
612.t: har aaraadhe arog anadhaiee ||
612.e: Worshipping the Lord in adoration, one becomes happy, and free of disease.

612.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਰਾਮ ਸਨੇਹੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਲਾਖ ਬੇਦਨ ਜਣੁ ਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
612.t: jis no visarai meraa raam sanehee tis laakh bedhan jan aaiee || rahaau ||
612.e: But one who forgets my Dear Lord - know him to be afflicted with tens of thousands of illnesses. ||Pause||

613.g: ਜਿਹ ਜਨ ਓਟ ਗਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇ ਸੁਖੀਏ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣੇ ॥
613.t: jeh jan oT gahee prabh teree se sukhe'ee prabh sarane ||
613.e: Those who hold tightly to Your Support, God, are happy in Your Sanctuary.

613.g: ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਬਿਸਰਿਆ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਤੇ ਦੁਖੀਆ ਮਹਿ ਗਨਣੇ ॥੨॥
613.t: jeh nar bisariaa purakh bidhaataa te dhukheeaa meh ganane ||2||
613.e: But those humble beings who forget the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny, are counted among the most miserable beings. ||2||

613.g: ਜਿਹ ਗੁਰ ਮਾਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਹ ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਰਸੁ ਕਰਿਆ ॥
613.t: jeh gur maan prabhoo liv laiee teh mahaa ana(n)dh ras kariaa ||
613.e: One who has faith in the Guru, and who is lovingly attached to God, enjoys the delights of supreme ecstasy.

613.g: ਜਿਹ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਬਿਸਾਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਬੇਮੁਖਾਈ ਤੇ ਨਰਕ ਘੋਰ ਮਹਿ ਪਰਿਆ ॥੩॥
613.t: jeh prabhoo bisaar gur te bemukhaiee te narak ghor meh pariaa ||3||
613.e: One who forgets God and forsakes the Guru, falls into the most horrible hell. ||3||

613.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਕੋ ਲਾਇਆ ਤਿਤ ਹੀ ਲਾਗਾ ਤੈਸੋ ਹੀ ਵਰਤਾਰਾ ॥
613.t: jit ko laiaa tit hee laagaa taiso hee varataaraa ||
613.e: As the Lord engages someone, so he is engaged, and so does he perform.

613.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਹ ਪਕਰੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਭਏ ਮਗਨ ਚਰਨਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੪॥੧੫॥
613.t: naanak seh pakaree sa(n)tan kee ridhai bhe magan charanaaraa ||4||4||15||
613.e: Nanak has taken to the Shelter of the Saints; his heart is absorbed in the Lord's feet. ||4||4||15||

613.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
613.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
613.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

613.g: ਰਾਜਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ਮਾਨਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੀ ॥
613.t: raajan meh raajaa urajhaio maanan meh abhimaanee ||
613.e: As the king is entangled in kingly affairs, and the egotist in his own egotism,

613.g: ਲੋਭਨ ਮਹਿ ਲੋਭੀ ਲੋਭਾਇਓ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਚੇ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥੧॥
613.t: lobhan meh lobhee lobhaio tiau har ra(n)g rache giaanee ||1||
613.e: and the greedy man is enticed by greed, so is the spiritually enlightened being absorbed in the Love of the Lord. ||1||

613.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਇਹੀ ਸੁਹਾਵੈ ॥
613.t: har jan kau ihee suhaavai ||
613.e: This is what befits the Lord's servant.

613.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨਿ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
613.t: pekh nikaT kar sevaa satigur har keeratan hee tirapataavai || rahaau ||
613.e: Beholding the Lord near at hand, he serves the True Guru, and he is satisfied through the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. ||Pause||

613.g: ਅਮਲਨ ਸਿਉ ਅਮਲੀ ਲਪਟਾਇਓ ਭੂਮਨ ਭੂਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
613.t: amalan siau amalee lapaTaio bhooman bhoom piaaree ||
613.e: The addict is addicted to his drug, and the landlord is in love with his land.

613.g: ਖੀਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਹੈ ਲੀਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੰਤ ਐਸੇ ਹਿਤਕਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
613.t: kheer sa(n)g baarik hai leenaa prabh sa(n)t aaise hitakaaree ||2||
613.e: As the baby is attached to his milk, so the Saint is in love with God. ||2||

613.g: ਬਿਦਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਬਿਦੁਅੰਸੀ ਰਚਿਆ ਨੈਨ ਦੇਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ॥
613.t: bidhiaa meh bidhua(n)see rachiaa nain dhekh sukh paaveh ||
613.e: The scholar is absorbed in scholarship, and the eyes are happy to see.

613.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਰਸਨਾ ਸਾਦਿ ਲੁਭਾਨੀ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹਿ ॥੩॥
613.t: jaise rasanaa saadh lubhaanee tiau har jan har gun gaaveh ||3||
613.e: As the tongue savors the tastes, so does the humble servant of the Lord sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||3||

613.g: ਜੈਸੀ ਭੂਖ ਤੈਸੀ ਕਾ ਪੂਰਕੁ ਸਗਲ ਘਟਾ ਕਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
613.t: jaisee bhookh taisee kaa poorak sagal ghaTaa kaa suaamee ||
613.e: As is the hunger, so is the fulfiller; He is the Lord and Master of all hearts.

613.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਿਆਸ ਲਗੀ ਦਰਸਨ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੪॥੫॥੧੬॥
613.t: naanak piaas lagee dharasan kee prabh miliaa a(n)tarajaamee ||4||5||16||
613.e: Nanak thirsts for the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan; he has met God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||4||5||16||

613.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
613.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
613.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

613.g: ਹਮ ਮੈਲੇ ਤੁਮ ਊਜਲ ਕਰਤੇ ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
613.t: ham maile tum uoojal karate ham niragun too dhaataa ||
613.e: We are filthy, and You are immaculate, O Creator Lord; we are worthless, and You are the Great Giver.

613.g: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਤੁਮ ਚਤੁਰ ਸਿਆਣੇ ਤੂ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਾ ਕਾ ਗਿਆਤਾ ॥੧॥
613.t: ham moorakh tum chatur siaane too sarab kalaa kaa giaataa ||1||
613.e: We are fools, and You are wise and all-knowing. You are the knower of all things. ||1||

613.g: ਮਾਧੋ ਹਮ ਐਸੇ ਤੂ ਐਸਾ ॥
613.t: maadho ham aaise too aaisaa ||
613.e: O Lord, this is what we are, and this is what You are.

613.g: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਤੁਮ ਪਾਪ ਖੰਡਨ ਨੀਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਦੇਸਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
613.t: ham paapee tum paap kha(n)ddan neeko Thaakur dhesaa || rahaau ||
613.e: We are sinners, and You are the Destroyer of sins. Your abode is so beautiful, O Lord and Master. ||Pause||

613.g: ਤੁਮ ਸਭ ਸਾਜੇ ਸਾਜਿ ਨਿਵਾਜੇ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਦੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਾ ॥
613.t: tum sabh saaje saaj nivaaje jeeau pi(n)dd dhe praanaa ||
613.e: You fashion all, and having fashioned them, You bless them. You bestow upon them soul, body and the breath of life.

613.g: ਨਿਰਗੁਨੀਆਰੇ ਗੁਨੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਤੁਮ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
613.t: niraguneeaare gun nahee koiee tum dhaan dheh miharavaanaa ||2||
613.e: We are worthless - we have no virtue at all; please, bless us with Your gift, O Merciful Lord and Master. ||2||

613.g: ਤੁਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਭਲਾ ਹਮ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਜਾਨਹ ਤੁਮ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
613.t: tum karahu bhalaa ham bhalo na jaaneh tum sadhaa sadhaa dhiaalaa ||
613.e: You do good for us, but we do not see it as good; You are kind and compassionate, forever and ever.

613.g: ਤੁਮ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਬਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
613.t: tum sukhadhaiee purakh bidhaate tum raakhahu apune baalaa ||3||
613.e: You are the Giver of peace, the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny; please, save us, Your children! ||3||

613.g: ਤੁਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਅਟਲ ਸੁਲਿਤਾਨ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਜਾਚੈ ॥
613.t: tum nidhaan aTal sulitaan jeea ja(n)t sabh jaachai ||
613.e: You are the treasure, eternal Lord King; all beings and creatures beg of You.

613.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਮ ਇਹੈ ਹਵਾਲਾ ਰਾਖੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਾਛੈ ॥੪॥੬॥੧੭॥
613.t: kahu naanak ham ihai havaalaa raakh sa(n)tan kai paachhai ||4||6||17||
613.e: Says Nanak, such is our condition; please, Lord, keep us on the Path of the Saints. ||4||6||17||

613.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ॥
613.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa ||
613.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla, Second House:

613.g: ਮਾਤ ਗਰਭ ਮਹਿ ਆਪਨ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਦੇ ਤਹ ਤੁਮ ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੇ ॥
613.t: maat garabh meh aapan simaran dhe teh tum raakhanahaare ||
613.e: In our mother's womb, You blessed us with Your meditative remembrance, and You preserved us there.

613.g: ਪਾਵਕ ਸਾਗਰ ਅਥਾਹ ਲਹਰਿ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰਹੁ ਤਾਰਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
613.t: paavak saagar athaeh lahar meh taarahu taaranahaare ||1||
613.e: Through the countless waves of the ocean of fire, please, carry us across and save us, O Savior Lord! ||1||

613.g: ਮਾਧੌ ਤੂ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਿਰਿ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
613.t: maadhau too Thaakur sir moraa ||
613.e: O Lord, You are the Master above my head.

613.g: ਈਹਾ ਊਹਾ ਤੁਹਾਰੋ ਧੋਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
613.t: e'eehaa uoohaa tuhaaro dhoraa || rahaau ||
613.e: Here and hereafter, You alone are my Support. ||Pause||

613.g: ਕੀਤੇ ਕਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਸੰਮਾਨੈ ਕਰਣਹਾਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਣੁ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
613.t: keete kau merai sa(n)maanai karanahaar tiran jaanai ||
613.e: He looks upon the creation like a mountain of gold, and sees the Creator as a blade of grass.

613.g: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਮਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਸਗਲੀ ਦਾਨੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਨੈ ॥੨॥
613.t: too dhaataa maagan kau sagalee dhaan dheh prabh bhaanai ||2||
613.e: You are the Great Giver, and we are all mere beggars; O God, You give gifts according to Your Will. ||2||

613.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਖਿਨੈ ਮਹਿ ਅਵਰਾ ਅਚਰਜ ਚਲਤ ਤੁਮਾਰੇ ॥
613.t: khin meh avar khinai meh avaraa acharaj chalat tumaare ||
613.e: In an instant, You are one thing, and in another instant, You are another. Wondrous are Your ways!

613.g: ਰੂੜੋ ਗੂੜੋ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰੋ ਊਚੌ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
613.t: rooRo gooRo gahir ga(n)bheero uoochau agam apaare ||3||
613.e: You are beautiful, mysterious, profound, unfathomable, lofty, inaccessible and infinite. ||3||

614.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਜਉ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ਤਉ ਸੁਨੀ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
614.t: saadhasa(n)g jau tumeh milaio tau sunee tumaaree baanee ||
614.e: When You brought me to the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, then I heard the Bani of Your Word.

614.g: ਅਨਦੁ ਭਇਆ ਪੇਖਤ ਹੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪ ਪੁਰਖ ਨਿਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੮॥
614.t: anadh bhiaa pekhat hee naanak prataap purakh nirabaanee ||4||7||18||
614.e: Nanak is in ecstasy, beholding the Glory of the Primal Lord of Nirvaanaa. ||4||7||18||

614.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
614.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
614.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

614.g: ਹਮ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਰੇਨੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਮ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾ ॥
614.t: ham sa(n)tan kee ren piaare ham sa(n)tan kee saranaa ||
614.e: I am the dust of the feet of the Beloved Saints; I seek the Protection of their Sanctuary.

614.g: ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰੀ ਓਟ ਸਤਾਣੀ ਸੰਤ ਹਮਾਰਾ ਗਹਣਾ ॥੧॥
614.t: sa(n)t hamaaree oT sataanee sa(n)t hamaaraa gahanaa ||1||
614.e: The Saints are my all-powerful Support; the Saints are my ornament and decoration. ||1||

614.g: ਹਮ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਣਿ ਆਈ ॥
614.t: ham sa(n)tan siau ban aaiee ||
614.e: I am hand and glove with the Saints.

614.g: ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਪਾਈ ॥
614.t: poorab likhiaa paiee ||
614.e: I have realized my pre-ordained destiny.

614.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਭਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
614.t: eih man teraa bhaiee || rahaau ||
614.e: This mind is yours, O Siblings of Destiny. ||Pause||

614.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਲੇਵਾ ਦੇਵੀ ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ॥
614.t: sa(n)tan siau meree levaa dhevee sa(n)tan siau biauhaaraa ||
614.e: My dealings are with the Saints, and my business is with the Saints.

614.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਸਿਉ ਹਮ ਲਾਹਾ ਖਾਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭਰੇ ਭੰਡਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
614.t: sa(n)tan siau ham laahaa khaaTiaa har bhagat bhare bha(n)ddaaraa ||2||
614.e: I have earned the profit with the Saints, and the treasure filled to over-flowing with devotion to the Lord. ||2||

614.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਪੂੰਜੀ ਸਉਪੀ ਤਉ ਉਤਰਿਆ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਧੋਖਾ ॥
614.t: sa(n)tan mo kau poo(n)jee saupee tau utariaa man kaa dhokhaa ||
614.e: The Saints entrusted to me the capital, and my mind's delusion was dispelled.

614.g: ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਅਬ ਕਹਾ ਕਰੈਗੋ ਜਉ ਫਾਟਿਓ ਸਗਲੋ ਲੇਖਾ ॥੩॥
614.t: dharam rai ab kahaa karaigo jau faaTio sagalo lekhaa ||3||
614.e: What can the Righteous Judge of Dharma do now? All my accounts have been torn up. ||3||

614.g: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਭਏ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਪਰਸਾਦੇ ॥
614.t: mahaa ana(n)dh bhe sukh paiaa sa(n)tan kai parasaadhe ||
614.e: I have found the greatest bliss, and I am at peace, by the Grace of the Saints.

614.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤੇ ਬਿਸਮਾਦੇ ॥੪॥੮॥੧੯॥
614.t: kahu naanak har siau man maaniaa ra(n)g rate bisamaadhe ||4||8||19||
614.e: Says Nanak, my mind is reconciled with the Lord; it is imbued with the wondrous Love of the Lord. ||4||8||19||

614.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
614.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
614.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

614.g: ਜੇਤੀ ਸਮਗ੍ਰੀ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਰੇ ਨਰ ਤੇਤੀ ਹੀ ਛਡਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
614.t: jetee samagree dhekhahu re nar tetee hee chhadd jaanee ||
614.e: All the things that you see, O man, you shall have to leave behind.

614.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਿਉਹਾਰਾ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਪਦੁ ਨਿਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
614.t: raam naam sa(n)g kar biauhaaraa paaveh padh nirabaanee ||1||
614.e: Let your dealings be with the Lord's Name, and you shall attain the state of Nirvaanaa. ||1||

614.g: ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
614.t: piaare too mero sukhadhaataa ||
614.e: O my Beloved, You are the Giver of peace.

614.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਦੀਆ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
614.t: gur poorai dheeaa upadhesaa tum hee sa(n)g paraataa || rahaau ||
614.e: The Perfect Guru has given me these Teachings, and I am attuned to You. ||Pause||

614.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ਤਾ ਮਹਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
614.t: kaam karodh lobh moh abhimaanaa taa meh sukh nahee paieeaai ||
614.e: In sexual desire, anger, greed, emotional attachment and self-conceit, peace is not to be found.

614.g: ਹੋਹੁ ਰੇਨ ਤੂ ਸਗਲ ਕੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਤਉ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੨॥
614.t: hoh ren too sagal kee mere man tau anadh ma(n)gal sukh paieeaai ||2||
614.e: So be the dust of the feet of all, O my mind, and then you shall find bliss, joy and peace. ||2||

614.g: ਘਾਲ ਨ ਭਾਨੈ ਅੰਤਰ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਰਿ ਮਨ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
614.t: ghaal na bhaanai a(n)tar bidh jaanai taa kee kar man sevaa ||
614.e: He knows the condition of your inner self, and He will not let your work go in vain - serve Him, O mind.

614.g: ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਾ ਹੋਮਿ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੂਆ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਾ ॥੩॥
614.t: kar poojaa hom ih manooaa akaal moorat gurdhevaa ||3||
614.e: Worship Him, and dedicate this mind unto Him, the Image of the Undying Lord, the Divine Guru. ||3||

614.g: ਗੋਬਿਦ ਦਾਮੋਦਰ ਦਇਆਲ ਮਾਧਵੇ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰਾ ॥
614.t: gobidh dhaamodhar dhiaal maadhave paarabraham nira(n)kaaraa ||
614.e: He is the Lord of the Universe, the Compassionate Lord, the Supreme Lord God, the Formless Lord.

614.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਨਾਮੋ ਵਾਲੇਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੪॥੯॥੨੦॥
614.t: naam varatan naamo vaalevaa naam naanak praan adhaaraa ||4||9||20||
614.e: The Naam is my merchandise, the Naam is my nourishment; the Naam, O Nanak, is the Support of my breath of life. ||4||9||20||

614.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
614.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
614.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

614.g: ਮਿਰਤਕ ਕਉ ਪਾਇਓ ਤਨਿ ਸਾਸਾ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਆਨਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
614.t: mritak kau paio tan saasaa bichhurat aan milaiaa ||
614.e: He infuses the breath into the dead bodies, and he reunited the separated ones.

614.g: ਪਸੂ ਪਰੇਤ ਮੁਗਧ ਭਏ ਸ੍ਰੋਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਗਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
614.t: pasoo paret mugadh bhe srote har naamaa mukh gaiaa ||1||
614.e: Even beasts, demons and fools become attentive listeners, when He sings the Praises of the Lord's Name. ||1||

614.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਦੇਖੁ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
614.t: poore gur kee dhekh vaddaiee ||
614.e: Behold the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

614.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
614.t: taa kee keemat kahan na jaiee || rahaau ||
614.e: His worth cannot be described. ||Pause||

614.g: ਦੂਖ ਸੋਗ ਕਾ ਢਾਹਿਓ ਡੇਰਾ ਅਨਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਬਿਸਰਾਮਾ ॥
614.t: dhookh sog kaa ddaahio dderaa anadh ma(n)gal bisaraamaa ||
614.e: He has demolished the abode of sorrow and disease, and brought bliss, joy and happiness.

614.g: ਮਨ ਬਾਂਛਤ ਫਲ ਮਿਲੇ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਏ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੨॥
614.t: man baa(n)chhat fal mile achi(n)taa pooran hoe kaamaa ||2||
614.e: He effortlessly awards the fruits of the mind's desire, and all works are brought to perfection. ||2||

614.g: ਈਹਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਏ ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣੇ ॥
614.t: e'eehaa sukh aagai mukh uoojal miT ge aavan jaane ||
614.e: He finds peace in this world, and his face is radiant in the world hereafter; his comings and goings are finished.

614.g: ਨਿਰਭਉ ਭਏ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥੩॥
614.t: nirabhau bhe hiradhai naam vasiaa apune satigur kai man bhaane ||3||
614.e: He becomes fearless, and his heart is filled with the Naam, the Name of the Lord; his mind is pleasing to the True Guru. ||3||

614.g: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਦੂਖੁ ਦਰਦੁ ਭ੍ਰਮੁ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
614.t: uooThat baiThat har gun gaavai dhookh dharadh bhram bhaagaa ||
614.e: Standing up and sitting down, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord; his pain, sorrow and doubt are dispelled.

614.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਤਾ ਕੇ ਪੂਰ ਕਰੰਮਾ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੪॥੧੦॥੨੧॥
614.t: kahu naanak taa ke poor kara(n)maa jaa kaa gur charanee man laagaa ||4||10||21||
614.e: Says Nanak, his karma is perfect; his mind is attached to the Guru's feet. ||4||10||21||

614.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
614.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
614.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

614.g: ਰਤਨੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਕਉਡੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਾਗੇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
614.t: ratan chhaadd kauddee sa(n)g laage jaa te kachhoo na paieeaai ||
614.e: Forsaking the jewel, he is attached to the shell; nothing will come of it.

615.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਸਦਾ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥੧॥
615.t: pooran paarabraham paramesur mere man sadhaa dhiaaieeaai ||1||
615.e: O my mind, meditate forever on the Perfect, Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord. ||1||

615.g: ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥
615.t: simarahu har har naam paraanee ||
615.e: Meditate in remembrance on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, O mortal.

615.g: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਕਾਚੀ ਦੇਹ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
615.t: binasai kaachee dheh agiaanee || rahaau ||
615.e: Your frail body shall perish, you ignorant fool. ||Pause||

615.g: ਮ੍ਰਿਗ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਰੁ ਸੁਪਨ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
615.t: mirag tirasanaa ar supan manorath taa kee kachh na vaddaiee ||
615.e: Illusions and dream-objects possess nothing of greatness.

615.g: ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਸਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
615.t: raam bhajan bin kaam na aavas sa(n)g na kaahoo jaiee ||2||
615.e: Without meditating on the Lord, nothing succeeds, and nothing will go along with you. ||2||

615.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਕਰਤ ਬਿਹਾਇ ਅਵਰਦਾ ਜੀਅ ਕੋ ਕਾਮੁ ਨ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
615.t: hau hau karat bihai avaradhaa jeea ko kaam na keenaa ||
615.e: Acting in egotism and pride, his life passes away, and he does nothing for his soul.

615.g: ਧਾਵਤ ਧਾਵਤ ਨਹ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸਿਆ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਹੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
615.t: dhaavat dhaavat neh tirapataasiaa raam naam nahee cheenaa ||3||
615.e: Wandering and wandering all around, he is never satisfied; he does not remember the Name of the Lord. ||3||

615.g: ਸਾਦ ਬਿਕਾਰ ਬਿਖੈ ਰਸ ਮਾਤੋ ਅਸੰਖ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੇ ॥
615.t: saadh bikaar bikhai ras maato asa(n)kh khate kar fere ||
615.e: Intoxicated with the taste of corruption, cruel pleasures and countless sins, he is consigned to the cycle of reincarnation.

615.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਪਾਹਿ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਕਾਟਹੁ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਮੇਰੇ ॥੪॥੧੧॥੨੨॥
615.t: naanak kee prabh paeh bina(n)tee kaaTahu avagun mere ||4||11||22||
615.e: Nanak offers his prayer to God, to eradicate his demerits. ||4||11||22||

615.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
615.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
615.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

615.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਰੇ ॥
615.t: gun gaavahu pooran abinaasee kaam karodh bikh jaare ||
615.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Perfect, Imperishable Lord, and the poison of sexual desire and anger shall be burnt away.

615.g: ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖਮੁ ਅਗਨਿ ਕੋ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਉਧਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
615.t: mahaa bikham agan ko saagar saadhoo sa(n)g udhaare ||1||
615.e: You shall cross over the awesome, arduous ocean of fire, in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||

615.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਗੁਰਿ ਮੇਟਿਓ ਭਰਮੁ ਅੰਧੇਰਾ ॥
615.t: poorai gur meTio bharam a(n)dheraa ||
615.e: The Perfect Guru has dispelled the darkness of doubt.

615.g: ਭਜੁ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਨੇਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
615.t: bhaj prem bhagat prabh neraa || rahaau ||
615.e: Remember God with love and devotion; He is near at hand. ||Pause||

615.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਆ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਰਹੇ ਅਘਾਈ ॥
615.t: har har naam nidhaan ras peeaa man tan rahe aghaiee ||
615.e: Drink in the sublime essence, the treasure of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and your mind and body shall remain satisfied.

615.g: ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਕਤ ਆਵੈ ਕਤ ਜਾਈ ॥੨॥
615.t: jat kat poor rahio paramesar kat aavai kat jaiee ||2||
615.e: The Transcendent Lord is totally permeating and pervading everywhere; where would He come from, and where would He go? ||2||

615.g: ਜਪ ਤਪ ਸੰਜਮ ਗਿਆਨ ਤਤ ਬੇਤਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਗੋੁਪਾਲਾ ॥
615.t: jap tap sa(n)jam giaan tat betaa jis man vasai guopaalaa ||
615.e: One whose mind is filled with the Lord, is a person of meditation, penance, self-restraint and spiritual wisdom, and a knower of reality.

615.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲਾ ॥੩॥
615.t: naam ratan jin gurmukh paiaa taa kee pooran ghaalaa ||3||
615.e: The Gurmukh obtains the jewel of the Naam; his efforts come to perfect fruition. ||3||

615.g: ਕਲਿ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟੇ ਦੁਖ ਸਗਲੇ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਾ ॥
615.t: kal kales miTe dhukh sagale kaaTee jam kee faasaa ||
615.e: All his struggles, sufferings and pains are dispelled, and the noose of death is cut away from him.

615.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਭਏ ਬਿਗਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੨੩॥
615.t: kahu naanak prabh kirapaa dhaaree man tan bhe bigaasaa ||4||12||23||
615.e: Says Nanak, God has extended His Mercy, and so his mind and body blossom forth. ||4||12||23||

615.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
615.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
615.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

615.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਰਾਵਣਹਾਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
615.t: karan karaavanahaar prabh dhaataa paarabraham prabh suaamee ||
615.e: God is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Great Giver; God is the Supreme Lord and Master.

615.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਜੀਅ ਕੀਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥੧॥
615.t: sagale jeea ke'ee dhiaalaa so prabh a(n)tarajaamee ||1||
615.e: The Merciful Lord created all beings; God is the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||1||

615.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਆਪਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
615.t: meraa gur hoaa aap sahaiee ||
615.e: My Guru is Himself my friend and support.

615.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਅਚਰਜ ਭਈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
615.t: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh ma(n)gal ras acharaj bhiee baddaiee || rahaau ||
615.e: I am in celestial peace, bliss, joy, pleasure and wondrous glory. ||Pause||

615.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਏ ਭੈ ਨਾਸੇ ਸਾਚੀ ਦਰਗਹ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
615.t: gur kee saran pe bhai naase saachee dharageh maane ||
615.e: Seeking the Sanctuary of the Guru, my fears have been dispelled, and I am accepted in the Court of the True Lord.

615.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਏ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਥਾਨੇ ॥੨॥
615.t: gun gaavat aaraadh naam har aae apunai thaane ||2||
615.e: Singing His Glorious Praises, and worshipping in adoration the Name of the Lord, I have reached my destination. ||2||

615.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੈ ਸਭ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥
615.t: jai jai kaar karai sabh usatat sa(n)gat saadh piaaree ||
615.e: Everyone applauds and congratulates me; the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, is dear to me.

615.g: ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਿ ਜਾਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
615.t: sadh balihaar jaau prabh apune jin pooran paij savaaree ||3||
615.e: I am forever a sacrifice to my God, who has totally protected and preserved my honor. ||3||

615.g: ਗੋਸਟਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਉਧਰੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
615.t: gosaT giaan naam sun udhare jin jin dharasan paiaa ||
615.e: They are saved, who receive the Blessed Vision of His Darshan; they listen to the spiritual dialogue of the Naam.

615.g: ਭਇਓ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਅਨਦ ਸੇਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੨੪॥
615.t: bhio kirapaal naanak prabh apunaa anadh setee ghar aaiaa ||4||13||24||
615.e: Nanak's God has become Merciful to him; he has arrived home in ecstasy. ||4||13||24||

615.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
615.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
615.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

615.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਗਲ ਭੈ ਲਾਥੇ ਦੁਖ ਬਿਨਸੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
615.t: prabh kee saran sagal bhai laathe dhukh binase sukh paiaa ||
615.e: In God's Sanctuary, all fears depart, suffering disappears, and peace is obtained.

615.g: ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥੧॥
615.t: dhiaal hoaa paarabraham suaamee pooraa satigur dhiaaiaa ||1||
615.e: When the Supreme Lord God and Master becomes merciful, we meditate on the Perfect True Guru. ||1||

615.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
615.t: prabh jeeau too mero saahib dhaataa ||
615.e: O Dear God, You are my Lord Master and Great Giver.

615.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
615.t: kar kirapaa prabh dheen dhiaalaa gun gaavau ra(n)g raataa || rahaau ||
615.e: By Your Mercy, O God, Merciful to the meek, imbue me with Your Love, that I might sing Your Glorious Praises. ||Pause||

615.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
615.t: satigur naam nidhaan dhiraRaiaa chi(n)taa sagal binaasee ||
615.e: The True Guru has implanted the treasure of the Naam within me, and all my anxieties have been dispelled.

616.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥੨॥
616.t: kar kirapaa apuno kar leenaa man vasiaa abinaasee ||2||
616.e: By His Mercy, He has made me His own, and the imperishable Lord has come to dwell within my mind. ||2||

616.g: ਤਾ ਕਉ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਕੋਊ ਲਾਗੈ ਜੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਰਾਖੇ ॥
616.t: taa kau bighan na kouoo laagai jo satigur apunai raakhe ||
616.e: No misfortune afflicts one who is protected by the True Guru.

616.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਬਸੇ ਰਿਦ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੇ ॥੩॥
616.t: charan kamal base ridh a(n)tar a(n)mirat har ras chaakhe ||3||
616.e: The Lotus Feet of God come to abide within his heart, and he savors the sublime essence of the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar. ||3||

616.g: ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੇਵਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥
616.t: kar sevaa sevak prabh apune jin man kee ichh pujaiee ||
616.e: So, as a servant, serve your God, who fulfills your mind's desires.

616.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੪॥੨੫॥
616.t: naanak dhaas taa kai balihaarai jin pooran paij rakhaiee ||4||14||25||
616.e: Slave Nanak is a sacrifice to the Perfect Lord, who has protected and preserved his honor. ||4||14||25||

616.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
616.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
616.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

616.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਮਗਨੁ ਅੰਧਿਆਰੈ ਦੇਵਨਹਾਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਨੈ ॥
616.t: maiaa moh magan a(n)dhiaarai dhevanahaar na jaanai ||
616.e: Infatuated with the darkness of emotional attachment to Maya, he does not know the Lord, the Great Giver.

616.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਸਾਜਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਬਲੁ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥
616.t: jeeau pi(n)dd saaj jin rachiaa bal apuno kar maanai ||1||
616.e: The Lord created his body and fashioned his soul, but he claims that his power is his own. ||1||

616.g: ਮਨ ਮੂੜੇ ਦੇਖਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ॥
616.t: man mooRe dhekh rahio prabh suaamee ||
616.e: O foolish mind, God, your Lord and Master is watching over you.

616.g: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਜਾਣੈ ਰਹੈ ਨ ਕਛੂਐ ਛਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
616.t: jo kichh kareh soiee soiee jaanai rahai na kachhooaai chhaanee || rahaau ||
616.e: Whatever you do, He knows; nothing can remain concealed from Him. ||Pause||

616.g: ਜਿਹਵਾ ਸੁਆਦ ਲੋਭ ਮਦਿ ਮਾਤੋ ਉਪਜੇ ਅਨਿਕ ਬਿਕਾਰਾ ॥
616.t: jihavaa suaadh lobh madh maato upaje anik bikaaraa ||
616.e: You are intoxicated with the tastes of the tongue, with greed and pride; countless sins spring from these.

616.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਰਮਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਬੰਧਨ ਕੇ ਭਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
616.t: bahut jon bharamat dhukh paiaa haumai ba(n)dhan ke bhaaraa ||2||
616.e: You wandered in pain through countless incarnations, weighed down by the chains of egotism. ||2||

616.g: ਦੇਇ ਕਿਵਾੜ ਅਨਿਕ ਪੜਦੇ ਮਹਿ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਸੰਗਿ ਫਾਕੈ ॥
616.t: dhei kivaaR anik paRadhe meh par dhaaraa sa(n)g faakai ||
616.e: Behind closed doors, hidden by many screens, the man takes his pleasure with another man's wife.

616.g: ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤੁ ਜਬ ਲੇਖਾ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਤਬ ਕਉਣੁ ਪੜਦਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਢਾਕੈ ॥੩॥
616.t: chitr gupat jab lekhaa maageh tab kaun paRadhaa teraa ddaakai ||3||
616.e: When Chitr and Gupt, the celestial accountants of the conscious and subconscious, call for your account, who will screen you then? ||3||

616.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤੁਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਓਟ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
616.t: dheen dhiaal pooran dhukh bha(n)jan tum bin oT na kaiee ||
616.e: O Perfect Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pain, without You, I have no shelter at all.

616.g: ਕਾਢਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਸਾਗਰ ਮਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੨੬॥
616.t: kaadd leh sa(n)saar saagar meh naanak prabh saranaiee ||4||15||26||
616.e: Please, lift me up out of the world-ocean; O God, I have come to Your Sanctuary. ||4||15||26||

616.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
616.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
616.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

616.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਹਾਈ ਕਥਾ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
616.t: paarabraham hoaa sahaiee kathaa keeratan sukhadhaiee ||
616.e: The Supreme Lord God has become my helper and friend; His sermon and the Kirtan of His Praises have brought me peace.

616.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਜਪਿ ਅਨਦੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਨਿਤ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ॥੧॥
616.t: gur poore kee baanee jap anadh karahu nit praanee ||1||
616.e: Chant the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani, and be ever in bliss, O mortal. ||1||

616.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
616.t: har saachaa simarahu bhaiee ||
616.e: Remember the True Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.

616.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਸਰਿ ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
616.t: saadhasa(n)g sadhaa sukh paieeaai har bisar na kabahoo jaiee || rahaau ||
616.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, eternal peace is obtained, and the Lord is never forgotten. ||Pause||

616.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਸੋ ਜੀਵੈ ॥
616.t: a(n)mirat naam paramesar teraa jo simarai so jeevai ||
616.e: Your Name, O Transcendent Lord, is Ambrosial Nectar; whoever meditates on it, lives.

616.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਥੀਵੈ ॥੨॥
616.t: jis no karam paraapat hovai so jan niramal theevai ||2||
616.e: One who is blessed with God's Grace - that humble servant becomes immaculate and pure. ||2||

616.g: ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਨ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
616.t: bighan binaasan sabh dhukh naasan gur charanee man laagaa ||
616.e: Obstacles are removed, and all pains are eliminated; my mind is attached to the Guru's feet.

616.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਤ ਅਚੁਤ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗਿ ਜਾਗਾ ॥੩॥
616.t: gun gaavat achut abinaasee anadhin har ra(n)g jaagaa ||3||
616.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of the immovable and imperishable Lord, one remains awake to the Lord's Love, day and night. ||3||

616.g: ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਸੇਈ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਹੇਲੀ ॥
616.t: man ichhe seiee fal paae har kee kathaa suhelee ||
616.e: He obtains the fruits of his mind's desires, listening to the comforting sermon of the Lord.

616.g: ਆਦਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਮਧਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਬੇਲੀ ॥੪॥੧੬॥੨੭॥
616.t: aadh a(n)t madh naanak kau so prabh hoaa belee ||4||16||27||
616.e: In the beginning, in the middle, and in the end, God is Nanak's best friend. ||4||16||27||

616.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਪੰਚਪਦਾ ॥
616.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa pa(n)chapadhaa ||
616.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla, Panch-Padhay:

616.g: ਬਿਨਸੈ ਮੋਹੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਧਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
616.t: binasai moh meraa ar teraa binasai apanee dhaaree ||1||
616.e: May my emotional attachment, my sense of mine and yours, and my self-conceit be dispelled. ||1||

616.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਇਹਾ ਬਤਾਵਹੁ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
616.t: sa(n)tahu ihaa bataavahu kaaree ||
616.e: O Saints, show me such a way,

616.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਰਬੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
616.t: jit haumai garab nivaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
616.e: by which my egotism and pride might be eliminated. ||1||Pause||

616.g: ਸਰਬ ਭੂਤ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਹੋਵਾਂ ਸਗਲ ਰੇਨਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
616.t: sarab bhoot paarabraham kar maaniaa hovaa(n) sagal renaaree ||2||
616.e: I see the Supreme Lord God in all beings, and I am the dust of all. ||2||

616.g: ਪੇਖਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਸੰਗੇ ਚੂਕੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
616.t: pekhio prabh jeeau apunai sa(n)ge chookai bheet bhramaaree ||3||
616.e: I see God always with me, and the wall of doubt has been shattered. ||3||

616.g: ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਜਲੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੁਆਰੀ ॥੪॥
616.t: aaukhadh naam niramal jal a(n)mrit paieeaai guroo dhuaaree ||4||
616.e: The medicine of the Naam, and the Immaculate Water of Ambrosial Nectar, are obtained through the Guru's Gate. ||4||

616.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੧੭॥੨੮॥
616.t: kahu naanak jis masatak likhiaa tis gur mil rog bidhaaree ||5||17||28||
616.e: Says Nanak, one who has such pre-ordained destiny inscribed upon his forehead, meets with the Guru, and his diseases are cured. ||5||17||28||

617.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਦੁਪਦੇ
617.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ghar doojaa dhupadhe
617.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla, Second House, Dho-Padhay:

617.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
617.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
617.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

617.g: ਸਗਲ ਬਨਸਪਤਿ ਮਹਿ ਬੈਸੰਤਰੁ ਸਗਲ ਦੂਧ ਮਹਿ ਘੀਆ ॥
617.t: sagal banasapat meh baisa(n)tar sagal dhoodh meh gheeaa ||
617.e: Fire is contained in all firewood, and butter is contained in all milk.

617.g: ਊਚ ਨੀਚ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਧਉ ਜੀਆ ॥੧॥
617.t: uooch neech meh jot samaanee ghaT ghaT maadhau jeeaa ||1||
617.e: God's Light is contained in the high and the low; the Lord is in the hearts of all beings. ||1||

617.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਹਿਓ ॥
617.t: sa(n)tahu ghaT ghaT rahiaa samaahio ||
617.e: O Saints, He is pervading and permeating each and every heart.

617.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਸਰਬ ਮਹਿ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਰਮਈਆ ਆਹਿਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
617.t: pooran poor rahio sarab meh jal thal ramieeaa aahio ||1|| rahaau ||
617.e: The Perfect Lord is completely permeating everyone, everywhere; He is diffused in the water and the land. ||1||Pause||

617.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਓ ॥
617.t: gun nidhaan naanak jas gaavai satigur bharam chukaio ||
617.e: Nanak sings the Praises of the Lord, the treasure of excellence; the True Guru has dispelled his doubt.

617.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਦਾ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੧॥੨੯॥
617.t: sarab nivaasee sadhaa alepaa sabh meh rahiaa samaio ||2||1||29||
617.e: The Lord is pervading everywhere, permeating all, and yet, He is unattached from all. ||2||1||29||

617.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
617.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
617.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

617.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਹੋਇ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਣ ਭੈ ਦੁਖੀ ॥
617.t: jaa kai simaran hoi ana(n)dhaa binasai janam maran bhai dhukhee ||
617.e: Meditating on Him, one is in ecstasy; the pains of birth and death and fear are removed.

617.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖੀ ॥੧॥
617.t: chaar padhaarath nav nidh paaveh bahur na tirasanaa bhukhee ||1||
617.e: The four cardinal blessings, and the nine treasures are received; you shall never feel hunger or thirst again. ||1||

617.g: ਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੈਤ ਤੂ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
617.t: jaa ko naam lait too sukhee ||
617.e: Chanting His Name, you shall be at peace.

617.g: ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਕਉ ਮਨ ਤਨ ਜੀਅਰੇ ਮੁਖੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
617.t: saas saas dhiaavahu Thaakur kau man tan jeeare mukhee ||1|| rahaau ||
617.e: With each and every breath, meditate on the Lord and Master, O my soul, with mind, body and mouth. ||1||Pause||

617.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਹੋਵਹਿ ਮਨ ਸੀਤਲ ਅਗਨਿ ਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਧੁਖੀ ॥
617.t: saa(n)t paaveh hoveh man seetal agan na a(n)tar dhukhee ||
617.e: You shall find peace, and your mind shall be soothed and cooled; the fire of desire shall not burn within you.

617.g: ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣਿ ਰੁਖੀ ॥੨॥੨॥੩੦॥
617.t: gur naanak kau prabhoo dhikhaiaa jal thal tirabhavan rukhee ||2||2||30||
617.e: The Guru has revealed God to Nanak, in the three worlds, in the water, the earth and the woods. ||2||2||30||

617.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
617.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
617.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

617.g: ਕਾਮ ਕ੍ਰੋਧ ਲੋਭ ਝੂਠ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਇਨ ਤੇ ਆਪਿ ਛਡਾਵਹੁ ॥
617.t: kaam karodh lobh jhooTh ni(n)dhaa in te aap chhaddaavahu ||
617.e: Sexual desire, anger, greed, falsehood and slander - please, save me from these, O Lord.

617.g: ਇਹ ਭੀਤਰ ਤੇ ਇਨ ਕਉ ਡਾਰਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਬੁਲਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥
617.t: eeh bheetar te in kau ddaarahu aapan nikaT bulaavahu ||1||
617.e: Please eradicate these from within me, and call me to come close to You. ||1||

617.g: ਅਪੁਨੀ ਬਿਧਿ ਆਪਿ ਜਨਾਵਹੁ ॥
617.t: apunee bidh aap janaavahu ||
617.e: You alone teach me Your Ways.

617.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਗਾਵਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
617.t: har jan ma(n)gal gaavahu ||1|| rahaau ||
617.e: With the Lord's humble servants, I sing His Praises. ||1||Pause||

617.g: ਬਿਸਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਬਹੂ ਹੀਏ ਤੇ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਪਾਵਹੁ ॥
617.t: bisar naahee kabahoo he'ee te ieh bidh man meh paavahu ||
617.e: May I never forget the Lord within my heart; please, instill such understanding within my mind.

617.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਤਹਿ ਨ ਧਾਵਹੁ ॥੨॥੩॥੩੧॥
617.t: gur pooraa bheTio vaddabhaagee jan naanak kateh na dhaavahu ||2||3||31||
617.e: By great good fortune, servant Nanak has met with the Perfect Guru, and now, he will not go anywhere else. ||2||3||31||

617.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
617.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
617.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

617.g: ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਣਿ ਸਭੁ ਕਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਘਾਲ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
617.t: jaa kai simaran sabh kachh paieeaai birathee ghaal na jaiee ||
617.e: Meditating in remembrance on Him, all things are obtained, and one's efforts shall not be in vain.

617.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਅਵਰ ਕਤ ਰਾਚਹੁ ਜੋ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
617.t: tis prabh tiaag avar kat raachahu jo sabh meh rahiaa samaiee ||1||
617.e: Forsaking God, why do you attach yourself to another? He is contained in everything. ||1||

617.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ॥
617.t: har har simarahu sa(n)t gopaalaa ||
617.e: O Saints, meditate in remembrance on the World-Lord, Har, Har.

617.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਵੈ ਘਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
617.t: saadhasa(n)g mil naam dhiaavahu pooran hovai ghaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
617.e: Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; your efforts shall be rewarded. ||1||Pause||

617.g: ਸਾਰਿ ਸਮਾਲੈ ਨਿਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲੈ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਸਹਿਤ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
617.t: saar samaalai nit pratipaalai prem sahit gal laavai ||
617.e: He ever preserves and cherishes His servant; with Love, He hugs him close.

617.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੁਮਰੇ ਬਿਸਰਤ ਜਗਤ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੪॥੩੨॥
617.t: kahu naanak prabh tumare bisarat jagat jeevan kaise paavai ||2||4||32||
617.e: Says Nanak, forgetting You, O God, how can the world find life? ||2||4||32||

617.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
617.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
617.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

617.g: ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਜੀਅਨ ਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਸਭ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਈ ॥
617.t: abinaasee jeean ko dhaataa simarat sabh mal khoiee ||
617.e: He is imperishable, the Giver of all beings; meditating on Him, all filth is removed.

617.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਭਗਤਨ ਕਉ ਬਰਤਨਿ ਬਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥
617.t: gun nidhaan bhagatan kau baratan biralaa paavai koiee ||1||
617.e: He is the treasure of excellence, the object of His devotees, but rare are those who find Him. ||1||

617.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸੋਈ ॥
617.t: mere man jap gur gopaal prabh soiee ||
617.e: O my mind, meditate on the Guru, and God, the Cherisher of the world.

617.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਪਇਆਂ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਦੂਖੁ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
617.t: jaa kee saran piaa(n) sukh paieeaai baahuR dhookh na hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
617.e: Seeking His Sanctuary, one finds peace, and he shall not suffer in pain again. ||1||Pause||

617.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਭੇਟਤ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥
617.t: vaddabhaagee saadhasa(n)g paraapat tin bheTat dhuramat khoiee ||
617.e: By great good fortune, one obtains the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. Meeting them, evil-mindedness is eliminated.

618.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ਬਾਛੈ ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਪਰੋਈ ॥੨॥੫॥੩੩॥
618.t: tin kee dhoor naanak dhaas baachhai jin har naam ridhai paroiee ||2||5||33||
618.e: Slave Nanak yearns for the dust of the feet of those, who have woven the Lord's Name into their hearts. ||2||5||33||

618.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
618.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
618.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

618.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੈ ਸੂਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਸਾਧਾਰੈ ॥
618.t: janam janam ke dhookh nivaarai sookaa man saadhaarai ||
618.e: He dispels the pains of countless incarnations, and lends support to the dry and shrivelled mind.

618.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਨਿਹਾਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੈ ॥੧॥
618.t: dharasan bheTat hot nihaalaa har kaa naam beechaarai ||1||
618.e: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, one is enraptured, contemplating the Name of the Lord. ||1||

618.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਬੈਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ॥
618.t: meraa baidh guroo govi(n)dhaa ||
618.e: My physician is the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

618.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਕਾਟੈ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫੰਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
618.t: har har naam aaukhadh mukh dhevai kaaTai jam kee fa(n)dhaa ||1|| rahaau ||
618.e: He places the medicine of the Naam into my mouth, and cuts away the noose of Death. ||1||Pause||

618.g: ਸਮਰਥ ਪੁਰਖ ਪੂਰਨ ਬਿਧਾਤੇ ਆਪੇ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
618.t: samarath purakh pooran bidhaate aape karanaihaaraa ||
618.e: He is the all-powerful, Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny; He Himself is the Doer of deeds.

618.g: ਅਪੁਨਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਆਪਿ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੩੪॥
618.t: apunaa dhaas har aap ubaariaa naanak naam adhaaraa ||2||6||34||
618.e: The Lord Himself saves His slave; Nanak takes the Support of the Naam. ||2||6||34||

618.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
618.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
618.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

618.g: ਅੰਤਰ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਪਾਹਿ ਨਿਬੇਰੋ ॥
618.t: a(n)tar kee gat tum hee jaanee tujh hee paeh nibero ||
618.e: Only You know the state of my innermost self; You alone can judge me.

618.g: ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਲਾਖ ਖਤੇ ਕਰਿ ਫੇਰੋ ॥੧॥
618.t: bakhas laih saahib prabh apane laakh khate kar fero ||1||
618.e: Please forgive me, O Lord God Master; I have committed thousands of sins and mistakes. ||1||

618.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਨੇਰੋ ॥
618.t: prabh jee too mero Thaakur nero ||
618.e: O my Dear Lord God Master, You are always near me.

618.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਸਰਣ ਮੋਹਿ ਚੇਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
618.t: har charan saran moh chero ||1|| rahaau ||
618.e: O Lord, please bless Your disciple with the shelter of Your feet. ||1||Pause||

618.g: ਬੇਸੁਮਾਰ ਬੇਅੰਤ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਊਚੋ ਗੁਨੀ ਗਹੇਰੋ ॥
618.t: besumaar bea(n)t suaamee uoocho gunee gahero ||
618.e: Infinite and endless is my Lord and Master; He is lofty, virtuous and profoundly deep.

618.g: ਕਾਟਿ ਸਿਲਕ ਕੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨੋ ਦਾਸਰੋ ਤਉ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਾ ਨਿਹੋਰੋ ॥੨॥੭॥੩੫॥
618.t: kaaT silak keeno apuno dhaasaro tau naanak kahaa nihoro ||2||7||35||
618.e: Cutting away the noose of death, the Lord has made Nanak His slave, and now, what does he owe to anyone else? ||2||7||35||

618.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
618.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
618.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

618.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਗੋਵਿੰਦਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਪਾਏ ॥
618.t: bhe kirapaal guroo govi(n)dhaa sagal manorath paae ||
618.e: The Guru, the Lord of the Universe, became merciful to me, and I obtained all of my mind's desires.

618.g: ਅਸਥਿਰ ਭਏ ਲਾਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥੧॥
618.t: asathir bhe laag har charanee govi(n)dh ke gun gaae ||1||
618.e: I have become stable and steady, touching the Lord's Feet, and singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe. ||1||

618.g: ਭਲੋ ਸਮੂਰਤੁ ਪੂਰਾ ॥
618.t: bhalo samoorat pooraa ||
618.e: It is a good time, a perfectly auspicious time.

618.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਵਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਦ ਤੂਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
618.t: saa(n)t sahaj aana(n)dh naam jap vaaje anahadh tooraa ||1|| rahaau ||
618.e: I am in celestial peace, tranquility and ecstasy, chanting the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the unstruck melody of the sound current vibrates and resounds. ||1||Pause||

618.g: ਮਿਲੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
618.t: mile suaamee preetam apune ghar ma(n)dhar sukhadhaiee ||
618.e: Meeting with my Beloved Lord and Master, my home has become a mansion filled with happiness.

618.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਗਲੀ ਇਛ ਪੁਜਾਈ ॥੨॥੮॥੩੬॥
618.t: har naam nidhaan naanak jan paiaa sagalee ichh pujaiee ||2||8||36||
618.e: Servant Nanak has attained the treasure of the Lord's Name; all his desires have been fulfilled. ||2||8||36||

618.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
618.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
618.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

618.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਬਸੇ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸੁਭ ਲਖਣ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
618.t: gur ke charan base ridh bheetar subh lakhan prabh keene ||
618.e: The Guru's feet abide within my heart; God has blessed me with good fortune.

618.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰ ਨਾਮ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮਨਿ ਚੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
618.t: bhe kirapaal pooran paramesar naam nidhaan man cheene ||1||
618.e: The Perfect Transcendent Lord became merciful to me, and I found the treasure of the Naam within my mind. ||1||

618.g: ਮੇਰੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਰੋ ਮੀਤ ॥
618.t: mero gur rakhavaaro meet ||
618.e: My Guru is my Saving Grace, my only best friend.

618.g: ਦੂਣ ਚਊਣੀ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਸੋਭਾ ਨੀਤਾ ਨੀਤ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
618.t: dhoon chuoonee dhe vaddiaaiee sobhaa neetaa neet ||1|| rahaau ||
618.e: Over and over again, He blesses me with double, even four-fold, greatness. ||1||Pause||

618.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਗਲ ਉਧਾਰੇ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖਣਹਾਰੇ ॥
618.t: jeea ja(n)t prabh sagal udhaare dharasan dhekhanahaare ||
618.e: God saves all beings and creatures, giving them the Blessed Vision of His Darshan.

618.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਅਚਰਜ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੯॥੩੭॥
618.t: gur poore kee acharaj vaddiaaiee naanak sadh balihaare ||2||9||37||
618.e: Wondrous is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru; Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||37||

618.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
618.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
618.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

618.g: ਸੰਚਨਿ ਕਰਉ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਥਾਤੀ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰ ॥
618.t: sa(n)chan karau naam dhan niramal thaatee agam apaar ||
618.e: I gather in and collect the immaculate wealth of the Naam; this commodity is inaccessible and incomparable.

618.g: ਬਿਲਛਿ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਆਨੰਦ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਣਹੁ ਖਾਇ ਜੀਵਹੁ ਸਿਖ ਪਰਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
618.t: bilachh binodh aana(n)dh sukh maanahu khai jeevahu sikh paravaar ||1||
618.e: Revel in it, delight in it, be happy and enjoy peace, and live long, O Sikhs and brethren. ||1||

618.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਆਧਾਰ ॥
618.t: har ke charan kamal aadhaar ||
618.e: I have the support of the Lotus Feet of the Lord.

618.g: ਸੰਤ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਪਾਇਓ ਸਚ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਚੜਿ ਲੰਘਉ ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਸਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
618.t: sa(n)t prasaadh paio sach bohith chaR la(n)ghau bikh sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
618.e: By the Grace of the Saints, I have found the boat of Truth; embarking on it, I sail across the ocean of poison. ||1||Pause||

618.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਆਪਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਸਾਰ ॥
618.t: bhe kirapaal pooran abinaasee aapeh keenee saar ||
618.e: The perfect, imperishable Lord has become merciful; He Himself has taken care of me.

618.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਗਸਾਨੋ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਹੀ ਸੁਮਾਰ ॥੨॥੧੦॥੩੮॥
618.t: pekh pekh naanak bigasaano naanak naahee sumaar ||2||10||38||
618.e: Beholding, beholding His Vision, Nanak has blossomed forth in ecstasy. O Nanak, He is beyond estimation. ||2||10||38||

618.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
618.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
618.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

618.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪਨੀ ਕਲ ਧਾਰੀ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਉਪਜੀ ਦਇਆ ॥
618.t: gur poorai apanee kal dhaaree sabh ghaT upajee dhiaa ||
618.e: The Perfect Guru has revealed His power, and compassion has welled up in every heart.

618.g: ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਵਡਾਈ ਕੀਨੀ ਕੁਸਲ ਖੇਮ ਸਭ ਭਇਆ ॥੧॥
618.t: aape mel vaddaiee keenee kusal khem sabh bhiaa ||1||
618.e: Blending me with Himself, He has blessed me with glorious greatness, and I have found pleasure and happiness. ||1||

618.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਮੇਰੈ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
618.t: satigur pooraa merai naal ||
618.e: The Perfect True Guru is always with me.

619.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਹਾਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
619.t: paarabraham jap sadhaa nihaal || rahaau ||
619.e: Meditating on the Supreme Lord God, I am forever in ecstasy. ||Pause||

619.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਥਾਨ ਥਨੰਤਰਿ ਜਤ ਕਤ ਪੇਖਉ ਸੋਈ ॥
619.t: a(n)tar baahar thaan thana(n)tar jat kat pekhau soiee ||
619.e: Inwardly and outwardly, in all places and interspaces, wherever I look, He is there.

619.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਓ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਤਿਸੁ ਜੇਵਡੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੨॥੧੧॥੩੯॥
619.t: naanak gur paio vaddabhaagee tis jevadd avar na koiee ||2||11||39||
619.e: Nanak has found the Guru, by great good fortune; no one else is as great as He. ||2||11||39||

619.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
619.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
619.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

619.g: ਸੂਖ ਮੰਗਲ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਨਿਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
619.t: sookh ma(n)gal kaliaan sahaj dhun prabh ke charan nihaariaa ||
619.e: I have been blessed with peace, pleasure, bliss, and the celestial sound current, gazing upon the feet of God.

619.g: ਰਾਖਨਹਾਰੈ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਬਾਰਿਕੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
619.t: raakhanahaarai raakhio baarik satigur taap utaariaa ||1||
619.e: The Savior has saved His child, and the True Guru has cured his fever. ||1||

619.g: ਉਬਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ॥
619.t: aubare satigur kee saranaiee ||
619.e: I have been saved, in the True Guru's Sanctuary;

619.g: ਜਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
619.t: jaa kee sev na birathee jaiee || rahaau ||
619.e: service to Him does not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

619.g: ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਖ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਸੂਖਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
619.t: ghar meh sookh baahar fun sookhaa prabh apune bhe dhiaalaa ||
619.e: There is peace within the home of one's heart, and there is peace outside as well, when God becomes kind and compassionate.

619.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਕੋਊ ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹੋਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੨॥੪੦॥
619.t: naanak bighan na laagai kouoo meraa prabh hoaa kirapaalaa ||2||12||40||
619.e: O Nanak, no obstacles block my way; my God has become gracious and merciful to me. ||2||12||40||

619.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
619.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
619.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

619.g: ਸਾਧੂ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਇਆ ਮਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਈ ॥
619.t: saadhoo sa(n)g bhiaa man udham naam ratan jas gaiee ||
619.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, my mind became excited, and I sang the Praises of the jewel of the Naam.

619.g: ਮਿਟਿ ਗਈ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਅਨੰਤਾ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਤਰਿਆ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
619.t: miT giee chi(n)taa simar ana(n)taa saagar tariaa bhaiee ||1||
619.e: My anxiety was dispelled, meditating in remembrance on the Infinite Lord; I have crossed over the world ocean, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

619.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
619.t: hiradhai har ke charan vasaiee ||
619.e: I enshrine the Lord's Feet within my heart.

619.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜ ਧੁਨਿ ਉਪਜੀ ਰੋਗਾ ਘਾਣਿ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
619.t: sukh paiaa sahaj dhun upajee rogaa ghaan miTaiee || rahaau ||
619.e: I have found peace, and the celestial sound current resounds within me; countless diseases have been eradicated. ||Pause||

619.g: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣਾ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
619.t: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanaa keemat kahan na jaiee ||
619.e: Which of Your Glorious Virtues can I speak and describe? Your worth cannot be estimated.

619.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਭਏ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਭਇਆ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥੧੩॥੪੧॥
619.t: naanak bhagat bhe abinaasee apunaa prabh bhiaa sahaiee ||2||13||41||
619.e: O Nanak, the Lord's devotees become imperishable and immortal; their God becomes their friend and support. ||2||13||41||

619.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
619.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
619.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

619.g: ਗਏ ਕਲੇਸ ਰੋਗ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਸੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪੁਨੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
619.t: ge kales rog sabh naase prabh apunai kirapaa dhaaree ||
619.e: My sufferings have come to an end, and all diseases have been eradicated.

619.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਘਾਲ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
619.t: aaTh pahar aaraadhahu suaamee pooran ghaal hamaaree ||1||
619.e: God has showered me with His Grace. Twenty-four hours a day, I worship and adore my Lord and Master; my efforts have come to fruition. ||1||

619.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੂ ਸੁਖ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਰਾਸਿ ॥
619.t: har jeeau too sukh sa(n)pat raas ||
619.e: O Dear Lord, You are my peace, wealth and capital.

619.g: ਰਾਖਿ ਲੈਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਰੇ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਆਗੈ ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
619.t: raakh laih bhaiee mere kau prabh aagai aradhaas || rahaau ||
619.e: Please, save me, O my Beloved! I offer this prayer to my God. ||Pause||

619.g: ਜੋ ਮਾਗਉ ਸੋਈ ਸੋਈ ਪਾਵਉ ਅਪਨੇ ਖਸਮ ਭਰੋਸਾ ॥
619.t: jo maagau soiee soiee paavau apane khasam bharosaa ||
619.e: Whatever I ask for, I receive; I have total faith in my Master.

619.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਮਿਟਿਓ ਸਗਲ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੪॥੪੨॥
619.t: kahu naanak gur pooraa bheTio miTio sagal a(n)dhesaa ||2||14||42||
619.e: Says Nanak, I have met with the Perfect Guru, and all my fears have been dispelled. ||2||14||42||

619.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
619.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
619.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

619.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਸਗਲਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥
619.t: simar simar gur satigur apanaa sagalaa dhookh miTaiaa ||
619.e: Meditating, meditating in remembrance on my Guru, the True Guru, all pains have been eradicated.

619.g: ਤਾਪ ਰੋਗ ਗਏ ਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ਮਨ ਇਛੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
619.t: taap rog ge gur bachanee man ichhe fal paiaa ||1||
619.e: The fever and the disease are gone, through the Word of the Guru's Teachings, and I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires. ||1||

619.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ॥
619.t: meraa gur pooraa sukhadhaataa ||
619.e: My Perfect Guru is the Giver of peace.

619.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
619.t: karan kaaran samarath suaamee pooran purakh bidhaataa || rahaau ||
619.e: He is the Doer, the Cause of causes, the Almighty Lord and Master, the Perfect Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny. ||Pause||

619.g: ਅਨੰਦ ਬਿਨੋਦ ਮੰਗਲ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ॥
619.t: ana(n)dh binodh ma(n)gal gun gaavahu gur naanak bhe dhiaalaa ||
619.e: Sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord in bliss, joy and ecstasy; Guru Nanak has become kind and compassionate.

619.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰ ਭਏ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੋਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ॥੨॥੧੫॥੪੩॥
619.t: jai jai kaar bhe jag bheetar hoaa paarabraham rakhavaalaa ||2||15||43||
619.e: Shouts of cheers and congratulations ring out all over the world; the Supreme Lord God has become my Savior and Protector. ||2||15||43||

619.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
619.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
619.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

619.g: ਹਮਰੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣੀਆ ਕਾਈ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਣਿ ॥
619.t: hamaree ganat na ganeeaa kaiee apanaa biradh pachhaan ||
619.e: He did not take my accounts into account; such is His forgiving nature.

619.g: ਹਾਥ ਦੇਇ ਰਾਖੇ ਕਰਿ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਮਾਣਿ ॥੧॥
619.t: haath dhei raakhe kar apune sadhaa sadhaa ra(n)g maan ||1||
619.e: He gave me His hand, and saved me and made me His own; forever and ever, I enjoy His Love. ||1||

619.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਦ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਣ ॥
619.t: saachaa saahib sadh miharavaan ||
619.e: The True Lord and Master is forever merciful and forgiving.

619.g: ਬੰਧੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹੋਈ ਸਰਬ ਕਲਿਆਣ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
619.t: ba(n)dh paiaa merai satigur poorai hoiee sarab kaliaan || rahaau ||
619.e: My Perfect Guru has bound me to Him, and now, I am in absolute ecstasy. ||Pause||

619.g: ਜੀਉ ਪਾਇ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਾਜਿਆ ਦਿਤਾ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ॥
619.t: jeeau pai pi(n)dd jin saajiaa dhitaa painan khaan ||
619.e: The One who fashioned the body and placed the soul within, who gives you clothing and nourishment

619.g: ਅਪਣੇ ਦਾਸ ਕੀ ਆਪਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥੨॥੧੬॥੪੪॥
619.t: apane dhaas kee aap paij raakhee naanak sadh kurabaan ||2||16||44||
619.e: - He Himself preserves the honor of His slaves. Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||16||44||

620.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
620.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
620.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

620.g: ਦੁਰਤੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪੇ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਉਬਾਰਿਆ ॥
620.t: dhurat gavaiaa har prabh aape sabh sa(n)saar ubaariaa ||
620.e: The Lord God Himself has rid the whole world of its sins, and saved it.

620.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ਅਪਣਾ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਸਮਾਰਿਆ ॥੧॥
620.t: paarabraham prabh kirapaa dhaaree apanaa biradh samaariaa ||1||
620.e: The Supreme Lord God extended His mercy, and confirmed His innate nature. ||1||

620.g: ਹੋਈ ਰਾਜੇ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਰਖਵਾਲੀ ॥
620.t: hoiee raaje raam kee rakhavaalee ||
620.e: I have attained the Protective Sanctuary of the Lord, my King.

620.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨਦ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਸੁਖਾਲੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
620.t: sookh sahaj aanadh gun gaavahu man tan dheh sukhaalee || rahaau ||
620.e: In celestial peace and ecstasy, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and my mind, body and being are at peace. ||Pause||

620.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਉਧਾਰਣੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਮੋਹਿ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਭਰਵਾਸਾ ॥
620.t: patit udhaaran satigur meraa moh tis kaa bharavaasaa ||
620.e: My True Guru is the Savior of sinners; I have placed my trust and faith in Him.

620.g: ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਸਭਿ ਸਚੈ ਸਾਹਿਬਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸਾ ॥੨॥੧੭॥੪੫॥
620.t: bakhas le sabh sachai saahib sun naanak kee aradhaasaa ||2||17||45||
620.e: The True Lord has heard Nanak's prayer, and He has forgiven everything. ||2||17||45||

620.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
620.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
620.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

620.g: ਬਖਸਿਆ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਰੋਗ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥
620.t: bakhasiaa paarabraham paramesar sagale rog bidhaare ||
620.e: The Supreme Lord God, the Transcendent Lord, has forgiven me, and all diseases have been cured.

620.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਉਬਰੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
620.t: gur poore kee saranee ubare kaaraj sagal savaare ||1||
620.e: Those who come to the Sanctuary of the True Guru are saved, and all their affairs are resolved. ||1||

620.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਨਿ ਸਿਮਰਿਆ ਨਾਮ ਅਧਾਰਿ ॥
620.t: har jan simariaa naam adhaar ||
620.e: The Lord's humble servant meditates in remembrance on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; this is his only support.

620.g: ਤਾਪੁ ਉਤਾਰਿਆ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
620.t: taap utaariaa satigur poorai apanee kirapaa dhaar || rahaau ||
620.e: The Perfect True Guru extended His Mercy, and the fever has been dispelled. ||Pause||

620.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦ ਕਰਹ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਗੁਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਆ ॥
620.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh kareh mere piaare har govidh gur raakhiaa ||
620.e: So celebrate and be happy, my beloveds - the Guru has saved Hargobind.

620.g: ਵਡੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਰਤੇ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਤਿ ਭਾਖਿਆ ॥੨॥੧੮॥੪੬॥
620.t: vaddee vaddiaaiee naanak karate kee saach sabadh sat bhaakhiaa ||2||18||46||
620.e: Great is the glorious greatness of the Creator, O Nanak; True is the Word of His Shabad, and True is the sermon of His Teachings. ||2||18||46||

620.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
620.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
620.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

620.g: ਭਏ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
620.t: bhe kirapaal suaamee mere tit saachai dharabaar ||
620.e: My Lord and Master has become Merciful, in His True Court.

620.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਠਾਂਢਿ ਪਈ ਸੰਸਾਰਿ ॥
620.t: satigur taap gavaiaa bhaiee Thaa(n)dd piee sa(n)saar ||
620.e: The True Guru has taken away the fever, and the whole world is at peace, O Siblings of Destiny.

620.g: ਅਪਣੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੇ ਜਮਹਿ ਕੀਓ ਹਟਤਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
620.t: apane jeea ja(n)t aape raakhe jameh keeo haTataar ||1||
620.e: The Lord Himself protects His beings and creatures, and the Messenger of Death is out of work. ||1||

620.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
620.t: har ke charan ridhai ur dhaar ||
620.e: Enshrine the Lord's feet within your heart.

620.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਿਮਰੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਦੁਖ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
620.t: sadhaa sadhaa prabh simareeaai bhaiee dhukh kilabikh kaaTanahaar ||1|| rahaau ||
620.e: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on God, O Siblings of Destiny. He is the Eradicator of suffering and sins. ||1||Pause||

620.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸਰਣੀ ਊਬਰੈ ਭਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਰਚਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥
620.t: tis kee saranee uoobarai bhaiee jin rachiaa sabh koi ||
620.e: He fashioned all beings, O Siblings of Destiny, and His Sanctuary saves them.

620.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸੋ ਭਾਈ ਸਚੈ ਸਚੀ ਸੋਇ ॥
620.t: karan kaaran samarath so bhaiee sachai sachee soi ||
620.e: He is the Almighty Creator, the Cause of causes, O Siblings of Destiny; He, the True Lord, is True.

620.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥੧੯॥੪੭॥
620.t: naanak prabhoo dhiaaieeaai bhaiee man tan seetal hoi ||2||19||47||
620.e: Nanak: meditate on God, O Siblings of Destiny, and your mind and body shall be cool and calm. ||2||19||47||

620.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
620.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
620.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

620.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
620.t: sa(n)tahu har har naam dhiaaiee ||
620.e: O Saints, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

620.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਵਿਸਰਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਅੜਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
620.t: sukh saagar prabh visarau naahee man chi(n)dhiaRaa fal paiee ||1|| rahaau ||
620.e: Never forget God, the ocean of peace; thus you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||1||Pause||

620.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਤਾਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
620.t: satigur poorai taap gavaiaa apanee kirapaa dhaaree ||
620.e: Extending His Mercy, the Perfect True Guru has dispelled the fever.

620.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਸਭ ਪਰਵਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
620.t: paarabraham prabh bhe dhiaalaa dhukh miTiaa sabh paravaaree ||1||
620.e: The Supreme Lord God has become kind and compassionate, and my whole family is now free of pain and suffering. ||1||

620.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਮੰਗਲ ਰਸ ਰੂਪਾ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੋ ॥
620.t: sarab nidhaan ma(n)gal ras roopaa har kaa naam adhaaro ||
620.e: The Treasure of absolute joy, sublime elixir and beauty, the Name of the Lord is my only Support.

620.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੀ ਪਰਮੇਸਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਆ ਸਭੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੋ ॥੨॥੨੦॥੪੮॥
620.t: naanak pat raakhee paramesar udhariaa sabh sa(n)saaro ||2||20||48||
620.e: O Nanak, the Transcendent Lord has preserved my honor, and saved the whole world. ||2||20||48||

620.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
620.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
620.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

620.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਰਖਵਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ॥
620.t: meraa satigur rakhavaalaa hoaa ||
620.e: My True Guru is my Savior and Protector.

620.g: ਧਾਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਾਥ ਦੇ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੋਵਿਦੁ ਨਵਾ ਨਿਰੋਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
620.t: dhaar kirapaa prabh haath dhe raakhiaa har govidh navaa niroaa ||1|| rahaau ||
620.e: Showering us with His Mercy and Grace, God extended His Hand, and saved Hargobind, who is now safe and secure. ||1||Pause||

620.g: ਤਾਪੁ ਗਇਆ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
620.t: taap giaa prabh aap miTaiaa jan kee laaj rakhaiee ||
620.e: The fever is gone - God Himself eradicated it, and preserved the honor of His servant.

620.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੇ ਸਭ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਂਈ ॥੧॥
620.t: saadhasa(n)gat te sabh fal paae satigur kai bal jaa(n)iee ||1||
620.e: I have obtained all blessings from the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; I am a sacrifice to the True Guru. ||1||

620.g: ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੋਵੈ ਸਵਾਰੇ ਹਮਰਾ ਗੁਣੁ ਅਵਗੁਣੁ ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਆ ॥
620.t: halat palat prabh dhovai savaare hamaraa gun avagun na beechaariaa ||
620.e: God has saved me, both here and hereafter. He has not taken my merits and demerits into account.

621.g: ਅਟਲ ਬਚਨੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇਰਾ ਸਫਲ ਕਰੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਧਾਰਿਆ ॥੨॥੨੧॥੪੯॥
621.t: aTal bachan naanak gur teraa safal kar masatak dhaariaa ||2||21||49||
621.e: Your Word is eternal, O Guru Nanak; You placed Your Hand of blessing upon my forehead. ||2||21||49||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

621.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ੍ਰ ਸਭਿ ਤਿਸ ਕੇ ਕੀਏ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤ ਸਹਾਈ ॥
621.t: jeea ja(n)tr sabh tis ke ke'ee soiee sa(n)t sahaiee ||
621.e: All beings and creatures were created by Him; He alone is the support and friend of the Saints.

621.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਕੀ ਆਪੇ ਰਾਖੈ ਪੂਰਨ ਭਈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
621.t: apune sevak kee aape raakhai pooran bhiee baddaiee ||1||
621.e: He Himself preserves the honor of His servants; their glorious greatness becomes perfect. ||1||
The Perfect Supreme Lord God is always with me.

621.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪੂਰੀ ਸਭ ਰਾਖੀ ਹੋਏ ਸਰਬ ਦਇਆਲ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
621.t: gur poorai pooree sabh raakhee hoe sarab dhiaal ||1|| rahaau ||
621.e: The Perfect Guru has perfectly and totally protected me, and now everyone is kind and compassionate to me. ||1||Pause||

621.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
621.t: anadhin naanak naam dhiaae jeea praan kaa dhaataa ||
621.e: Night and day, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; He is the Giver of the soul, and the breath of life itself.

621.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਰਿਕ ਪਿਤ ਮਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੨੨॥੫੦॥
621.t: apune dhaas kau ka(n)Th lai raakhai jiau baarik pit maataa ||2||22||50||
621.e: He hugs His slave close in His loving embrace, like the mother and father hug their child. ||2||22||50||

621.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa chaupadhe
621.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla, Third House, Chau-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Meeting with the council, my doubts were not dispelled.
The chiefs did not give me satisfaction.
I presented my dispute to the noblemen as well.
But it was only settled by meeting with the King, my Lord. ||1||
Now, I do not go searching anywhere else,
because I have met the Guru, the Lord of the Universe. ||Pause||
When I came to God's Darbaar, His Holy Court,
then all of my cries and complaints were settled.
Now that I have attained what I had sought,
where should I come and where should I go? ||2||
There, true justice is administered.
There, the Lord Master and His disciple are one and the same.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows.
Without our speaking, He understands. ||3||
He is the King of all places.
There, the unstruck melody of the Shabad resounds.
Of what use is cleverness when dealing with Him?
Meeting with Him, O Nanak, one loses his self-conceit. ||4||1||51||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
Enshrine the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within your heart;
sitting within your own home, meditate on the Guru.
The Perfect Guru has spoken the Truth;
the True Peace is obtained only from the Lord. ||1||
My Guru has become merciful.

621.g: ਅਨਦ ਸੂਖ ਕਲਿਆਣ ਮੰਗਲ ਸਿਉ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਕਰਿ ਇਸਨਾਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
621.t: anadh sookh kaliaan ma(n)gal siau ghar aae kar isanaanaa || rahaau ||
621.e: In bliss, peace, pleasure and joy, I have returned to my own home, after my purifying bath. ||Pause||
True is the glorious greatness of the Guru;

621.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
621.t: taa kee keemat kahan na jaiee ||
621.e: His worth cannot be described.
He is the Supreme Overlord of kings.
Meeting with the Guru, the mind is enraptured. ||2||
All sins are washed away,
meeting with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
The Lord's Name is the treasure of excellence;
chanting it, one's affairs are perfectly resolved. ||3||
The Guru has opened the door of liberation,
and the entire world applauds Him with cheers of victory.
O Nanak, God is always with me;
my fears of birth and death are gone. ||4||2||52||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Perfect Guru has granted His Grace,
and God has fulfilled my desire.
After taking my bath of purification, I returned to my home,
and I found bliss, happiness and peace. ||1||
O Saints, salvation comes from the Lord's Name.

621.g: ਊਠਤ ਬੈਠਤ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਕਰੀਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
621.t: uooThat baiThat har har dhiaaieeaai anadhin sukirat kareeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
621.e: While standing up and sitting down, meditate on the Lord's Name. Night and day, do good deeds. ||1||Pause||

622.g: ਸੰਤ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਪਉੜੀ ਕੋ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਪਾਏ ॥
622.t: sa(n)t kaa maarag dharam kee pauRee ko vaddabhaagee paae ||
622.e: The way of the Saints is the ladder of righteous living, found only by great good fortune.

622.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਨਾਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
622.t: koT janam ke kilabikh naase har charanee chit laae ||2||
622.e: The sins of millions of incarnations are washed away, by focusing your consciousness on the Lord's feet. ||2||

622.g: ਉਸਤਤਿ ਕਰਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰੀ ਕਲ ਰਾਖੀ ॥
622.t: ausatat karahu sadhaa prabh apane jin pooree kal raakhee ||
622.e: So sing the Praises of your God forever; His almighty power is perfect.

622.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਭਏ ਪਵਿਤ੍ਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਚੁ ਸਾਖੀ ॥੩॥
622.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh bhe pavitraa satigur kee sach saakhee ||3||
622.e: All beings and creatures are purified, listening to the True Teachings of the True Guru. ||3||

622.g: ਬਿਘਨ ਬਿਨਾਸਨ ਸਭਿ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ॥
622.t: bighan binaasan sabh dhukh naasan satigur naam dhiraRaiaa ||
622.e: The True Guru has implanted the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within me; it is the Eliminator of obstructions, the Destroyer of all pains.

622.g: ਖੋਏ ਪਾਪ ਭਏ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਵਨ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਇਆ ॥੪॥੩॥੫੩॥
622.t: khoe paap bhe sabh paavan jan naanak sukh ghar aaiaa ||4||3||53||
622.e: All of my sins were erased, and I have been purified; servant Nanak has returned to his home of peace. ||4||3||53||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
O Lord Master, You are the ocean of excellence.
My home and all my possessions are Yours.
The Guru, the Lord of the world, is my Savior.
All beings have become kind and compassionate to me. ||1||
Meditating on the Guru's feet, I am in bliss.

622.g: ਭਉ ਕਤਹਿ ਨਹੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਰਣਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
622.t: bhau kateh nahee prabh saranaa || rahaau ||
622.e: There is no fear at all, in God's Sanctuary. ||Pause||
You dwell in the hearts of Your slaves, Lord.
God has laid the eternal foundation.
You are my strength, wealth and support.
You are my Almighty Lord and Master. ||2||
Whoever finds the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy,
is saved by God Himself.
By His Grace, He has blessed me with the sublime essence of the Naam.
All joy and pleasure then came to me. ||3||
God became my helper and my best friend;
everyone rises up and bows down at my feet.
With each and every breath, meditate on God;
O Nanak, sing the songs of joy to the Lord. ||4||4||54||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
Celestial peace and bliss have come,
meeting God, who is so pleasing to my mind.
The Perfect Guru showered me with His Mercy,
and I attained salvation. ||1||

622.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਨਾ ॥
622.t: har kee prem bhagat man leenaa ||
622.e: My mind is absorbed in loving devotional worship of the Lord,
and the unstruck melody of the celestial sound current ever resounds within me. ||Pause||
The Lord's feet are my all-powerful shelter and support;
my dependence on other people is totally finished.
I have found the Life of the world, the Great Giver;
in joyful rapture, I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||
God has cut away the noose of death.
My mind's desires have been fulfilled;
wherever I look, He is there.

622.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥੩॥
622.t: har prabh bin avar na koiee ||3||
622.e: Without the Lord God, there is no other at all. ||3||
In His Mercy, God has protected and preserved me.
I am rid of all the pains of countless incarnations.
I have meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Fearless Lord;
O Nanak, I have found eternal peace. ||4||5||55||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Creator has brought utter peace to my home;
the fever has left my family.
The Perfect Guru has saved us.
I sought the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||1||
The Transcendent Lord Himself has become my Protector.

622.g: ਸਾਂਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਉਪਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਆ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
622.t: saa(n)t sahaj sukh khin meh upaje man hoaa sadhaa sukhaalaa || rahaau ||
622.e: Tranquility, intuitive peace and poise welled up in an instant, and my mind was comforted forever. ||Pause||
The Lord, Har, Har, gave me the medicine of His Name,
which has cured all disease.
He extended His Mercy to me,
and resolved all these affairs. ||2||
God confirmed His loving nature;
He did not take my merits or demerits into account.
The Word of the Guru's Shabad has become manifest,

623.e: and through it, my honor was totally preserved. ||3||
I speak as You cause me to speak;
O Lord and Master, You are the ocean of excellence.
Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, according to the Teachings of Truth.
God preserves the honor of His slaves. ||4||6||56||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Creator Lord Himself stood between us,
and not a hair upon my head was touched.
The Guru made my cleansing bath successful;
meditating on the Lord, Har, Har, my sins were erased. ||1||
O Saints, the purifying pool of Ram Das is sublime.

623.g: ਜੋ ਨਾਵੈ ਸੋ ਕੁਲੁ ਤਰਾਵੈ ਉਧਾਰੁ ਹੋਆ ਹੈ ਜੀ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
623.t: jo naavai so kul taraavai udhaar hoaa hai jee kaa ||1|| rahaau ||
623.e: Whoever bathes in it, his family and ancestry are saved, and his soul is saved as well. ||1||Pause||
The world sings cheers of victory,
and the fruits of his mind's desires are obtained.

623.g: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਨਾਇ ਆਏ ॥ ਅਪਣਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੨॥
623.t: sahee salaamat nai aae || apanaa prabhoo dhiaae ||2||
623.e: Whoever comes and bathes here, and meditates on his God, is safe and sound. ||2||
One who bathes in the healing pool of the Saints,
that humble being obtains the supreme status.
He does not die, or come and go in reincarnation;
he meditates on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||3||
He alone knows this about God,
whom God blesses with His kindness.
Baba Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of God;
all his worries and anxieties are dispelled. ||4||7||57||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Supreme Lord God has stood by me and fulfilled me,
and nothing is left unfinished.
Attached to the Guru's feet, I am saved;
I contemplate and cherish the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||1||
He is forever the Savior of His slaves.

623.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਰਾਖੇ ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
623.t: kar kirapaa apune kar raakhe maat pitaa jiau paalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
623.e: Bestowing His Mercy, He made me His own and preserved me; like a mother or father, He cherishes me. ||1||Pause||
By great good fortune, I found the True Guru,
who obliterated the path of the Messenger of Death.
My consciousness is focused on loving, devotional worship of the Lord.
One who lives in this meditation is very fortunate indeed. ||2||
He sings the Ambrosial Word of the Guru's Bani,
and bathes in the dust of the feet of the Holy.
He Himself bestows His Name.
God, the Creator, saves us. ||3||
The Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan is the support of the breath of life.
This is the perfect, pure wisdom.
The Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, has granted His Mercy;
slave Nanak seeks the Sanctuary of his Lord and Master. ||4||8||58||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Perfect Guru has attached me to His feet.
I have obtained the Lord as my companion, my support, my best friend.
