Wherever I go, I am happy there.
By His Kind Mercy, God united me with Himself. ||1||
So sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord with loving devotion.

623.g: ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਫਲ ਪਾਵਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
623.t: man chi(n)dhe sagale fal paavahu jeea kai sa(n)g sahaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
623.e: You shall obtain all the fruits of your mind's desires, and the Lord shall become the companion and the support of your soul. ||1||Pause||
The Lord is the support of the breath of life.
I am the dust of the feet of the Holy people.
I am a sinner, but the Lord made me pure.
By His Kind Mercy, the Lord blessed me with His Praises. ||2||
The Supreme Lord God cherishes and nurtures me.
He is always with me, the Protector of my soul.
Singing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises day and night,
I shall not be consigned to reincarnation again. ||3||
One who is blessed by the Primal Lord, the Architect of Destiny,
realizes the subtle essence of the Lord.
The Messenger of Death does not come near him.
In the Lord's Sanctuary, Nanak has found peace. ||4||9||59||

624.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Perfect Guru has made me perfect.
God is totally pervading and permeating everywhere.
With joy and pleasure, I take my purifying bath.
I am a sacrifice to the Supreme Lord God. ||1||

624.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਕਵਲ ਰਿਦ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
624.t: gur ke charan kaval ridh dhaare ||
624.e: I enshrine the lotus feet of the Guru within my heart.

624.g: ਬਿਘਨੁ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਤਿਲ ਕਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
624.t: bighan na laagai til kaa koiee kaaraj sagal savaare ||1|| rahaau ||
624.e: Not even the tiniest obstacle blocks my way; all my affairs are resolved. ||1||Pause||
Meeting with the Holy Saints, my evil-mindedness was eradicated.
All the sinners are purified.
Bathing in the sacred pool of Guru Ram Das,
all the sins one has committed are washed away. ||2||
So sing forever the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe;
joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, meditate on Him.
The fruits of your mind's desires are obtained
by meditating on the Perfect Guru within your heart. ||3||
The Guru, the Lord of the World, is blissful;
chanting, meditating on the Lord of supreme bliss, He lives.
Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
God has confirmed His innate nature. ||4||10||60||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

624.g: ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਛਤ੍ਰ ਮੇਘ ਘਟਾ ਘਟ ਦਾਮਨਿ ਚਮਕਿ ਡਰਾਇਓ ॥
624.t: dheh dhis chhatr megh ghaTaa ghaT dhaaman chamak ddaraio ||
624.e: In the ten directions, the clouds cover the sky like a canopy; through the dark clouds, lightning flashes, and I am terrified.

624.g: ਸੇਜ ਇਕੇਲੀ ਨੀਦ ਨਹੁ ਨੈਨਹ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਰਦੇਸਿ ਸਿਧਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
624.t: sej ikelee needh nahu naineh pir paradhes sidhaio ||1||
624.e: By bed is empty, and my eyes are sleepless; my Husband Lord has gone far away. ||1||
Now, I receive no messages from Him, O mother!

624.g: ਏਕ ਕੋਸਰੋ ਸਿਧਿ ਕਰਤ ਲਾਲੁ ਤਬ ਚਤੁਰ ਪਾਤਰੋ ਆਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
624.t: ek kosaro sidh karat laal tab chatur paataro aaio || rahaau ||
624.e: When my Beloved used to go even a mile away, He would send me four letters. ||Pause||

624.g: ਕਿਉ ਬਿਸਰੈ ਇਹੁ ਲਾਲੁ ਪਿਆਰੋ ਸਰਬ ਗੁਣਾ ਸੁਖਦਾਇਓ ॥
624.t: kiau bisarai ih laal piaaro sarab gunaa sukhadhaio ||
624.e: How could I forget this Dear Beloved of mine? He is the Giver of peace, and all virtues.

624.g: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਚਰਿ ਕੈ ਪੰਥੁ ਨਿਹਾਰਉ ਨੈਨ ਨੀਰਿ ਭਰਿ ਆਇਓ ॥੨॥
624.t: ma(n)dhar char kai pa(n)th nihaarau nain neer bhar aaio ||2||
624.e: Ascending to His Mansion, I gaze upon His path, and my eyes are filled with tears. ||2||

624.g: ਹਉ ਹਉ ਭੀਤਿ ਭਇਓ ਹੈ ਬੀਚੋ ਸੁਨਤ ਦੇਸਿ ਨਿਕਟਾਇਓ ॥
624.t: hau hau bheet bhio hai beecho sunat dhes nikaTaio ||
624.e: The wall of egotism and pride separates us, but I can hear Him nearby.

624.g: ਭਾਂਭੀਰੀ ਕੇ ਪਾਤ ਪਰਦੋ ਬਿਨੁ ਪੇਖੇ ਦੂਰਾਇਓ ॥੩॥
624.t: bhaa(n)bheeree ke paat paradho bin pekhe dhooraio ||3||
624.e: There is a veil between us, like the wings of a butterfly; without being able to see Him, He seems so far away. ||3||

624.g: ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਸਰਬ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਗਰੋ ਦੂਖੁ ਮਿਟਾਇਓ ॥
624.t: bhio kirapaal sarab ko Thaakur sagaro dhookh miTaio ||
624.e: The Lord and Master of all has become merciful; He has dispelled all my sufferings.

624.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉਮੈ ਭੀਤਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਖੋਈ ਤਉ ਦਇਆਰੁ ਬੀਠਲੋ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੪॥
624.t: kahu naanak haumai bheet gur khoiee tau dhiaar beeThalo paio ||4||
624.e: Says Nanak, when the Guru tore down the wall of egotism, then, I found my Merciful Lord and Master. ||4||
All my fears have been dispelled, O mother!
Whoever I seek, the Guru leads me to find.

624.g: ਸਰਬ ਗੁਨਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਰਾਇਓ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧੧॥੬੧॥
624.t: sarab gunaa nidh raio || rahaau dhoojaa ||11||61||
624.e: The Lord, our King, is the treasure of all virtue. ||Second Pause||11||61||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

624.g: ਗਈ ਬਹੋੜੁ ਬੰਦੀ ਛੋੜੁ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੁ ਦੁਖਦਾਰੀ ॥
624.t: giee bahoR ba(n)dhee chhoR nira(n)kaar dhukhadhaaree ||
624.e: The Restorer of what was taken away, the Liberator from captivity; the Formless Lord, the Destroyer of pain.

624.g: ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਲੋਭੀ ਮਾਇਆਧਾਰੀ ॥
624.t: karam na jaanaa dharam na jaanaa lobhee maiaadhaaree ||
624.e: I do not know about karma and good deeds; I do not know about Dharma and righteous living. I am so greedy, chasing after Maya.

624.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਰਿਓ ਭਗਤੁ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਕਾ ਇਹ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਪੈਜ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
624.t: naam pario bhagat govi(n)dh kaa ieh raakhahu paij tumaaree ||1||
624.e: I go by the name of God's devotee; please, save this honor of Yours. ||1||
O Dear Lord, You are the honor of the dishonored.

624.g: ਨਿਚੀਜਿਆ ਚੀਜ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
624.t: nicheejiaa cheej kare meraa govi(n)dh teree kudharat kau kurabaan || rahaau ||
624.e: You make the unworthy ones worthy, O my Lord of the Universe; I am a sacrifice to Your almighty creative power. ||Pause||

624.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਬਾਲਕੁ ਭਾਇ ਸੁਭਾਈ ਲਖ ਅਪਰਾਧ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
624.t: jaisaa baalak bhai subhaiee lakh aparaadh kamaavai ||
624.e: Like the child, innocently making thousands of mistakes

624.g: ਕਰਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਝਿੜਕੇ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤੀ ਬਹੁੜਿ ਪਿਤਾ ਗਲਿ ਲਾਵੈ ॥
624.t: kar upadhes jhiRake bahu bhaatee bahuR pitaa gal laavai ||
624.e: his father teaches him, and scolds him so many times, but still, he hugs him close in his embrace.

624.g: ਪਿਛਲੇ ਅਉਗੁਣ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਗੈ ਮਾਰਗਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
624.t: pichhale aaugun bakhas le prabh aagai maarag paavai ||2||
624.e: Please forgive my past actions, God, and place me on Your path for the future. ||2||

624.g: ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਤਾ ਕਿਸੁ ਪਹਿ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਈਐ ॥
624.t: har a(n)tarajaamee sabh bidh jaanai taa kis peh aakh sunaieeaai ||
624.e: The Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts, knows all about my state of mind; so who else should I go to and speak to?

624.g: ਕਹਣੈ ਕਥਨਿ ਨ ਭੀਜੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈਐ ॥
624.t: kahanai kathan na bheejai gobi(n)dh har bhaavai paij rakhaieeaai ||
624.e: The Lord, the Lord of the Universe, is not pleased by mere recitation of words; if it is pleasing to His Will, He preserves our honor.

624.g: ਅਵਰ ਓਟ ਮੈ ਸਗਲੀ ਦੇਖੀ ਇਕ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਟ ਰਹਾਈਐ ॥੩॥
624.t: avar oT mai sagalee dhekhee ik teree oT rahaieeaai ||3||
624.e: I have seen all other shelters, but Yours alone remains for me. ||3||

625.g: ਹੋਇ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਣੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ॥
625.t: hoi dhiaal kirapaal prabh Thaakur aape sunai bena(n)tee ||
625.e: Becoming kind and compassionate, God the Lord and Master Himself listens to my prayer.

625.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਵੈ ਸਭ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਚਿੰਤੀ ॥
625.t: pooraa satagur mel milaavai sabh chookai man kee chi(n)tee ||
625.e: He unites me in Union with the Perfect True Guru, and all the cares and anxieties of my mind are dispelled.

625.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਵਖਦੁ ਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੁਖਿ ਵਸੰਤੀ ॥੪॥੧੨॥੬੨॥
625.t: har har naam avakhadh mukh paiaa jan naanak sukh vasa(n)tee ||4||12||62||
625.e: The Lord, Har, Har, has placed the medicine of the Naam into my mouth; servant Nanak abides in peace. ||4||12||62||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

625.g: ਸਿਮਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਏ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਕਲੇਸ ਸਭਿ ਨਾਠੇ ॥
625.t: simar simar prabh bhe ana(n)dhaa dhukh kales sabh naaThe ||
625.e: Remembering, remembering God in meditation, bliss ensues, and one is rid of all suffering and pain.

625.g: ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵਤ ਧਿਆਵਤ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਂਠੇ ॥੧॥
625.t: gun gaavat dhiaavat prabh apanaa kaaraj sagale saa(n)The ||1||
625.e: Singing the Glorious Praises of God, and meditating on Him, all my affairs are brought into harmony. ||1||
Your Name is the Life of the world.

625.g: ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਦੀਓ ਉਪਦੇਸਾ ਜਪਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
625.t: gur poore dheeo upadhesaa jap bhaujal paar utaaraa || rahaau ||
625.e: The Perfect Guru has taught me, that by meditating, I cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||Pause||

625.g: ਤੂਹੈ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੀ ਸੁਨਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰਣੈਹਾਰਾ ॥
625.t: toohai ma(n)tree suneh prabh toohai sabh kichh karanaihaaraa ||
625.e: You are Your own advisor; You hear everything, God, and You do everything.

625.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਪੇ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਕਿਆ ਇਹੁ ਜੰਤੁ ਵਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
625.t: too aape dhaataa aape bhugataa kiaa ih ja(n)t vichaaraa ||2||
625.e: You Yourself are the Giver, and You Yourself are the Enjoyer. What can this poor creature do? ||2||

625.g: ਕਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਤੇਰੇ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
625.t: kiaa gun tere aakh vakhaanee keemat kahan na jaiee ||
625.e: Which of Your Glorious Virtues should I describe and speak of? Your value cannot be described.

625.g: ਪੇਖਿ ਪੇਖਿ ਜੀਵੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਤੁਮਹਿ ਵਡਾਈ ॥੩॥
625.t: pekh pekh jeevai prabh apanaa acharaj tumeh vaddaiee ||3||
625.e: I live by beholding, beholding You, O God. Your glorious greatness is wonderful and amazing! ||3||

625.g: ਧਾਰਿ ਅਨੁਗ੍ਰਹੁ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਪਤਿ ਮਤਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਪੂਰੀ ॥
625.t: dhaar anugrahu aap prabh savaiaamee pat mat keenee pooree ||
625.e: Granting His Grace, God my Lord and Master Himself saved my honor, and my intellect has been made perfect.

625.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਬਾਛਉ ਸੰਤਾ ਧੂਰੀ ॥੪॥੧੩॥੬੩॥
625.t: sadhaa sadhaa naanak balihaaree baachhau sa(n)taa dhooree ||4||13||63||
625.e: Forever and ever, Nanak is a sacrifice, longing for the dust of the feet of the Saints. ||4||13||63||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
I bow in reverence to the Perfect Guru.
God has resolved all my affairs.
The Lord has showered me with His Mercy.
God has perfectly preserved my honor. ||1||
He has become the help and support of His slave.

625.g: ਸਗਲ ਮਨੋਰਥ ਕੀਨੇ ਕਰਤੈ ਊਣੀ ਬਾਤ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
625.t: sagal manorath keene karatai uoonee baat na kaiee || rahaau ||
625.e: The Creator has achieved all my goals, and now, nothing is lacking. ||Pause||
The Creator Lord has caused the pool of nectar to be constructed.
The wealth of Maya follows in my footsteps,
and now, nothing is lacking at all.
This is pleasing to my Perfect True Guru. ||2||
Remembering, remembering the Merciful Lord in meditation,
all beings have become kind and compassionate to me.
Hail! Hail to the Lord of the world,
who created the perfect creation. ||3||
You are my Great Lord and Master.
These blessings and wealth are Yours.
Servant Nanak has meditated on the One Lord;
he has obtained the fruitful rewards for all good deeds. ||4||14||64||

625.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ghar teejaa dhupadhe
625.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla, Third House, Dho-Padhay:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Bathing in the nectar tank of Ram Das,
all sins are erased.
One becomes immaculately pure, taking this cleansing bath.
The Perfect Guru has bestowed this gift. ||1||
God has blessed all with peace and pleasure.

625.g: ਸਹੀ ਸਲਾਮਤਿ ਸਭਿ ਥੋਕ ਉਬਾਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਵੀਚਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
625.t: sahee salaamat sabh thok ubaare gur kaa sabadh veechaare || rahaau ||
625.e: Everything is safe and sound, as we contemplate the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||Pause||
In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, filth is washed off.
The Supreme Lord God has become our friend and helper.
Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
He has found God, the Primal Being. ||2||1||65||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

625.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਚਿਤਿ ਆਇਆ ॥ ਸੋ ਘਰੁ ਦਯਿ ਵਸਾਇਆ ॥
625.t: jit paarabraham chit aaiaa || so ghar dhay vasaiaa ||
625.e: The Supreme Lord God has established that home, in which He comes to mind.

626.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥ ਤਾ ਸਹਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
626.t: sukh saagar gur paiaa || taa sahasaa sagal miTaiaa ||1||
626.e: I found the Guru, the ocean of peace, and all my doubts were dispelled. ||1||
This is the glorious greatness of the Naam.
Twenty-four hours a day, I sing His Glorious Praises.
I obtained this from the Perfect Guru. ||Pause||
God's sermon is inexpressible.
His humble servants speak words of Ambrosial Nectar.
Slave Nanak has spoken.
Through the Perfect Guru, it is known. ||2||2||66||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Guru has blessed me with peace here,
and the Guru has arranged peace and pleasure for me hereafter.
I have all treasures and comforts,
meditating on the Guru in my heart. ||1||
This is the glorious greatness of my True Guru;
I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires.

626.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
626.t: sa(n)tahu dhin dhin chaRai savaiee || rahaau ||
626.e: O Saints, His Glory increases day by day. ||Pause||

626.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਭਏ ਦਇਆਲਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਅਪਨੇ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥
626.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh bhe dhiaalaa prabh apane kar dheene ||
626.e: All beings and creatures have become kind and compassionate to me; my God has made them so.

626.g: ਸਹਜ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੋਪਾਲਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਪਤੀਨੇ ॥੨॥੩॥੬੭॥
626.t: sahaj subhai mile gopaalaa naanak saach pateene ||2||3||67||
626.e: Nanak has met with the Lord of the world with intuitive ease, and with Truth, he is pleased. ||2||3||67||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Word of the Guru's Shabad is my Saving Grace.
It is a guardian posted on all four sides around me.
My mind is attached to the Lord's Name.
The Messenger of Death has run away in shame. ||1||
O Dear Lord, You are my Giver of peace.

626.g: ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਕਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
626.t: ba(n)dhan kaaT kare man niramal pooran purakh bidhaataa || rahaau ||
626.e: The Perfect Lord, the Architect of Destiny, has shattered my bonds, and made my mind immaculately pure. ||Pause||
O Nanak, God is eternal and imperishable.

626.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵ ਨ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਜਾਸੀ ॥
626.t: taa kee sev na birathee jaasee ||
626.e: Service to Him shall never go unrewarded.
Your slaves are in bliss;
chanting and meditating, their desires are fulfilled. ||2||4||68||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
I am a sacrifice to my Guru.
He has totally preserved my honor.
I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires.
I meditate forever on my God. ||1||

626.g: ਸੰਤਹੁ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
626.t: sa(n)tahu tis bin avar na koiee ||
626.e: O Saints, without Him, there is no other at all.
He is God, the Cause of causes. ||Pause||
My God has given me His Blessing.
He has made all creatures subject to me.
Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord,
and all his sorrows depart. ||2||5||69||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Perfect Guru has dispelled the fever.
The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds.
God has bestowed all comforts.
In His Mercy, He Himself has given them. ||1||
The True Guru Himself has eradicated the disease.

626.g: ਸਿਖ ਸੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਸੇ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
626.t: sikh sa(n)t sabh sarase hoe har har naam dhiaaiee || rahaau ||
626.e: All the Sikhs and Saints are filled with joy, meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||Pause||
They obtain that which they ask for.
God gives to His Saints.
God saved Hargobind.
Servant Nanak speaks the Truth. ||2||6||70||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
You make me do what pleases You.
I have no cleverness at all.
I am just a child - I seek Your Protection.
God Himself preserves my honor. ||1||
The Lord is my King; He is my mother and father.

626.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਣ ਲਾਗਾ ਕਰਂੀ ਤੇਰਾ ਕਰਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
626.t: kar kirapaa pratipaalan laagaa kara(n)ee teraa karaiaa || rahaau ||
626.e: In Your Mercy, You cherish me; I do whatever You make me do. ||Pause||
The beings and creatures are Your creation.
O God, their reins are in Your hands.

627.e: Whatever You cause us to do, we do.
Nanak, Your slave, seeks Your Protection. ||2||7||71||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
I have woven the Lord's Name into the fabric of my heart.
All my affairs are resolved.
His mind is attached to God's feet,
whose destiny is perfect. ||1||
Joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I meditate on the Lord.

627.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਅਰਾਧਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
627.t: aaTh pahar araadhio har har man chi(n)dhiaa fal paiaa || rahaau ||
627.e: Twenty-four hours a day, I worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har; I have obtained the fruits of my mind's desires. ||Pause||
The seeds of my past actions have sprouted.
My mind is attached to the Lord's Name.
My mind and body are absorbed into the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan.
Slave Nanak sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||2||8||72||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
Meeting with the Guru, I contemplate God.
All of my affairs have been resolved.
No one speaks ill of me.
Everyone congratulates me on my victory. ||1||
O Saints, I seek the True Sanctuary of the Lord and Master.

627.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਹਾਥਿ ਤਿਸੈ ਕੈ ਸੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
627.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh haath tisai kai so prabh a(n)tarajaamee || rahaau ||
627.e: All beings and creatures are in His hands; He is God, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||Pause||
He has resolved all of my affairs.
God has confirmed His innate nature.
God's Name is the Purifier of sinners.
Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice to Him. ||2||9||73||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Supreme Lord God created and embellished him.
The Guru has saved this small child.
So celebrate and be happy, father and mother.
The Transcendent Lord is the Giver of souls. ||1||
Your slaves, O Lord, focus on pure thoughts.

627.g: ਰਾਖਹਿ ਪੈਜ ਦਾਸ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕਾਰਜ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
627.t: raakheh paij dhaas apune kee kaaraj aap savaare || rahaau ||
627.e: You preserve the honor of Your slaves, and You Yourself arrange their affairs. ||Pause||
My God is so benevolent.
His Almighty Power is manifest.
Nanak has come to His Sanctuary.
He has obtained the fruits of his mind's desires. ||2||10||74||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
Forever and ever, I chant the Lord's Name.
God Himself has saved my child.
He healed him from the smallpox.
My troubles have been removed through the Lord's Name. ||1||
My God is forever Merciful.

627.g: ਅਰਦਾਸਿ ਸੁਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਸਭ ਜੀਅ ਭਇਆ ਕਿਰਪਾਲਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
627.t: aradhaas sunee bhagat apune kee sabh jeea bhiaa kirapaalaa || rahaau ||
627.e: He heard the prayer of His devotee, and now all beings are kind and compassionate to him. ||Pause||
God is Almighty, the Cause of causes.
Remembering the Lord in meditation, all pains and sorrows vanish.
He has heard the prayer of His slave.
O Nanak, now everyone sleeps in peace. ||2||11||75||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
I meditated on my Guru.
I met with Him, and returned home in joy.
This is the glorious greatness of the Naam.
Its value cannot be estimated. ||1||
O Saints, worship and adore the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

627.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਿ ਸਭੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲੇ ਸਾਧਹੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
627.t: har aaraadh sabho kichh paieeaai kaaraj sagale saadhahu || rahaau ||
627.e: Worship the Lord in adoration, and you shall obtain everything; your affairs shall all be resolved. ||Pause||
He alone is attached in loving devotion to God,
who realizes his great destiny.
Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
He obtains the rewards of all joys and peace. ||2||12||76||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Transcendent Lord has given me His support.
The house of pain and disease has been demolished.
The men and women celebrate.
The Lord God, Har, Har, has extended His Mercy. ||1||

628.e: O Saints, there is peace everywhere.

628.g: ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪੂਰਨ ਪਰਮੇਸਰੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਭਨੀ ਜਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
628.t: paarabraham pooran paramesar rav rahiaa sabhanee jaiee || rahaau ||
628.e: The Supreme Lord God, the Perfect Transcendent Lord, is pervading everywhere. ||Pause||
The Bani of His Word emanated from the Primal Lord.
It eradicates all anxiety.
The Lord is merciful, kind and compassionate.
Nanak chants the Naam, the Name of the True Lord. ||2||13||77||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
Here and hereafter, He is our Savior.
God, the True Guru, is Merciful to the meek.
He Himself protects His slaves.
In each and every heart, the Beautiful Word of His Shabad resounds. ||1||

628.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਊਪਰਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
628.t: gur ke charan uoopar bal jaiee ||
628.e: I am a sacrifice to the Guru's Feet.

628.g: ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰੈਨਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਮਾਲੀ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਸਭਨੀ ਥਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
628.t: dhinas rain saas saas samaalee pooran sabhanee thaiee || rahaau ||
628.e: Day and night, with each and every breath, I remember Him; He is totally pervading and permeating all places. ||Pause||
He Himself has become my help and support.
True is the support of the True Lord.
Glorious and great is devotional worship to You.
Nanak has found God's Sanctuary. ||2||14||78||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
When it was pleasing to the Perfect True Guru,
then I chanted the Naam, the Name of the Pervading Lord.
The Lord of the Universe extended His Mercy to me,
and God saved my honor. ||1||
The Lord's feet are forever peace-giving.

628.g: ਜੋ ਇਛਹਿ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਬਿਰਥੀ ਆਸ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
628.t: jo ichheh soiee fal paaveh birathee aas na jaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
628.e: Whatever fruit one desires, he receives; his hopes shall not go in vain. ||1||Pause||

628.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੰਤੁ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
628.t: kirapaa kare jis praanapat dhaataa soiee sa(n)t gun gaavai ||
628.e: That Saint, unto whom the Lord of Life, the Great Giver, extends His Mercy - he alone sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

628.g: ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਲੀਣਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
628.t: prem bhagat taa kaa man leenaa paarabraham man bhaavai ||2||
628.e: His soul is absorbed in loving devotional worship; his mind is pleasing to the Supreme Lord God. ||2||

628.g: ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਜਸੁ ਰਵਣਾ ਬਿਖੈ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਲਾਥੀ ॥
628.t: aaTh pahar har kaa jas ravanaa bikhai Thagauree laathee ||
628.e: Twenty-four hours a day, he chants the Praises of the Lord, and the bitter poison does not affect him.

628.g: ਸੰਗਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਲੀਆ ਮੇਰੈ ਕਰਤੈ ਸੰਤ ਸਾਧ ਭਏ ਸਾਥੀ ॥੩॥
628.t: sa(n)g milai leeaa merai karatai sa(n)t saadh bhe saathee ||3||
628.e: My Creator Lord has united me with Himself, and the Holy Saints have become my companions. ||3||

628.g: ਕਰੁ ਗਹਿ ਲੀਨੇ ਸਰਬਸੁ ਦੀਨੇ ਆਪਹਿ ਆਪੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥
628.t: kar geh leene sarabas dheene aapeh aap milaiaa ||
628.e: Taking me by the hand, He has given me everything, and blended me with Himself.

628.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਬ ਥੋਕ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੂਰਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੧੫॥੭੯॥
628.t: kahu naanak sarab thok pooran pooraa satigur paiaa ||4||15||79||
628.e: Says Nanak, everything has been perfectly resolved; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||4||15||79||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
Humility is my spiked club.
My dagger is to be the dust of all men's feet.

628.g: ਇਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਕੋ ਨ ਟਿਕੈ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥
628.t: eis aagai ko na Tikai vekaaree ||
628.e: No evil-doer can withstand these weapons.
The Perfect Guru has given me this understanding. ||1||

628.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੀ ਓਟਾ ॥
628.t: har har naam sa(n)tan kee oTaa ||
628.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is the support and shelter of the Saints.

628.g: ਜੋ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਉਧਰਹਿ ਸਗਲੇ ਕੋਟਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
628.t: jo simarai tis kee gat hovai udhareh sagale koTaa ||1|| rahaau ||
628.e: One who remembers the Lord in meditation, is emancipated; millions have been saved in this way. ||1||Pause||
In the Society of the Saints, I sing His Praises.
I have found this, the perfect wealth of the Lord.
Says Nanak, I have eradicated my self-conceit.
I see the Supreme Lord God everywhere. ||2||16||80||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Perfect Guru has done it perfectly.
He blessed me with forgiveness.
I have found lasting peace and bliss.
Everywhere, the people dwell in peace. ||1||
Devotional worship to the Lord is what gives rewards.

628.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਵਿਰਲੈ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਜਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
628.t: gur poorai kirapaa kar dheenee viralai kin hee jaatee || rahaau ||
628.e: The Perfect Guru, by His Grace, gave it to me; how rare are those who know this. ||Pause||
Sing the Word of the Guru's Bani, O Siblings of Destiny.
That is always rewarding and peace-giving.
Nanak has meditated on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.
He has realized his pre-ordained destiny. ||2||17||81||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

629.e: I worship and adore the Perfect Guru.
All my affairs have been resolved.
All desires have been fulfilled.
The unstruck melody of the sound current resounds. ||1||
O Saints, meditating on the Lord, we obtain peace.

629.g: ਸੰਤ ਅਸਥਾਨਿ ਬਸੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਹਜੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
629.t: sa(n)t asathaan base sukh sahaje sagale dhookh miTaiaa ||1|| rahaau ||
629.e: In the home of the Saints, celestial peace is pervading; all pain and suffering is dispelled. ||1||Pause||
The Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani
is pleasing to the Mind of the Supreme Lord God.
Slave Nanak speaks
the Unspoken, immaculate sermon of the Lord. ||2||18||82||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The hungry man is not ashamed to eat.

629.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
629.t: tiau har jan har gun gaavai ||1||
629.e: Just so, the humble servant of the Lord sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||1||
Why are you so lazy in your mission (to become one with God)?

629.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਮੁਖੁ ਊਜਲ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
629.t: jit simaran dharageh mukh uoojal sadhaa sadhaa sukh paieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
629.e: Meditation on God leads to your acceptance in God's court and, by engrossing yourself in this meditation, your face shall be radiant having attained everlasting peace and pleasure.
Just as the lustful man is enticed by lust,

629.g: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
629.t: tiau har dhaas har jas bhaavai ||2||
629.e: so is the Lord's slave pleased with the Lord's Praise. ||2||
Just as the mother holds her baby close,
so does the spiritual person cherish the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||3||
This is obtained from the Perfect Guru.
Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||19||83||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
Safe and sound, I have returned home.
The slanderer's face is blackened with ashes.
The Perfect Guru has dressed me in robes of honor.
All my pains and sufferings are over. ||1||
O Saints, this is the glorious greatness of the True Lord.
He has created such wonder and glory! ||1||Pause||
I speak according to the Will of my Lord and Master.
God's slave chants the Word of His Bani.
O Nanak, God is the Giver of peace.
He has created the perfect creation. ||2||20||84||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
Within my heart, I meditate on God.
I have returned home safe and sound.
The world has become contented.
The Perfect Guru has saved me. ||1||
O Saints, my God is forever merciful.

629.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਭਗਤ ਕੀ ਗਣਤ ਨ ਗਣਈ ਰਾਖੈ ਬਾਲ ਗੁਪਾਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
629.t: apane bhagat kee ganat na ganiee raakhai baal gupaalaa ||1|| rahaau ||
629.e: The Lord of the world does not call His devotee to account; He protects His children. ||1||Pause||
I have enshrined the Lord's Name within my heart.
He has resolved all my affairs.
The Perfect Guru was pleased, and blessed me,
and now, Nanak shall never again suffer pain. ||2||21||85||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Lord abides in my mind and body.

629.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਕਰੇ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
629.t: jai jai kaar kare sabh koiee ||
629.e: Everyone congratulates me on my victory.
This is the glorious greatness of the Perfect Guru.

629.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
629.t: taa kee keemat kahee na jaiee ||1||
629.e: His value cannot be described. ||1||
I am a sacrifice to Your Name.

629.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸੋ ਜਸੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
629.t: jis no bakhas laih mere piaare so jas teraa gaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
629.e: He alone, whom You have forgiven, O my Beloved, sings Your Praises. ||1||Pause||
You are my Great Lord and Master.
You are the support of the Saints.
Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.
The faces of the slanderers are blackened with ashes. ||2||22||86||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
Peace in this world, O my friends,
and bliss in the world hereafter - God has given me this.
The Transcendent Lord has arranged these arrangements;
I shall never waver again. ||1||
My mind is pleased with the True Lord Master.
I know the Lord to be pervading all. ||1||Pause||

630.e: All beings are Yours, O Merciful Lord.
You cherish Your devotees.
Your glorious greatness is wonderful and marvellous.
Nanak ever meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||23||87||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
The Lord is always with me.
The Messenger of Death does not approach me.
God holds me close in His embrace, and protects me.
True are the Teachings of the True Guru. ||1||
The Perfect Guru has done it perfectly.

630.g: ਦੁਸਮਨ ਮਾਰਿ ਵਿਡਾਰੇ ਸਗਲੇ ਦਾਸ ਕਉ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਦੀਤੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
630.t: dhusaman maar viddaare sagale dhaas kau sumat dheetee ||1|| rahaau ||
630.e: He has beaten and driven off my enemies, and given me, His slave, the sublime understanding of the neutral mind. ||1||Pause||
God has blessed all places with prosperity.
I have returned again safe and sound.
Nanak has entered God's Sanctuary.
It has eradicated all disease. ||2||24||88||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

630.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸਰਨੀ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
630.t: sarab sukhaa kaa dhaataa satigur taa kee saranee paieeaai ||
630.e: The True Guru is the Giver of all peace and comfort - seek His Sanctuary.

630.g: ਦਰਸਨੁ ਭੇਟਤ ਹੋਤ ਅਨੰਦਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਗਇਆ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਈਐ ॥੧॥
630.t: dharasan bheTat hot ana(n)dhaa dhookh giaa har gaieeaai ||1||
630.e: Beholding the Blessed Vision of His Darshan, bliss ensues, pain is dispelled, and one sings the Lord's Praises. ||1||
Drink in the sublime essence of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny.

630.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਨਾਮੋ ਆਰਾਧਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੇ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
630.t: naam japahu naamo aaraadhahu gur poore kee saranaiee || rahaau ||
630.e: Chant the Naam, the Name of the Lord; worship the Naam in adoration, and enter the Sanctuary of the Perfect Guru. ||Pause||

630.g: ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਜਿਸੁ ਧੁਰਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸੋਈ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
630.t: tiseh paraapat jis dhur likhiaa soiee pooran bhaiee ||
630.e: Only one who has such pre-ordained destiny receives it; he alone becomes perfect, O Siblings of Destiny.

630.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹਾ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥੨॥੨੫॥੮੯॥
630.t: naanak kee bena(n)tee prabh jee naam rahaa liv laiee ||2||25||89||
630.e: Nanak's prayer, O Dear God, is to remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam. ||2||25||89||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

630.g: ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
630.t: karan karaavan har a(n)tarajaamee jan apune kee raakhai ||
630.e: The Lord is the Cause of Causes, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts; He preserves the honor of His servant.

630.g: ਜੈ ਜੈ ਕਾਰੁ ਹੋਤੁ ਜਗ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖੈ ॥੧॥
630.t: jai jai kaar hot jag bheetar sabadh guroo ras chaakhai ||1||
630.e: He is hailed and congratulated throughout the world, and he tastes the sublime essence of the Word of the Guru's Shabad. ||1||
Dear God, Lord of the world, You are my only support.

630.g: ਤੂ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਸਰਨਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਤਾ ਆਠ ਪਹਰ ਤੁਮੑ ਧਿਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
630.t: too samarath saran kaa dhaataa aaTh pahar tum(h) dhiaaiee || rahaau ||
630.e: You are all-powerful, the Giver of Sanctuary; twenty-four hours a day, I meditate on You. ||Pause||

630.g: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਜਨੁ ਕਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਤੇਰਾ ਤਿਸੈ ਅੰਦੇਸਾ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
630.t: jo jan bhajan kare prabh teraa tisai a(n)dhesaa naahee ||
630.e: That humble being, who vibrates upon You, O God, is not afflicted by anxiety.

630.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਗੇ ਭਉ ਮਿਟਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
630.t: satigur charan lage bhau miTiaa har gun gaae man maahee ||2||
630.e: Attached to the Feet of the True Guru, his fear is dispelled, and within his mind, he sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

630.g: ਸੂਖ ਸਹਜ ਆਨੰਦ ਘਨੇਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਲਾਸਾ ॥
630.t: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh ghanere satigur dheeaa dhilaasaa ||
630.e: He abides in celestial peace and utter ecstasy; the True Guru has comforted him.

630.g: ਜਿਣਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਏ ਸੋਭਾ ਸੇਤੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸਾ ॥੩॥
630.t: jin ghar aae sobhaa setee pooran hoiee aasaa ||3||
630.e: He has returned home victorious, with honor, and his hopes have been fulfilled. ||3||

630.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰੀ ਮਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੀ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੇ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
630.t: pooraa gur pooree mat jaa kee pooran prabh ke kaamaa ||
630.e: Perfect are the Teachings of the Perfect Guru; Perfect are the actions of God.

630.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਲਾਗਿ ਤਰਿਓ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਪਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੨੬॥੯੦॥
630.t: gur charanee laag tario bhav saagar jap naanak har har naamaa ||4||26||90||
630.e: Grasping hold of the Guru's feet, Nanak has crossed over the terrifying world-ocean, chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har. ||4||26||90||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

630.g: ਭਇਓ ਕਿਰਪਾਲੁ ਦੀਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਭ ਬਿਧਿ ਥਾਟੀ ॥
630.t: bhio kirapaal dheen dhukh bha(n)jan aape sabh bidh thaaTee ||
630.e: Becoming merciful, the Destroyer of the pains of the poor has Himself devised all devices.

630.g: ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੀਓ ਜਨੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਬੇੜੀ ਕਾਟੀ ॥੧॥
630.t: khin meh raakh leeo jan apunaa gur poorai beRee kaaTee ||1||
630.e: In an instant, He has saved His humble servant; the Perfect Guru has cut away his bonds. ||1||

630.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਗੁਰ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਈਐ ॥
630.t: mere man gur govi(n)dh sadh dhiaaieeaai ||
630.e: O my mind, meditate forever on the Guru, the Lord of the Universe.

630.g: ਸਗਲ ਕਲੇਸ ਮਿਟਹਿ ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤੇ ਮਨ ਚਿੰਦਿਆ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
630.t: sagal kales miTeh is tan te man chi(n)dhiaa fal paieeaai || rahaau ||
630.e: All illness shall depart from this body, and you shall obtain the fruits of your mind's desires. ||Pause||

630.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਊਚਾ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
630.t: jeea ja(n)t jaa ke sabh keene prabh uoochaa agam apaaraa ||
630.e: God created all beings and creatures; He is lofty, inaccessible and infinite.

630.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਭਏ ਦਰਬਾਰਾ ॥੨॥੨੭॥੯੧॥
630.t: saadhasa(n)g naanak naam dhiaaiaa mukh uoojal bhe dharabaaraa ||2||27||91||
630.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; his face is radiant in the Court of the Lord. ||2||27||91||
Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:
I meditate in remembrance on my Lord.
Day and night, I ever meditate on Him.
He gave me His hand, and protected me.
I drink in the most sublime essence of the Lord's Name. ||1||

631.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਗੁਰ ਊਪਰਿ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੁ ॥
631.t: apane gur uoopar kurabaan ||
631.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru.

631.g: ਭਏ ਕਿਰਪਾਲ ਪੂਰਨ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦਾਤੇ ਜੀਅ ਹੋਏ ਮਿਹਰਵਾਨ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
631.t: bhe kirapaal pooran prabh dhaate jeea hoe miharavaan || rahaau ||
631.e: God, the Great Giver, the Perfect One, has become merciful to me, and now, all are kind to me. ||Pause||

631.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਨ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥
631.t: naanak jan saranaiee ||
631.e: Servant Nanak has entered His Sanctuary.

631.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਾਈ ॥
631.t: jin pooran paij rakhaiee ||
631.e: He has perfectly preserved his honor.

631.g: ਸਗਲੇ ਦੂਖ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
631.t: sagale dhookh miTaiee ||
631.e: All suffering has been dispelled.

631.t: sukh bhu(n)chahu mere bhaiee ||2||28||92||
631.e: So enjoy peace, O my Siblings of Destiny! ||2||28||92||

631.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
631.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
631.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

631.g: ਸੁਨਹੁ ਬਿਨੰਤੀ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਤੇਰੇ ਧਾਰੇ ॥
631.t: sunahu bina(n)tee Thaakur mere jeea ja(n)t tere dhaare ||
631.e: Hear my prayer, O my Lord and Master; all beings and creatures were created by You.

631.g: ਰਾਖੁ ਪੈਜ ਨਾਮ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਕਰਨ ਕਰਾਵਨਹਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
631.t: raakh paij naam apune kee karan karaavanahaare ||1||
631.e: You preserve the honor of Your Name, O Lord, Cause of causes. ||1||

631.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜੀਉ ਖਸਮਾਨਾ ਕਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
631.t: prabh jeeau khasamaanaa kar piaare ||
631.e: O Dear God, Beloved, please, make me Your own.

631.g: ਬੁਰੇ ਭਲੇ ਹਮ ਥਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
631.t: bure bhale ham thaare || rahaau ||
631.e: Whether good or bad, I am Yours. ||Pause||

631.g: ਸੁਣੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ਸਮਰਥ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਬੰਧਨ ਕਾਟਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
631.t: sunee pukaar samarath suaamee ba(n)dhan kaaT savaare ||
631.e: The Almighty Lord and Master heard my prayer; cutting away my bonds, He has adorned me.

631.g: ਪਹਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਸੇਵਕ ਜਨ ਮੇਲੇ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਪਹਾਰੇ ॥੨॥੨੯॥੯੩॥
631.t: pahir sirapaau sevak jan mele naanak pragaT pahaare ||2||29||93||
631.e: He dressed me in robes of honor, and blended His servant with Himself; Nanak is revealed in glory throughout the world. ||2||29||93||

631.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
631.t: soraTh mahalaa panjavaa ||
631.e: Sorat'h, Fifth Mehla:

631.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਿ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਭਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
631.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh vas kar dheene sevak sabh dharabaare ||
631.e: All beings and creatures are subservient to all those who serve in the Lord's Court.

631.g: ਅੰਗੀਕਾਰੁ ਕੀਓ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਭਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
631.t: a(n)geekaar keeo prabh apune bhav nidh paar utaare ||1||
631.e: Their God made them His own, and carried them across the terrifying world-ocean. ||1||

631.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਗਲ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
631.t: sa(n)tan ke kaaraj sagal savaare ||
631.e: He resolves all the affairs of His Saints.

631.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਪੂਰਨ ਖਸਮ ਹਮਾਰੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
631.t: dheen dhiaal kirapaal kirapaa nidh pooran khasam hamaare || rahaau ||
631.e: He is merciful to the meek, kind and compassionate, the ocean of kindness, my Perfect Lord and Master. ||Pause||

631.g: ਆਉ ਬੈਠੁ ਆਦਰੁ ਸਭ ਥਾਈ ਊਨ ਨ ਕਤਹੂੰ ਬਾਤਾ ॥
631.t: aau baiTh aadhar sabh thaiee uoon na katahoo(n) baataa ||
631.e: I am asked to come and be seated, everywhere I go, and I lack nothing.

631.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਸਿਰਪਾਉ ਦੀਓ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਪ੍ਰਤਾਪੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਜਾਤਾ ॥੨॥੩੦॥੯੪॥
631.t: bhagat sirapaau dheeo jan apune prataap naanak prabh jaataa ||2||30||94||
631.e: The Lord blesses His humble devotee with robes of honor; O Nanak, the Glory of God is manifest. ||2||30||94||

631.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯
631.t: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa
631.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

631.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
631.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
631.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

631.g: ਰੇ ਮਨ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥
631.t: re man raam siau kar preet ||
631.e: O mind, love the Lord.

631.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਗੁਨੁ ਸੁਨਉ ਅਰੁ ਗਾਉ ਰਸਨਾ ਗੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
631.t: sravan gobi(n)dh gun sunau ar gaau rasanaa geet ||1|| rahaau ||
631.e: With your ears, hear the Glorious Praises of the Lord of the Universe, and with your tongue, sing His song. ||1||Pause||

631.g: ਕਰਿ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਿਮਰੁ ਮਾਧੋ ਹੋਹਿ ਪਤਿਤ ਪੁਨੀਤ ॥
631.t: kar saadhasa(n)gat simar maadho hoh patit puneet ||
631.e: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and meditate in remembrance on the Lord; even a sinner like yourself will become pure.

631.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਬਿਆਲੁ ਜਿਉ ਪਰਿਓ ਡੋਲੈ ਮੁਖੁ ਪਸਾਰੇ ਮੀਤ ॥੧॥
631.t: kaal biaal jiau pario ddolai mukh pasaare meet ||1||
631.e: Death is on the prowl, with its mouth wide open, friend. ||1||

631.g: ਆਜੁ ਕਾਲਿ ਫੁਨਿ ਤੋਹਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿ ਹੈ ਸਮਝਿ ਰਾਖਉ ਚੀਤਿ ॥
631.t: aaj kaal fun toh gras hai samajh raakhau cheet ||
631.e: Today or tomorrow, eventually it will seize you; understand this in your consciousness.

631.g: ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਭਜਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਤੁ ਅਉਸਰੁ ਬੀਤ ॥੨॥੧॥
631.t: kahai naanak raam bhaj lai jaat aausar beet ||2||1||
631.e: Says Nanak, meditate, and vibrate upon the Lord; this opportunity is slipping away! ||2||1||

631.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
631.t: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
631.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

631.g: ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਨ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਰਹੀ ॥
631.t: man kee man hee maeh rahee ||
631.e: The mind remains in the mind.

631.g: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੇ ਨ ਤੀਰਥ ਸੇਵੇ ਚੋਟੀ ਕਾਲਿ ਗਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
631.t: naa har bhaje na teerath seve choTee kaal gahee ||1|| rahaau ||
631.e: He does not meditate on the Lord, nor does he perform service at sacred shrines, and so death seizes him by the hair. ||1||Pause||

631.g: ਦਾਰਾ ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਰਥ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਧਨ ਪੂਰਨ ਸਭ ਮਹੀ ॥
631.t: dhaaraa meet poot rath sa(n)pat dhan pooran sabh mahee ||
631.e: Wife, friends, children, carriages, property, total wealth, the entire world

631.g: ਅਵਰ ਸਗਲ ਮਿਥਿਆ ਏ ਜਾਨਉ ਭਜਨੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੋ ਸਹੀ ॥੧॥
631.t: avar sagal mithiaa e jaanau bhajan raam ko sahee ||1||
631.e: - know that all of these things are false. The Lord's meditation alone is true. ||1||

631.g: ਫਿਰਤ ਫਿਰਤ ਬਹੁਤੇ ਜੁਗ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਲਹੀ ॥
631.t: firat firat bahute jug haario maanas dheh lahee ||
631.e: Wandering, wandering around for so many ages, he has grown weary, and finally, he obtained this human body.

631.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਮਿਲਨ ਕੀ ਬਰੀਆ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਕਹਾ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
631.t: naanak kahat milan kee bareeaa simarat kahaa nahee ||2||2||
631.e: Says Nanak, this is the opportunity to meet the Lord; why don't you remember Him in meditation? ||2||2||

631.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
631.t: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
631.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

631.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਕਉਨੁ ਕੁਮਤਿ ਤੈ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
631.t: man re kaun kumat tai leenee ||
631.e: O mind, what evil-mindedness have you developed?

631.g: ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਰਸ ਰਚਿਓ ਰਾਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹਿ ਕੀਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
631.t: par dhaaraa ni(n)dhiaa ras rachio raam bhagat neh keenee ||1|| rahaau ||
631.e: You are engrossed in the pleasures of other men's wives, and slander; you have not worshipped the Lord at all. ||1||Pause||

631.g: ਮੁਕਤਿ ਪੰਥੁ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਤੈ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਧਨ ਜੋਰਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਇਆ ॥
631.t: mukat pa(n)th jaanio tai naahan dhan joran kau dhaiaa ||
631.e: You do not know the way to liberation, but you run all around chasing wealth.

632.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਸੰਗ ਕਾਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਦੀਨਾ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
632.t: a(n)t sa(n)g kaahoo nahee dheenaa birathaa aap ba(n)dhaiaa ||1||
632.e: In the end, nothing shall go along with you; you have entrapped yourself in vain. ||1||

632.g: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਿਓ ਨਹ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
632.t: naa har bhajio na gur jan sevio neh upajio kachh giaanaa ||
632.e: You have not meditated or vibrated upon the Lord; you have not served the Guru, or His humble servants; spiritual wisdom has not welled up within you.

632.g: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤੇਰੈ ਤੈ ਖੋਜਤ ਉਦਿਆਨਾ ॥੨॥
632.t: ghaT hee maeh nira(n)jan terai tai khojat udhiaanaa ||2||
632.e: The Immaculate Lord is within your heart, and yet you search for Him in the wilderness. ||2||

632.g: ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮਤ ਤੈ ਹਾਰਿਓ ਅਸਥਿਰ ਮਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
632.t: bahut janam bharamat tai haario asathir mat nahee paiee ||
632.e: You have wandered through many many births; you are exhausted but have still not found a way out of this endless cycle.

632.g: ਮਾਨਸ ਦੇਹ ਪਾਇ ਪਦ ਹਰਿ ਭਜੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਾਤ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੩॥੩॥
632.t: maanas dheh pai padh har bhaj naanak baat bataiee ||3||3||
632.e: Now that you have obtained this human body, meditate on the Lord's Feet; Nanak advises with this advice. ||3||3||

632.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
632.t: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
632.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

632.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਬਿਚਾਰੋ ॥
632.t: man re prabh kee saran bichaaro ||
632.e: O mind, contemplate the Sanctuary of God.

632.g: ਜਿਹ ਸਿਮਰਤ ਗਨਕਾ ਸੀ ਉਧਰੀ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਸੁ ਉਰ ਧਾਰੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
632.t: jeh simarat ganakaa see udharee taa ko jas ur dhaaro ||1|| rahaau ||
632.e: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Ganika the prostitute was saved; enshrine His Praises within your heart. ||1||Pause||

632.g: ਅਟਲ ਭਇਓ ਧ੍ਰੂਅ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰਨਿ ਅਰੁ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
632.t: aTal bhio dhraooa jaa kai simaran ar nirabhai padh paiaa ||
632.e: Meditating on Him in remembrance, Dhroo became immortal, and obtained the state of fearlessness.

632.g: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤਾ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੈ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
632.t: dhukh harataa ieh bidh ko suaamee tai kaahe bisaraiaa ||1||
632.e: The Lord and Master removes suffering in this way - why have you forgotten Him? ||1||

632.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਗਹੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਗਜ ਗਰਾਹ ਤੇ ਛੂਟਾ ॥
632.t: jab hee saran gahee kirapaa nidh gaj garaeh te chhooTaa ||
632.e: As soon as the elephant took to the protective Sanctuary of the Lord, the ocean of mercy, he escaped from the crocodile.

632.g: ਮਹਮਾ ਨਾਮ ਕਹਾ ਲਉ ਬਰਨਉ ਰਾਮ ਕਹਤ ਬੰਧਨ ਤਿਹ ਤੂਟਾ ॥੨॥
632.t: mahamaa naam kahaa lau baranau raam kahat ba(n)dhan teh tooTaa ||2||
632.e: How much can I describe the Glorious Praises of the Naam? Whoever chants the Lord's Name, his bonds are broken. ||2||

632.g: ਅਜਾਮਲੁ ਪਾਪੀ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਨੇ ਨਿਮਖ ਮਾਹਿ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
632.t: ajaamal paapee jag jaane nimakh maeh nisataaraa ||
632.e: Ajaamal, known throughout the world as a sinner, was redeemed in an instant.

632.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕਹਤ ਚੇਤ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਤੈ ਭੀ ਉਤਰਹਿ ਪਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
632.t: naanak kahat chet chi(n)taaman tai bhee utareh paaraa ||3||4||
632.e: Says Nanak, remember the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and you too shall be carried across and saved. ||3||4||

632.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
632.t: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
632.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

632.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਉਨੁ ਉਪਾਉ ਕਰੈ ॥
632.t: praanee kaun upaau karai ||
632.e: What efforts should the mortal make,

632.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਮ ਕੋ ਤ੍ਰਾਸੁ ਹਰੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
632.t: jaa te bhagat raam kee paavai jam ko traas harai ||1|| rahaau ||
632.e: to attain devotional worship of the Lord, and eradicate the fear of death? ||1||Pause||

632.g: ਕਉਨੁ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਦਿਆ ਕਹੁ ਕੈਸੀ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਉਨੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਕਰਈ ॥
632.t: kaun karam bidhiaa kahu kaisee dharam kaun fun kariee ||
632.e: Which actions, what sort of knowledge, and what religion - what Dharma should one practice?

632.g: ਕਉਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੁਰ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਮਰੈ ਭਵ ਸਾਗਰ ਕਉ ਤਰਈ ॥੧॥
632.t: kaun naam gur jaa kai simarai bhav saagar kau tariee ||1||
632.e: What Name of the Guru should one remember in meditation, to cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||1||

632.g: ਕਲ ਮੈ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਜਾਹਿ ਜਪੈ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
632.t: kal mai ek naam kirapaa nidh jaeh japai gat paavai ||
632.e: In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Name of the One Lord is the treasure of mercy; chanting it, one obtains salvation.

632.g: ਅਉਰ ਧਰਮ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਸਮ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਤਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
632.t: aaur dharam taa kai sam naahan ieh bidh bedh bataavai ||2||
632.e: No other religion is comparable to this; so speak the Vedas. ||2||

632.g: ਸੁਖੁ ਦੁਖੁ ਰਹਤ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਰਲੇਪੀ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਕਹਤ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
632.t: sukh dhukh rahat sadhaa niralepee jaa kau kahat gusaiee ||
632.e: He is beyond pain and pleasure, forever unattached; He is called the Lord of the world.

632.g: ਸੋ ਤੁਮ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ ਬਸੈ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਰਪਨਿ ਨਿਆਈ ॥੩॥੫॥
632.t: so tum hee meh basai nira(n)tar naanak dharapan niaaiee ||3||5||
632.e: He dwells deep within your inner self, O Nanak, like the image in a mirror. ||3||5||

632.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
632.t: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
632.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

632.g: ਮਾਈ ਮੈ ਕਿਹਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਲਖਉ ਗੁਸਾਈ ॥
632.t: maiee mai keh bidh lakhau gusaiee ||
632.e: O mother, how can I see the Lord of the world?

632.g: ਮਹਾ ਮੋਹ ਅਗਿਆਨਿ ਤਿਮਰਿ ਮੋ ਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਓ ਉਰਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
632.t: mahaa moh agiaan timar mo man rahio urajhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
632.e: In the utter darkness of emotional attachment and spiritual ignorance, my mind remains entangled. ||1||Pause||

632.g: ਸਗਲ ਜਨਮ ਭਰਮ ਹੀ ਭਰਮ ਖੋਇਓ ਨਹ ਅਸਥਿਰੁ ਮਤਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
632.t: sagal janam bharam hee bharam khoio neh asathir mat paiee ||
632.e: Deluded by doubt, I have wasted my whole life; I have not obtained a stable intellect.

632.g: ਬਿਖਿਆਸਕਤ ਰਹਿਓ ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਨਹ ਛੂਟੀ ਅਧਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
632.t: bikhiaasakat rahio nis baasur neh chhooTee adhamaiee ||1||
632.e: I remain under the influence of corrupting sins, night and day, and I have not renounced wickedness. ||1||

632.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਨਾ ਨਹ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਗਾਈ ॥
632.t: saadhasa(n)g kabahoo nahee keenaa neh keerat prabh gaiee ||
632.e: I never joined the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, and I did not sing the Kirtan of God's Praises.

632.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈ ਨਾਹਿ ਕੋਊ ਗੁਨੁ ਰਾਖਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਸਰਨਾਈ ॥੨॥੬॥
632.t: jan naanak mai naeh kouoo gun raakh leh saranaiee ||2||6||
632.e: O servant Nanak, I have no virtues at all; keep me in Your Sanctuary, Lord. ||2||6||

632.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
632.t: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
632.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

632.g: ਮਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਮੇਰੋ ਬਸਿ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
632.t: maiee man mero bas naeh ||
632.e: O mother, my mind is out of control.

632.g: ਨਿਸ ਬਾਸੁਰ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ ਕਿਹਿ ਬਿਧਿ ਰੋਕਉ ਤਾਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
632.t: nis baasur bikhian kau dhaavat keh bidh rokau taeh ||1|| rahaau ||
632.e: Night and day, it runs after sin and corruption. How can I restrain it? ||1||Pause||

632.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਿਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਕੇ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੀਏ ਬਸਾਵੈ ॥
632.t: bedh puraan simirat ke mat sun nimakh na he'ee basaavai ||
632.e: He listens to the teachings of the Vedas, the Puraanas and the Simritees, but he does not enshrine them in his heart, even for an instant.

632.g: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਪਰ ਦਾਰਾ ਸਿਉ ਰਚਿਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਸਿਰਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
632.t: par dhan par dhaaraa siau rachio birathaa janam siraavai ||1||
632.e: Engrossed in the wealth and women of others, his life passes away uselessly. ||1||

632.g: ਮਦਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਭਇਓ ਬਾਵਰੋ ਸੂਝਤ ਨਹ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨਾ ॥
632.t: madh maiaa kai bhio baavaro soojhat neh kachh giaanaa ||
632.e: He has gone insane with the wine of Maya, and does not understand even a bit of spiritual wisdom.

632.g: ਘਟ ਹੀ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਬਸਤ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
632.t: ghaT hee bheetar basat nira(n)jan taa ko maram na jaanaa ||2||
632.e: Deep within his heart, the Immaculate Lord dwells, but he does not know this secret. ||2||

633.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਸਰਨਿ ਸਾਧ ਕੀ ਆਇਓ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਗਲ ਬਿਨਾਸੀ ॥
633.t: jab hee saran saadh kee aaio dhuramat sagal binaasee ||
633.e: When I came to the Sanctuary of the Holy Saints, all my evil-mindedness was dispelled.

633.g: ਤਬ ਨਾਨਕ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸੀ ॥੩॥੭॥
633.t: tab naanak chetio chi(n)taaman kaaTee jam kee faasee ||3||7||
633.e: Then, O Nanak, I remembered the Chintaamani, the jewel which fulfills all desires, and the noose of Death was snapped. ||3||7||

633.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
633.t: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
633.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

633.g: ਰੇ ਨਰ ਇਹ ਸਾਚੀ ਜੀਅ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
633.t: re nar ieh saachee jeea dhaar ||
633.e: O man, grasp this Truth firmly in your soul.

633.g: ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੁਪਨਾ ਬਿਨਸਤ ਲਗਤ ਨ ਬਾਰ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
633.t: sagal jagat hai jaise supanaa binasat lagat na baar ||1|| rahaau ||
633.e: The whole world is just like a dream; it will pass away in an instant. ||1||Pause||

633.g: ਬਾਰੂ ਭੀਤਿ ਬਨਾਈ ਰਚਿ ਪਚਿ ਰਹਤ ਨਹੀ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰਿ ॥
633.t: baaroo bheet banaiee rach pach rahat nahee dhin chaar ||
633.e: Like a wall of sand, built up and plastered with great care, which does not last even a few days,

633.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਇਹ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਉਰਝਿਓ ਕਹਾ ਗਵਾਰ ॥੧॥
633.t: taise hee ieh sukh maiaa ke urajhio kahaa gavaar ||1||
633.e: just so are the pleasures of Maya. Why are you entangled in them, you ignorant fool? ||1||

633.g: ਅਜਹੂ ਸਮਝਿ ਕਛੁ ਬਿਗਰਿਓ ਨਾਹਿਨਿ ਭਜਿ ਲੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ॥
633.t: ajahoo samajh kachh bigario naahin bhaj le naam muraar ||
633.e: Understand this today - it is not yet too late! Chant and vibrate the Name of the Lord.

633.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਜ ਮਤੁ ਸਾਧਨ ਕਉ ਭਾਖਿਓ ਤੋਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿ ॥੨॥੮॥
633.t: kahu naanak nij mat saadhan kau bhaakhio toh pukaar ||2||8||
633.e: Says Nanak, this is the subtle wisdom of the Holy Saints, which I proclaim out loud to you. ||2||8||

633.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
633.t: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
633.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

633.g: ਇਹ ਜਗਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਕੋਈ ॥
633.t: eeh jag meet na dhekhio koiee ||
633.e: In this world, I have not found any true friend.

633.g: ਸਗਲ ਜਗਤੁ ਅਪਨੈ ਸੁਖਿ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
633.t: sagal jagat apanai sukh laagio dhukh mai sa(n)g na hoiee ||1|| rahaau ||
633.e: The whole world is attached to its own pleasures, and when trouble comes, no one is with you. ||1||Pause||

633.g: ਦਾਰਾ ਮੀਤ ਪੂਤ ਸਨਬੰਧੀ ਸਗਰੇ ਧਨ ਸਿਉ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
633.t: dhaaraa meet poot sanaba(n)dhee sagare dhan siau laage ||
633.e: Wives, friends, children and relatives - all are attached to wealth.

633.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਨਿਰਧਨ ਦੇਖਿਓ ਨਰ ਕਉ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿ ਸਭ ਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥
633.t: jab hee niradhan dhekhio nar kau sa(n)g chhaadd sabh bhaage ||1||
633.e: When they see a poor man, they all forsake his company and run away. ||1||

633.g: ਕਹਂਉ ਕਹਾ ਯਿਆ ਮਨ ਬਉਰੇ ਕਉ ਇਨ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
633.t: kaha(n)au kahaa yiaa man baure kau in siau neh lagaio ||
633.e: So what should I say to this crazy mind, which is affectionately attached to them?

633.g: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥ ਸਕਲ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨ ਜਸੁ ਤਾ ਕੋ ਬਿਸਰਾਇਓ ॥੨॥
633.t: dheenaa naath sakal bhai bha(n)jan jas taa ko bisaraio ||2||
633.e: The Lord is the Master of the meek, the Destroyer of all fears, and I have forgotten to praise Him. ||2||

633.g: ਸੁਆਨ ਪੂਛ ਜਿਉ ਭਇਓ ਨ ਸੂਧਉ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਜਤਨੁ ਮੈ ਕੀਨਉ ॥
633.t: suaan poochh jiau bhio na soodhau bahut jatan mai keenau ||
633.e: Like a dog's tail, which will never straighten out, the mind will not change, no matter how many things are tried.

633.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਜ ਬਿਰਦ ਕੀ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੁਹਾਰਉ ਲੀਨਉ ॥੩॥੯॥
633.t: naanak laaj biradh kee raakhahu naam tuhaarau leenau ||3||9||
633.e: Says Nanak, please, Lord, uphold the honor of Your innate nature; I chant Your Name. ||3||9||

633.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
633.t: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
633.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

633.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਗਹਿਓ ਨ ਗੁਰ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ॥
633.t: man re gahio na gur upadhes ||
633.e: O mind, you have not accepted the Guru's Teachings.

633.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਜਉ ਮੂਡੁ ਮੁਡਾਇਓ ਭਗਵਉ ਕੀਨੋ ਭੇਸੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
633.t: kahaa bhio jau moodd muddaio bhagavau keeno bhes ||1|| rahaau ||
633.e: What is the use of shaving your head, and wearing saffron robes? ||1||Pause||

633.g: ਸਾਚ ਛਾਡਿ ਕੈ ਝੂਠਹ ਲਾਗਿਓ ਜਨਮੁ ਅਕਾਰਥੁ ਖੋਇਓ ॥
633.t: saach chhaadd kai jhooTheh laagio janam akaarath khoio ||
633.e: Abandoning Truth, you cling to falsehood; your life is uselessly wasting away.

633.g: ਕਰਿ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਉਦਰ ਨਿਜ ਪੋਖਿਓ ਪਸੁ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਸੋਇਓ ॥੧॥
633.t: kar parapa(n)ch udhar nij pokhio pas kee niaaiee soio ||1||
633.e: Practicing hypocrisy, you fill your belly, and then sleep like an animal. ||1||

633.g: ਰਾਮ ਭਜਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ॥
633.t: raam bhajan kee gat nahee jaanee maiaa haath bikaanaa ||
633.e: You do not know the Way of the Lord's meditation; you have sold yourself into Maya's hands.

633.g: ਉਰਝਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਬਿਖਿਅਨ ਸੰਗਿ ਬਉਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਬਿਸਰਾਨਾ ॥੨॥
633.t: aurajh rahio bikhian sa(n)g bauraa naam ratan bisaraanaa ||2||
633.e: The madman remains entangled in vice and corruption; he has forgotten the jewel of the Naam. ||2||

633.g: ਰਹਿਓ ਅਚੇਤੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਿਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਅਉਧ ਸਿਰਾਨੀ ॥
633.t: rahio achet na chetio gobi(n)dh birathaa aaudh siraanee ||
633.e: He remains thoughtless, not thinking of the Lord of the Universe; his life is uselessly passing away.

633.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਉ ਭੂਲੇ ਸਦਾ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੧੦॥
633.t: kahu naanak har biradh pachhaanau bhoole sadhaa paraanee ||3||10||
633.e: Says Nanak, O Lord, please, confirm your innate nature; this mortal is continually making mistakes. ||3||10||

633.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
633.t: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
633.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

633.g: ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਦੁਖ ਮੈ ਦੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
633.t: jo nar dhukh mai dhukh nahee maanai ||
633.e: That man, who in the midst of pain, does not feel pain,

633.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਨੇਹੁ ਅਰੁ ਭੈ ਨਹੀ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਮਾਟੀ ਮਾਨੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
633.t: sukh saneh ar bhai nahee jaa kai ka(n)chan maaTee maanai ||1|| rahaau ||
633.e: who is not affected by pleasure, affection or fear, and who looks alike upon gold and dust;||1||Pause||

633.g: ਨਹ ਨਿੰਦਿਆ ਨਹ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
633.t: neh ni(n)dhiaa neh usatat jaa kai lobh moh abhimaanaa ||
633.e: Who is not swayed by either slander or praise, nor affected by greed, attachment or pride;

633.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਆਰਉ ਨਾਹਿ ਮਾਨ ਅਪਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
633.t: harakh sog te rahai niaarau naeh maan apamaanaa ||1||
633.e: who remains unaffected by joy and sorrow, honor and dishonor;||1||

633.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਸਗਲ ਤਿਆਗੈ ਜਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥
633.t: aasaa manasaa sagal tiaagai jag te rahai niraasaa ||
633.e: who renounces all hopes and desires and remains desireless in the world;

633.g: ਕਾਮੁ ਕ੍ਰੋਧੁ ਜਿਹ ਪਰਸੈ ਨਾਹਨਿ ਤਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
633.t: kaam karodh jeh parasai naahan teh ghaT braham nivaasaa ||2||
633.e: who is not touched by sexual desire or anger - within his heart, God dwells. ||2||

633.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਜਿਹ ਨਰ ਕਉ ਕੀਨੀ ਤਿਹ ਇਹ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਪਛਾਨੀ ॥
633.t: gur kirapaa jeh nar kau keenee teh ieh jugat pachhaanee ||
633.e: That man, blessed by Guru's Grace, understands this way.

633.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਲੀਨ ਭਇਓ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਉ ਪਾਨੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੩॥੧੧॥
633.t: naanak leen bhio gobi(n)dh siau jiau paanee sa(n)g paanee ||3||11||
633.e: O Nanak, he merges with the Lord of the Universe, like water with water. ||3||11||

634.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੯ ॥
634.t: soraTh mahalaa nauvaa ||
634.e: Sorat'h, Ninth Mehla:

634.g: ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਜਾਨਿ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
634.t: preetam jaan leh man maahee ||
634.e: O dear friend, know this in your mind.

634.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੁਖ ਸਿਉ ਹੀ ਜਗੁ ਫਾਂਧਿਓ ਕੋ ਕਾਹੂ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
634.t: apane sukh siau hee jag faa(n)dhio ko kaahoo ko naahee ||1|| rahaau ||
634.e: The world is entangled in its own pleasures; no one is for anyone else. ||1||Pause||

634.g: ਸੁਖ ਮੈ ਆਨਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਮਿਲਿ ਬੈਠਤ ਰਹਤ ਚਹੂ ਦਿਸਿ ਘੇਰੈ ॥
634.t: sukh mai aan bahut mil baiThat rahat chahoo dhis gherai ||
634.e: In good times, many come and sit together, surrounding you on all four sides.

634.g: ਬਿਪਤਿ ਪਰੀ ਸਭ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੁ ਛਾਡਿਤ ਕੋਊ ਨ ਆਵਤ ਨੇਰੈ ॥੧॥
634.t: bipat paree sabh hee sa(n)g chhaaddit kouoo na aavat nerai ||1||
634.e: But when hard times come, they all leave, and no one comes near you. ||1||

634.g: ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਹਿਤੁ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਤ ਸੰਗ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
634.t: ghar kee naar bahut hit jaa siau sadhaa rahat sa(n)g laagee ||
634.e: Your wife, whom you love so much, and who has remained ever attached to you,

634.g: ਜਬ ਹੀ ਹੰਸ ਤਜੀ ਇਹ ਕਾਂਇਆ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਪ੍ਰੇਤ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
634.t: jab hee ha(n)s tajee ieh kaa(n)iaa pret pret kar bhaagee ||2||
634.e: runs away crying, ""Ghost! Ghost!"", as soon as the swan-soul leaves this body. ||2||

634.g: ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਬਿਉਹਾਰੁ ਬਨਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਾ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ਲਗਾਇਓ ॥
634.t: eeh bidh ko biauhaar banio hai jaa siau neh lagaio ||
634.e: This is the way they act - those whom we love so much.

634.g: ਅੰਤ ਬਾਰ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਕੋਊ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਇਓ ॥੩॥੧੨॥੧੩੯॥
634.t: a(n)t baar naanak bin har jee kouoo kaam na aaio ||3||12||139||
634.e: At the very last moment, O Nanak, no one is any use at all, except the Dear Lord. ||3||12||139||

634.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਅਸਟਪਦੀਆ ਚਉਤੁਕੀ
634.t: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa asaTapadheeaa chautukee
634.e: Sorat'h, First Mehla, First House, Ashtpadheeyaa, Chau-Thukay:

634.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
634.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
634.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

634.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਨ ਪੜਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰੁ ਨ ਪੂਜਉ ਮੜੈ ਮਸਾਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
634.t: dhubidhaa na paRau har bin hor na poojau maRai masaan na jaiee ||
634.e: I am not torn by duality, because I do not worship any other than the Lord; I do not visit tombs or crematoriums.

634.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਰਾਚਿ ਨ ਪਰ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਵਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
634.t: tirasanaa raach na par ghar jaavaa tirasanaa naam bujhaiee ||
634.e: I do not enter the houses of strangers, engrossed in desire. The Naam, the Name of the Lord, has satisfied my desires.

634.g: ਘਰ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਘਰੁ ਗੁਰੂ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਭਾਈ ॥
634.t: ghar bheetar ghar guroo dhikhaiaa sahaj rate man bhaiee ||
634.e: Deep within my heart, the Guru has shown me the home of my being, and my mind is imbued with peace and poise, O Siblings of Destiny.

634.g: ਤੂ ਆਪੇ ਦਾਨਾ ਆਪੇ ਬੀਨਾ ਤੂ ਦੇਵਹਿ ਮਤਿ ਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
634.t: too aape dhaanaa aape beenaa too dheveh mat saiee ||1||
634.e: You Yourself are all-knowing, and You Yourself are all-seeing; You alone bestow intelligence, O Lord. ||1||

634.g: ਮਨੁ ਬੈਰਾਗਿ ਰਤਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
634.t: man bairaag ratau bairaagee sabadh man bedhiaa meree maiee ||
634.e: My mind is detached, imbued with detachment; the Word of the Shabad has pierced my mind, O my mother.

634.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਸਿਉ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
634.t: a(n)tar jot nira(n)tar baanee saache saahib siau liv laiee || rahaau ||
634.e: God's Light shines continually within the nucleus of my deepest self; I am lovingly attached to the Bani, the Word of the True Lord Master. ||Pause||

634.g: ਅਸੰਖ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਕਹਹਿ ਬੈਰਾਗ ਸੋ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਜਿ ਖਸਮੈ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
634.t: asa(n)kh bairaagee kaheh bairaag so bairaagee j khasamai bhaavai ||
634.e: Countless detached renunciates talk of detachment and renunciation, but he alone is a true renunciate, who is pleasing to the Lord Master.

634.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਦਾ ਭੈ ਰਚਿਆ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
634.t: hiradhai sabadh sadhaa bhai rachiaa gur kee kaar kamaavai ||
634.e: The Word of the Shabad is ever in his heart; he is absorbed in the Fear of God, and he works to serve the Guru.

634.g: ਏਕੋ ਚੇਤੈ ਮਨੂਆ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਧਾਵਤੁ ਵਰਜਿ ਰਹਾਵੈ ॥
634.t: eko chetai manooaa na ddolai dhaavat varaj rahaavai ||
634.e: He remembers the One Lord, his mind does not waver, and he restrains its wanderings.

634.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਮਾਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
634.t: sahaje maataa sadhaa ra(n)g raataa saache ke gun gaavai ||2||
634.e: He is intoxicated with celestial bliss, and is ever imbued with the Lord's Love; he sings the Glorious Praises of the True Lord. ||2||

634.g: ਮਨੂਆ ਪਉਣੁ ਬਿੰਦੁ ਸੁਖਵਾਸੀ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਸੈ ਸੁਖ ਭਾਈ ॥
634.t: manooaa paun bi(n)dh sukhavaasee naam vasai sukh bhaiee ||
634.e: The mind is like the wind, but if it comes to rest in peace, even for an instant, then he shall abide in the peace of the Name, O Siblings of Destiny.

634.g: ਜਿਹਬਾ ਨੇਤ੍ਰ ਸੋਤ੍ਰ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ ਜਲਿ ਬੂਝੀ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
634.t: jihabaa netr sotr sach raate jal boojhee tujheh bujhaiee ||
634.e: His tongue, eyes and ears are imbued with Truth; O Lord, You quench the fires of desire.

634.g: ਆਸ ਨਿਰਾਸ ਰਹੈ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਤਾੜੀ ਲਾਈ ॥
634.t: aas niraas rahai bairaagee nij ghar taaRee laiee ||
634.e: In hope, the renunciate remains free of hopes; in the home of his own inner self, he is absorbed in the trance of deep meditation.

634.g: ਭਿਖਿਆ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਜੇ ਸੰਤੋਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਹਜਿ ਪੀਆਈ ॥੩॥
634.t: bhikhiaa naam raje sa(n)tokhee a(n)mrit sahaj peeaaiee ||3||
634.e: He remains content, satisfied with the charity of the Naam; he drinks in the Ambrosial Amrit with ease. ||3||

634.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਬੈਰਾਗੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੂਜੀ ਰਾਈ ॥
634.t: dhubidhaa vich bairaag na hovee jab lag dhoojee raiee ||
634.e: There is no renunciation in duality, as long as there is even a particle of duality.

634.g: ਸਭੁ ਜਗੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੂ ਏਕੋ ਦਾਤਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਈ ॥
634.t: sabh jag teraa too eko dhaataa avar na dhoojaa bhaiee ||
634.e: The whole world is Yours, Lord; You alone are the Giver. There is not any other, O Siblings of Destiny.

634.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜੰਤ ਦੁਖਿ ਸਦਾ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
634.t: manmukh ja(n)t dhukh sadhaa nivaasee gurmukh dhe vaddiaaiee ||
634.e: The self-willed manmukh dwells in misery forever, while the Lord bestows greatness upon the Gurmukh.

634.g: ਅਪਰ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਗੰਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਕਹਣੈ ਕੀਮ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੪॥
634.t: apar apaar aga(n)m agochar kahanai keem na paiee ||4||
634.e: God is infinite, endless, inaccessible and unfathomable; His worth cannot be described. ||4||

634.g: ਸੁੰਨ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਮਹਾ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਤੀਨਿ ਭਵਣ ਪਤਿ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
634.t: su(n)n samaadh mahaa paramaarath teen bhavan pat naama(n) ||
634.e: The consciousness in deep Samaadhi, the Supreme Being, the Lord of the three worlds - these are Your Names, Lord.

634.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਜੀਆ ਜਗਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਸਹਾਮੰ ॥
634.t: masatak lekh jeeaa jag jonee sir sir lekh sahaama(n) ||
634.e: The creatures born into this world have their destiny inscribed upon their foreheads; they experience according to their destinies.

634.g: ਕਰਮ ਸੁਕਰਮ ਕਰਾਏ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਭਗਤਿ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਮੰ ॥
634.t: karam sukaram karaae aape aape bhagat dhiraRaama(n) ||
634.e: The Lord Himself causes them to do good and bad deeds; He Himself makes them steadfast in devotional worship.

634.g: ਮਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਜੂਠਿ ਲਹੈ ਭੈ ਮਾਨੰ ਆਪੇ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਗਾਮੰ ॥੫॥
634.t: man mukh jooTh lahai bhai maana(n) aape giaan agaama(n) ||5||
634.e: The filth of their mind and mouth is washed off when they live in the Fear of God; the inaccessible Lord Himself blesses them with spiritual wisdom. ||5||

635.g: ਜਿਨ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੇਈ ਸਾਦੁ ਜਾਣਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਗੁੰਗੇ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥
635.t: jin chaakhiaa seiee saadh jaanan jiau gu(n)ge miThiaaiee ||
635.e: Only those who taste it know its sweet taste, like the mute, who eats the candy, and only smiles.

635.g: ਅਕਥੈ ਕਾ ਕਿਆ ਕਥੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਚਾਲਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਜਾਈ ॥
635.t: akathai kaa kiaa katheeaai bhaiee chaalau sadhaa rajaiee ||
635.e: How can I describe the indescribable, O Siblings of Destiny? I shall follow His Will forever.

635.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਦਾਤਾ ਮੇਲੇ ਤਾ ਮਤਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਨਿਗੁਰੇ ਮਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥
635.t: gur dhaataa mele taa mat hovai nigure mat na kaiee ||
635.e: If one meets with the Guru, the Generous Giver, then he understands; those who have no Guru cannot understand this.

635.g: ਜਿਉ ਚਲਾਏ ਤਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ ਭਾਈ ਹੋਰ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੬॥
635.t: jiau chalaae tiau chaaleh bhaiee hor kiaa ko kare chaturaiee ||6||
635.e: As the Lord causes us to act, so do we act, O Siblings of Destiny. What other clever tricks can anyone try? ||6||

635.g: ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਏ ਇਕਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਰਾਤੇ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
635.t: eik bharam bhulaae ik bhagatee raate teraa khel apaaraa ||
635.e: Some are deluded by doubt, while others are imbued with devotional worship; Your play is infinite and endless.

635.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਤੁਧੁ ਲਾਏ ਤੇਹਾ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੂ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਚਲਾਵਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
635.t: jit tudh laae tehaa fal paiaa too hukam chalaavanahaaraa ||
635.e: As You engage them, they receive the fruits of their rewards; You alone are the One who issues Your Commands.

635.g: ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੀ ਜੇ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਅਪਣਾ ਜੀਉ ਪਿੰਡੁ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ॥
635.t: sevaa karee je kichh hovai apanaa jeeau pi(n)dd tumaaraa ||
635.e: I would serve You, if anything were my own; my soul and body are Yours.

635.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਨੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰਾ ॥੭॥
635.t: satigur miliaai kirapaa keenee a(n)mirat naam adhaaraa ||7||
635.e: One who meets with the True Guru, by His Grace, takes the Support of the Ambrosial Naam. ||7||

635.g: ਗਗਨੰਤਰਿ ਵਾਸਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਗੁਣ ਮਹਿ ਗਿਆਨ ਧਿਆਨੰ ॥
635.t: gagana(n)tar vaasiaa gun paragaasiaa gun meh giaan dhiaana(n) ||
635.e: He dwells in the heavenly realms, and his virtues radiantly shine forth; meditation and spiritual wisdom are found in virtue.

635.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਕਹੈ ਕਹਾਵੈ ਤਤੋ ਤਤੁ ਵਖਾਨੰ ॥
635.t: naam man bhaavai kahai kahaavai tato tat vakhaana(n) ||
635.e: The Naam is pleasing to his mind; he speaks it, and causes others to speak it as well. He speaks the essential essence of wisdom.

635.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਗੁਰ ਪੀਰਾ ਗਹਿਰ ਗੰਭੀਰਾ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਜਗੁ ਬਉਰਾਨੰ ॥
635.t: sabadh gur peeraa gahir ga(n)bheeraa bin sabadhai jag bauraana(n) ||
635.e: The Word of the Shabad is his Guru and spiritual teacher, profound and unfathomable; without the Shabad, the world is insane.

635.g: ਪੂਰਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਗੀ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੰ ॥੮॥੧॥
635.t: pooraa bairaagee sahaj subhaagee sach naanak man maana(n) ||8||1||
635.e: He is a perfect renunciate, naturally at ease, O Nanak, whose mind is pleased with the True Lord. ||8||1||

635.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਤਿਤੁਕੀ ॥
635.t: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa titukee ||
635.e: Sorat'h, First Mehla, Thi-Thukay:

635.g: ਆਸਾ ਮਨਸਾ ਬੰਧਨੀ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਬੰਧਕਾਰੀ ॥
635.t: aasaa manasaa ba(n)dhanee bhaiee karam dharam ba(n)dhakaaree ||
635.e: Hope and desire are entrapments, O Siblings of Destiny. Religious rituals and ceremonies are traps.

635.g: ਪਾਪਿ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਜਗੁ ਜਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਬਿਨਸੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ॥
635.t: paap pu(n)n jag jaiaa bhaiee binasai naam visaaree ||
635.e: Because of good and bad deeds, one is born into the world, O Siblings of Destiny; forgetting the Naam, the Name of the Lord, he is ruined.

635.g: ਇਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਜਗਿ ਮੋਹਣੀ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮ ਸਭੇ ਵੇਕਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
635.t: eeh maiaa jag mohanee bhaiee karam sabhe vekaaree ||1||
635.e: This Maya is the enticer of the world, O Siblings of Destiny; all such actions are corrupt. ||1||

635.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਕਰਮਾ ਕਾਰੀ ॥
635.t: sun pa(n)ddit karamaa kaaree ||
635.e: Listen, O ritualistic Pandit:

635.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਕਰਮਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਸੁ ਆਤਮ ਤਤੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
635.t: jit karam sukh uoopajai bhaiee su aatam tat beechaaree || rahaau ||
635.e: that religious ritual which produces happiness, O Siblings of Destiny, is contemplation of the essence of the soul. ||Pause||

635.g: ਸਾਸਤੁ ਬੇਦੁ ਬਕੈ ਖੜੋ ਭਾਈ ਕਰਮ ਕਰਹੁ ਸੰਸਾਰੀ ॥
635.t: saasat bedh bakai khaRo bhaiee karam karahu sa(n)saaree ||
635.e: You may stand and recite the Shaastras and the Vedas, O Siblings of Destiny, but these are just worldly actions.

635.g: ਪਾਖੰਡਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਚੂਕਈ ਭਾਈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਵਿਕਾਰੀ ॥
635.t: paakha(n)dd mail na chookiee bhaiee a(n)tar mail vikaaree ||
635.e: Filth cannot be washed away by hypocrisy, O Siblings of Destiny; the filth of corruption and sin is within you.

635.g: ਇਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਡੂਬੀ ਮਾਕੁਰੀ ਭਾਈ ਊਂਡੀ ਸਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
635.t: ein bidh ddoobee maakuree bhaiee uoo(n)ddee sir kai bhaaree ||2||
635.e: This is how the spider is destroyed, O Siblings of Destiny, by falling head-long in its own web. ||2||

635.g: ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਘਣੀ ਵਿਗੂਤੀ ਭਾਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਈ ॥
635.t: dhuramat ghanee vigootee bhaiee dhoojai bhai khuaaiee ||
635.e: So many are destroyed by their own evil-mindedness, O Siblings of Destiny; in the love of duality, they are ruined.

635.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੈ ਭਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
635.t: bin satigur naam na paieeaai bhaiee bin naamai bharam na jaiee ||
635.e: Without the True Guru, the Name is not obtained, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Name, doubt does not depart.

635.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਭਾਈ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ਰਹਾਈ ॥੩॥
635.t: satigur seve taa sukh paae bhaiee aavan jaan rahaiee ||3||
635.e: If one serves the True Guru, then he obtains peace, O Siblings of Destiny; his comings and goings are ended. ||3||

635.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥
635.t: saach sahaj gur te uoopajai bhaiee man niramal saach samaiee ||
635.e: True celestial peace comes from the Guru, O Siblings of Destiny; the immaculate mind is absorbed into the True Lord.

635.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵੇ ਸੋ ਬੂਝੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਮਗੁ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
635.t: gur seve so boojhai bhaiee gur bin mag na paiee ||
635.e: One who serves the Guru, understands, O Siblings of Destiny; without the Guru, the way is not found.

635.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਕਿ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਭਾਈ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੪॥
635.t: jis a(n)tar lobh k karam kamaavai bhaiee kooR bol bikh khaiee ||4||
635.e: What can anyone do, with greed within? O Siblings of Destiny, by telling lies, they eat poison. ||4||

635.g: ਪੰਡਿਤ ਦਹੀ ਵਿਲੋਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਤਥੁ ॥
635.t: pa(n)ddit dhahee viloieeaai bhaiee vichahu nikalai tath ||
635.e: O Pandit, by churning cream, butter is produced.

635.g: ਜਲੁ ਮਥੀਐ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਏਹਾ ਵਥੁ ॥
635.t: jal matheeaai jal dhekheeaai bhaiee ih jag ehaa vath ||
635.e: By churning water, you shall only see water, O Siblings of Destiny; this world is like that.

635.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਵਿਗੂਚੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਦੇਉ ਅਲਖੁ ॥੫॥
635.t: gur bin bharam vigoocheeaai bhaiee ghaT ghaT dheau alakh ||5||
635.e: Without the Guru, he is ruined by doubt, O Siblings of Destiny; the unseen Divine Lord is in each and every heart. ||5||

635.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਤਾਗੋ ਸੂਤ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਦਹ ਦਿਸ ਬਾਧੋ ਮਾਇ ॥
635.t: eih jag taago soot ko bhaiee dheh dhis baadho mai ||
635.e: This world is like a thread of cotton, O Siblings of Destiny, which Maya has tied on all ten sides.

635.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਾਠਿ ਨ ਛੂਟਈ ਭਾਈ ਥਾਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
635.t: bin gur gaaTh na chhooTiee bhaiee thaake karam kamai ||
635.e: Without the Guru, the knots cannot be untied, O Siblings of Destiny; I am so tired of religious rituals.

635.g: ਇਹੁ ਜਗੁ ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਕਹਣਾ ਕਿਛੂ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੬॥
635.t: eih jag bharam bhulaiaa bhaiee kahanaa kichhoo na jai ||6||
635.e: This world is deluded by doubt, O Siblings of Destiny; no one can say anything about it. ||6||

635.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਭੈ ਮਰਣਾ ਸਚੁ ਲੇਖੁ ॥
635.t: gur miliaai bhau man vasai bhaiee bhai maranaa sach lekh ||
635.e: Meeting with the Guru, the Fear of God comes to abide in the mind; to die in the Fear of God is one's true destiny.

635.g: ਮਜਨੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਚੰਗਿਆਈਆ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਗਹ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥
635.t: majan dhaan cha(n)giaaieeaa bhaiee dharageh naam visekh ||
635.e: In the Court of the Lord, the Naam is far superior to ritualistic cleansing baths, charity and good deeds, O Siblings of Destiny.

636.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਚੂਕਾ ਭੇਖੁ ॥੭॥
636.t: gur a(n)kas jin naam dhiraRaiaa bhaiee man vasiaa chookaa bhekh ||7||
636.e: One who implants the Naam within himself, through the Guru's halter - O Siblings of Destiny, the Lord dwells in his mind, and he is free of hypocrisy. ||7||

636.g: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹਾਟੁ ਸਰਾਫ ਕੋ ਭਾਈ ਵਖਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ॥
636.t: eih tan haaT saraaf ko bhaiee vakhar naam apaar ||
636.e: This body is the jeweller's shop, O Siblings of Destiny; the incomparable Naam is the merchandise.

636.g: ਇਹੁ ਵਖਰੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਸੋ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੈ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
636.t: eih vakhar vaapaaree so dhiraRai bhaiee gur sabadh kare veechaar ||
636.e: The merchant secures this merchandise, O Siblings of Destiny, by contemplating the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

636.g: ਧਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਭਾਈ ਮੇਲਿ ਕਰੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੁ ॥੮॥੨॥
636.t: dhan vaapaaree naanakaa bhaiee mel kare vaapaar ||8||2||
636.e: Blessed is the merchant, O Nanak, who meets the Guru, and engages in this trade. ||8||2||

636.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
636.t: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa ||
636.e: Sorat'h, First Mehla:

636.g: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਿਨੑ ਕੇ ਸਾਥ ਤਰੇ ॥
636.t: jin(h)ee satigur seviaa piaare tin(h) ke saath tare ||
636.e: Those who serve the True Guru, O Beloved, their companions are saved as well.

636.g: ਤਿਨੑਾ ਠਾਕ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸਨ ਹਰੇ ॥
636.t: tin(h)aa Thaak na paieeaai piaare a(n)mirat rasan hare ||
636.e: No one blocks their way, O Beloved, and the Lord's Ambrosial Nectar is on their tongue.

636.g: ਬੂਡੇ ਭਾਰੇ ਭੈ ਬਿਨਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਤਾਰੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੧॥
636.t: boodde bhaare bhai binaa piaare taare nadhar kare ||1||
636.e: Without the Fear of God, they are so heavy that they sink and drown, O Beloved; but the Lord, casting His Glance of Grace, carries them across. ||1||

636.g: ਭੀ ਤੂਹੈ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਭੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਲਾਹ ॥
636.t: bhee toohai saalaahanaa piaare bhee teree saalaeh ||
636.e: I ever praise You, O Beloved, I ever sing Your Praises.

636.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਬੋਹਿਥ ਭੈ ਡੁਬੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੰਧੀ ਪਾਇ ਕਹਾਹ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
636.t: vin bohith bhai ddubeeaai piaare ka(n)dhee pai kahaeh ||1|| rahaau ||
636.e: Without the boat, one is drowned in the sea of fear, O Beloved; how can I reach the distant shore? ||1||Pause||

636.g: ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਾਲਾਹਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
636.t: saalaahee saalaahanaa piaare dhoojaa avar na koi ||
636.e: I praise the Praiseworthy Lord, O Beloved; there is no other one to praise.

636.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਲਾਹਨਿ ਸੇ ਭਲੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਰੰਗੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
636.t: mere prabh saalaahan se bhale piaare sabadh rate ra(n)g hoi ||
636.e: Those who praise my God are good, O Beloved; they are imbued with the Word of the Shabad, and His Love.

636.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਜੇ ਮਿਲੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਰਸੁ ਲੈ ਤਤੁ ਵਿਲੋਇ ॥੨॥
636.t: tis kee sa(n)gat je milai piaare ras lai tat viloi ||2||
636.e: If I join them, O Beloved, I can churn the essence and so find joy. ||2||

636.g: ਪਤਿ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ਸਾਚ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਚਾ ਨੀਸਾਣੁ ॥
636.t: pat paravaanaa saach kaa piaare naam sachaa neesaan ||
636.e: The gateway to honor is Truth, O Beloved; it bears the Insignia of the True Name of the Lord.

636.g: ਆਇਆ ਲਿਖਿ ਲੈ ਜਾਵਣਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣੁ ॥
636.t: aaiaa likh lai jaavanaa piaare hukamee hukam pachhaan ||
636.e: We come into the world, and we depart, with our destiny written and pre-ordained, O Beloved; realize the Command of the Commander.

636.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚੇ ਸਾਚਾ ਤਾਣੁ ॥੩॥
636.t: gur bin hukam na boojheeaai piaare saache saachaa taan ||3||
636.e: Without the Guru, this Command is not understood, O Beloved; True is the Power of the True Lord. ||3||

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਨਿੰਮਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੈ ਉਦਰ ਮਝਾਰਿ ॥
636.t: hukamai a(n)dhar ni(n)miaa piaare hukamai udhar majhaar ||
636.e: By His Command, we are conceived, O Beloved, and by His Command, we grow in the womb.

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਜੰਮਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਊਧਉ ਸਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਰਿ ॥
636.t: hukamai a(n)dhar ja(n)miaa piaare uoodhau sir kai bhaar ||
636.e: By His Command, we are born, O Beloved, head-first, and upside-down.

636.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਜਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਚਲੈ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਾਰਿ ॥੪॥
636.t: gurmukh dharageh jaaneeaai piaare chalai kaaraj saar ||4||
636.e: The Gurmukh is honored in the Court of the Lord, O Beloved; he departs after resolving his affairs. ||4||

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਆਇਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਜਾਦੋ ਜਾਇ ॥
636.t: hukamai a(n)dhar aaiaa piaare hukame jaadho jai ||
636.e: By His Command, one comes into the world, O Beloved, and by His Will, he goes.

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਬੰਨਿੑ ਚਲਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਲਹੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥
636.t: hukame ba(n)ni(h) chalaieeaai piaare manmukh lahai sajai ||
636.e: By His Will, some are bound and gagged and driven away, O Beloved; the self-willed manmukhs suffer their punishment.

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਣੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਦਰਗਹ ਪੈਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੫॥
636.t: hukame sabadh pachhaaneeaai piaare dharageh paidhaa jai ||5||
636.e: By His Command, the Word of the Shabad, is realized, O Beloved, and one goes to the Court of the Lord robed in honor. ||5||

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਗਣਤ ਗਣਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹੁਕਮੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੋਇ ॥
636.t: hukame ganat ganaieeaai piaare hukame haumai dhoi ||
636.e: By His Command, some accounts are accounted for, O Beloved; by His Command, some suffer in egotism and duality.

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੇ ਭਵੈ ਭਵਾਈਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਅਵਗਣਿ ਮੁਠੀ ਰੋਇ ॥
636.t: hukame bhavai bhavaieeaai piaare avagan muThee roi ||
636.e: By His Command, one wanders in reincarnation, O Beloved; deceived by sins and demerits, he cries out in his suffering.

636.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਸਾਹ ਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹੋਇ ॥੬॥
636.t: hukam sin(j)aapai saeh kaa piaare sach milai vaddiaaiee hoi ||6||
636.e: If he comes to realize the Command of the Lord's Will, O Beloved, then he is blessed with Truth and Honor. ||6||

636.g: ਆਖਣਿ ਅਉਖਾ ਆਖੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕਿਉ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਉ ॥
636.t: aakhan aaukhaa aakheeaai piaare kiau suneeaai sach naau ||
636.e: It is so difficult to speak it, O Beloved; how can we speak, and hear, the True Name?

636.g: ਜਿਨੑੀ ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹਿਆ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਉ ਤਿਨੑ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥
636.t: jin(h)ee so saalaahiaa piaare hau tin(h) balihaarai jaau ||
636.e: I am a sacrifice to those who praise the Lord, O Beloved.

636.g: ਨਾਉ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੰਤੋਖੀਆਂ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਦਰੀ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਉ ॥੭॥
636.t: naau milai sa(n)tokheeaa(n) piaare nadharee mel milaau ||7||
636.e: I have obtained the Name, and I am satisfied, O Beloved; by His Grace, I am united in His Union. ||7||

636.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਕਾਗਦੁ ਜੇ ਥੀਐ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਮਨੁ ਮਸਵਾਣੀ ਧਾਰਿ ॥
636.t: kaiaa kaagadh je theeaai piaare man masavaanee dhaar ||
636.e: If my body were to become the paper, O Beloved, and my mind the inkpot;

636.g: ਲਲਤਾ ਲੇਖਣਿ ਸਚ ਕੀ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਲਿਖਹੁ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ॥
636.t: lalataa lekhan sach kee piaare har gun likhahu veechaar ||
636.e: and if my tongue became the pen, O Beloved, I would write, and contemplate, the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.

636.g: ਧਨੁ ਲੇਖਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਾਚੁ ਲਿਖੈ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ॥੮॥੩॥
636.t: dhan lekhaaree naanakaa piaare saach likhai ur dhaar ||8||3||
636.e: Blessed is that scribe, O Nanak, who writes the True Name, and enshrines it within his heart. ||8||3||

636.g: ਸੋਰਠਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਪਹਿਲਾ ਦੁਤੁਕੀ ॥
636.t: soraTh mahalaa pehilaa pahilaa dhutukee ||
636.e: Sorat'h, First Mehla, Dho-Thukay:

636.g: ਤੂ ਗੁਣਦਾਤੌ ਨਿਰਮਲੋ ਭਾਈ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਨਾ ਮਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
636.t: too gunadhaatau niramalo bhaiee niramal naa man hoi ||
636.e: You are the Giver of virtue, O Immaculate Lord, but my mind is not immaculate, O Siblings of Destiny.

636.g: ਹਮ ਅਪਰਾਧੀ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੇ ਭਾਈ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਤੇ ਗੁਣੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
636.t: ham aparaadhee niragune bhaiee tujh hee te gun soi ||1||
636.e: I am a worthless sinner, O Siblings of Destiny; virtue is obtained from You alone, Lord. ||1||

636.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮਾ ਤੂ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੁ ॥
636.t: mere preetamaa too karataa kar vekh ||
636.e: O my Beloved Creator Lord, You create, and You behold.

636.g: ਹਉ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਖੰਡੀਆ ਭਾਈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਸੇਖੁ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
636.t: hau paapee paakha(n)ddeeaa bhaiee man tan naam visekh || rahaau ||
636.e: I am a hypocritical sinner, O Siblings of Destiny. Bless my mind and body with Your Name, O Lord. ||Pause||

637.g: ਬਿਖੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਚਿਤੁ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਭਾਈ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਇ ॥
637.t: bikh maiaa chit mohiaa bhaiee chaturaiee pat khoi ||
637.e: The poisonous Maya has enticed the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny; through clever tricks, one loses his honor.

637.g: ਚਿਤ ਮਹਿ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਸਚਿ ਵਸੈ ਭਾਈ ਜੇ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਮੋਇ ॥੨॥
637.t: chit meh Thaakur sach vasai bhaiee je gur giaan samoi ||2||
637.e: The True Lord and Master abides in the consciousness, O Siblings of Destiny, if the Guru's spiritual wisdom permeates it. ||2||

637.g: ਰੂੜੌ ਰੂੜੌ ਆਖੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਰੂੜੌ ਲਾਲ ਚਲੂਲੁ ॥
637.t: rooRau rooRau aakheeaai bhaiee rooRau laal chalool ||
637.e: Beautiful, beautiful, the Lord is called, O Siblings of Destiny; beautiful, like the deep crimson color of the poppy.

637.g: ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਬੈਰਾਗੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਅਭੂਲੁ ॥੩॥
637.t: je man har siau bairaageeaai bhaiee dhar ghar saach abhool ||3||
637.e: If man loves the Lord with detachment, O Siblings of Destiny, he is judged to be true and infallible in the Lord's court and home. ||3||

637.g: ਪਾਤਾਲੀ ਆਕਾਸਿ ਤੂ ਭਾਈ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਤੂ ਗੁਣ ਗਿਆਨੁ ॥
637.t: paataalee aakaas too bhaiee ghar ghar too gun giaan ||
637.e: You are pervading the realms of the underworld and the heavenly skies; Your wisdom and glories are in each and every heart.

637.g: ਗੁਰ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਭਾਈ ਚੂਕਾ ਮਨਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨੁ ॥੪॥
637.t: gur miliaai sukh paiaa bhaiee chookaa manahu gumaan ||4||
637.e: Meeting with the Guru, one finds peace, O Siblings of Destiny, and pride is dispelled from the mind. ||4||

637.g: ਜਲਿ ਮਲਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਾਜੀਐ ਭਾਈ ਭੀ ਮੈਲਾ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
637.t: jal mal kaiaa maajeeaai bhaiee bhee mailaa tan hoi ||
637.e: Scrubbing with water, the body can be cleaned, O Siblings of Destiny, but the body becomes dirty again.

637.g: ਗਿਆਨਿ ਮਹਾ ਰਸਿ ਨਾਈਐ ਭਾਈ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥੫॥
637.t: giaan mahaa ras naieeaai bhaiee man tan niramal hoi ||5||
