647.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਵਿਸਾਰਿਆ ਦੂਜੈ ਲਗਾ ਜਾਇ ॥
647.t: naam nidhaan visaariaa dhoojai lagaa jai ||
647.e: He has forgotten the treasure of the Naam; he is caught in the love of duality.

647.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਹਿ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਜੇ ਆਪੇ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
647.t: naanak gurmukh mileh vaddiaaieeaa je aape mel milai ||2||
647.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukhs are honored with glory, when the Lord Himself unites them in His Union. ||2||

647.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
647.t: pauRee ||
647.e: Pauree:

647.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵੈ ਖਰੀ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੀ ॥
647.t: har rasanaa har jas gaavai kharee suhaavanee ||
647.e: The tongue which sings the Lord's Praises, is so very beautiful.

647.g: ਜੋ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੈ ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵਣੀ ॥
647.t: jo man tan mukh har bolai saa har bhaavanee ||
647.e: One who speaks the Lord's Name, with mind, body and mouth, is pleasing to the Lord.

647.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਚਖੈ ਸਾਦੁ ਸਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਵਣੀ ॥
647.t: jo gurmukh chakhai saadh saa tirapataavanee ||
647.e: That Gurmukh tastes the the sublime taste of the Lord, and is satisfied.

647.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਵਣੀ ॥
647.t: gun gaavai piaare nit gun gai gunee samajhaavanee ||
647.e: She sings continually the Glorious Praises of her Beloved; singing His Glorious Praises, she is uplifted.

647.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਆਪਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਸਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਗੁਰੂ ਬੁਲਾਵਣੀ ॥੧੩॥
647.t: jis hovai aap dhiaal saa satiguroo guroo bulaavanee ||13||
647.e: She is blessed with the Lord's Mercy, and she chants the Words of the Guru, the True Guru. ||13||

647.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
647.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
647.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

647.g: ਹਸਤੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਜਿਉ ਅੰਕਸੁ ਹੈ ਅਹਰਣਿ ਜਿਉ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੇਇ ॥
647.t: hasatee sir jiau a(n)kas hai aharan jiau sir dhei ||
647.e: The elephant offers its head to the reins, and the anvil offers itself to the hammer;

647.g: ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਆਗੈ ਰਾਖਿ ਕੈ ਊਭੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
647.t: man tan aagai raakh kai uoobhee sev karei ||
647.e: just so, we offer our minds and bodies to our Guru; we stand before Him, and serve Him.

648.g: ਇਉ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਆਪੁ ਨਿਵਾਰੀਐ ਸਭੁ ਰਾਜੁ ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਕਾ ਲੇਇ ॥
648.t: eiau gurmukh aap nivaareeaai sabh raaj sirasaT kaa lei ||
648.e: This is how the Gurmukhs eliminate their self-conceit, and come to rule the whole world.

648.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਬੁਝੀਐ ਜਾ ਆਪੇ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇਇ ॥੧॥
648.t: naanak gurmukh bujheeaai jaa aape nadhar karei ||1||
648.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh understands, when the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||1||

648.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
648.e: Third Mehla:

648.g: ਜਿਨ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਆਏ ਤੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
648.t: jin gurmukh naam dhiaaiaa aae te paravaan ||
648.e: Blessed and approved is the coming into the world, of those Gurmukhs who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

648.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਕੁਲ ਉਧਾਰਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਦਰਗਹ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
648.t: naanak kul udhaareh aapanaa dharageh paaveh maan ||2||
648.e: O Nanak, they save their families, and they are honored in the Court of the Lord. ||2||

648.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
648.t: pauRee ||
648.e: Pauree:

648.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਖੀਆ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਮੇਲਾਈਆ ॥
648.t: gurmukh sakheeaa sikh guroo melaieeaa ||
648.e: The Guru unites His Sikhs, the Gurmukhs, with the Lord.

648.g: ਇਕਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਾਸਿ ਇਕਿ ਗੁਰਿ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਾਈਆ ॥
648.t: eik sevak gur paas ik gur kaarai laieeaa ||
648.e: The Guru keeps some of them with Himself, and engages others in His Service.

648.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਾਉ ਗੁਰੂ ਦੇਵਾਈਆ ॥
648.t: jinaa gur piaaraa man chit tinaa bhaau guroo dhevaieeaa ||
648.e: Those who cherish their Beloved in their conscious minds, the Guru blesses them with His Love.

648.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਿਖਾ ਇਕੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ਗੁਰ ਮਿਤਾ ਪੁਤਾ ਭਾਈਆ ॥
648.t: gur sikhaa iko piaar gur mitaa putaa bhaieeaa ||
648.e: The Guru loves all of His Gursikhs equally well, like friends, children and siblings.

648.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਸਭਿ ਗੁਰੁ ਆਖਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਜੀਵਾਈਆ ॥੧੪॥
648.t: gur satigur bolahu sabh gur aakh guroo jeevaieeaa ||14||
648.e: So chant the Name of the Guru, the True Guru, everyone! Chanting the Name of the Guru, Guru, you shall be rejuvenated. ||14||

648.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
648.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
648.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

648.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਚੇਤਨੀ ਅਗਿਆਨੀ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਅਵਰੇ ਕਰਮ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
648.t: naanak naam na chetanee agiaanee a(n)dhule avare karam kamaeh ||
648.e: O Nanak, the blind, ignorant fools do not remember the Naam, the Name of the Lord; they involve themselves in other activities.

648.g: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਵਿਸਟਾ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਚਾਹਿ ॥੧॥
648.t: jam dhar badhe maare'eh fir visaTaa maeh pachaeh ||1||
648.e: They are bound and gagged at the door of the Messenger of Death; they are punished, and in the end, they rot away in manure. ||1||

648.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
648.e: Third Mehla:

648.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਆਪਣਾ ਸੇ ਜਨ ਸਚੇ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ॥
648.t: naanak satigur seveh aapanaa se jan sache paravaan ||
648.e: O Nanak, those humble beings are true and approved, who serve their True Guru.

648.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਇ ਸਮਾਇ ਰਹੇ ਚੂਕਾ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥੨॥
648.t: har kai nai samai rahe chookaa aavan jaan ||2||
648.e: They remain absorbed in the Name of the Lord, and their comings and goings cease. ||2||

648.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
648.t: pauRee ||
648.e: Pauree:

648.g: ਧਨੁ ਸੰਪੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਚੀਐ ਅੰਤੇ ਦੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
648.t: dhan sa(n)pai maiaa sa(n)cheeaai a(n)te dhukhadhaiee ||
648.e: Gathering the wealth and property of Maya, brings only pain in the end.

648.g: ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਸਵਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
648.t: ghar ma(n)dhar mahal savaare'eh kichh saath na jaiee ||
648.e: Homes, mansions and adorned palaces will not go with anyone.

648.g: ਹਰ ਰੰਗੀ ਤੁਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਪਾਲੀਅਹਿ ਕਿਤੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
648.t: har ra(n)gee ture nit paale'eeh kitai kaam na aaiee ||
648.e: He may breed horses of various colors, but these will not be of any use to him.

648.g: ਜਨ ਲਾਵਹੁ ਚਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਉ ਅੰਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
648.t: jan laavahu chit har naam siau a(n)t hoi sakhaiee ||
648.e: O human, link your consciousness to the Lord's Name, and in the end, it shall be your companion and helper.

648.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੧੫॥
648.t: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa gurmukh sukh paiee ||15||
648.e: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Gurmukh is blessed with peace. ||15||

648.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
648.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
648.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

648.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਕਰਮੈ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੂਰੈ ਕਰਮਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
648.t: bin karamai naau na paieeaai poorai karam paiaa jai ||
648.e: Without the karma of good actions, the Name is not obtained; it can be obtained only by perfect good karma.

648.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
648.t: naanak nadhar kare je aapanee taa gurmat mel milai ||1||
648.e: O Nanak, if the Lord casts His Glance of Grace, then under Guru's Instruction, one is united in His Union. ||1||

648.t: mahalaa pehilaa ||
648.e: First Mehla:

648.g: ਇਕ ਦਝਹਿ ਇਕ ਦਬੀਅਹਿ ਇਕਨਾ ਕੁਤੇ ਖਾਹਿ ॥
648.t: eik dhajheh ik dhabe'eeh ikanaa kute khaeh ||
648.e: Some are cremated, and some are buried; some are eaten by dogs.

648.g: ਇਕਿ ਪਾਣੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਉਸਟੀਅਹਿ ਇਕਿ ਭੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਸਣਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
648.t: eik paanee vich usaTe'eeh ik bhee fir hasan paeh ||
648.e: Some are thrown into water, while others are thrown into wells.

648.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਏਵ ਨ ਜਾਪਈ ਕਿਥੈ ਜਾਇ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
648.t: naanak ev na jaapiee kithai jai samaeh ||2||
648.e: O Nanak, it is not known, where they go and into what they merge. ||2||

648.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
648.t: pauRee ||
648.e: Pauree:

648.g: ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਖਾਧਾ ਪੈਧਾ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਭੁ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਤੇ ॥
648.t: tin kaa khaadhaa paidhaa maiaa sabh pavit hai jo naam har raate ||
648.e: The food and clothes, and all the worldly possessions of those who are attuned to the Lord's Name are sacred.

648.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਘਰ ਮੰਦਰ ਮਹਲ ਸਰਾਈ ਸਭਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਅਭਿਆਗਤ ਜਾਇ ਵਰਸਾਤੇ ॥
648.t: tin ke ghar ma(n)dhar mahal saraiee sabh pavit heh jinee gurmukh sevak sikh abhiaagat jai varasaate ||
648.e: All the homes, temples, palaces and way-stations are sacred, where the Gurmukhs, the selfless servants, the Sikhs and the renouncers of the world, go and take their rest.

648.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਤੁਰੇ ਜੀਨ ਖੁਰਗੀਰ ਸਭਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖ ਸਾਧ ਸੰਤ ਚੜਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥
648.t: tin ke ture jeen khurageer sabh pavit heh jinee gurmukh sikh saadh sa(n)t chaR jaate ||
648.e: All the horses, saddles and horse blankets are sacred, upon which the Gurmukhs, the Sikhs, the Holy and the Saints, mount and ride.

648.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਕਾਰਜ ਸਭਿ ਪਵਿਤੁ ਹਹਿ ਜੋ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਸਾਤੇ ॥
648.t: tin ke karam dharam kaaraj sabh pavit heh jo boleh har har raam naam har saate ||
648.e: All the rituals and Dharmic practices and deeds are sacred, for those who utter the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, the True Name of the Lord.

648.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੈ ਪੋਤੈ ਪੁੰਨੁ ਹੈ ਸੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖ ਗੁਰੂ ਪਹਿ ਜਾਤੇ ॥੧੬॥
648.t: jin kai potai pu(n)n hai se gurmukh sikh guroo peh jaate ||16||
648.e: Those Gurmukhs, those Sikhs, who have purity as their treasure, go to their Guru. ||16||

648.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
648.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
648.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

648.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਵਹੁ ਘੁਥਿਆ ਹਲਤੁ ਪਲਤੁ ਸਭੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
648.t: naanak naavahu ghuthiaa halat palat sabh jai ||
648.e: O Nanak, forsaking the Name, he loses everything, in this world and the next.

648.g: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸੰਜਮੁ ਸਭੁ ਹਿਰਿ ਲਇਆ ਮੁਠੀ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
648.t: jap tap sa(n)jam sabh hir liaa muThee dhoojai bhai ||
648.e: Chanting, deep meditation and austere self-disciplined practices are all wasted; he is deceived by the love of duality.

648.g: ਜਮ ਦਰਿ ਬਧੇ ਮਾਰੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੀ ਮਿਲੈ ਸਜਾਇ ॥੧॥
648.t: jam dhar badhe maare'eh bahutee milai sajai ||1||
648.e: He is bound and gagged at the door of the Messenger of Death. He is beaten, and receives terrible punishment. ||1||

649.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
649.e: Third Mehla:

649.g: ਸੰਤਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਵੈਰੁ ਕਮਾਵਦੇ ਦੁਸਟਾ ਨਾਲਿ ਮੋਹੁ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
649.t: sa(n)taa naal vair kamaavadhe dhusaTaa naal moh piaar ||
649.e: They inflict their hatred upon the Saints, and they love the wicked sinners.

649.g: ਅਗੈ ਪਿਛੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਨਹੀ ਮਰਿ ਜੰਮਹਿ ਵਾਰੋ ਵਾਰ ॥
649.t: agai pichhai sukh nahee mar ja(n)meh vaaro vaar ||
649.e: They find no peace in either this world or the next; they are born only to die, again and again.

649.g: ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਬੁਝਈ ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
649.t: tirasanaa kadhe na bujhiee dhubidhaa hoi khuaar ||
649.e: Their hunger is never satisfied, and they are ruined by duality.

649.g: ਮੁਹ ਕਾਲੇ ਤਿਨਾ ਨਿੰਦਕਾ ਤਿਤੁ ਸਚੈ ਦਰਬਾਰਿ ॥
649.t: muh kaale tinaa ni(n)dhakaa tit sachai dharabaar ||
649.e: The faces of these slanderers are blackened in the Court of the True Lord.

649.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣਿਆ ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
649.t: naanak naam vihooniaa naa uravaar na paar ||2||
649.e: O Nanak, without the Naam, they find no shelter on either this shore, or the one beyond. ||2||

649.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
649.t: pauRee ||
649.e: Pauree:

649.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
649.t: jo har naam dhiaaidhe se har har naam rate man maahee ||
649.e: Those who meditate on the Lord's Name, are imbued with the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, in their minds.

649.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਮਨਿ ਚਿਤਿ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨਾ ਇਕਸ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
649.t: jinaa man chit ik araadhiaa tinaa ikas bin dhoojaa ko naahee ||
649.e: For those who worship the One Lord in their conscious minds, there is no other than the One Lord.

649.g: ਸੇਈ ਪੁਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਦੇ ਜਿਨ ਧੁਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲੇਖੁ ਲਿਖਾਹੀ ॥
649.t: seiee purakh har sevadhe jin dhur masatak lekh likhaahee ||
649.e: They alone serve the Lord, upon whose foreheads such pre-ordained destiny is written.

649.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਸਮਝਾਹੀ ॥
649.t: har ke gun nit gaavadhe har gun gai gunee samajhaahee ||
649.e: They continually sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and singing the Glories of the Glorious Lord, they are uplifted.

649.g: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਵਡੀ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਗੁਰ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧੭॥
649.t: vaddiaaiee vaddee gurmukhaa gur poorai har naam samaahee ||17||
649.e: Great is the greatness of the Gurmukhs, who, through the Perfect Guru, remain absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||17||

649.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
649.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
649.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

649.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗਾਖੜੀ ਸਿਰੁ ਦੀਜੈ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
649.t: satigur kee sevaa gaakhaRee sir dheejai aap gavai ||
649.e: It is very difficult to serve the True Guru; offer your head, and eradicate self-conceit.

649.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਨਾ ਮਰਹਿ ਤਾ ਸੇਵਾ ਪਵੈ ਸਭ ਥਾਇ ॥
649.t: sabadh mareh fir naa mareh taa sevaa pavai sabh thai ||
649.e: One who dies in the Word of the Shabad shall never have to die again; his service is totally approved.

649.g: ਪਾਰਸ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
649.t: paaras parasiaai paaras hovai sach rahai liv lai ||
649.e: Touching the philosopher's stone, one becomes the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold; remain lovingly attached to the True Lord.

649.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਇ ॥
649.t: jis poorab hovai likhiaa tis satigur milai prabh aai ||
649.e: One who has such pre-ordained destiny, comes to meet the True Guru and God.

649.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗਣਤੈ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਬਖਸੇ ਸੋ ਪਵੈ ਥਾਇ ॥੧॥
649.t: naanak ganatai sevak naa milai jis bakhase so pavai thai ||1||
649.e: O Nanak, the Lord's servant does not meet Him because of his own account; he alone is acceptable, whom the Lord forgives. ||1||

649.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
649.e: Third Mehla:

649.g: ਮਹਲੁ ਕੁਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਨੀ ਮੂਰਖ ਅਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ॥
649.t: mahal kumahal na jaananee moorakh apanai suaai ||
649.e: The fools do not know the difference between good and bad; they are deceived by their self-interests.

649.g: ਸਬਦੁ ਚੀਨਹਿ ਤਾ ਮਹਲੁ ਲਹਹਿ ਜੋਤੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
649.t: sabadh cheeneh taa mahal laheh jotee jot samai ||
649.e: But if they contemplate the Word of the Shabad, they obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence, and their light merges in the Light.

649.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਚੇ ਕਾ ਭਉ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਤਾ ਸਭਾ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਇ ॥
649.t: sadhaa sache kaa bhau man vasai taa sabhaa sojhee pai ||
649.e: The Fear of God is always on their minds, and so they come to understand everything.

649.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਅਪਣੈ ਘਰਿ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
649.t: satigur apanai ghar varatadhaa aape le milai ||
649.e: The True Guru is pervading the homes within; He Himself blends them with the Lord.

649.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਸਭ ਪੂਰੀ ਪਈ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਰਜਾਇ ॥੨॥
649.t: naanak satigur miliaai sabh pooree piee jis no kirapaa kare rajai ||2||
649.e: O Nanak, they meet the True Guru, and all their desires are fulfilled, if the Lord grants His Grace and so wills. ||2||

649.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
649.t: pauRee ||
649.e: Pauree:

649.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਕਹਤਿਆ ॥
649.t: dha(n)n dhan bhaag tinaa bhagat janaa jo har naamaa har mukh kahatiaa ||
649.e: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those devotees, who, with their mouths, utter the Name of the Lord.

649.g: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣਤਿਆ ॥
649.t: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa sa(n)t janaa jo har jas sravanee sunatiaa ||
649.e: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Saints, who, with their ears, listen to the Lord's Praises.

649.g: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਗਾਇ ਗੁਣੀ ਜਨ ਬਣਤਿਆ ॥
649.t: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa saadh janaa har keeratan gai gunee jan banatiaa ||
649.e: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those holy people, who sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and so become virtuous.

649.g: ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਭਾਗ ਤਿਨਾ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਲੈ ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਤਿਆ ॥
649.t: dhan dhan bhaag tinaa gurmukhaa jo gursikh lai man jinatiaa ||
649.e: Blessed, blessed is the good fortune of those Gurmukhs, who live as Gursikhs, and conquer their minds.

649.g: ਸਭ ਦੂ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਗੁਰਸਿਖਾ ਕੇ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਸਿਖ ਪੜਤਿਆ ॥੧੮॥
649.t: sabh dhoo vadde bhaag gursikhaa ke jo gur charanee sikh paRatiaa ||18||
649.e: But the greatest good fortune of all, is that of the Guru's Sikhs, who fall at the Guru's feet. ||18||

649.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
649.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
649.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

649.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਬਿੰਦੈ ਤਿਸ ਦਾ ਬ੍ਰਹਮਤੁ ਰਹੈ ਏਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
649.t: braham bi(n)dhai tis dhaa brahamat rahai ek sabadh liv lai ||
649.e: One who knows God, and who lovingly focuses his attention on the One Word of the Shabad, keeps his spirituality intact.

649.g: ਨਵ ਨਿਧੀ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਿਧੀ ਪਿਛੈ ਲਗੀਆ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦਾ ਵਸਾਇ ॥
649.t: nav nidhee aThaareh sidhee pichhai lageeaa fireh jo har hiradhai sadhaa vasai ||
649.e: The nine treasures and the eighteen spiritual powers of the Siddhas follow him, who keeps the Lord enshrined in his heart.

649.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਨਾਉ ਨ ਪਾਈਐ ਬੁਝਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
649.t: bin satigur naau na paieeaai bujhahu kar veechaar ||
649.e: Without the True Guru, the Name is not found; understand this, and reflect upon it.

649.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਜੁਗ ਚਾਰਿ ॥੧॥
649.t: naanak poorai bhaag satigur milai sukh paae jug chaar ||1||
649.e: O Nanak, through perfect good destiny, one meets the True Guru, and finds peace, throughout the four ages. ||1||

649.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
649.e: Third Mehla:

649.g: ਕਿਆ ਗਭਰੂ ਕਿਆ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
649.t: kiaa gabharoo kiaa biradh hai manmukh tirasanaa bhukh na jai ||
649.e: Whether he is young or old, the self-willed manmukh cannot escape hunger and thirst.

649.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਬਦੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਸੀਤਲੁ ਹੋਏ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥
649.t: gurmukh sabadhe ratiaa seetal hoe aap gavai ||
649.e: The Gurmukhs are imbued with the Word of the Shabad; they are at peace, having lost their self-conceit.

649.g: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਸੰਤੋਖਿਆ ਫਿਰਿ ਭੁਖ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
649.t: a(n)dhar tirapat sa(n)tokhiaa fir bhukh na lagai aai ||
649.e: They are satisfied and satiated within; they never feel hungry again.

650.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸੋ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਹੈ ਜੋ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
650.t: naanak j gurmukh kareh so paravaan hai jo naam rahe liv lai ||2||
650.e: O Nanak, whatever the Gurmukhs do is acceptable; they remain lovingly absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||2||

650.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
650.t: pauRee ||
650.e: Pauree:

650.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਕੰਉ ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਿਖਾ ॥
650.t: hau balihaaree ti(n)n ka(n)au jo gurmukh sikhaa ||
650.e: I am a sacrifice to those Sikhs who are Gurmukhs.

650.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਿਖਾ ॥
650.t: jo har naam dhiaaidhe tin dharasan pikhaa ||
650.e: I behold the Blessed Vision, the Darshan of those who meditate on the Lord's Name.

650.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਲਿਖਾ ॥
650.t: sun keeratan har gun ravaa har jas man likhaa ||
650.e: Listening to the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, I contemplate His virtues; I write His Praises on the fabric of my mind.

650.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀ ਰੰਗ ਸਿਉ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਕ੍ਰਿਖਾ ॥
650.t: har naam salaahee ra(n)g siau sabh kilavikh kirakhaa ||
650.e: I praise the Lord's Name with love, and eradicate all my sins.

650.g: ਧਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਸੋ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਥਾਨੁ ਹੈ ਜਿਥੈ ਮੇਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਧਰੇ ਵਿਖਾ ॥੧੯॥
650.t: dhan dha(n)n suhaavaa so sareer thaan hai jithai meraa gur dhare vikhaa ||19||
650.e: Blessed, blessed and beauteous is that body and place, where my Guru places His feet. ||19||

650.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
650.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
650.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

650.g: ਗੁਰ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਨਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥
650.t: gur bin giaan na hoviee naa sukh vasai man aai ||
650.e: Without the Guru, spiritual wisdom is not obtained, and peace does not come to abide in the mind.

650.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਹੂਣੇ ਮਨਮੁਖੀ ਜਾਸਨਿ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇ ॥੧॥
650.t: naanak naam vihoone manmukhee jaasan janam gavai ||1||
650.e: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the self-willed manmukhs depart, after having wasted their lives. ||1||

650.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
650.e: Third Mehla:

650.g: ਸਿਧ ਸਾਧਿਕ ਨਾਵੈ ਨੋ ਸਭਿ ਖੋਜਦੇ ਥਕਿ ਰਹੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
650.t: sidh saadhik naavai no sabh khojadhe thak rahe liv lai ||
650.e: All the Siddhas, spiritual masters and seekers search for the Name; they have grown weary of concentrating and focusing their attention.

650.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥
650.t: bin satigur kinai na paio gurmukh milai milai ||
650.e: Without the True Guru, no one finds the Name; the Gurmukhs unite in Union with the Lord.

650.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਪੈਨਣੁ ਖਾਣੁ ਸਭੁ ਬਾਦਿ ਹੈ ਧਿਗੁ ਸਿਧੀ ਧਿਗੁ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ॥
650.t: bin naavai painan khaan sabh baadh hai dhig sidhee dhig karamaat ||
650.e: Without the Name, all food and clothes are worthless; cursed is such spirituality, and cursed are such miraculous powers.

650.g: ਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਸਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ਹੈ ਅਚਿੰਤੁ ਕਰੇ ਜਿਸੁ ਦਾਤਿ ॥
650.t: saa sidh saa karamaat hai achi(n)t kare jis dhaat ||
650.e: That alone is spirituality, and that alone is miraculous power, which the Carefree Lord spontaneously bestows.

650.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਵਸੈ ਏਹਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਏਹਾ ਕਰਮਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
650.t: naanak gurmukh har naam man vasai ehaa sidh ehaa karamaat ||2||
650.e: O Nanak, the Lord's Name abides in the mind of the Gurmukh; this is spirituality, and this is miraculous power. ||2||

650.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
650.t: pauRee ||
650.e: Pauree:

650.g: ਹਮ ਢਾਢੀ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਖਸਮ ਕੇ ਨਿਤ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਛੰਤਾ ॥
650.t: ham ddaaddee har prabh khasam ke nit gaaveh har gun chha(n)taa ||
650.e: I am a minstrel of God, my Lord and Master; every day, I sing the songs of the Lord's Glorious Praises.

650.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਕਰਹ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਣਹ ਤਿਸੁ ਕਵਲਾ ਕੰਤਾ ॥
650.t: har keeratan kareh har jas suneh tis kavalaa ka(n)taa ||
650.e: I sing the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises, and I listen to the Praises of the Lord, the Master of wealth and Maya.

650.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਤਾ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਭਿਖਾਰੀਆ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
650.t: har dhaataa sabh jagat bhikhaareeaa ma(n)gat jan ja(n)taa ||
650.e: The Lord is the Great Giver; all the world is begging; all beings and creatures are beggars.

650.g: ਹਰਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਹੋਇ ਵਿਚਿ ਪਾਥਰ ਕ੍ਰਿਮ ਜੰਤਾ ॥
650.t: har dhevahu dhaan dhiaal hoi vich paathar kiram ja(n)taa ||
650.e: O Lord, You are kind and compassionate; You give Your gifts to even worms and insects among the rocks.

650.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਧਨਵੰਤਾ ॥੨੦॥
650.t: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa gurmukh dhanava(n)taa ||20||
650.e: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; as Gurmukh, he has become truly wealthy. ||20||

650.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
650.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
650.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

650.g: ਪੜਣਾ ਗੁੜਣਾ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਕੀ ਕਾਰ ਹੈ ਅੰਦਰਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਵਿਕਾਰੁ ॥
650.t: paRanaa guRanaa sa(n)saar kee kaar hai a(n)dhar tirasanaa vikaar ||
650.e: Reading and studying are just worldly pursuits, if there is thirst and corruption within.

650.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭਿ ਪੜਿ ਥਕੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
650.t: haumai vich sabh paR thake dhoojai bhai khuaar ||
650.e: Reading in egotism, all have grown weary; through the love of duality, they are ruined.

650.g: ਸੋ ਪੜਿਆ ਸੋ ਪੰਡਿਤੁ ਬੀਨਾ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
650.t: so paRiaa so pa(n)ddit beenaa gur sabadh kare veechaar ||
650.e: He alone is educated, and he alone is a wise Pandit, who contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

650.g: ਅੰਦਰੁ ਖੋਜੈ ਤਤੁ ਲਹੈ ਪਾਏ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰੁ ॥
650.t: a(n)dhar khojai tat lahai paae mokh dhuaar ||
650.e: He searches within himself, and finds the true essence; he finds the Door of Salvation.

650.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਕਰੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
650.t: gun nidhaan har paiaa sahaj kare veechaar ||
650.e: He finds the Lord, the treasure of excellence, and peacefully contemplates Him.

650.g: ਧੰਨੁ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
650.t: dha(n)n vaapaaree naanakaa jis gurmukh naam adhaar ||1||
650.e: Blessed is the trader, O Nanak, who, as Gurmukh, takes the Name as his only Support. ||1||

650.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
650.e: Third Mehla:

650.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੇ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਸਿਝਈ ਵੇਖਹੁ ਕੋ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
650.t: vin man maare koi na sijhiee vekhahu ko liv lai ||
650.e: Without conquering his mind, no one can be successful. See this, and concentrate on it.

650.g: ਭੇਖਧਾਰੀ ਤੀਰਥੀ ਭਵਿ ਥਕੇ ਨਾ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
650.t: bhekhadhaaree teerathee bhav thake naa eh man maariaa jai ||
650.e: The wandering holy men are tired of of making pilgrimages to sacred shrines; they have not been able to conquer their minds.

650.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਏਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਸਚਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
650.t: gurmukh eh man jeevat marai sach rahai liv lai ||
650.e: The Gurmukh has conquered his mind, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the True Lord.

650.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਲੁ ਇਉ ਉਤਰੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
650.t: naanak is man kee mal iau utarai haumai sabadh jalai ||2||
650.e: O Nanak, this is how the filth of the mind is removed; the Word of the Shabad burns away the ego. ||2||

650.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
650.t: pauRee ||
650.e: Pauree:

650.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤ ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵਹੁ ਇਕ ਕਿਨਕਾ ॥
650.t: har har sa(n)t milahu mere bhaiee har naam dhiraRaavahu ik kinakaa ||
650.e: O Saints of the Lord, O my Siblings of Destiny, please meet with me, and implant the Name of the One Lord within me.

650.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਬਨਾਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਹਰਿ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਪਹਿਰਹੁ ਖਿਮ ਕਾ ॥
650.t: har har seegaar banaavahu har jan har kaapaR pahirahu khim kaa ||
650.e: O humble servants of the Lord, adorn me with the decorations of the Lord, Har, Har; let me wear the robes of the Lord's forgiveness.

650.g: ਐਸਾ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਗੈ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਿਮ ਕਾ ॥
650.t: aaisaa seegaar mere prabh bhaavai har laagai piaaraa piram kaa ||
650.e: Such decorations are pleasing to my God; such love is dear to the Lord.

650.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਬਿਖ ਕਾਟੈ ਇਕ ਪਲਕਾ ॥
650.t: har har naam bolahu dhin raatee sabh kilabikh kaaTai ik palakaa ||
650.e: I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night; in an instant, all sins are eradicated.

650.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਉਪਰਿ ਸੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਿਣਕਾ ॥੨੧॥
650.t: har har dhiaal hovai jis upar so gurmukh har jap jinakaa ||21||
650.e: That Gurmukh, unto whom the Lord becomes merciful, chants the Lord's Name, and wins the game of life. ||21||

651.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
651.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
651.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

651.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੀ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕਉ ਮਲੁ ਲਾਗੀ ਕਾਲਾ ਹੋਆ ਸਿਆਹੁ ॥
651.t: janam janam kee is man kau mal laagee kaalaa hoaa siaahu ||
651.e: The filth of countless incarnations sticks to this mind; it has become pitch black.

651.g: ਖੰਨਲੀ ਧੋਤੀ ਉਜਲੀ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਸਉ ਧੋਵਣਿ ਪਾਹੁ ॥
651.t: kha(n)nalee dhotee ujalee na hoviee je sau dhovan paahu ||
651.e: The oily rag cannot be cleaned by merely washing it, even if it is washed a hundred times.

651.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜੀਵਤੁ ਮਰੈ ਉਲਟੀ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਤਿ ਬਦਲਾਹੁ ॥
651.t: gur parasaadhee jeevat marai ulaTee hovai mat badhalaahu ||
651.e: By Guru's Grace, one remains dead while yet alive; his intellect is transformed, and he becomes detached from the world.

651.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਲਗਈ ਨਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਹੁ ॥੧॥
651.t: naanak mail na lagiee naa fir jonee paahu ||1||
651.e: O Nanak, no filth sticks to him, and he does not fall into the womb again. ||1||

651.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
651.e: Third Mehla:

651.g: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗੀ ਕਲਿ ਕਾਲੀ ਕਾਂਢੀ ਇਕ ਉਤਮ ਪਦਵੀ ਇਸੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
651.t: chahu jugee kal kaalee kaa(n)ddee ik utam padhavee is jug maeh ||
651.e: Kali Yuga is called the Dark Age, but the most sublime state is attained in this age.

651.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖਿ ਪਾਹਿ ॥
651.t: gurmukh har keerat fal paieeaai jin kau har likh paeh ||
651.e: The Gurmukh obtains the fruit, the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises; this is his destiny, ordained by the Lord.

651.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
651.t: naanak gur parasaadhee anadhin bhagat har uchareh har bhagatee maeh samaeh ||2||
651.e: O Nanak, by Guru's Grace, he worships the Lord night and day; he chants the Lord's Name, and remains absorbed in the Lord's devotional worship. ||2||

651.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
651.t: pauRee ||
651.e: Pauree:

651.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੁਖਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਲੀ ਬਾਣਿ ॥
651.t: har har mel saadh jan sa(n)gat mukh bolee har har bhalee baan ||
651.e: O Lord, unite me with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, so that with my mouth, I may speak the sublime Word of the Guru's Bani.

651.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਤ ਚਵਾ ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਸਦਾ ਮਾਣਿ ॥
651.t: har gun gaavaa har nit chavaa gurmatee har ra(n)g sadhaa maan ||
651.e: I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, and constantly chant the Lord's Name; through the Guru's Teachings, I enjoy the Lord's Love constantly.

651.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਜਪਿ ਅਉਖਧ ਖਾਧਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਰੋਗ ਗਵਾਤੇ ਦੁਖਾ ਘਾਣਿ ॥
651.t: har jap jap aaukhadh khaadhiaa sabh rog gavaate dhukhaa ghaan ||
651.e: I take the medicine of meditation on the Lord's Name, which has cured all diseases and multitudes of sufferings.

651.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਨ ਵਿਸਰੈ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਹੀ ਜਾਣਿ ॥
651.t: jinaa saas giraas na visarai se har jan poore sahee jaan ||
651.e: Those who do not forget the Lord, while breathing or eating - know them to be the perfect servants of the Lord.

651.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹਰਿ ਆਰਾਧਦੇ ਤਿਨ ਚੂਕੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਜਗਤ ਕਾਣਿ ॥੨੨॥
651.t: jo gurmukh har aaraadhadhe tin chookee jam kee jagat kaan ||22||
651.e: Those Gurmukhs who worship the Lord in adoration end their subservience to the Messenger of Death, and to the world. ||22||

651.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
651.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
651.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

651.g: ਰੇ ਜਨ ਉਥਾਰੈ ਦਬਿਓਹੁ ਸੁਤਿਆ ਗਈ ਵਿਹਾਇ ॥
651.t: re jan uthaarai dhabioh sutiaa giee vihai ||
651.e: O man, you have been tormented by a nightmare, and you have passed your life in sleep.

651.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸੁਣਿ ਨ ਜਾਗਿਓ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਚਾਉ ॥
651.t: satigur kaa sabadh sun na jaagio a(n)tar na upajio chaau ||
651.e: You did not wake to hear the Word of the True Guru's Shabad; you have no inspiration within yourself.

651.g: ਸਰੀਰੁ ਜਲਉ ਗੁਣ ਬਾਹਰਾ ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕਾਰ ਨ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
651.t: sareer jalau gun baaharaa jo gur kaar na kamai ||
651.e: That body burns, which has no virtue, and which does not serve the Guru.

651.g: ਜਗਤੁ ਜਲੰਦਾ ਡਿਠੁ ਮੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ॥
651.t: jagat jala(n)dhaa ddiTh mai haumai dhoojai bhai ||
651.e: I have seen that the world is burning, in egotism and the love of duality.

651.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਉਬਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਮਨਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਧਿਆਇ ॥੧॥
651.t: naanak gur saranaiee ubare sach man sabadh dhiaai ||1||
651.e: O Nanak, those who seek the Guru's Sanctuary are saved; within their minds, they meditate on the True Word of the Shabad. ||1||

651.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
651.e: Third Mehla:

651.g: ਸਬਦਿ ਰਤੇ ਹਉਮੈ ਗਈ ਸੋਭਾਵੰਤੀ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
651.t: sabadh rate haumai giee sobhaava(n)tee naar ||
651.e: Attuned to the Word of the Shabad, the soul-bride is rid of egotism, and she is glorified.

651.g: ਪਿਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਸਦਾ ਚਲੈ ਤਾ ਬਨਿਆ ਸੀਗਾਰੁ ॥
651.t: pir kai bhaanai sadhaa chalai taa baniaa seegaar ||
651.e: If she walks steadily in the way of His Will, then she is adorned with decorations.

651.g: ਸੇਜ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਦਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਰਾਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਵਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
651.t: sej suhaavee sadhaa pir raavai har var paiaa naar ||
651.e: Her couch becomes beautiful, and she constantly enjoys her Husband Lord; she obtains the Lord as her Husband.

651.g: ਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਰੈ ਨ ਕਦੇ ਦੁਖੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ॥
651.t: naa har marai na kadhe dhukh laagai sadhaa suhaagan naar ||
651.e: The Lord does not die, and she never suffers pain; she is a happy soul-bride forever.

651.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਮੇਲਿ ਲਈ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਹੇਤਿ ਪਿਆਰਿ ॥੨॥
651.t: naanak har prabh mel liee gur kai het piaar ||2||
651.e: O Nanak, the Lord God unites her with Himself; she enshrines love and affection for the Guru. ||2||

651.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
651.t: pauRee ||
651.e: Pauree:

651.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਗੋਪਿਆ ਆਪਣਾ ਤੇ ਨਰ ਬੁਰਿਆਰੀ ॥
651.t: jinaa gur gopiaa aapanaa te nar buriaaree ||
651.e: Those who conceal and deny their Guru, are the most evil people.

651.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਨਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪਾਪਿਸਟ ਹਤਿਆਰੀ ॥
651.t: har jeeau tin kaa dharasan naa karahu paapisaT hatiaaree ||
651.e: O Dear Lord, let me not even see them; they are the worst sinners and murderers.

651.g: ਓਹਿ ਘਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਫਿਰਹਿ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਮਨਿ ਜਿਉ ਧਰਕਟ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
651.t: oh ghar ghar fireh kusudh man jiau dharakaT naaree ||
651.e: They wander from house to house, with impure minds, like wicked, forsaken women.

651.g: ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੇ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
651.t: vaddabhaagee sa(n)gat mile gurmukh savaaree ||
651.e: But by great good fortune, they may meet the Company of the Holy; as Gurmukhs, they are reformed.

651.g: ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨੩॥
651.t: har melahu satigur dhiaa kar gur kau balihaaree ||23||
651.e: O Lord, please be kind and let me meet the True Guru; I am a sacrifice to the Guru. ||23||

651.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
651.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
651.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

651.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੁਖੁ ਨ ਲਗੈ ਆਇ ॥
651.t: gur sevaa te sukh uoopajai fir dhukh na lagai aai ||
651.e: Serving the Guru, peace is produced, and then, one does not suffer in pain.

651.g: ਜੰਮਣੁ ਮਰਣਾ ਮਿਟਿ ਗਇਆ ਕਾਲੈ ਕਾ ਕਿਛੁ ਨ ਬਸਾਇ ॥
651.t: ja(n)man maranaa miT giaa kaalai kaa kichh na basai ||
651.e: The cycle of birth and death is brought to an end, and death has no power over at all.

651.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੇਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਰਵਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਚੇ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
651.t: har setee man rav rahiaa sache rahiaa samai ||
651.e: His mind is imbued with the Lord, and he remains merged in the True Lord.

651.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਹਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੀ ਤਿੰਨ ਕਉ ਜੋ ਚਲਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਭਾਇ ॥੧॥
651.t: naanak hau balihaaree ti(n)n kau jo chalan satigur bhai ||1||
651.e: O Nanak, I am a sacrifice to those who walk in the Way of the True Guru's Will. ||1||

651.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
651.e: Third Mehla:

651.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਸਬਦੈ ਸੁਧੁ ਨ ਹੋਵਈ ਜੇ ਅਨੇਕ ਕਰੈ ਸੀਗਾਰ ॥
651.t: bin sabadhai sudh na hoviee je anek karai seegaar ||
651.e: Without the Word of the Shabad, purity is not obtained, even though the soul-bride may adorn herself with all sorts of decorations.

652.g: ਪਿਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਰ ਨ ਜਾਣਈ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
652.t: pir kee saar na jaaniee dhoojai bhai piaar ||
652.e: She does not know the value of her Husband Lord; she is attached to the love of duality.

652.g: ਸਾ ਕੁਸੁਧ ਸਾ ਕੁਲਖਣੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਰੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਕੁਨਾਰਿ ॥੨॥
652.t: saa kusudh saa kulakhanee naanak naaree vich kunaar ||2||
652.e: She is impure, and ill-mannered, O Nanak; among women, she is the most evil woman. ||2||

652.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
652.t: pauRee ||
652.e: Pauree:

652.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲੀ ਬੈਣੀ ॥
652.t: har har apanee dhiaa kar har bolee bainee ||
652.e: Be kind to me, Lord, that I might chant the Word of Your Bani.

652.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਹਾ ਲੈਣੀ ॥
652.t: har naam dhiaaiee har ucharaa har laahaa lainee ||
652.e: May I meditate on the Lord's Name, chant the Lord's Name, and obtain the profit of the Lord's Name.

652.g: ਜੋ ਜਪਦੇ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਤਿਨ ਹਉ ਕੁਰਬੈਣੀ ॥
652.t: jo japadhe har har dhinas raat tin hau kurabainee ||
652.e: I am a sacrifice to those who chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, day and night.

652.g: ਜਿਨਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ਅਰਾਧਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਾ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
652.t: jinaa satigur meraa piaaraa araadhiaa tin jan dhekhaa nainee ||
652.e: May I behold with my eyes those who worship and adore my Beloved True Guru.

652.g: ਹਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ਅਪਣੇ ਗੁਰੂ ਕਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਸਜਣੁ ਮੇਲਿਆ ਸੈਣੀ ॥੨੪॥
652.t: hau vaariaa apane guroo kau jin meraa har sajan meliaa sainee ||24||
652.e: I am a sacrifice to my Guru, who has united me with my Lord, my friend, my very best friend. ||24||

652.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
652.t: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
652.e: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

652.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੋ ਮਿਤੁ ॥
652.t: har dhaasan siau preet hai har dhaasan ko mit ||
652.e: The Lord loves His slaves; the Lord is the friend of His slaves.

652.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਜਿਉ ਜੰਤੀ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਜੰਤੁ ॥
652.t: har dhaasan kai vas hai jiau ja(n)tee kai vas ja(n)t ||
652.e: The Lord is under the control of His slaves, like the musical instrument under the control of the musician.

652.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਦਾਸ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਸਿਉ ਨੇਹੁ ॥
652.t: har ke dhaas har dhiaaidhe kar preetam siau neh ||
652.e: The Lord's slaves meditate on the Lord; they love their Beloved.

652.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਭ ਜਗ ਮਹਿ ਵਰਸੈ ਮੇਹੁ ॥
652.t: kirapaa kar kai sunahu prabh sabh jag meh varasai meh ||
652.e: Please, hear me, O God - let Your Grace rain over the whole world.

652.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਕੀ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਹੈ ਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
652.t: jo har dhaasan kee usatat hai saa har kee vaddiaaiee ||
652.e: The praise of the Lord's slaves is the Glory of the Lord.

652.g: ਹਰਿ ਆਪਣੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਭਾਵਦੀ ਜਨ ਕਾ ਜੈਕਾਰੁ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
652.t: har aapanee vaddiaaiee bhaavadhee jan kaa jaikaar karaiee ||
652.e: The Lord loves His Own Glory, and so His humble servant is celebrated and hailed.

652.g: ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਇਕ ਸਮਾਨਿ ॥
652.t: so har jan naam dhiaaidhaa har har jan ik samaan ||
652.e: That humble servant of the Lord meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord; the Lord, and the Lord's humble servant, are one and the same.

652.g: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਪੈਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਭਗਵਾਨ ॥੧॥
652.t: jan naanak har kaa dhaas hai har paij rakhahu bhagavaan ||1||
652.e: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; O Lord, O God, please, preserve his honor. ||1||

652.t: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
652.e: Fourth Mehla:

652.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਈ ਤਿਨਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
652.t: naanak preet laiee tin saachai tis bin rahan na jaiee ||
652.e: Nanak loves the True Lord; without Him, he cannot even survive.

652.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਤ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਈ ॥੨॥
652.t: satigur milai ta pooraa paieeaai har ras rasan rasaiee ||2||
652.e: Meeting the True Guru, one finds the Perfect Lord, and the tongue enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord. ||2||

652.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
652.t: pauRee ||
652.e: Pauree:

652.g: ਰੈਣਿ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਪਰਭਾਤਿ ਤੂਹੈ ਹੀ ਗਾਵਣਾ ॥
652.t: rain dhinas parabhaat toohai hee gaavanaa ||
652.e: Night and day, morning and night, I sing to You, Lord.

652.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਰਬਤ ਨਾਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਧਿਆਵਣਾ ॥
652.t: jeea ja(n)t sarabat naau teraa dhiaavanaa ||
652.e: All beings and creatures meditate on Your Name.

652.g: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦਿਤਾ ਖਾਵਣਾ ॥
652.t: too dhaataa dhaataar teraa dhitaa khaavanaa ||
652.e: You are the Giver, the Great Giver; we eat whatever You give us.

652.g: ਭਗਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਪਾਪ ਗਵਾਵਣਾ ॥
652.t: bhagat janaa kai sa(n)g paap gavaavanaa ||
652.e: In the congregation of the devotees, sins are eradicated.

652.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਵਣਾ ॥੨੫॥
652.t: jan naanak sadh balihaarai bal bal jaavanaa ||25||
652.e: Servant Nanak is forever a sacrifice, a sacrifice, a sacrifice, O Lord. ||25||

652.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
652.t: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
652.e: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

652.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਅਗਿਆਨੁ ਭਈ ਮਤਿ ਮਧਿਮ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
652.t: a(n)tar agiaan bhiee mat madhim satigur kee parateet naahee ||
652.e: He has spiritual ignorance within, and his intellect is dull and dim; he does not place his faith in the True Guru.

652.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਕਪਟੁ ਸਭੁ ਕਪਟੋ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਣੈ ਕਪਟੇ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਹੀ ॥
652.t: a(n)dhar kapaT sabh kapaTo kar jaanai kapaTe khapeh khapaahee ||
652.e: He has deceit within himself, and so he sees deception in all others; through his deceptions, he is totally ruined.

652.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਭਾਣਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਆਪਣੈ ਸੁਆਇ ਫਿਰਾਹੀ ॥
652.t: satigur kaa bhaanaa chit na aavai aapanai suaai firaahee ||
652.e: The True Guru's Will does not enter into his consciousness, and so he wanders around, pursuing his own interests.

652.g: ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਜੇ ਆਪਣੀ ਤਾ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥
652.t: kirapaa kare je aapanee taa naanak sabadh samaahee ||1||
652.e: If He grants His Grace, then Nanak is absorbed into the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

652.t: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
652.e: Fourth Mehla:

652.g: ਮਨਮੁਖ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹਿ ਵਿਆਪੇ ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਮਨੂਆ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
652.t: manmukh maiaa moh viaape dhoojai bhai manooaa thir naeh ||
652.e: The self-willed manmukhs are engrossed in emotional attachment to Maya; in the love of duality, their minds are unsteady.

652.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਲਤ ਰਹਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਉਮੈ ਖਪਹਿ ਖਪਾਹਿ ॥
652.t: anadhin jalat raheh dhin raatee haumai khapeh khapaeh ||
652.e: Night and day, they are burning; day and night, they are totally ruined by their egotism.

652.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਲੋਭੁ ਮਹਾ ਗੁਬਾਰਾ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਨਿਕਟਿ ਨ ਕੋਈ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
652.t: a(n)tar lobh mahaa gubaaraa tin kai nikaT na koiee jaeh ||
652.e: Within them, is the total pitch darkness of greed, and no one even approaches them.

652.g: ਓਇ ਆਪਿ ਦੁਖੀ ਸੁਖੁ ਕਬਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਮਰਹਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਹਿ ॥
652.t: oi aap dhukhee sukh kabahoo na paaveh janam mareh mar jaeh ||
652.e: They themselves are miserable, and they never find peace; they are born, only to die, and die again.

652.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਬਖਸਿ ਲਏ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਜਿ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨੀ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਹਿ ॥੨॥
652.t: naanak bakhas le prabh saachaa j gur charanee chit laeh ||2||
652.e: O Nanak, the True Lord God forgives those, who focus their consciousness on the Guru's feet. ||2||

652.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
652.t: pauRee ||
652.e: Pauree:

652.g: ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਪਰਵਾਣੁ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਭਾਇਆ ॥
652.t: sa(n)t bhagat paravaan jo prabh bhaiaa ||
652.e: That Saint, that devotee, is acceptable, who is loved by God.

652.g: ਸੇਈ ਬਿਚਖਣ ਜੰਤ ਜਿਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
652.t: seiee bichakhan ja(n)t jinee har dhiaaiaa ||
652.e: Those beings are wise, who meditate on the Lord.

652.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
652.t: a(n)mrit naam nidhaan bhojan khaiaa ||
652.e: They eat the food, the treasure of the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord.

652.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
652.t: sa(n)t janaa kee dhoor masatak laiaa ||
652.e: They apply the dust of the feet of the Saints to their foreheads.

653.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਏ ਪੁਨੀਤ ਹਰਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਇਆ ॥੨੬॥
653.t: naanak bhe puneet har teerath naiaa ||26||
653.e: O Nanak, they are purified, bathing in the sacred shrine of the Lord. ||26||

653.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੪ ॥
653.t: salok mahalaa chauthhaa ||
653.e: Shalok, Fourth Mehla:

653.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਾਂਤਿ ਹੈ ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
653.t: gurmukh a(n)tar saa(n)t hai man tan naam samai ||
653.e: Within the Gurmukh is peace and tranquility; his mind and body are absorbed in the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

653.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਚਿਤਵੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਪੜੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
653.t: naamo chitavai naam paRai naam rahai liv lai ||
653.e: He contemplates the Naam, he studies the Naam, and he remains lovingly absorbed in the Naam.

653.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਚਿੰਤਾ ਗਈ ਬਿਲਾਇ ॥
653.t: naam padhaarath paiaa chi(n)taa giee bilai ||
653.e: He obtains the treasure of the Naam, and his anxiety is dispelled.

653.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਐ ਨਾਮੁ ਊਪਜੈ ਤਿਸਨਾ ਭੁਖ ਸਭ ਜਾਇ ॥
653.t: satigur miliaai naam uoopajai tisanaa bhukh sabh jai ||
653.e: Meeting with the Guru, the Naam wells up, and his thirst and hunger are completely relieved.

653.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੇ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੋ ਪਲੈ ਪਾਇ ॥੧॥
653.t: naanak naame ratiaa naamo palai pai ||1||
653.e: O Nanak, imbued with the Naam, he gathers in the Naam. ||1||

653.t: mahalaa chauthhaa ||
653.e: Fourth Mehla:

653.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਜਿ ਮਾਰਿਆ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿਆ ਘਰੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਗਇਆ ॥
653.t: satigur purakh j maariaa bhram bhramiaa ghar chhodd giaa ||
653.e: One who is cursed by the True Guru, abandons his home, and wanders around aimlessly.

653.g: ਓਸੁ ਪਿਛੈ ਵਜੈ ਫਕੜੀ ਮੁਹੁ ਕਾਲਾ ਆਗੈ ਭਇਆ ॥
653.t: os pichhai vajai fakaRee muh kaalaa aagai bhiaa ||
653.e: He is jeered at, and his face is blackened in the world hereafter.

653.g: ਓਸੁ ਅਰਲੁ ਬਰਲੁ ਮੁਹਹੁ ਨਿਕਲੈ ਨਿਤ ਝਗੂ ਸੁਟਦਾ ਮੁਆ ॥
653.t: os aral baral muhahu nikalai nit jhagoo suTadhaa muaa ||
653.e: He babbles incoherently, and foaming at the mouth, he dies.

653.g: ਕਿਆ ਹੋਵੈ ਕਿਸੈ ਹੀ ਦੈ ਕੀਤੈ ਜਾਂ ਧੁਰਿ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਓਸ ਦਾ ਏਹੋ ਜੇਹਾ ਪਇਆ ॥
653.t: kiaa hovai kisai hee dhai keetai jaa(n) dhur kirat os dhaa eho jehaa piaa ||
653.e: What can anyone do? Such is his destiny, according to his past deeds.

653.g: ਜਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਇ ਤਿਥੈ ਓਹੁ ਝੂਠਾ ਕੂੜੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
653.t: jithai oh jai tithai oh jhooThaa kooR bole kisai na bhaavai ||
653.e: Wherever he goes, he is a liar, and by telling lies, he not liked by anyone.

653.g: ਵੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਕੀ ਜੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਕਰੈ ਤੈਸਾ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
653.t: vekhahu bhaiee vaddiaaiee har sa(n)tahu suaamee apune kee jaisaa koiee karai taisaa koiee paavai ||
653.e: O Siblings of Destiny, behold this, the glorious greatness of our Lord and Master, O Saints; as one behaves, so does he receive.

653.g: ਏਹੁ ਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਅਗੋ ਦੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਆਖਿ ਸੁਣਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
653.t: eh braham beechaar hovai dhar saachai ago dhe jan naanak aakh sunaavai ||2||
653.e: This shall be God's determination in His True Court; servant Nanak predicts and proclaims this. ||2||

653.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
653.t: pauRee ||
653.e: Pauree:

653.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਸਚੈ ਬਧਾ ਥੇਹੁ ਰਖਵਾਲੇ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਤੇ ॥
653.t: gur sachai badhaa theh rakhavaale gur dhite ||
653.e: The True Guru has established the village; the Guru has appointed its guards and protectors.

653.g: ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਆਸ ਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਮਨ ਰਤੇ ॥
653.t: pooran hoiee aas gur charanee man rate ||
653.e: My hopes are fulfilled, and my mind is imbued with the love of the Guru's Feet.

653.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲਿ ਬੇਅੰਤਿ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਸਭਿ ਹਤੇ ॥
653.t: gur kirapaal bea(n)t avagun sabh hate ||
653.e: The Guru is infinitely merciful; He has erased all my sins.

653.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਅਪਣੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਅਪਣੇ ਕਰਿ ਲਿਤੇ ॥
653.t: gur apanee kirapaa dhaar apane kar lite ||
653.e: The Guru has showered me with His Mercy, and He has made me His own.

653.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰ ਜਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਇਤੇ ॥੨੭॥
653.t: naanak sadh balihaar jis gur ke gun ite ||27||
653.e: Nanak is forever a sacrifice to the Guru, who has countless virtues. ||27||

653.g: ਸਲੋਕ ਮਃ ੧ ॥
653.t: salok mahalaa pehilaa ||
653.e: Shalok, First Mehla:

653.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਰਜਾਇ ਲੇਖਿਆ ਪਾਇ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ਪਾਂਡੇ ॥
653.t: taa kee rajai lekhiaa pai ab kiaa keejai paa(n)dde ||
653.e: By His Command, we receive our pre-ordained rewards; so what can we do now, O Pandit?

653.g: ਹੁਕਮੁ ਹੋਆ ਹਾਸਲੁ ਤਦੇ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੜਿਆ ਹੰਢਹਿ ਜੀਅ ਕਮਾਂਦੇ ॥੧॥
653.t: hukam hoaa haasal tadhe hoi nibaRiaa ha(n)ddeh jeea kamaa(n)dhe ||1||
653.e: When His Command is received, then it is decided; all beings move and act accordingly. ||1||

653.t: mahalaa doojaa ||
653.e: Second Mehla:

653.g: ਨਕਿ ਨਥ ਖਸਮ ਹਥ ਕਿਰਤੁ ਧਕੇ ਦੇ ॥
653.t: nak nath khasam hath kirat dhake dhe ||
653.e: The string through the nose is in the hands of the Lord Master; one's own actions drive him on.

653.g: ਜਹਾ ਦਾਣੇ ਤਹਾਂ ਖਾਣੇ ਨਾਨਕਾ ਸਚੁ ਹੇ ॥੨॥
653.t: jahaa dhaane tahaa(n) khaane naanakaa sach he ||2||
653.e: Wherever his food is, there he eats it; O Nanak, this is the Truth. ||2||

653.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
653.t: pauRee ||
653.e: Pauree:

653.g: ਸਭੇ ਗਲਾ ਆਪਿ ਥਾਟਿ ਬਹਾਲੀਓਨੁ ॥
653.t: sabhe galaa aap thaaT bahaaleeon ||
653.e: The Lord Himself puts everything in its proper place.

653.g: ਆਪੇ ਰਚਨੁ ਰਚਾਇ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਘਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
653.t: aape rachan rachai aape hee ghaalion ||
653.e: He Himself created the creation, and He Himself destroys it.

653.g: ਆਪੇ ਜੰਤ ਉਪਾਇ ਆਪਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
653.t: aape ja(n)t upai aap pratipaalion ||
653.e: He Himself fashions His creatures, and He Himself nourishes them.

653.g: ਦਾਸ ਰਖੇ ਕੰਠਿ ਲਾਇ ਨਦਰਿ ਨਿਹਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥
653.t: dhaas rakhe ka(n)Th lai nadhar nihaalion ||
653.e: He hugs His slaves close in His embrace, and blesses them with His Glance of Grace.

653.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤਾ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਭਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ਜਾਲਿਓਨੁ ॥੨੮॥
653.t: naanak bhagataa sadhaa ana(n)dh bhaau dhoojaa jaalion ||28||
653.e: O Nanak, His devotees are forever in bliss; they have burnt away the love of duality. ||28||

653.g: ਸਲੋਕੁ ਮਃ ੩ ॥
653.t: salok mahalaa teejaa ||
653.e: Shalok, Third Mehla:

653.g: ਏ ਮਨ ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਧਿਆਇ ਤੂ ਇਕ ਮਨਿ ਇਕ ਚਿਤਿ ਭਾਇ ॥
653.t: e man har jee dhiaai too ik man ik chit bhai ||
653.e: O mind, meditate on the Dear Lord, with single-minded conscious concentration.

653.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਵਡਿਆਈਆ ਦੇਇ ਨ ਪਛੋਤਾਇ ॥
653.t: har keeaa sadhaa sadhaa vaddiaaieeaa dhei na pachhotai ||
653.e: The glorious greatness of the Lord shall last forever and ever; He never regrets what He gives.

653.g: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰਣੈ ਜਿਤੁ ਸੇਵਿਐ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇ ॥
653.t: hau har kai sadh balihaaranai jit seviaai sukh pai ||
653.e: I am forever a sacrifice to the Lord; serving Him, peace is obtained.

653.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਿਲਿ ਰਹੈ ਹਉਮੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਜਲਾਇ ॥੧॥
653.t: naanak gurmukh mil rahai haumai sabadh jalai ||1||
653.e: O Nanak, the Gurmukh remains merged with the Lord; he burns away his ego through the Word of the Shabad. ||1||

653.t: mahalaa teejaa ||
653.e: Third Mehla:

653.g: ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਇਅਨੁ ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
653.t: aape sevaa laian aape bakhas karei ||
653.e: He Himself enjoins us to serve Him, and He Himself blesses us with forgiveness.

653.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਮਾ ਪਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਾਰ ਕਰੇਇ ॥
653.t: sabhanaa kaa maa piau aap hai aape saar karei ||
653.e: He Himself is the father and mother of all; He Himself cares for us.

653.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਨਿ ਤਿਨ ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਜੁਗੁ ਜੁਗੁ ਸੋਭਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
653.t: naanak naam dhiaain tin nij ghar vaas hai jug jug sobhaa hoi ||2||
653.e: O Nanak, those who meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord, abide in the home of their inner being; they are honored throughout the ages. ||2||

653.g: ਪਉੜੀ ॥
653.t: pauRee ||
653.e: Pauree:

653.g: ਤੂ ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਮਰਥੁ ਹਹਿ ਕਰਤੇ ਮੈ ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਈ ॥
653.t: too karan kaaran samarath heh karate mai tujh bin avar na koiee ||
653.e: You are the Creator, all-powerful, able to do anything. Without You, there is no other at all.

654.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਆਪੇ ਸਿਸਟਿ ਸਿਰਜੀਆ ਆਪੇ ਫੁਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
654.t: tudh aape sisaT sirajeeaa aape fun goiee ||
654.e: You Yourself created the world, and You Yourself shall destroy it in the end.

654.g: ਸਭੁ ਇਕੋ ਸਬਦੁ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਜੋ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
654.t: sabh iko sabadh varatadhaa jo kare su hoiee ||
654.e: The Word of Your Shabad alone is pervading everywhere; whatever You do, comes to pass.

654.g: ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਇ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
654.t: vaddiaaiee gurmukh dhei prabh har paavai soiee ||
654.e: God blesses the Gurmukh with glorious greatness, and then, he finds the Lord.

654.g: ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਰਾਧਿਆ ਸਭਿ ਆਖਹੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਧੰਨੁ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੨੯॥੧॥ ਸੁਧੁ
654.t: gurmukh naanak aaraadhiaa sabh aakhahu dha(n)n dha(n)n dha(n)n gur soiee ||29||1|| sudhu
654.e: As Gurmukh, Nanak worships and adores the Lord; let everyone proclaim, ""Blessed, blessed, blessed is He, the Guru!""||29||1||Sudh||

654.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੧
654.t: raag soraTh baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee ghar pehilaa
654.e: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee, First House:

654.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
654.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
654.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

654.g: ਬੁਤ ਪੂਜਿ ਪੂਜਿ ਹਿੰਦੂ ਮੂਏ ਤੁਰਕ ਮੂਏ ਸਿਰੁ ਨਾਈ ॥
654.t: but pooj pooj hi(n)dhoo mooe turak mooe sir naiee ||
654.e: Worshipping their idols, the Hindus die; the Muslims die bowing their heads.

654.g: ਓਇ ਲੇ ਜਾਰੇ ਓਇ ਲੇ ਗਾਡੇ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਦੁਹੂ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
654.t: oi le jaare oi le gaadde teree gat dhuhoo na paiee ||1||
654.e: The Hindus cremate their dead, while the Muslims bury theirs; neither finds Your true state, Lord. ||1||

654.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਅੰਧ ਗਹੇਰਾ ॥
654.t: man re sa(n)saar a(n)dh gaheraa ||
654.e: O mind, the world is a deep, dark pit.

654.g: ਚਹੁ ਦਿਸ ਪਸਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਜਮ ਜੇਵਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
654.t: chahu dhis pasario hai jam jevaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
654.e: On all four sides, Death has spread his net. ||1||Pause||

654.g: ਕਬਿਤ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਕਬਿਤਾ ਮੂਏ ਕਪੜ ਕੇਦਾਰੈ ਜਾਈ ॥
654.t: kabit paRe paR kabitaa mooe kapaR kedhaarai jaiee ||
654.e: Reciting their poems, the poets die; the mystical ascetics die while journeying to Kaydaar Naat'h.

654.g: ਜਟਾ ਧਾਰਿ ਧਾਰਿ ਜੋਗੀ ਮੂਏ ਤੇਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਇਨਹਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
654.t: jaTaa dhaar dhaar jogee mooe teree gat ineh na paiee ||2||
654.e: The Yogis die, with their matted hair, but even they do not find Your state, Lord. ||2||

654.g: ਦਰਬੁ ਸੰਚਿ ਸੰਚਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਮੂਏ ਗਡਿ ਲੇ ਕੰਚਨ ਭਾਰੀ ॥
654.t: dharab sa(n)ch sa(n)ch raaje mooe gadd le ka(n)chan bhaaree ||
654.e: The kings die, gathering and hoarding their money, burying great quantities of gold.

654.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੜੇ ਪੜਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਮੂਏ ਰੂਪੁ ਦੇਖਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
654.t: bedh paRe paR pa(n)ddit mooe roop dhekh dhekh naaree ||3||
654.e: The Pandits die, reading and reciting the Vedas; women die, gazing at their own beauty. ||3||

654.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਭੈ ਬਿਗੂਤੇ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਨਿਰਖਿ ਸਰੀਰਾ ॥
654.t: raam naam bin sabhai bigoote dhekhahu nirakh sareeraa ||
654.e: Without the Lord's Name, all come to ruin; behold, and know this, O body.

654.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਕਿਨਿ ਗਤਿ ਪਾਈ ਕਹਿ ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਕਬੀਰਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
654.t: har ke naam bin kin gat paiee keh upadhes kabeeraa ||4||1||
654.e: Without the Name of the Lord, who can find salvation? Kabeer speaks the Teachings. ||4||1||

654.g: ਜਬ ਜਰੀਐ ਤਬ ਹੋਇ ਭਸਮ ਤਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਕਿਰਮ ਦਲ ਖਾਈ ॥
654.t: jab jareeaai tab hoi bhasam tan rahai kiram dhal khaiee ||
654.e: When the body is burnt, it turns to ashes; if it is not cremated, then it is eaten by armies of worms.

654.g: ਕਾਚੀ ਗਾਗਰਿ ਨੀਰੁ ਪਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਇਆ ਤਨ ਕੀ ਇਹੈ ਬਡਾਈ ॥੧॥
654.t: kaachee gaagar neer parat hai iaa tan kee ihai baddaiee ||1||
654.e: The unbaked clay pitcher dissolves, when water is poured into it; this is also the nature of the body. ||1||

654.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਭਈਆ ਫਿਰਤੌ ਫੂਲਿਆ ਫੂਲਿਆ ॥
654.t: kaahe bhieeaa firatau fooliaa fooliaa ||
654.e: Why, O Siblings of Destiny, do you strut around, all puffed up with pride?

654.g: ਜਬ ਦਸ ਮਾਸ ਉਰਧ ਮੁਖ ਰਹਤਾ ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਕੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
654.t: jab dhas maas uradh mukh rahataa so dhin kaise bhooliaa ||1|| rahaau ||
654.e: Have you forgotten those days, when you were hanging, face down, for ten months? ||1||Pause||

654.g: ਜਿਉ ਮਧੁ ਮਾਖੀ ਤਿਉ ਸਠੋਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਜੋਰਿ ਜੋਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਕੀਆ ॥
654.t: jiau madh maakhee tiau saThor ras jor jor dhan keeaa ||
654.e: Like the bee which collects honey, the fool eagerly gathers and collects wealth.

654.g: ਮਰਤੀ ਬਾਰ ਲੇਹੁ ਲੇਹੁ ਕਰੀਐ ਭੂਤੁ ਰਹਨ ਕਿਉ ਦੀਆ ॥੨॥
654.t: maratee baar leh leh kareeaai bhoot rahan kiau dheeaa ||2||
654.e: At the time of death, they shout, ""Take him away, take him away! Why leave a ghost lying around?""||2||

654.g: ਦੇਹੁਰੀ ਲਉ ਬਰੀ ਨਾਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਈ ਆਗੈ ਸਜਨ ਸੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
654.t: dhehuree lau baree naar sa(n)g bhiee aagai sajan suhelaa ||
654.e: His wife accompanies him to the threshold, and his friends and companions beyond.

654.g: ਮਰਘਟ ਲਉ ਸਭੁ ਲੋਗੁ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਭਇਓ ਆਗੈ ਹੰਸੁ ਅਕੇਲਾ ॥੩॥
654.t: maraghaT lau sabh log kuTa(n)b bhio aagai ha(n)s akelaa ||3||
654.e: All the people and relatives go as far as the cremation grounds, and then, the soul-swan goes on alone. ||3||

654.g: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਪਰੇ ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸ ਕੂਆ ॥
654.t: kahat kabeer sunahu re praanee pare kaal gras kooaa ||
654.e: Says Kabeer, listen, O mortal being: you have been seized by Death, and you have fallen into the deep, dark pit.

654.g: ਝੂਠੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਬੰਧਾਇਆ ਜਿਉ ਨਲਨੀ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਸੂਆ ॥੪॥੨॥
654.t: jhooThee maiaa aap ba(n)dhaiaa jiau nalanee bhram sooaa ||4||2||
654.e: You have entangled yourself in the false wealth of Maya, like the parrot caught in the trap. ||4||2||

654.g: ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਸਭੈ ਮਤ ਸੁਨਿ ਕੈ ਕਰੀ ਕਰਮ ਕੀ ਆਸਾ ॥
654.t: bedh puraan sabhai mat sun kai karee karam kee aasaa ||
654.e: Listening to all the teachings of the Vedas and the Puraanas, I wanted to perform the religious rituals.

654.g: ਕਾਲ ਗ੍ਰਸਤ ਸਭ ਲੋਗ ਸਿਆਨੇ ਉਠਿ ਪੰਡਿਤ ਪੈ ਚਲੇ ਨਿਰਾਸਾ ॥੧॥
654.t: kaal grasat sabh log siaane uTh pa(n)ddit pai chale niraasaa ||1||
654.e: But seeing all the wise men caught by Death, I arose and left the Pandits; now I am free of this desire. ||1||

654.g: ਮਨ ਰੇ ਸਰਿਓ ਨ ਏਕੈ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
654.t: man re sario na ekai kaajaa ||
654.e: O mind, you have not completed the only task you were given;

654.g: ਭਜਿਓ ਨ ਰਘੁਪਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
654.t: bhajio na raghupat raajaa ||1|| rahaau ||
654.e: you have not meditated on the Lord, your King. ||1||Pause||

654.g: ਬਨ ਖੰਡ ਜਾਇ ਜੋਗੁ ਤਪੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਕੰਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਚੁਨਿ ਖਾਇਆ ॥
654.t: ban kha(n)dd jai jog tap keeno ka(n)dh mool chun khaiaa ||
654.e: Going to the forests, they practice Yoga and deep, austere meditation; they live on roots and the fruits they gather.

654.g: ਨਾਦੀ ਬੇਦੀ ਸਬਦੀ ਮੋਨੀ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਪਟੈ ਲਿਖਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
654.t: naadhee bedhee sabadhee monee jam ke paTai likhaiaa ||2||
654.e: The musicians, the Vedic scholars, the chanters of one word and the men of silence, all are listed on the Register of Death. ||2||

654.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਨਾਰਦੀ ਰਿਦੈ ਨ ਆਈ ਕਾਛਿ ਕੂਛਿ ਤਨੁ ਦੀਨਾ ॥
654.t: bhagat naaradhee ridhai na aaiee kaachh koochh tan dheenaa ||
654.e: Loving devotional worship does not enter into your heart; pampering and adorning your body, you must still give it up.

654.g: ਰਾਗ ਰਾਗਨੀ ਡਿੰਭ ਹੋਇ ਬੈਠਾ ਉਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਪਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੩॥
654.t: raag raaganee ddi(n)bh hoi baiThaa un har peh kiaa leenaa ||3||
654.e: You sit and play music, but you are still a hypocrite; what do you expect to receive from the Lord? ||3||

654.g: ਪਰਿਓ ਕਾਲੁ ਸਭੈ ਜਗ ਊਪਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਗਿਆਨੀ ॥
654.t: pario kaal sabhai jag uoopar maeh likhe bhram giaanee ||
654.e: Death has fallen on the whole world; the doubting religious scholars are also listed on the Register of Death.

655.g: ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ ਜਨ ਭਏ ਖਾਲਸੇ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਭਗਤਿ ਜਿਹ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
655.t: kahu kabeer jan bhe khaalase prem bhagat jeh jaanee ||4||3||
655.e: Says Kabeer, those humble people become pure - they become Khalsa - who know the Lord's loving devotional worship. ||4||3||
Second House||
With both of my eyes, I look around;

655.g: ਹਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਖਾ ॥
655.t: hau har bin aaur na dhekhaa ||
655.e: I don't see anything except the Lord.
My eyes gaze lovingly upon Him,

655.g: ਅਬ ਬੇ ਗਲ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
655.t: ab be gal kahan na jaiee ||1||
655.e: and now, I cannot speak of anything else. ||1||
My doubts were removed, and my fear ran away,

655.g: ਜਬ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
655.t: jab raam naam chit laagaa ||1|| rahaau ||
655.e: when my consciousness became attached to the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||
When the magician beats his tambourine,
everyone comes to see the show.
When the magician winds up his show,
then he enjoys its play all alone. ||2||
By preaching sermons, one's doubt is not dispelled.
Everyone is tired of preaching and teaching.
The Lord causes the Gurmukh to understand;
his heart remains permeated with the Lord. ||3||
When the Guru grants even a bit of His Grace,

655.g: ਸਭੁ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਹ ਹਰਿ ਲੀਨੀ ॥
655.t: sabh tan man dheh har leenee ||
655.e: one's body, mind and entire being are absorbed into the Lord.
Says Kabeer, I am imbued with the Lord's Love;
I have met with the Life of the world, the Great Giver. ||4||4||

655.g: ਜਾ ਕੇ ਨਿਗਮ ਦੂਧ ਕੇ ਠਾਟਾ ॥
655.t: jaa ke nigam dhoodh ke ThaaTaa ||
655.e: Let the sacred scriptures be your milk and cream,
and the ocean of the mind the churning vat.
Be the butter-churner of the Lord,
and your buttermilk shall not be wasted. ||1||

655.g: ਚੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਰਾਮੁ ਨ ਕਰਸਿ ਭਤਾਰਾ ॥
655.t: cheree too raam na karas bhataaraa ||
655.e: O soul-bride slave, why don't you take the Lord as your Husband?
He is the Life of the world, the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||
The chain is around your neck, and the cuffs are on your feet.
The Lord has sent you wandering around from house to house.
And still, you do not meditate on the Lord, O soul-bride, slave.
Death is watching you, O wretched woman. ||2||
The Lord God is the Cause of causes.
What is in the hands of the poor soul-bride, the slave?
She awakens from her slumber,
and she becomes attached to whatever the Lord attaches her. ||3||

655.g: ਚੇਰੀ ਤੈ ਸੁਮਤਿ ਕਹਾਂ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
655.t: cheree tai sumat kahaa(n) te paiee ||
655.e: O soul-bride, slave, where did you obtain that wisdom,

655.g: ਜਾ ਤੇ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਲੀਕ ਮਿਟਾਈ ॥
655.t: jaa te bhram kee leek miTaiee ||
655.e: by which you erased your inscription of doubt?
Kabeer has tasted that subtle essence;
by Guru's Grace, his mind is reconciled with the Lord. ||4||5||
Without Him, we cannot even live;
when we meet Him, then our task is completed.
People say it is good to live forever,
but without dying, there is no life. ||1||
So now, what sort wisdom should I contemplate and preach?
As I watch, worldly things dissipate. ||1||Pause||
Saffron is ground up, and mixed with sandalwood;
without eyes, the world is seen.
The son has given birth to his father;
without a place, the city has been established. ||2||
The humble beggar has found the Great Giver,
but he is unable to eat what he has been given.
He cannot leave it alone, but it is never exhausted.
He shall not go to beg from others any longer. ||3||

655.g: ਜੋ ਜੀਵਨ ਮਰਨਾ ਜਾਨੈ ॥ ਸੋ ਪੰਚ ਸੈਲ ਸੁਖ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
655.t: jo jeevan maranaa jaanai || so pa(n)ch sail sukh maanai ||
655.e: Those select few, who know how to die while yet alive, enjoy great peace.
Kabeer has found that wealth;
meeting with the Lord, he has erased his self-conceit. ||4||6||
What use is it to read, and what use is it to study?
What use is it to listen to the Vedas and the Puraanas?
What use is reading and listening,
if celestial peace is not attained? ||1||

655.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨ ਜਪਸਿ ਗਵਾਰਾ ॥
655.t: har kaa naam na japas gavaaraa ||
655.e: The fool does not chant the Name of the Lord.
So what does he think of, over and over again? ||1||Pause||
In the darkness, we need a lamp

656.e: to find the incomprehensible thing.
I have found this incomprehensible thing;
my mind is illuminated and enlightened. ||2||
Says Kabeer, now I know Him;
since I know Him, my mind is pleased and appeased.
My mind is pleased and appeased, and yet, people do not believe it.
They do not believe it, so what can I do? ||3||7||
In his heart there is deception, and yet in his mouth are words of wisdom.
You are false - why are you churning water? ||1||
Why do you bother to wash your body?

656.g: ਜਉ ਘਟ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਹੈ ਮਲਨਾਂ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
656.t: jau ghaT bheetar hai malanaa(n) ||1|| rahaau ||
656.e: Your heart is still full of filth. ||1||Pause||
The gourd may be washed at the sixty-eight sacred shrines,
but even then, its bitterness is not removed. ||2||
Says Kabeer after deep contemplation,
please help me cross over the terrifying world-ocean, O Lord, O Destroyer of ego. ||3||8||
Sorat'h:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

656.g: ਬਹੁ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਕਰਿ ਪਰ ਧਨੁ ਲਿਆਵੈ ॥
656.t: bahu parapa(n)ch kar par dhan liaavai ||
656.e: Practicing great hypocrisy, he acquires the wealth of others.
Returning home, he squanders it on his wife and children. ||1||

656.g: ਮਨ ਮੇਰੇ ਭੂਲੇ ਕਪਟੁ ਨ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
656.t: man mere bhoole kapaT na keejai ||
656.e: O my mind, do not practice deception, even inadvertently.

656.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਨਿਬੇਰਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਹਿ ਲੀਜੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
656.t: a(n)t niberaa tere jeea peh leejai ||1|| rahaau ||
656.e: In the end, your own soul shall have to answer for its account. ||1||Pause||

656.g: ਛਿਨੁ ਛਿਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ਜਰਾ ਜਨਾਵੈ ॥
656.t: chhin chhin tan chheejai jaraa janaavai ||
656.e: Moment by moment, the body is wearing away, and old age is asserting itself.

656.g: ਤਬ ਤੇਰੀ ਓਕ ਕੋਈ ਪਾਨੀਓ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
656.t: tab teree ok koiee paaneeo na paavai ||2||
656.e: And then, when you are old, no one shall pour water into your cup. ||2||
Says Kabeer, no one belongs to you.

656.g: ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਮੁ ਕੀ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਸਵੇਰਾ ॥੩॥੯॥
656.t: hiradhai raam kee na japeh saveraa ||3||9||
656.e: Why not chant the Lord's Name in your heart, when you are still young? ||3||9||
O Saints, my windy mind has now become peaceful and still.
It seems that I have learned something of the science of Yoga. ||Pause||
The Guru has shown me the hole,
through which the deer carefully enters.
I have now closed off the doors,
and the unstruck celestial sound current resounds. ||1||
The pitcher of my heart-lotus is filled with water;
I have spilled out the water, and set it upright.
Says Kabeer, the Lord's humble servant, this I know.
Now that I know this, my mind is pleased and appeased. ||2||10||
Raag Sorat'h:
I am so hungry, I cannot perform devotional worship service.
Here, Lord, take back Your mala.
I beg for the dust of the feet of the Saints.
I do not owe anyone anything. ||1||
O Lord, how can I be with You?

656.g: ਆਪਿ ਨ ਦੇਹੁ ਤ ਲੇਵਉ ਮੰਗੇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
656.t: aap na dheh ta levau ma(n)ge || rahaau ||
656.e: If You do not give me Yourself, then I shall beg until I get You. ||Pause||
I ask for two kilos of flour,
and half a pound of ghee, and salt.
I ask for a pound of beans,
which I shall eat twice a day. ||2||
I ask for a cot, with four legs,
and a pillow and mattress.
I ask for a quilt to cover myself.
Your humble servant shall perform Your devotional worship service with love. ||3||
I have no greed;
Your Name is the only ornament I wish for.
Says Kabeer, my mind is pleased and appeased;
now that my mind is pleased and appeased, I have come to know the Lord. ||4||11||

656.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇ ਜੀ ਕੀ ਘਰੁ ੨
656.t: raag soraTh baanee bhagat naamadhe jee kee ghar doojaa
656.e: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
When I see Him, I sing His Praises.
Then I, his humble servant, become patient. ||1||

657.g: ਨਾਦਿ ਸਮਾਇਲੋ ਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਭੇਟਿਲੇ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
657.t: naadh samailo re satigur bheTile dhevaa ||1|| rahaau ||
657.e: Meeting the Divine True Guru, I merge into the sound current of the Naad. ||1||Pause||
Where the dazzling white light is seen,
there the unstruck sound current of the Shabad resounds.
One's light merges in the Light;
by Guru's Grace, I know this. ||2||
The jewels are in the treasure chamber of the heart-lotus.
They sparkle and glitter like lightning.
The Lord is near at hand, not far away.
He is totally permeating and pervading in my soul. ||3||
Where the light of the undying sun shines,
the light of burning lamps seems insignificant.
By Guru's Grace, I know this.
Servant Naam Dayv is absorbed in the Celestial Lord. ||4||1||
Fourth House, Sorat'h:

657.g: ਪਾੜ ਪੜੋਸਣਿ ਪੂਛਿ ਲੇ ਨਾਮਾ ਕਾ ਪਹਿ ਛਾਨਿ ਛਵਾਈ ਹੋ ॥
657.t: paaR paRosan poochh le naamaa kaa peh chhaan chhavaiee ho ||
657.e: The woman next door asked Naam Dayv, ""Who built your house?

657.g: ਤੋ ਪਹਿ ਦੁਗਣੀ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਦੈਹਉ ਮੋ ਕਉ ਬੇਢੀ ਦੇਹੁ ਬਤਾਈ ਹੋ ॥੧॥
657.t: to peh dhuganee majooree dhaihau mo kau beddee dheh bataiee ho ||1||
657.e: I shall pay him double wages. Tell me, who is your carpenter?""||1||

657.g: ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ਬੇਢੀ ਦੇਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
657.t: ree baiee beddee dhen na jaiee ||
657.e: O sister, I cannot give this carpenter to you.
Behold, my carpenter is pervading everywhere.
My carpenter is the Support of the breath of life. ||1||Pause||

657.g: ਬੇਢੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਮਜੂਰੀ ਮਾਂਗੈ ਜਉ ਕੋਊ ਛਾਨਿ ਛਵਾਵੈ ਹੋ ॥
657.t: beddee preet majooree maa(n)gai jau kouoo chhaan chhavaavai ho ||
657.e: This carpenter demands the wages of love, if someone wants Him to build their house.

657.g: ਲੋਗ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਭਹੁ ਤੇ ਤੋਰੈ ਤਉ ਆਪਨ ਬੇਢੀ ਆਵੈ ਹੋ ॥੨॥
657.t: log kuTa(n)b sabhahu te torai tau aapan beddee aavai ho ||2||
657.e: When one breaks his ties with all the people and relatives, then the carpenter comes of His own accord. ||2||

657.g: ਐਸੋ ਬੇਢੀ ਬਰਨਿ ਨ ਸਾਕਉ ਸਭ ਅੰਤਰ ਸਭ ਠਾਂਈ ਹੋ ॥
657.t: aaiso beddee baran na saakau sabh a(n)tar sabh Thaa(n)iee ho ||
657.e: I cannot describe such a carpenter, who is contained in everything, everywhere.

657.g: ਗੂੰਗੈ ਮਹਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਪੂਛੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ਹੋ ॥੩॥
657.t: goo(n)gai mahaa a(n)mirat ras chaakhiaa poochhe kahan na jaiee ho ||3||
657.e: The mute tastes the most sublime ambrosial nectar, but if you ask him to describe it, he cannot. ||3||

657.g: ਬੇਢੀ ਕੇ ਗੁਣ ਸੁਨਿ ਰੀ ਬਾਈ ਜਲਧਿ ਬਾਂਧਿ ਧ੍ਰੂ ਥਾਪਿਓ ਹੋ ॥
657.t: beddee ke gun sun ree baiee jaladh baa(n)dh dhraoo thaapio ho ||
657.e: Listen to the virtues of this carpenter, O sister; He stopped the oceans, and established Dhroo as the pole star.

657.g: ਨਾਮੇ ਕੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸੀਅ ਬਹੋਰੀ ਲੰਕ ਭਭੀਖਣ ਆਪਿਓ ਹੋ ॥੪॥੨॥
657.t: naame ke suaamee seea bahoree la(n)k bhabheekhan aapio ho ||4||2||
657.e: Naam Dayv's Lord Master brought Sita back, and gave Sri Lanka to Bhabheekhan. ||4||2||
Sorat'h, Third House:
The skinless drum plays.
Without the rainy season, the clouds shake with thunder.
Without clouds, the rain falls,
if one contemplates the essence of reality. ||1||
I have met my Beloved Lord.
Meeting with Him, my body is made beauteous and sublime. ||1||Pause||
Touching the philosopher's stone, I have been transformed into gold.
I have threaded the jewels into my mouth and mind.
I love Him as my own, and my doubt has been dispelled.
Seeking the Guru's guidance, my mind is content. ||2||
The water is contained within the pitcher;
I know that the One Lord is contained in all.
The mind of the disciple has faith in the Guru.
Servant Naam Dayv understands the essence of reality. ||3||3||

657.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ
657.t: raag soraTh baanee bhagat ravidhaas jee kee
657.e: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Ravi Daas Jee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

657.g: ਜਬ ਹਮ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਬ ਤੂ ਨਾਹੀ ਅਬ ਤੂਹੀ ਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
657.t: jab ham hote tab too naahee ab toohee mai naahee ||
657.e: When I am in my ego, then You are not with me. Now that You are with me, there is no egotism within me.

657.g: ਅਨਲ ਅਗਮ ਜੈਸੇ ਲਹਰਿ ਮਇ ਓਦਧਿ ਜਲ ਕੇਵਲ ਜਲ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥੧॥
657.t: anal agam jaise lahar mi odhadh jal keval jal maa(n)hee ||1||
657.e: The wind may raise up huge waves in the vast ocean, but they are just water in water. ||1||
O Lord, what can I say about such an illusion?

657.g: ਜੈਸਾ ਮਾਨੀਐ ਹੋਇ ਨ ਤੈਸਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
657.t: jaisaa maaneeaai hoi na taisaa ||1|| rahaau ||
657.e: Things are not as they seem. ||1||Pause||

657.g: ਨਰਪਤਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਿੰਘਾਸਨਿ ਸੋਇਆ ਸੁਪਨੇ ਭਇਆ ਭਿਖਾਰੀ ॥
657.t: narapat ek si(n)ghaasan soiaa supane bhiaa bhikhaaree ||
657.e: It is like the king, who falls asleep upon his throne, and dreams that he is a beggar.

657.g: ਅਛਤ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਛੁਰਤ ਦੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਸੋ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
657.t: achhat raaj bichhurat dhukh paiaa so gat bhiee hamaaree ||2||
657.e: His kingdom is intact, but separated from it, he suffers in sorrow. Such is my own condition. ||2||

658.g: ਰਾਜ ਭੁਇਅੰਗ ਪ੍ਰਸੰਗ ਜੈਸੇ ਹਹਿ ਅਬ ਕਛੁ ਮਰਮੁ ਜਨਾਇਆ ॥
658.t: raaj bhuia(n)g prasa(n)g jaise heh ab kachh maram janaiaa ||
658.e: Like the story of the rope mistaken for a snake, the mystery has now been explained to me.

658.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਕਟਕ ਜੈਸੇ ਭੂਲਿ ਪਰੇ ਅਬ ਕਹਤੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਆਇਆ ॥੩॥
658.t: anik kaTak jaise bhool pare ab kahate kahan na aaiaa ||3||
658.e: Like the many bracelets, which I mistakenly thought were gold; now, I do not say what I said then. ||3||

658.g: ਸਰਬੇ ਏਕੁ ਅਨੇਕੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਭ ਘਟ ਭੋੁਗਵੈ ਸੋਈ ॥
658.t: sarabe ek anekai suaamee sabh ghaT bhuogavai soiee ||
658.e: The One Lord is pervading the many forms; He enjoys Himself in all hearts.

658.g: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਹਾਥ ਪੈ ਨੇਰੈ ਸਹਜੇ ਹੋਇ ਸੁ ਹੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
658.t: keh ravidhaas haath pai nerai sahaje hoi su hoiee ||4||1||
658.e: Says Ravi Daas, the Lord is nearer than our own hands and feet. Whatever will be, will be. ||4||1||

658.g: ਜਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਮੋਹ ਫਾਸ ਹਮ ਪ੍ਰੇਮ ਬਧਨਿ ਤੁਮ ਬਾਧੇ ॥
658.t: jau ham baa(n)dhe moh faas ham prem badhan tum baadhe ||
658.e: If I am bound by the noose of emotional attachment, then I shall bind You, Lord, with the bonds of love.

658.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਛੂਟਨ ਕੋ ਜਤਨੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਛੂਟੇ ਤੁਮ ਆਰਾਧੇ ॥੧॥
658.t: apane chhooTan ko jatan karahu ham chhooTe tum aaraadhe ||1||
658.e: Go ahead and try to escape, Lord; I have escaped by worshipping and adoring You. ||1||

658.g: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਜਾਨਤ ਹਹੁ ਜੈਸੀ ਤੈਸੀ ॥
658.t: maadhave jaanat hahu jaisee taisee ||
658.e: O Lord, You know my love for You.

658.g: ਅਬ ਕਹਾ ਕਰਹੁਗੇ ਐਸੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
658.t: ab kahaa karahuge aaisee ||1|| rahaau ||
658.e: Now, what will You do? ||1||Pause||

658.g: ਮੀਨੁ ਪਕਰਿ ਫਾਂਕਿਓ ਅਰੁ ਕਾਟਿਓ ਰਾਂਧਿ ਕੀਓ ਬਹੁ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
658.t: meen pakar faa(n)kio ar kaaTio raa(n)dh keeo bahu baanee ||
658.e: A fish is caught, cut up, and cooked it in many different ways.

658.g: ਖੰਡ ਖੰਡ ਕਰਿ ਭੋਜਨੁ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਊ ਨ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਪਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
658.t: kha(n)dd kha(n)dd kar bhojan keeno tuoo na bisario paanee ||2||
658.e: Bit by bit, it is eaten, but still, it does not forget the water. ||2||

658.g: ਆਪਨ ਬਾਪੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੋ ਭਾਵਨ ਕੋ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਜਾ ॥
658.t: aapan baapai naahee kisee ko bhaavan ko har raajaa ||
658.e: The Lord, our King, is father to no one, except those who love Him.

658.g: ਮੋਹ ਪਟਲ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਬਿਆਪਿਓ ਭਗਤ ਨਹੀ ਸੰਤਾਪਾ ॥੩॥
658.t: moh paTal sabh jagat biaapio bhagat nahee sa(n)taapaa ||3||
658.e: The veil of emotional attachment has been cast over the entire world, but it does not bother the Lord's devotee. ||3||

658.g: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕ ਬਾਢੀ ਅਬ ਇਹ ਕਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
658.t: keh ravidhaas bhagat ik baaddee ab ieh kaa siau kaheeaai ||
658.e: Says Ravi Daas, my devotion to the One Lord is increasing; now, who can I tell this to?

658.g: ਜਾ ਕਾਰਨਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਆਰਾਧੇ ਸੋ ਦੁਖੁ ਅਜਹੂ ਸਹੀਐ ॥੪॥੨॥
658.t: jaa kaaran ham tum aaraadhe so dhukh ajahoo saheeaai ||4||2||
658.e: That which brought me to worship and adore You - I am still suffering that pain. ||4||2||

658.g: ਦੁਲਭ ਜਨਮੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਫਲ ਪਾਇਓ ਬਿਰਥਾ ਜਾਤ ਅਬਿਬੇਕੈ ॥
658.t: dhulabh janam pu(n)n fal paio birathaa jaat abibekai ||
658.e: I obtained this precious human life as a reward for my past actions, but without discriminating wisdom, it is wasted in vain.

658.g: ਰਾਜੇ ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਸਮਸਰਿ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਆਸਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਿਹ ਲੇਖੈ ॥੧॥
658.t: raaje i(n)dhr samasar gireh aasan bin har bhagat kahahu keh lekhai ||1||
658.e: Tell me, without devotional worship of the Lord, of what use are mansions and thrones like those of King Indra? ||1||

658.g: ਨ ਬੀਚਾਰਿਓ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਰਸੁ ॥
658.t: n beechaario raajaa raam ko ras ||
658.e: You have not considered the sublime essence of the Name of the Lord, our King;

658.g: ਜਿਹ ਰਸ ਅਨ ਰਸ ਬੀਸਰਿ ਜਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
658.t: jeh ras an ras beesar jaahee ||1|| rahaau ||
658.e: this sublime essence shall cause you to forget all other essences. ||1||Pause||

658.g: ਜਾਨਿ ਅਜਾਨ ਭਏ ਹਮ ਬਾਵਰ ਸੋਚ ਅਸੋਚ ਦਿਵਸ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
658.t: jaan ajaan bhe ham baavar soch asoch dhivas jaahee ||
658.e: We do not know what we need to know, and we have become insane. We do not consider what we should consider; our days are passing away.

658.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰੀ ਸਬਲ ਨਿਬਲ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਪਰਮਾਰਥ ਪਰਵੇਸ ਨਹੀ ॥੨॥
658.t: ei(n)dhree sabal nibal bibek budh paramaarath paraves nahee ||2||
658.e: Our passions are strong, and our discriminating intellect is weak; we have no access to the supreme objective. ||2||

658.g: ਕਹੀਅਤ ਆਨ ਅਚਰੀਅਤ ਅਨ ਕਛੁ ਸਮਝ ਨ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
658.t: kaheeat aan achareeat an kachh samajh na parai apar maiaa ||
658.e: We say one thing, and do something else; entangled in endless Maya, we do not understand anything.

658.g: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਉਦਾਸ ਦਾਸ ਮਤਿ ਪਰਹਰਿ ਕੋਪੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਜੀਅ ਦਇਆ ॥੩॥੩॥
658.t: keh ravidhaas udhaas dhaas mat parahar kop karahu jeea dhiaa ||3||3||
658.e: Says Ravi Daas, Your slave, O Lord, I am disillusioned and detached; please, spare me Your anger, and have mercy on my soul. ||3||3||

658.g: ਸੁਖ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਸੁਰਤਰ ਚਿੰਤਾਮਨਿ ਕਾਮਧੇਨੁ ਬਸਿ ਜਾ ਕੇ ॥
658.t: sukh saagar suratar chi(n)taaman kaamadhen bas jaa ke ||
658.e: He is the ocean of peace; the miraculous tree of life, the wish-fulfilling jewel, and the Kaamadhayna, the cow which fulfills all desires, all are in His power.

658.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਅਸਟ ਦਸਾ ਸਿਧਿ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਕਰ ਤਲ ਤਾ ਕੇ ॥੧॥
658.t: chaar padhaarath asaT dhasaa sidh nav nidh kar tal taa ke ||1||
658.e: The four great blessings, the eighteen supernatural spiritual powers of the Siddhas, and the nine treasures, are all in the palm of His hand. ||1||

658.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨ ਜਪਹਿ ਰਸਨਾ ॥
658.t: har har har na japeh rasanaa ||
658.e: You do not chant with your tongue the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

658.g: ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਬਚਨ ਰਚਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
658.t: avar sabh tiaag bachan rachanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
658.e: Abandon your involvement in all other words. ||1||Pause||

658.g: ਨਾਨਾ ਖਿਆਨ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਬੇਦ ਬਿਧਿ ਚਉਤੀਸ ਅਖਰ ਮਾਂਹੀ ॥
658.t: naanaa khiaan puraan bedh bidh chautees akhar maa(n)hee ||
658.e: The various Shaastras, Puranaas, and the Vedas of Brahma, are made up of thirty-four letters.

658.g: ਬਿਆਸ ਬਿਚਾਰਿ ਕਹਿਓ ਪਰਮਾਰਥੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਰਿ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
658.t: biaas bichaar kahio paramaarath raam naam sar naahee ||2||
658.e: After deep contemplation, Vyaas spoke of the supreme objective; there is nothing equal to the Lord's Name. ||2||

658.g: ਸਹਜ ਸਮਾਧਿ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਰਹਤ ਫੁਨਿ ਬਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
658.t: sahaj samaadh upaadh rahat fun baddai bhaag liv laagee ||
658.e: Very fortunate are those who are absorbed in celestial bliss, and released from their entanglements; they are lovingly attached to the Lord.

658.g: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਰਿ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਭੈ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥੪॥
658.t: keh ravidhaas pragaas ridhai dhar janam maran bhai bhaagee ||3||4||
658.e: Says Ravi Daas, enshrine the Lord's Light within your heart, and your fear of birth and death shall run away from you. ||3||4||

658.g: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਗਿਰਿਵਰ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਮੋਰਾ ॥
658.t: jau tum girivar tau ham moraa ||
658.e: If You are the mountain, Lord, then I am the peacock.

658.g: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਚੰਦ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਚਕੋਰਾ ॥੧॥
658.t: jau tum cha(n)dh tau ham bhe hai chakoraa ||1||
658.e: If You are the moon, then I am the partridge in love with it. ||1||

658.g: ਮਾਧਵੇ ਤੁਮ ਨ ਤੋਰਹੁ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਨਹੀ ਤੋਰਹਿ ॥
658.t: maadhave tum na torahu tau ham nahee toreh ||
658.e: O Lord, if You will not break with me, then I will not break with You.

658.g: ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਤੋਰਿ ਕਵਨ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰਹਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
658.t: tum siau tor kavan siau joreh ||1|| rahaau ||
658.e: For, if I were to break with You, with whom would I then join? ||1||Pause||

658.g: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਦੀਵਰਾ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਬਾਤੀ ॥
658.t: jau tum dheevaraa tau ham baatee ||
658.e: If You are the lamp, then I am the wick.

658.g: ਜਉ ਤੁਮ ਤੀਰਥ ਤਉ ਹਮ ਜਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
658.t: jau tum teerath tau ham jaatee ||2||
658.e: If You are the sacred place of pilgrimage, then I am the pilgrim. ||2||

659.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰੀ ॥
659.t: saachee preet ham tum siau joree ||
659.e: I am joined in true love with You, Lord.

659.g: ਤੁਮ ਸਿਉ ਜੋਰਿ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਤੋਰੀ ॥੩॥
659.t: tum siau jor avar sa(n)g toree ||3||
659.e: I am joined with You, and I have broken with all others. ||3||

659.g: ਜਹ ਜਹ ਜਾਉ ਤਹਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ॥
659.t: jeh jeh jaau tahaa teree sevaa ||
659.e: Wherever I go, there I serve You.

659.g: ਤੁਮ ਸੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਅਉਰੁ ਨ ਦੇਵਾ ॥੪॥
659.t: tum so Thaakur aaur na dhevaa ||4||
659.e: There is no other Lord Master than You, O Divine Lord. ||4||

659.g: ਤੁਮਰੇ ਭਜਨ ਕਟਹਿ ਜਮ ਫਾਂਸਾ ॥
659.t: tumare bhajan kaTeh jam faa(n)saa ||
659.e: Meditating, vibrating upon You, the noose of death is cut away.

659.g: ਭਗਤਿ ਹੇਤ ਗਾਵੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸਾ ॥੫॥੫॥
659.t: bhagat het gaavai ravidhaasaa ||5||5||
659.e: To attain devotional worship, Ravi Daas sings to You, Lord. ||5||5||

659.g: ਜਲ ਕੀ ਭੀਤਿ ਪਵਨ ਕਾ ਥੰਭਾ ਰਕਤ ਬੁੰਦ ਕਾ ਗਾਰਾ ॥
659.t: jal kee bheet pavan kaa tha(n)bhaa rakat bu(n)dh kaa gaaraa ||
659.e: The body is a wall of water, supported by the pillars of air; the egg and sperm are the mortar.

659.g: ਹਾਡ ਮਾਸ ਨਾੜਂੀ ਕੋ ਪਿੰਜਰੁ ਪੰਖੀ ਬਸੈ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥੧॥
659.t: haadd maas naaRa(n)ee ko pi(n)jar pa(n)khee basai bichaaraa ||1||
659.e: The framework is made up of bones, flesh and veins; the poor soul-bird dwells within it. ||1||

659.g: ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਕਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ਕਿਆ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
659.t: praanee kiaa meraa kiaa teraa ||
659.e: O mortal, what is mine, and what is yours?

659.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਤਰਵਰ ਪੰਖਿ ਬਸੇਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
659.t: jaise taravar pa(n)kh baseraa ||1|| rahaau ||
659.e: The soul is like a bird perched upon a tree. ||1||Pause||

659.g: ਰਾਖਹੁ ਕੰਧ ਉਸਾਰਹੁ ਨੀਵਾਂ ॥
659.t: raakhahu ka(n)dh usaarahu neevaa(n) ||
659.e: You lay the foundation and build the walls.

659.g: ਸਾਢੇ ਤੀਨਿ ਹਾਥ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੀਵਾਂ ॥੨॥
659.t: saadde teen haath teree seevaa(n) ||2||
659.e: But in the end, three and a half cubits will be your measured space. ||2||

659.g: ਬੰਕੇ ਬਾਲ ਪਾਗ ਸਿਰਿ ਡੇਰੀ ॥
659.t: ba(n)ke baal paag sir dderee ||
659.e: You make your hair beautiful, and wear a stylish turban on your head.

659.g: ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਗੋ ਭਸਮ ਕੀ ਢੇਰੀ ॥੩॥
659.t: eih tan hoigo bhasam kee dderee ||3||
659.e: But in the end, this body shall be reduced to a pile of ashes. ||3||

659.g: ਊਚੇ ਮੰਦਰ ਸੁੰਦਰ ਨਾਰੀ ॥
659.t: uooche ma(n)dhar su(n)dhar naaree ||
659.e: Your palaces are lofty, and your brides are beautiful.

659.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਬਾਜੀ ਹਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
659.t: raam naam bin baajee haaree ||4||
659.e: But without the Lord's Name, you shall lose the game entirely. ||4||

659.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਕਮੀਨੀ ਪਾਂਤਿ ਕਮੀਨੀ ਓਛਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਹਮਾਰਾ ॥
659.t: meree jaat kameenee paa(n)t kameenee ochhaa janam hamaaraa ||
659.e: My social status is low, my ancestry is low, and my life is wretched.

659.g: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਨਾਗਤਿ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਚੰਦ ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਚਮਾਰਾ ॥੫॥੬॥
659.t: tum saranaagat raajaa raam cha(n)dh keh ravidhaas chamaaraa ||5||6||
659.e: I have come to Your Sanctuary, O Luminous Lord, my King; so says Ravi Daas, the shoemaker. ||5||6||

659.g: ਚਮਰਟਾ ਗਾਂਠਿ ਨ ਜਨਈ ॥
659.t: chamaraTaa gaa(n)Th na janiee ||
659.e: I am a shoemaker, but I do not know how to mend shoes.

659.g: ਲੋਗੁ ਗਠਾਵੈ ਪਨਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
659.t: log gaThaavai panahee ||1|| rahaau ||
659.e: People come to me to mend their shoes. ||1||Pause||

659.g: ਆਰ ਨਹੀ ਜਿਹ ਤੋਪਉ ॥
659.t: aar nahee jeh topau ||
659.e: I have no awl to stitch them;

659.g: ਨਹੀ ਰਾਂਬੀ ਠਾਉ ਰੋਪਉ ॥੧॥
659.t: nahee raa(n)bee Thaau ropau ||1||
659.e: I have no knife to patch them. ||1||

659.g: ਲੋਗੁ ਗੰਠਿ ਗੰਠਿ ਖਰਾ ਬਿਗੂਚਾ ॥
659.t: log ga(n)Th ga(n)Th kharaa bigoochaa ||
659.e: Mending, mending, people waste their lives and ruin themselves.

659.g: ਹਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਗਾਂਠੇ ਜਾਇ ਪਹੂਚਾ ॥੨॥
659.t: hau bin gaa(n)The jai pahoochaa ||2||
659.e: Without wasting my time mending, I have found the Lord. ||2||

659.g: ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਜਪੈ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਾ ॥
659.t: ravidhaas japai raam naamaa ||
659.e: Ravi Daas chants the Lord's Name;

659.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਜਮ ਸਿਉ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੩॥੭॥
659.t: moh jam siau naahee kaamaa ||3||7||
659.e: he is not concerned with the Messenger of Death. ||3||7||

659.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਸੋਰਠਿ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਭੀਖਨ ਕੀ
659.t: raag soraTh baanee bhagat bheekhan kee
659.e: Raag Sorat'h, The Word Of Devotee Bheekhan Jee:

659.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
659.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
659.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

659.g: ਨੈਨਹੁ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਹੈ ਤਨੁ ਖੀਨਾ ਭਏ ਕੇਸ ਦੁਧ ਵਾਨੀ ॥
659.t: nainahu neer bahai tan kheenaa bhe kes dhudh vaanee ||
659.e: Tears well up in my eyes, my body has become weak, and my hair has become milky-white.

659.g: ਰੂਧਾ ਕੰਠੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਨਹੀ ਉਚਰੈ ਅਬ ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹਿ ਪਰਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
659.t: roodhaa ka(n)Th sabadh nahee ucharai ab kiaa kareh paraanee ||1||
659.e: My throat is tight, and I cannot utter even one word; what can I do now? I am a mere mortal. ||1||

659.g: ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਹੋਹਿ ਬੈਦ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
659.t: raam rai hoh baidh banavaaree ||
659.e: O Lord, my King, Gardener of the world-garden, be my Physician,

659.g: ਅਪਨੇ ਸੰਤਹ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
659.t: apane sa(n)teh leh ubaaree ||1|| rahaau ||
659.e: and save me, Your Saint. ||1||Pause||
