659.g: ਮਾਥੇ ਪੀਰ ਸਰੀਰਿ ਜਲਨਿ ਹੈ ਕਰਕ ਕਰੇਜੇ ਮਾਹੀ ॥
659.t: maathe peer sareer jalan hai karak kareje maahee ||
659.e: My head aches, my body is burning, and my heart is filled with anguish.

659.g: ਐਸੀ ਬੇਦਨ ਉਪਜਿ ਖਰੀ ਭਈ ਵਾ ਕਾ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥੨॥
659.t: aaisee bedhan upaj kharee bhiee vaa kaa aaukhadh naahee ||2||
659.e: Such is the disease that has struck me; there is no medicine to cure it. ||2||

659.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਜਲੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਇਹੁ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਗਿ ਸਾਰਾ ॥
659.t: har kaa naam a(n)mirat jal niramal ih aaukhadh jag saaraa ||
659.e: The Name of the Lord, the ambrosial, immaculate water, is the best medicine in the world.

659.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕਹੈ ਜਨੁ ਭੀਖਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ਮੋਖ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
659.t: gur parasaadh kahai jan bheekhan paavau mokh dhuaaraa ||3||1||
659.e: By Guru's Grace, says servant Bheekhan, I have found the Door of Salvation. ||3||1||

659.g: ਐਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਪੁੰਨਿ ਪਦਾਰਥੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
659.t: aaisaa naam ratan niramolak pu(n)n padhaarath paiaa ||
659.e: Such is the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the invaluable jewel, the most sublime wealth, which I have found through good deeds.

659.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਰਾਖਿਆ ਰਤਨੁ ਨ ਛਪੈ ਛਪਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
659.t: anik jatan kar hiradhai raakhiaa ratan na chhapai chhapaiaa ||1||
659.e: By various efforts, I have enshrined it within my heart; this jewel cannot be hidden by hiding it. ||1||

659.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਕਹਤੇ ਕਹਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥
659.t: har gun kahate kahan na jaiee ||
659.e: The Glorious Praises of the Lord cannot be spoken by speaking.

659.g: ਜੈਸੇ ਗੂੰਗੇ ਕੀ ਮਿਠਿਆਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
659.t: jaise goo(n)ge kee miThiaaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
659.e: They are like the sweet candies given to a mute. ||1||Pause||

659.g: ਰਸਨਾ ਰਮਤ ਸੁਨਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਸ੍ਰਵਨਾ ਚਿਤ ਚੇਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
659.t: rasanaa ramat sunat sukh sravanaa chit chete sukh hoiee ||
659.e: The tongue speaks, the ears listen, and the mind contemplates the Lord; they find peace and comfort.

659.g: ਕਹੁ ਭੀਖਨ ਦੁਇ ਨੈਨ ਸੰਤੋਖੇ ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾਂ ਤਹ ਸੋਈ ॥੨॥੨॥
659.t: kahu bheekhan dhui nain sa(n)tokhe jeh dhekhaa(n) teh soiee ||2||2||
659.e: Says Bheekhan, my eyes are content; wherever I look, there I see the Lord. ||2||2||

660.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
660.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
660.e: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

660.g: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
660.t: ikOankaar sat naam karataa purakh nirabhau niravair akaal moorat ajoonee saibha(n) gur prasaadh ||
660.e: One Universal Creator God. Truth Is The Name. Creative Being Personified. No Fear. No Hatred. Image Of The Undying. Beyond Birth. Self-Existent. By Guru's Grace:

660.g: ਜੀਉ ਡਰਤੁ ਹੈ ਆਪਣਾ ਕੈ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੀ ਪੁਕਾਰ ॥
660.t: jeeau ddarat hai aapanaa kai siau karee pukaar ||
660.e: My soul is afraid; to whom should I complain?

660.g: ਦੂਖ ਵਿਸਾਰਣੁ ਸੇਵਿਆ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
660.t: dhookh visaaran seviaa sadhaa sadhaa dhaataar ||1||
660.e: I serve Him, who makes me forget my pains; He is the Giver, forever and ever. ||1||

660.g: ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਨੀਤ ਨਵਾ ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
660.t: saahib meraa neet navaa sadhaa sadhaa dhaataar ||1|| rahaau ||
660.e: My Lord and Master is forever new; He is the Giver, forever and ever. ||1||Pause||

660.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸੇਵੀਐ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਏ ਸੋਇ ॥
660.t: anadhin saahib seveeaai a(n)t chhaddaae soi ||
660.e: Night and day, I serve my Lord and Master; He shall save me in the end.

660.g: ਸੁਣਿ ਸੁਣਿ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਾਮਣੀ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
660.t: sun sun meree kaamanee paar utaaraa hoi ||2||
660.e: Hearing and listening, O my dear sister, I have crossed over. ||2||

660.g: ਦਇਆਲ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਰਾ ॥
660.t: dhiaal terai naam taraa ||
660.e: O Merciful Lord, Your Name carries me across.

660.g: ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੈ ਜਾਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
660.t: sadh kurabaanai jaau ||1|| rahaau ||
660.e: I am forever a sacrifice to You. ||1||Pause||

660.g: ਸਰਬੰ ਸਾਚਾ ਏਕੁ ਹੈ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥
660.t: saraba(n) saachaa ek hai dhoojaa naahee koi ||
660.e: In all the world, there is only the One True Lord; there is no other at all.

660.g: ਤਾ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ॥੩॥
660.t: taa kee sevaa so kare jaa kau nadhar kare ||3||
660.e: He alone serves the Lord, upon whom the Lord casts His Glance of Grace. ||3||

660.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਾਝੁ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਕੇਵ ਰਹਾ ॥
660.t: tudh baajh piaare kev rahaa ||
660.e: Without You, O Beloved, how could I even live?

660.g: ਸਾ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਦੇਹਿ ਜਿਤੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਲਾਗਿ ਰਹਾਂ ॥
660.t: saa vaddiaaiee dheh jit naam tere laag rahaa(n) ||
660.e: Bless me with such greatness, that I may remain attached to Your Name.

660.g: ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ਜਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਾਇ ਕਹਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
660.t: dhoojaa naahee koi jis aagai piaare jai kahaa ||1|| rahaau ||
660.e: There is no other, O Beloved, to whom I can go and speak. ||1||Pause||

660.g: ਸੇਵੀ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਆਪਣਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਜਾਚੰਉ ਕੋਇ ॥
660.t: sevee saahib aapanaa avar na jaacha(n)au koi ||
660.e: I serve my Lord and Master; I ask for no other.

660.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਤਾ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਬਿੰਦ ਬਿੰਦ ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਹੋਇ ॥੪॥
660.t: naanak taa kaa dhaas hai bi(n)dh bi(n)dh chukh chukh hoi ||4||
660.e: Nanak is His slave; moment by moment, bit by bit, he is a sacrifice to Him. ||4||

660.g: ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ਬਿੰਦ ਬਿੰਦ ਚੁਖ ਚੁਖ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥੪॥੧॥
660.t: saahib tere naam viTahu bi(n)dh bi(n)dh chukh chukh hoi ||1|| rahaau ||4||1||
660.e: O Lord Master, I am a sacrifice to Your Name, moment by moment, bit by bit. ||1||Pause||4||1||

660.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
660.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
660.e: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:

660.g: ਹਮ ਆਦਮੀ ਹਾਂ ਇਕ ਦਮੀ ਮੁਹਲਤਿ ਮੁਹਤੁ ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ॥
660.t: ham aadhamee haa(n) ik dhamee muhalat muhat na jaanaa ||
660.e: We are human beings of the briefest moment; we do not know the appointed time of our departure.

660.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ ਜਾ ਕੇ ਜੀਅ ਪਰਾਣਾ ॥੧॥
660.t: naanak binavai tisai sarevahu jaa ke jeea paraanaa ||1||
660.e: Prays Nanak, serve the One, to whom our soul and breath of life belong. ||1||

660.g: ਅੰਧੇ ਜੀਵਨਾ ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਦੇਖਿ ਕੇਤੇ ਕੇ ਦਿਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
660.t: a(n)dhe jeevanaa veechaar dhekh kete ke dhinaa ||1|| rahaau ||
660.e: You are blind - see and consider, how many days your life shall last. ||1||Pause||

660.g: ਸਾਸੁ ਮਾਸੁ ਸਭੁ ਜੀਉ ਤੁਮਾਰਾ ਤੂ ਮੈ ਖਰਾ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
660.t: saas maas sabh jeeau tumaaraa too mai kharaa piaaraa ||
660.e: My breath, my flesh and my soul are all Yours, Lord; You are so very dear to me.

660.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਸਾਇਰੁ ਏਵ ਕਹਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਚੇ ਪਰਵਦਗਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
660.t: naanak sair ev kahat hai sache paravadhagaaraa ||2||
660.e: Nanak, the poet, says this, O True Lord Cherisher. ||2||

660.g: ਜੇ ਤੂ ਕਿਸੈ ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਢੈ ਗਹਣਾ ॥
660.t: je too kisai na dhehee mere saahibaa kiaa ko kaddai gahanaa ||
660.e: If you gave nothing, O my Lord and Master, what could anyone pledge to You?

660.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਬਿਨਵੈ ਸੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਈਐ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਕਾ ਲਹਣਾ ॥੩॥
660.t: naanak binavai so kichh paieeaai purab likhe kaa lahanaa ||3||
660.e: Nanak prays, we receive that which we are pre-destined to receive. ||3||

660.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਖਸਮ ਕਾ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਕੀਆ ਕਪਟੀ ਕਪਟੁ ਕਮਾਣਾ ॥
660.t: naam khasam kaa chit na keeaa kapaTee kapaT kamaanaa ||
660.e: The deceitful person does not remember the Lord's Name; he practices only deceit.

660.g: ਜਮ ਦੁਆਰਿ ਜਾ ਪਕੜਿ ਚਲਾਇਆ ਤਾ ਚਲਦਾ ਪਛੁਤਾਣਾ ॥੪॥
660.t: jam dhuaar jaa pakaR chalaiaa taa chaladhaa pachhutaanaa ||4||
660.e: When he is marched in chains to Death's door, then, he regrets his actions. ||4||

661.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਦੁਨੀਆ ਰਹੀਐ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਿਛੁ ਸੁਣੀਐ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਹੀਐ ॥
661.t: jab lag dhuneeaa raheeaai naanak kichh suneeaai kichh kaheeaai ||
661.e: As long as we are in this world, O Nanak, we should listen, and speak of the Lord.

661.g: ਭਾਲਿ ਰਹੇ ਹਮ ਰਹਣੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਵਤਿਆ ਮਰਿ ਰਹੀਐ ॥੫॥੨॥
661.t: bhaal rahe ham rahan na paiaa jeevatiaa mar raheeaai ||5||2||
661.e: I have searched, but I have found no way to remain here; so, remain dead while yet alive. ||5||2||
Dhanaasaree, First Mehla, Second House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
How can I remember the Lord in meditation? I cannot meditate on Him in remembrance.
My heart is burning, and my soul is crying out in pain.
The True Lord creates and adorns.
Forgetting Him, how can one be good? ||1||
By clever tricks and commands, He cannot be found.

661.g: ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਸਾਚਿ ਮਿਲਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
661.t: kiau kar saach milau meree mai ||1|| rahaau ||
661.e: How am I to meet my True Lord, O my mother? ||1||Pause||
How rare is the one who goes out, and searches for the merchandise of the Naam.

661.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਚਾਖੈ ਨਾ ਕੋ ਖਾਇ ॥
661.t: naa ko chaakhai naa ko khai ||
661.e: No one tastes it, and no one eats it.
Honor is not obtained by trying to please other people.

661.g: ਤਾ ਪਤਿ ਰਹੈ ਰਾਖੈ ਜਾ ਸੋਇ ॥੨॥
661.t: taa pat rahai raakhai jaa soi ||2||
661.e: One's honor is preserved, only if the Lord preserves it. ||2||
Wherever I look, there I see Him, pervading and permeating.
Without You, I have no other place of rest.

661.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਕੀਤੈ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਇ ॥
661.t: je ko kare keetai kiaa hoi ||
661.e: He may try, but what can anyone do by his own doing?
He alone is blessed, whom the True Lord forgives. ||3||

661.g: ਹੁਣਿ ਉਠਿ ਚਲਣਾ ਮੁਹਤਿ ਕਿ ਤਾਲਿ ॥
661.t: hun uTh chalanaa muhat k taal ||
661.e: Now, I shall have to get up and depart, in an instant, in the clapping of hands.

661.g: ਕਿਆ ਮੁਹੁ ਦੇਸਾ ਗੁਣ ਨਹੀ ਨਾਲਿ ॥
661.t: kiaa muh dhesaa gun nahee naal ||
661.e: What face will I show the Lord? I have no virtue at all.
As is the Lord's Glance of Grace, so it is.
Without His Glance of Grace, O Nanak, no one is blessed. ||4||1||3||
Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:
If the Lord bestows His Glance of Grace, then one remembers Him in meditation.
The soul is softened, and he remains absorbed in the Lord's Love.
His soul and the Supreme Soul become one.
The duality of the inner mind is overcome. ||1||
By Guru's Grace, God is found.

661.g: ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਚਿਤੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਕਾਲੁ ਨ ਖਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
661.t: har siau chit laagai fir kaal na khai ||1|| rahaau ||
661.e: One's consciousness is attached to the Lord, and so Death does not devour him. ||1||Pause||
Remembering the True Lord in meditation, one is enlightened.

661.g: ਤਾ ਤੇ ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਰਹੈ ਉਦਾਸੁ ॥
661.t: taa te bikhiaa meh rahai udhaas ||
661.e: Then, in the midst of Maya, he remains detached.
Such is the Glory of the True Guru;
in the midst of children and spouses, they attain emancipation. ||2||
Such is the service which the Lord's servant performs,

661.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਜੀਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਗੈ ਧਰੈ ॥
661.t: jis kaa jeeau tis aagai dharai ||
661.e: that he dedicates his soul to the Lord, to whom it belongs.
One who is pleasing to the Lord and Master is acceptable.
Such a servant obtains honor in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
He enshrines the image of the True Guru in his heart.
He obtains the rewards which he desires.
The True Lord and Master grants His Grace;

661.g: ਸੋ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕੈਸਾ ਡਰੈ ॥੪॥
661.t: so sevak jam te kaisaa ddarai ||4||
661.e: how can such a servant be afraid of death? ||4||
Prays Nanak, practice contemplation,
and enshrine love for the True Word of His Bani.
Then, you shall find the Gate of Salvation.

661.g: ਜਪੁ ਤਪੁ ਸਭੁ ਇਹੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਹੈ ਸਾਰੁ ॥੫॥੨॥੪॥
661.t: jap tap sabh ih sabadh hai saar ||5||2||4||
661.e: This Shabad is the most excellent of all chanting and austere meditations. ||5||2||4||
Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:
My soul burns, over and over again.
Burning and burning, it is ruined, and it falls into evil.
That body, which forgets the Word of the Guru's Bani,
cries out in pain, like a chronic patient. ||1||
To speak too much and babble is useless.

661.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਬੋਲੇ ਜਾਣੈ ਸਭੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
661.t: vin bole jaanai sabh soi ||1|| rahaau ||
661.e: Even without our speaking, He knows everything. ||1||Pause||
He created our ears, eyes and nose.
He gave us our tongue to speak so fluently.

662.e: He preserved the mind in the fire of the womb;
at His Command, the wind blows everywhere. ||2||
These worldly attachments, loves and pleasurable tastes,
all are just black stains.
One who departs, with these black stains of sin on his face
shall find no place to sit in the Court of the Lord. ||3||
By Your Grace, we chant Your Name.

662.g: ਜਿਤੁ ਲਗਿ ਤਰਣਾ ਹੋਰੁ ਨਹੀ ਥਾਉ ॥
662.t: jit lag taranaa hor nahee thaau ||
662.e: Becoming attached to it, one is saved; there is no other way.

662.g: ਜੇ ਕੋ ਡੂਬੈ ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਵੈ ਸਾਰ ॥
662.t: je ko ddoobai fir hovai saar ||
662.e: Even if one is drowning, still, he may be saved.
O Nanak, the True Lord is the Giver of all. ||4||3||5||
Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:
If a thief praises someone, his mind is not pleased.

662.g: ਜੇ ਬਦੀ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਤਸੂ ਨ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
662.t: je badhee kare taa tasoo na chheejai ||
662.e: If a thief curses him, no damage is done.

662.g: ਚੋਰ ਕੀ ਹਾਮਾ ਭਰੇ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
662.t: chor kee haamaa bhare na koi ||
662.e: No one will take responsibility for a thief.
How can a thief's actions be good? ||1||
Listen, O mind, you blind, false dog!
Even without your speaking, the Lord knows and understands. ||1||Pause||
A thief may be handsome, and a thief may be wise,
but he is still just a counterfeit coin, worth only a shell.
If it is kept and mixed with other coins,
it will be found to be false, when the coins are inspected. ||2||
As one acts, so does he receive.
As he plants, so does he eat.
He may praise himself gloriously,
but still, according to his understanding, so is the path he must follow. ||3||
He may tell hundreds of lies to conceal his falsehood,
and all the world may call him good.
If it pleases You, Lord, even the foolish are approved.
O Nanak, the Lord is wise, knowing, all-knowing. ||4||4||6||
Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:
The body is the paper, and the mind is the inscription written upon it.

662.g: ਸਿਰ ਕੇ ਲੇਖ ਨ ਪੜੈ ਇਆਣਾ ॥
662.t: sir ke lekh na paRai iaanaa ||
662.e: The ignorant fool does not read what is written on his forehead.
In the Court of the Lord, three inscriptions are recorded.
Behold, the counterfeit coin is worthless there. ||1||
O Nanak, if there is silver in it,

662.g: ਖਰਾ ਖਰਾ ਆਖੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
662.t: kharaa kharaa aakhai sabh koi ||1|| rahaau ||
662.e: then everyone proclaims, ""It is genuine, it is genuine.""||1||Pause||
The Qazi tells lies and eats filth;
the Brahmin kills and then takes cleansing baths.
The Yogi is blind, and does not know the Way.
The three of them devise their own destruction. ||2||
He alone is a Yogi, who understands the Way.
By Guru's Grace, he knows the One Lord.
He alone is a Qazi, who turns away from the world,
and who, by Guru's Grace, remains dead while yet alive.
He alone is a Brahmin, who contemplates God.
He saves himself, and saves all his generations as well. ||3||
One who cleanses his own mind is wise.
One who cleanses himself of impurity is a Muslim.
One who reads and understands is acceptable.
Upon his forehead is the Insignia of the Court of the Lord. ||4||5||7||
Dhanaasaree, First Mehla, Third House:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

662.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਜੋਗੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਤ ਕਾ ਢਬੁ ॥
662.t: kaal naahee jog naahee naahee sat kaa ddab ||
662.e: No, no, this is not the time, when people know the way to Yoga and Truth.

662.g: ਥਾਨਸਟ ਜਗ ਭਰਿਸਟ ਹੋਏ ਡੂਬਤਾ ਇਵ ਜਗੁ ॥੧॥
662.t: thaanasaT jag bharisaT hoe ddoobataa iv jag ||1||
662.e: The holy places of worship in the world are polluted, and so the world is drowning. ||1||
In this Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Lord's Name is the most sublime.

662.g: ਅਖੀ ਤ ਮੀਟਹਿ ਨਾਕ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਠਗਣ ਕਉ ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
662.t: akhee ta meeTeh naak pakaReh Thagan kau sa(n)saar ||1|| rahaau ||
662.e: Some people try to deceive the world by closing their eyes and holding their nostrils closed. ||1||Pause||

662.g: ਆਂਟ ਸੇਤੀ ਨਾਕੁ ਪਕੜਹਿ ਸੂਝਤੇ ਤਿਨਿ ਲੋਅ ॥
662.t: aa(n)T setee naak pakaReh soojhate tin loa ||
662.e: They close off their nostrils with their fingers, and claim to see the three worlds.

663.g: ਮਗਰ ਪਾਛੈ ਕਛੁ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ਏਹੁ ਪਦਮੁ ਅਲੋਅ ॥੨॥
663.t: magar paachhai kachh na soojhai eh padham aloa ||2||
663.e: But they cannot even see what is behind them. What a strange lotus pose this is! ||2||

663.g: ਖਤ੍ਰੀਆ ਤ ਧਰਮੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਲੇਛ ਭਾਖਿਆ ਗਹੀ ॥
663.t: khatreeaa ta dharam chhoddiaa malechh bhaakhiaa gahee ||
663.e: The K'shatriyas have abandoned their religion, and have adopted a foreign language.

663.g: ਸ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਸਭ ਇਕ ਵਰਨ ਹੋਈ ਧਰਮ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਰਹੀ ॥੩॥
663.t: sirasaT sabh ik varan hoiee dharam kee gat rahee ||3||
663.e: The whole world has been reduced to the same social status; the state of righteousness and Dharma has been lost. ||3||

663.g: ਅਸਟ ਸਾਜ ਸਾਜਿ ਪੁਰਾਣ ਸੋਧਹਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਬੇਦ ਅਭਿਆਸੁ ॥
663.t: asaT saaj saaj puraan sodheh kareh bedh abhiaas ||
663.e: They analyze eight chapters of (Panini's) grammar and the Puraanas. They study the Vedas,

663.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਮ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਹੈ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਦਾਸੁ ॥੪॥੧॥੬॥੮॥
663.t: bin naam har ke mukat naahee kahai naanak dhaas ||4||1||6||8||
663.e: but without the Lord's Name, no one is liberated; so says Nanak, the Lord's slave. ||4||1||6||8||

663.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਆਰਤੀ
663.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa aaratee
663.e: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla, Aartee:

663.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
663.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
663.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

663.g: ਗਗਨ ਮੈ ਥਾਲੁ ਰਵਿ ਚੰਦੁ ਦੀਪਕ ਬਨੇ ਤਾਰਿਕਾ ਮੰਡਲ ਜਨਕ ਮੋਤੀ ॥
663.t: gagan mai thaal rav cha(n)dh dheepak bane taarikaa ma(n)ddal janak motee ||
663.e: In the bowl of the sky, the sun and moon are the lamps; the stars in the constellations are the pearls.

663.g: ਧੂਪੁ ਮਲਆਨਲੋ ਪਵਣੁ ਚਵਰੋ ਕਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬਨਰਾਇ ਫੂਲੰਤ ਜੋਤੀ ॥੧॥
663.t: dhoop malaanalo pavan chavaro kare sagal banarai foola(n)t jotee ||1||
663.e: The fragrance of sandalwood is the incense, the wind is the fan, and all the vegetation are flowers in offering to You, O Luminous Lord. ||1||

663.g: ਕੈਸੀ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨਾ ਤੇਰੀ ਆਰਤੀ ॥
663.t: kaisee aaratee hoi bhav kha(n)ddanaa teree aaratee ||
663.e: What a beautiful lamp-lit worship service this is! O Destroyer of fear, this is Your Aartee, Your worship service.

663.g: ਅਨਹਤਾ ਸਬਦ ਵਾਜੰਤ ਭੇਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
663.t: anahataa sabadh vaaja(n)t bheree ||1|| rahaau ||
663.e: The sound current of the Shabad is the sounding of the temple drums. ||1||Pause||

663.g: ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਨੈਨ ਨਨ ਨੈਨ ਹੈ ਤੋਹਿ ਕਉ ਸਹਸ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਨਨਾ ਏਕ ਤੋਹੀ ॥
663.t: sahas tav nain nan nain hai toh kau sahas moorat nanaa ek tohee ||
663.e: Thousands are Your eyes, and yet You have no eyes. Thousands are Your forms, and yet You have not even one form.

663.g: ਸਹਸ ਪਦ ਬਿਮਲ ਨਨ ਏਕ ਪਦ ਗੰਧ ਬਿਨੁ ਸਹਸ ਤਵ ਗੰਧ ਇਵ ਚਲਤ ਮੋਹੀ ॥੨॥
663.t: sahas padh bimal nan ek padh ga(n)dh bin sahas tav ga(n)dh iv chalat mohee ||2||
663.e: Thousands are Your lotus feet, and yet You have no feet. Without a nose, thousands are Your noses. I am enchanted with Your play! ||2||

663.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
663.t: sabh meh jot jot hai soi ||
663.e: The Divine Light is within everyone; You are that Light.

663.g: ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਚਾਨਣਿ ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
663.t: tis kai chaanan sabh meh chaanan hoi ||
663.e: Yours is that Light which shines within everyone.

663.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਾਖੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
663.t: gur saakhee jot paragaT hoi ||
663.e: By the Guru's Teachings, this Divine Light is revealed.

663.g: ਜੋ ਤਿਸੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੁ ਆਰਤੀ ਹੋਇ ॥੩॥
663.t: jo tis bhaavai su aaratee hoi ||3||
663.e: That which pleases the Lord is the true worship service. ||3||

663.g: ਹਰਿ ਚਰਣ ਕਮਲ ਮਕਰੰਦ ਲੋਭਿਤ ਮਨੋ ਅਨਦਿਨੋ ਮੋਹਿ ਆਹੀ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
663.t: har charan kamal makara(n)dh lobhit mano anadhino moh aahee piaasaa ||
663.e: My soul is enticed by the honey-sweet lotus feet of the Lord; night and day, I thirst for them.

663.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਜਲੁ ਦੇਹਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਰਿੰਗ ਕਉ ਹੋਇ ਜਾ ਤੇ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਵਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੧॥੭॥੯॥
663.t: kirapaa jal dheh naanak saari(n)g kau hoi jaa te terai naam vaasaa ||4||1||7||9||
663.e: Bless Nanak, the thirsty song-bird, with the water of Your Mercy, that he may come to dwell in Your Name. ||4||1||7||9||

663.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੨ ਚਉਪਦੇ
663.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa teejaa ghar doojaa chaupadhe
663.e: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla, Second House, Chau-Padhay:

663.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
663.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
663.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

663.g: ਇਹੁ ਧਨੁ ਅਖੁਟੁ ਨ ਨਿਖੁਟੈ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
663.t: eih dhan akhuT na nikhuTai na jai ||
663.e: This wealth is inexhaustible. It shall never be exhausted, and it shall never be lost.

663.g: ਪੂਰੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਆ ਦਿਖਾਇ ॥
663.t: poorai satigur dheeaa dhikhai ||
663.e: The Perfect True Guru has revealed it to me.

663.g: ਅਪੁਨੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਸਦ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
663.t: apune satigur kau sadh bal jaiee ||
663.e: I am forever a sacrifice to my True Guru.

663.g: ਗੁਰ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥੧॥
663.t: gur kirapaa te har ma(n)n vasaiee ||1||
663.e: By Guru's Grace, I have enshrined the Lord within my mind. ||1||

663.g: ਸੇ ਧਨਵੰਤ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
663.t: se dhanava(n)t har naam liv lai ||
663.e: They alone are wealthy, who lovingly attune themselves to the Lord's Name.

663.g: ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਪਰਗਾਸਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
663.t: gur poorai har dhan paragaasiaa har kirapaa te vasai man aai || rahaau ||
663.e: The Perfect Guru has revealed to me the Lord's treasure; by the Lord's Grace, it has come to abide in my mind. ||Pause||

663.g: ਅਵਗੁਣ ਕਾਟਿ ਗੁਣ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਮਾਇ ॥
663.t: avagun kaaT gun ridhai samai ||
663.e: He is rid of his demerits, and his heart is permeated with merit and virtue.

663.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਇ ॥
663.t: poore gur kai sahaj subhai ||
663.e: By Guru's Grace, he naturally dwells in celestial peace.

663.g: ਪੂਰੇ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
663.t: poore gur kee saachee baanee ||
663.e: True is the Word of the Perfect Guru's Bani.

663.g: ਸੁਖ ਮਨ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਣੀ ॥੨॥
663.t: sukh man a(n)tar sahaj samaanee ||2||
663.e: They bring peace to the mind, and celestial peace is absorbed within. ||2||

663.g: ਏਕੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਜਨ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥
663.t: ek acharaj jan dhekhahu bhaiee ||
663.e: O my humble Siblings of Destiny, behold this strange and wonderful thing:

663.g: ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਮਾਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਈ ॥
663.t: dhubidhaa maar har ma(n)n vasaiee ||
663.e: duality is overcome, and the Lord dwells within his mind.

663.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਕੁ ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਜਾਇ ॥
663.t: naam amolak na paiaa jai ||
663.e: The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is priceless; it cannot be taken.

663.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਇ ॥੩॥
663.t: gur parasaadh vasai man aai ||3||
663.e: By Guru's Grace, it comes to abide in the mind. ||3||

663.g: ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਵਸੈ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਏਕੋ ਸੋਇ ॥
663.t: sabh meh vasai prabh eko soi ||
663.e: He is the One God, abiding within all.

663.g: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਘਟਿ ਪਰਗਟੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
663.t: gurmatee ghaT paragaT hoi ||
663.e: Through the Guru's Teachings, He is revealed in the heart.

663.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਜਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਜਾਣਿ ਪਛਾਣਿਆ ॥
663.t: sahaje jin prabh jaan pachhaaniaa ||
663.e: One who intuitively knows and realizes God,

664.e: O Nanak, obtains the Naam; his mind is pleased and appeased. ||4||1||
Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:

664.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਅਤਿ ਅਪਾਰਾ ॥
664.t: har naam dhan niramal at apaaraa ||
664.e: The wealth of the Lord's Name is immaculate, and absolutely infinite.
The Word of the Guru's Shabad is over-flowing with treasure.

664.g: ਨਾਮ ਧਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਹੋਰ ਸਭ ਬਿਖੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
664.t: naam dhan bin hor sabh bikh jaan ||
664.e: Know that, except for the wealth of the Name, all other wealth is poison.
The egotistical people are burning in their attachment to Maya. ||1||
How rare is that Gurmukh who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord.

664.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਪੂਰੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
664.t: tis sadhaa ana(n)dh hovai dhin raatee poorai bhaag paraapat hoi || rahaau ||
664.e: He is always in bliss, day and night; through perfect good destiny, he obtains the Name. ||Pause||
The Word of the Shabad is a lamp, illuminating the three worlds.
One who tastes it, becomes immaculate.
The immaculate Naam, the Name of the Lord, washes off the filth of ego.
True devotional worship brings lasting peace. ||2||

664.g: ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚਾਖਿਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਲੋਗੁ ॥
664.t: jin har ras chaakhiaa so har jan log ||
664.e: One who tastes the sublime essence of the Lord is the Lord's humble servant.

664.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਖੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਕਦੇ ਸੋਗੁ ॥
664.t: tis sadhaa harakh naahee kadhe sog ||
664.e: He is forever happy; he is never sad.
He himself is liberated, and he liberates others as well.

664.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਤੇ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੩॥
664.t: har naam japai har te sukh paavai ||3||
664.e: He chants the Lord's Name, and through the Lord, he finds peace. ||3||
Without the True Guru, everyone dies, crying out in pain.
Night and day, they burn, and find no peace.
But meeting the True Guru, all thirst is quenched.
O Nanak, through the Naam, one finds peace and tranquility. ||4||2||
Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:
Gather in and cherish forever the wealth of the Lord's Name, deep within;
He cherishes and nurtures all beings and creatures.
They alone obtain the treasure of Liberation,

664.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤੇ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
664.t: har kai naam rate liv laae ||1||
664.e: who are lovingly imbued with, and focused on the Lord's Name. ||1||

664.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਨੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
664.t: gur sevaa te har naam dhan paavai ||
664.e: Serving the Guru, one obtains the wealth of the Lord's Name.

664.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਪਰਗਾਸੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵੈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
664.t: a(n)tar paragaas har naam dhiaavai || rahaau ||
664.e: He is illumined and enlightened within, and he meditates on the Lord's Name. ||Pause||

664.g: ਇਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਗੂੜਾ ਧਨ ਪਿਰ ਹੋਇ ॥
664.t: eih har ra(n)g gooRaa dhan pir hoi ||
664.e: This love for the Lord is like the love of the bride for her husband.
God ravishes and enjoys the soul-bride who is adorned with peace and tranquility.

664.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
664.t: haumai vich prabh koi na paae ||
664.e: No one finds God through egotism.
Wandering away from the Primal Lord, the root of all, one wastes his life in vain. ||2||

664.g: ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸਾਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖੁ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
664.t: gur te saat sahaj sukh baanee ||
664.e: Tranquility, celestial peace, pleasure and the Word of His Bani come from the Guru.
True is that service, which leads one to merge in the Naam.
Blessed with the Word of the Shabad, he meditates forever on the Lord, the Beloved.
Through the True Name, glorious greatness is obtained. ||3||
The Creator Himself abides throughout the ages.
If He casts His Glance of Grace, then we meet Him.
Through the Word of Gurbani, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind.

664.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਰਤੇ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੩॥
664.t: naanak saach rate prabh aap milaae ||4||3||
664.e: O Nanak, God unites with Himself those who are imbued with Truth. ||4||3||
Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:
The world is polluted, and those in the world become polluted as well.
In attachment to duality, it comes and goes.
This love of duality has ruined the entire world.

664.g: ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਚੋਟਾ ਖਾਇ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਪਤਿ ਖੋਈ ॥੧॥
664.t: manmukh choTaa khai apunee pat khoiee ||1||
664.e: The self-willed manmukh suffers punishment, and forfeits his honor. ||1||

664.g: ਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਤੇ ਜਨੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
664.t: gur sevaa te jan niramal hoi ||
664.e: Serving the Guru, one becomes immaculate.

664.g: ਅੰਤਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਸੈ ਪਤਿ ਊਤਮ ਹੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
664.t: a(n)tar naam vasai pat uootam hoi || rahaau ||
664.e: He enshrines the Naam, the Name of the Lord, within, and his state becomes exalted. ||Pause||
The Gurmukhs are saved, taking to the Lord's Sanctuary.
Attuned to the Lord's Name, they commit themselves to devotional worship.
The Lord's humble servant performs devotional worship, and is blessed with greatness.
Attuned to Truth, he is absorbed in celestial peace. ||2||

664.g: ਸਾਚੇ ਕਾ ਗਾਹਕੁ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
664.t: saache kaa gaahak viralaa ko jaan ||
664.e: Know that one who purchases the True Name is very rare.
Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, he comes to understand himself.
True is his capital, and true is his trade.

664.g: ਸੋ ਧੰਨੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜਿਸੁ ਨਾਮਿ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥੩॥
664.t: so dha(n)n purakh jis naam piaar ||3||
664.e: Blessed is that person, who loves the Naam. ||3||

664.g: ਤਿਨਿ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਇਕਿ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ॥
664.t: tin prabh saachai ik sach laae ||
664.e: God, the True Lord, has attached some to His True Name.
They listen to the most sublime Word of His Bani, and the Word of His Shabad.

665.e: True is service to the True Lord God.
O Nanak, the Naam is the Embellisher. ||4||4||
Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:

665.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ॥
665.t: jo har seveh tin bal jaau ||
665.e: I am a sacrifice to those who serve the Lord.

665.g: ਤਿਨ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਚਾ ਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਉ ॥
665.t: tin hiradhai saach sachaa mukh naau ||
665.e: The Truth is in their hearts, and the True Name is on their lips.
Dwelling upon the Truest of the True, their pains are dispelled.
Through the True Word of the Shabad, the Lord comes to dwell in their minds. ||1||
Listening to the Word of Gurbani, filth is washed off,

665.g: ਸਹਜੇ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
665.t: sahaje har naam ma(n)n vasaae ||1|| rahaau ||
665.e: and they naturally enshrine the Lord's Name in their minds. ||1||Pause||
One who conquers fraud, deceit and the fire of desire
finds tranquility, peace and pleasure within.

665.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਣੈ ਚਲੈ ਤਾ ਆਪੁ ਜਾਇ ॥
665.t: gur kai bhaanai chalai taa aap jai ||
665.e: If one walks in harmony with the Guru's Will, he eliminates his self-conceit.

665.g: ਸਾਚੁ ਮਹਲੁ ਪਾਏ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ॥੨॥
665.t: saach mahal paae har gun gai ||2||
665.e: He finds the True Mansion of the Lord's Presence, singing the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||2||

665.g: ਨ ਸਬਦੁ ਬੂਝੈ ਨ ਜਾਣੈ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
665.t: n sabadh boojhai na jaanai baanee ||
665.e: The blind, self-willed manmukh does not understand the Shabad; he does not know the Word of the Guru's Bani,
and so he passes his life in misery.
But if he meets the True Guru, then he finds peace,
and the ego within is silenced. ||3||

665.g: ਕਿਸ ਨੋ ਕਹੀਐ ਦਾਤਾ ਇਕੁ ਸੋਇ ॥
665.t: kis no kaheeaai dhaataa ik soi ||
665.e: Who else should I speak to? The One Lord is the Giver of all.
When He grants His Grace, then we obtain the Word of the Shabad.
Meeting with my Beloved, I sing the Glorious Praises of the True Lord.
O Nanak, becoming truthful, I have become pleasing to the True Lord. ||4||5||
Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:
When the mind is conquered, its turbulent wanderings are stopped.

665.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਮਨ ਮੂਏ ਕੈਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇ ॥
665.t: bin man mooe kaise har pai ||
665.e: Without conquering the mind, how can the Lord be found?

665.g: ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਰੈ ਦਾਰੂ ਜਾਣੈ ਕੋਇ ॥
665.t: eih man marai dhaaroo jaanai koi ||
665.e: Rare is the one who knows the medicine to conquer the mind.

665.g: ਮਨੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਮਰੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਜਨੁ ਸੋਇ ॥੧॥
665.t: man sabadh marai boojhai jan soi ||1||
665.e: The mind is conquered through the Word of the Shabad; this is known to the Lord's humble servant. ||1||

665.g: ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਬਖਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
665.t: jis no bakhase har dhe vaddiaaiee ||
665.e: The Lord forgives him, and blesses him with glory.

665.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
665.t: gur parasaadh vasai man aaiee || rahaau ||
665.e: By Guru's Grace, the Lord comes to dwell in the mind. ||Pause||
The Gurmukh does good deeds,

665.g: ਤਾ ਇਸੁ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
665.t: taa is man kee sojhee paavai ||
665.e: and so, he comes to understand this mind.
The mind is intoxicated, like the elephant with wine.
The Guru places the harness upon it, and rejuvenates it. ||2||
The mind is undisciplined; only a rare few can discipline it.
If someone eats the uneatable, then he becomes immaculate.
As Gurmukh, his mind is embellished.
Egotism and corruption are eradicated from within. ||3||
Those whom the Primal Lord keeps united in His Union,
shall never be separated from Him; they are merged in the Word of the Shabad.
Only God Himself knows His own power.
O Nanak, the Gurmukh realizes the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||4||6||
Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:
The ignorant fools amass false wealth.
The blind, foolish, self-willed manmukhs have gone astray.

665.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕੈ ਧਨਿ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
665.t: bikhiaa kai dhan sadhaa dhukh hoi ||
665.e: Poisonous wealth brings constant pain.

665.g: ਨਾ ਸਾਥਿ ਜਾਇ ਨ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਹੋਇ ॥੧॥
665.t: naa saath jai na paraapat hoi ||1||
665.e: It will not go with you, and it will not yield any profit. ||1||
True wealth is obtained through the Guru's Teachings.

665.g: ਕਾਚਾ ਧਨੁ ਫੁਨਿ ਆਵੈ ਜਾਏ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
665.t: kaachaa dhan fun aavai jaae || rahaau ||
665.e: False wealth continues coming and going. ||Pause||
The foolish self-willed manmukhs all go astray and die.

665.g: ਭਵਜਲਿ ਡੂਬੇ ਨ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਰਿ ॥
665.t: bhavajal ddoobe na uravaar na paar ||
665.e: They drown in the terrifying world-ocean, and they cannot reach either this shore, or the one beyond.
But by perfect destiny, they meet the True Guru;
imbued with the True Name, day and night, they remain detached from the world. ||2||

665.g: ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗ ਮਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸਾਚੀ ਬਾਣੀ ॥
665.t: chahu jug meh a(n)mrit saachee baanee ||
665.e: Throughout the four ages, the True Bani of His Word is Ambrosial Nectar.
By perfect destiny, one is absorbed in the True Name.
The Siddhas, the seekers and all men long for the Name.
It is obtained only by perfect destiny. ||3||

665.g: ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਚਾ ਹੈ ਸੋਇ ॥
665.t: sabh kichh saachaa saachaa hai soi ||
665.e: The True Lord is everything; He is True.
Only a few realize the exalted Lord God.
He is the Truest of the True; He Himself implants the True Name within.

666.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਵੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ॥੪॥੭॥
666.t: naanak aape vekhai aape sach laae ||4||7||
666.e: O Nanak, the Lord Himself sees all; He Himself links us to the Truth. ||4||7||

666.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ॥
666.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa teejaa ||
666.e: Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla:

666.g: ਨਾਵੈ ਕੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥
666.t: naavai kee keemat mit kahee na jai ||
666.e: The value and worth of the Lord's Name cannot be described.

666.g: ਸੇ ਜਨ ਧੰਨੁ ਜਿਨ ਇਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ॥
666.t: se jan dha(n)n jin ik naam liv lai ||
666.e: Blessed are those humble beings, who lovingly focus their minds on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

666.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਚੀ ਸਾਚਾ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
666.t: gurmat saachee saachaa veechaar ||
666.e: True are the Guru's Teachings, and True is contemplative meditation.

666.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦੇ ਵੀਚਾਰੁ ॥੧॥
666.t: aape bakhase dhe veechaar ||1||
666.e: God Himself forgives, and bestows contemplative meditation. ||1||

666.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਆਪਿ ਸੁਣਾਏ ॥
666.t: har naam acharaj prabh aap sunaae ||
666.e: The Lord's Name is wonderful! God Himself imparts it.

666.g: ਕਲੀ ਕਾਲ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
666.t: kalee kaal vich gurmukh paae ||1|| rahaau ||
666.e: In the Dark Age of Kali Yuga, the Gurmukhs obtain it. ||1||Pause||

666.g: ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੂਰਖ ਮਨ ਮਾਹਿ ॥
666.t: ham moorakh moorakh man maeh ||
666.e: We are ignorant; ignorance fills our minds.

666.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਸਭ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਹਿ ॥
666.t: haumai vich sabh kaar kamaeh ||
666.e: We do all our deeds in ego.

666.g: ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਹੰਉਮੈ ਜਾਇ ॥
666.t: gur parasaadhee ha(n)aumai jai ||
666.e: By Guru's Grace, egotism is eradicated.

666.g: ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਲਏ ਮਿਲਾਇ ॥੨॥
666.t: aape bakhase le milai ||2||
666.e: Forgiving us, the Lord blends us with Himself. ||2||

666.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਕਾ ਧਨੁ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਅਭਿਮਾਨੁ ॥
666.t: bikhiaa kaa dhan bahut abhimaan ||
666.e: Poisonous wealth gives rise to great arrogance.

666.g: ਅਹੰਕਾਰਿ ਡੂਬੈ ਨ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਾਨੁ ॥
666.t: aha(n)kaar ddoobai na paavai maan ||
666.e: Drowning in egotism, no one is honored.

666.g: ਆਪੁ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਈ ॥
666.t: aap chhodd sadhaa sukh hoiee ||
666.e: Forsaking self-conceit, one finds lasting peace.

666.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੩॥
666.t: gurmat saalaahee sach soiee ||3||
666.e: Under Guru's Instruction, he praises the True Lord. ||3||

666.g: ਆਪੇ ਸਾਜੇ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੋਇ ॥
666.t: aape saaje karataa soi ||
666.e: The Creator Lord Himself fashions all.

666.g: ਤਿਸੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥
666.t: tis bin dhoojaa avar na koi ||
666.e: Without Him, there is no other at all.

666.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਸਚਿ ਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਲਾਗੈ ॥
666.t: jis sach laae soiee laagai ||
666.e: He alone is attached to Truth, whom the Lord Himself so attaches.

666.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਆਗੈ ॥੪॥੮॥
666.t: naanak naam sadhaa sukh aagai ||4||8||
666.e: O Nanak, through the Naam, lasting peace is attained in the hereafter. ||4||8||

666.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਿਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੩ ਘਰੁ ੪
666.t: raag dhanaasiree mahalaa teejaa ghar chauthhaa
666.e: Raag Dhanaasaree, Third Mehla, Fourth House:

666.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
666.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
666.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

666.g: ਹਮ ਭੀਖਕ ਭੇਖਾਰੀ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਨਿਜ ਪਤਿ ਹੈ ਦਾਤਾ ॥
666.t: ham bheekhak bhekhaaree tere too nij pat hai dhaataa ||
666.e: I am just a poor beggar of Yours; You are Your Own Lord Master, You are the Great Giver.

666.g: ਹੋਹੁ ਦੈਆਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਮੰਗਤ ਜਨ ਕੰਉ ਸਦਾ ਰਹਉ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ॥੧॥
666.t: hoh dhaiaal naam dheh ma(n)gat jan ka(n)au sadhaa rahau ra(n)g raataa ||1||
666.e: Be Merciful, and bless me, a humble beggar, with Your Name, so that I may forever remain imbued with Your Love. ||1||

666.g: ਹੰਉ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ਸਾਚੇ ਤੇਰੇ ਨਾਮ ਵਿਟਹੁ ॥
666.t: ha(n)au balihaarai jaau saache tere naam viTahu ||
666.e: I am a sacrifice to Your Name, O True Lord.

666.g: ਕਰਣ ਕਾਰਣ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਾ ਏਕੋ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਕੋਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
666.t: karan kaaran sabhanaa kaa eko avar na dhoojaa koiee ||1|| rahaau ||
666.e: The One Lord is the Cause of causes; there is no other at all. ||1||Pause||

666.g: ਬਹੁਤੇ ਫੇਰ ਪਏ ਕਿਰਪਨ ਕਉ ਅਬ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
666.t: bahute fer pe kirapan kau ab kichh kirapaa keejai ||
666.e: I was wretched; I wandered through so many cycles of reincarnation. Now, Lord, please bless me with Your Grace.

666.g: ਹੋਹੁ ਦਇਆਲ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਐਸੀ ਬਖਸ ਕਰੀਜੈ ॥੨॥
666.t: hoh dhiaal dharasan dheh apunaa aaisee bakhas kareejai ||2||
666.e: Be merciful, and grant me the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan; please grant me such a gift. ||2||

666.g: ਭਨਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਭਰਮ ਪਟ ਖੂਲੑੇ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦੀ ਜਾਨਿਆ ॥
666.t: bhanat naanak bharam paT khool(h)e gur parasaadhee jaaniaa ||
666.e: Prays Nanak, the shutters of doubt have been opened wide; by Guru's Grace, I have come to know the Lord.

666.g: ਸਾਚੀ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ਹੈ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ॥੩॥੧॥੯॥
666.t: saachee liv laagee hai bheetar satigur siau man maaniaa ||3||1||9||
666.e: I am filled to overflowing with true love; my mind is pleased and appeased by the True Guru. ||3||1||9||

666.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
666.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
666.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

666.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
666.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
666.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

666.g: ਜੋ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹਿ ਸੰਤ ਭਗਤ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਸਭਿ ਪਾਪ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥
666.t: jo har seveh sa(n)t bhagat tin ke sabh paap nivaaree ||
666.e: Those Saints and devotees who serve the Lord have all their sins washed away.

666.g: ਹਮ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਰਖੁ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਤੁਮ ਜੁ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੧॥
666.t: ham uoopar kirapaa kar suaamee rakh sa(n)gat tum ju piaaree ||1||
666.e: Have Mercy on me, O Lord and Master, and keep me in the Sangat, the Congregation that You love. ||1||

666.g: ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥
666.t: har gun keh na sakau banavaaree ||
666.e: I cannot even speak the Praises of the Lord, the Gardener of the world.

666.g: ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਪਾਥਰ ਨੀਰਿ ਡੁਬਤ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪਾਖਣ ਹਮ ਤਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
666.t: ham paapee paathar neer ddubat kar kirapaa paakhan ham taaree || rahaau ||
666.e: We are sinners, sinking like stones in water; grant Your Grace, and carry us stones across. ||Pause||

666.g: ਜਨਮ ਜਨਮ ਕੇ ਲਾਗੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਮੋਰਚਾ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥
666.t: janam janam ke laage bikh morachaa lag sa(n)gat saadh savaaree ||
666.e: The rust of poison and corruption from countless incarnations sticks to us; joining the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, it is cleaned away.

666.g: ਜਿਉ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਬੈਸੰਤਰਿ ਤਾਇਓ ਮਲੁ ਕਾਟੀ ਕਟਿਤ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
666.t: jiau ka(n)chan baisa(n)tar taio mal kaaTee kaTit utaaree ||2||
666.e: It is just like gold, which is heated in the fire, to remove the impurities from it. ||2||

666.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਉ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
666.t: har har japan japau dhin raatee jap har har har ur dhaaree ||
666.e: I chant the chant of the Name of the Lord, day and night; I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, and enshrine it within my heart.

666.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਉਖਧੁ ਜਗਿ ਪੂਰਾ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਉਮੈ ਮਾਰੀ ॥੩॥
666.t: har har har aaukhadh jag pooraa jap har har haumai maaree ||3||
666.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, Har, is the most perfect medicine in this world; chanting the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have conquered my ego. ||3||

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅਗਮ ਅਗਾਧਿ ਬੋਧਿ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਪਾਰੀ ॥
667.t: har har agam agaadh bodh apara(n)par purakh apaaree ||
667.e: The Lord, Har, Har, is unapproachable, of unfathomable wisdom, unlimited, all-powerful and infinite.

667.g: ਜਨ ਕਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਪੈਜ ਸਵਾਰੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
667.t: jan kau kirapaa karahu jagajeevan jan naanak paij savaaree ||4||1||
667.e: Show Mercy to Your humble servant, O Life of the world, and save the honor of servant Nanak. ||4||1||

667.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
667.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
667.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੀ ॥
667.t: har ke sa(n)t janaa har japio tin kaa dhookh bharam bhau bhaagee ||
667.e: The humble Saints of the Lord meditate on the Lord; their pain, doubt and fear have run away.

667.g: ਅਪਨੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਆਪਿ ਕਰਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਜਾਗੀ ॥੧॥
667.t: apanee sevaa aap karaiee gurmat a(n)tar jaagee ||1||
667.e: The Lord Himself inspires them to serve Him; they are awakened within to the Guru's Teachings. ||1||

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਾ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
667.t: har kai naam rataa bairaagee ||
667.e: Imbued with the Lord's Name, they are unattached to the world.

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਣੀ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
667.t: har har kathaa sunee man bhaiee gurmat har liv laagee ||1|| rahaau ||
667.e: Listening to the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, their minds are pleased; through Guru's Instruction, they enshrine love for the Lord. ||1||Pause||

667.g: ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ਜਾਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਤੁਮੑ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਹਮ ਸਾਂਗੀ ॥
667.t: sa(n)t janaa kee jaat har suaamee tum(h) Thaakur ham saa(n)gee ||
667.e: God, the Lord and Master, is the caste and social status of His humble Saints. You are the Lord and Master; I am just Your puppet.

667.g: ਜੈਸੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਤੈਸੇ ਬੁਲਗ ਬੁਲਾਗੀ ॥੨॥
667.t: jaisee mat dhevahu har suaamee ham taise bulag bulaagee ||2||
667.e: As is the understanding You bless us with, so are the words we speak. ||2||

667.g: ਕਿਆ ਹਮ ਕਿਰਮ ਨਾਨੑ ਨਿਕ ਕੀਰੇ ਤੁਮੑ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਾਗੀ ॥
667.t: kiaa ham kiram naan(h) nik keere tum(h) vadd purakh vaddaagee ||
667.e: What are we? Tiny worms, and microscopic germs. You are our great and glorious Lord and Master.

667.g: ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮਿਲਹ ਅਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
667.t: tum(h)ree gat mit keh na sakeh prabh ham kiau kar mileh abhaagee ||3||
667.e: I cannot describe Your state and extent. O God, how can we unfortunate ones meet with You? ||3||

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰਹੁ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
667.t: har prabh suaamee kirapaa dhaarahu ham har har sevaa laagee ||
667.e: O God, my Lord and Master, shower me with Your Mercy, and commit me to Your service.

667.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਥਾਗੀ ॥੪॥੨॥
667.t: naanak dhaasan dhaas karahu prabh ham har kathaa kathaagee ||4||2||
667.e: Make Nanak the slave of Your slaves, God; I speak the speech of the Lord's sermon. ||4||2||

667.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
667.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
667.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸਤ ਪੁਰਖਾ ਜੋ ਬੋਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
667.t: har kaa sa(n)t satagur sat purakhaa jo bolai har har baanee ||
667.e: The True Guru is the Lord's Saint, the True Being, who chants the Bani of the Lord, Har, Har.

667.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਕਹੈ ਸੁਣੈ ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਹਮ ਤਿਸ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਕੁਰਬਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
667.t: jo jo kahai sunai so mukataa ham tis kai sadh kurabaanee ||1||
667.e: Whoever chants it, and listens to it, is liberated; I am forever a sacrifice to him. ||1||

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਜਸੁ ਕਾਨੀ ॥
667.t: har ke sa(n)t sunahu jas kaanee ||
667.e: O Saints of the Lord, listen to the Lord's Praises with your ears.

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਇਕ ਨਿਮਖ ਪਲ ਸਭਿ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਾਪ ਲਹਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
667.t: har har kathaa sunahu ik nimakh pal sabh kilavikh paap leh jaanee ||1|| rahaau ||
667.e: Listen to the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, for a moment, for even an instant, and all your sins and mistakes shall be erased. ||1||Pause||

667.g: ਐਸਾ ਸੰਤੁ ਸਾਧੁ ਜਿਨ ਪਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡਾਨੀ ॥
667.t: aaisaa sa(n)t saadh jin paiaa te vadd purakh vaddaanee ||
667.e: Those who find such humble, Holy Saints, are the greatest of the great persons.

667.g: ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਧੂਰਿ ਮੰਗਹ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਹਰਿ ਲੋਚ ਲੁਚਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
667.t: tin kee dhoor ma(n)geh prabh suaamee ham har loch luchaanee ||2||
667.e: I beg for the dust of their feet; I long for the longing for God, my Lord and Master. ||2||

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਫਲਿਓ ਬਿਰਖੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਸੇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥
667.t: har har safalio birakh prabh suaamee jin japio se tirapataanee ||
667.e: The Name of God, the Lord and Master, Har, Har, is the fruit-bearing tree; those who meditate on it are satisfied.

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਸੇ ਸਭ ਲਾਥੀ ਭੂਖ ਭੁਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
667.t: har har a(n)mrit pee tirapataase sabh laathee bhookh bhukhaanee ||3||
667.e: Drinking in the ambrosia of the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I am satisfied; all my hunger and thirst is quenched. ||3||

667.g: ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਵਡੇ ਭਾਗ ਵਡ ਊਚੇ ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਜਪਾਨੀ ॥
667.t: jin ke vadde bhaag vadd uooche tin har japio japaanee ||
667.e: Those who are blessed with the highest, loftiest destiny, chant and meditate on the Lord.

667.g: ਤਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੩॥
667.t: tin har sa(n)gat mel prabh suaamee jan naanak dhaas dhasaanee ||4||3||
667.e: Let me join their congregation, O God, my Lord and Master; Nanak is the slave of their slaves. ||4||3||

667.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
667.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
667.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

667.g: ਹਮ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ ਅੰਧ ਬਿਖੈ ਬਿਖੁ ਰਾਤੇ ਕਿਉ ਚਾਲਹ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
667.t: ham a(n)dhule a(n)dh bikhai bikh raate kiau chaaleh gur chaalee ||
667.e: I am blind, totally blind, entangled in corruption and poison. How can I walk on the Guru's Path?

667.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਦਇਆ ਕਰੇ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਮ ਲਾਵੈ ਆਪਨ ਪਾਲੀ ॥੧॥
667.t: satagur dhiaa kare sukhadhaataa ham laavai aapan paalee ||1||
667.e: If the True Guru, the Giver of peace, shows His kindness, He attaches us to the hem of His robe. ||1||

667.g: ਗੁਰਸਿਖ ਮੀਤ ਚਲਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਚਾਲੀ ॥
667.t: gursikh meet chalahu gur chaalee ||
667.e: O Sikhs of the Guru, O friends, walk on the Guru's Path.

667.g: ਜੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਹੈ ਸੋਈ ਭਲ ਮਾਨਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਨਿਰਾਲੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
667.t: jo gur kahai soiee bhal maanahu har har kathaa niraalee ||1|| rahaau ||
667.e: Whatever the Guru says, accept that as good; the sermon of the Lord, Har, Har, is unique and wonderful. ||1||Pause||

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਸੁਣਹੁ ਜਨ ਭਾਈ ਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿਹੁ ਬੇਗਿ ਬੇਗਾਲੀ ॥
667.t: har ke sa(n)t sunahu jan bhaiee gur sevih beg begaalee ||
667.e: O Saints of the Lord, O Siblings of Destiny, listen: serve the Guru, quickly now!

667.g: ਸਤਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਹਰਿ ਬਾਧਹੁ ਮਤ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਆਜੁ ਕਿ ਕਾਲੑੀ ॥੨॥
667.t: satagur sev kharach har baadhahu mat jaanahu aaj k kaal(h)ee ||2||
667.e: Let your service to the True Guru be your supplies on the Lord's Path; pack them up, and don't think of today or tomorrow. ||2||

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਪਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਣਾ ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤੁ ਚਲੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੀ ॥
667.t: har ke sa(n)t japahu har japanaa har sa(n)t chalai har naalee ||
667.e: O Saints of the Lord, chant the chant of the Lord's Name; the Lord's Saints walk with the Lord.

667.g: ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਏ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕੇਲ ਕੇਲਾਲੀ ॥੩॥
667.t: jin har japiaa se har hoe har miliaa kel kelaalee ||3||
667.e: Those who meditate on the Lord, become the Lord; the playful, wondrous Lord meets them. ||3||

667.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਿ ਲੋਚ ਲੋੁਚਾਨੀ ਹਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਵਾਲੀ ॥
667.t: har har japan jap loch luochaanee har kirapaa kar banavaalee ||
667.e: To chant the chant of the Lord's Name, Har, Har, is the longing I long for; have Mercy upon me, O Lord of the world-forest.

667.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਮ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਪਗ ਰਾਲੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
667.t: jan naanak sa(n)gat saadh har melahu ham saadh janaa pag raalee ||4||4||
667.e: O Lord, unite servant Nanak with the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy; make me the dust of the feet of the Holy. ||4||4||

668.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
668.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
668.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

668.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੂੰਦ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਮ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਬਿਲਲ ਬਿਲਲਾਤੀ ॥
668.t: har har boo(n)dh bhe har suaamee ham chaatirak bilal bilalaatee ||
668.e: The Lord, Har, Har, is the rain-drop; I am the song-bird, crying, crying out for it.

668.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਪਨੀ ਮੁਖਿ ਦੇਵਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਿਮਖਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
668.t: har har kirapaa karahu prabh apanee mukh dhevahu har nimakhaatee ||1||
668.e: O Lord God, please bless me with Your Mercy, and pour Your Name into my mouth, even if for only an instant. ||1||

668.g: ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਰਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਉ ਇਕ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
668.t: har bin reh na sakau ik raatee ||
668.e: Without the Lord, I cannot live for even a second.

668.g: ਜਿਉ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਮਲੈ ਅਮਲੀ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ਹੈ ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਮ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਤੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
668.t: jiau bin amalai amalee mar jaiee hai tiau har bin ham mar jaatee || rahaau ||
668.e: Like the addict who dies without his drug, I die without the Lord. ||Pause||

668.g: ਤੁਮ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਵਰ ਅਤਿ ਅਗਾਹ ਹਮ ਲਹਿ ਨ ਸਕਹਿ ਅੰਤੁ ਮਾਤੀ ॥
668.t: tum har saravar at agaeh ham leh na sakeh a(n)t maatee ||
668.e: You, Lord, are the deepest, most unfathomable ocean; I cannot find even a trace of Your limits.

668.g: ਤੂ ਪਰੈ ਪਰੈ ਅਪਰੰਪਰੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਮਿਤਿ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਆਪਨ ਗਾਤੀ ॥੨॥
668.t: too parai parai apara(n)par suaamee mit jaanahu aapan gaatee ||2||
668.e: You are the most remote of the remote, limitless and transcendent; O Lord Master, You alone know Your state and extent. ||2||

668.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਰੰਗਿ ਚਲੂਲੈ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
668.t: har ke sa(n)t janaa har japio gur ra(n)g chaloolai raatee ||
668.e: The Lord's humble Saints meditate on the Lord; they are imbued with the deep crimson color of the Guru's Love.

668.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਬਨੀ ਅਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਊਤਮ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੩॥
668.t: har har bhagat banee at sobhaa har japio uootam paatee ||3||
668.e: Meditating on the Lord, they attain great glory, and the most sublime honor. ||3||

668.g: ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ ਆਪਿ ਬਨਾਵੈ ਭਾਤੀ ॥
668.t: aape Thaakur aape sevak aap banaavai bhaatee ||
668.e: He Himself is the Lord and Master, and He Himself is the servant; He Himself creates His environments.

668.g: ਨਾਨਕੁ ਜਨੁ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਲਾਜ ਭਗਾਤੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
668.t: naanak jan tumaree saranaiee har raakhahu laaj bhagaatee ||4||5||
668.e: Servant Nanak has come to Your Sanctuary, O Lord; protect and preserve the honor of Your devotee. ||4||5||

668.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
668.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
668.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

668.g: ਕਲਿਜੁਗ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਤੁਮ ਭਾਈ ਕਿਵ ਛੂਟਹ ਹਮ ਛੁਟਕਾਕੀ ॥
668.t: kalijug kaa dharam kahahu tum bhaiee kiv chhooTeh ham chhuTakaakee ||
668.e: Tell me, O Siblings of Destiny, the religion for this Dark Age of Kali Yuga. I seek emancipation - how can I be emancipated?

668.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਬੇੜੀ ਹਰਿ ਤੁਲਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਓ ਤਰੈ ਤਰਾਕੀ ॥੧॥
668.t: har har jap beRee har tulahaa har japio tarai taraakee ||1||
668.e: Meditation on the Lord, Har, Har, is the boat, the raft; meditating on the Lord, the swimmer swims across. ||1||

668.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀ ਲਾਜ ਰਖਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ॥
668.t: har jee laaj rakhahu har jan kee ||
668.e: O Dear Lord, protect and preserve the honor of Your humble servant.

668.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨੁ ਜਪਾਵਹੁ ਅਪਨਾ ਹਮ ਮਾਗੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਇਕਾਕੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
668.t: har har japan japaavahu apanaa ham maagee bhagat ikaakee || rahaau ||
668.e: O Lord, Har, Har, please make me chant the chant of Your Name; I beg only for Your devotional worship. ||Pause||

668.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਜਿਨ ਜਪਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਬਚਨਾਕੀ ॥
668.t: har ke sevak se har piaare jin japio har bachanaakee ||
668.e: The Lord's servants are very dear to the Lord; they chant the Word of the Lord's Bani.

668.g: ਲੇਖਾ ਚਿਤ੍ਰ ਗੁਪਤਿ ਜੋ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਭ ਛੂਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਬਾਕੀ ॥੨॥
668.t: lekhaa chitr gupat jo likhiaa sabh chhooTee jam kee baakee ||2||
668.e: The account of the recording angels, Chitr and Gupt, and the account with the Messenger of Death is totally erased. ||2||

668.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਸੰਤ ਜਪਿਓ ਮਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਗਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧ ਜਨਾ ਕੀ ॥
668.t: har ke sa(n)t japio man har har lag sa(n)gat saadh janaa kee ||
668.e: The Saints of the Lord meditate on the Lord in their minds; they join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

668.g: ਦਿਨੀਅਰੁ ਸੂਰੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਅਗਨਿ ਬੁਝਾਨੀ ਸਿਵ ਚਰਿਓ ਚੰਦੁ ਚੰਦਾਕੀ ॥੩॥
668.t: dhineear soor tirasanaa agan bujhaanee siv chario cha(n)dh cha(n)dhaakee ||3||
668.e: The piercing sun of desires has set, and the cool moon has risen. ||3||

668.g: ਤੁਮ ਵਡ ਪੁਰਖ ਵਡ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਤੁਮ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਅਪਾਕੀ ॥
668.t: tum vadd purakh vadd agam agochar tum aape aap apaakee ||
668.e: You are the Greatest Being, absolutely unapproachable and unfathomable; You created the Universe from Your Own Being.

668.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕੀਜੈ ਕਰਿ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ਦਸਾਕੀ ॥੪॥੬॥
668.t: jan naanak kau prabh kirapaa keejai kar dhaasan dhaas dhasaakee ||4||6||
668.e: O God, take pity on servant Nanak, and make him the slave of the slave of Your slaves. ||4||6||

668.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੫ ਦੁਪਦੇ
668.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ghar panjavaa dhupadhe
668.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla, Fifth House, Dho-Padhay:

668.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
668.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
668.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

668.g: ਉਰ ਧਾਰਿ ਬੀਚਾਰਿ ਮੁਰਾਰਿ ਰਮੋ ਰਮੁ ਮਨਮੋਹਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪੀਨੇ ॥
668.t: aur dhaar beechaar muraar ramo ram manmohan naam japeene ||
668.e: Enshrine the Lord within your heart, and contemplate Him. Dwell upon Him, reflect upon Him, and chant the Name of the Lord, the Enticer of hearts.

668.g: ਅਦ੍ਰਿਸਟੁ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਅਪਰੰਪਰ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਪੂਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਗਟ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਨੇ ॥੧॥
668.t: adhirasaT agochar apara(n)par suaamee gur poorai pragaT kar dheene ||1||
668.e: The Lord Master is unseen, unfathomable and unreachable; through the Perfect Guru, He is revealed. ||1||

668.g: ਰਾਮ ਪਾਰਸ ਚੰਦਨ ਹਮ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਸਟ ॥
668.t: raam paaras cha(n)dhan ham kaasaT losaT ||
668.e: The Lord is the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold, and sandalwood, while I am just dry wood and iron.

668.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰੀ ਸਤਸੰਗੁ ਭਏ ਹਰਿ ਕੰਚਨੁ ਚੰਦਨੁ ਕੀਨੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
668.t: har sa(n)g haree satasa(n)g bhe har ka(n)chan cha(n)dhan keene ||1|| rahaau ||
668.e: Associating with the Lord, and the Sat Sangat, the Lord's True Congregation, the Lord has transformed me into gold and sandalwood. ||1||Pause||

668.g: ਨਵ ਛਿਅ ਖਟੁ ਬੋਲਹਿ ਮੁਖ ਆਗਰ ਮੇਰਾ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਇਵ ਨ ਪਤੀਨੇ ॥
668.t: nav chhia khaT boleh mukh aagar meraa har prabh iv na pateene ||
668.e: One may repeat, verbatim, the nine grammars and the six Shaastras, but my Lord God is not pleased by this.

668.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਸਦ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ ਇਉ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਭੀਨੇ ॥੨॥੧॥੭॥
668.t: jan naanak har hiradhai sadh dhiaavahu iau har prabh meraa bheene ||2||1||7||
668.e: O servant Nanak, meditate forever on the Lord in your heart; this is what pleases my Lord God. ||2||1||7||

668.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
668.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
668.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

669.g: ਗੁਨ ਕਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਹੁ ਕਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਇਵ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ॥
669.t: gun kahu har lahu kar sevaa satigur iv har har naam dhiaaiee ||
669.e: Chant His Praises, learn of the Lord, and serve the True Guru; in this way, meditate on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

669.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਗਹ ਭਾਵਹਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜਨਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥
669.t: har dharageh bhaaveh fir janam na aaveh har har har jot samaiee ||1||
669.e: In the Court of the Lord, He shall be pleased with you, and you shall not have to enter the cycle of reincarnation again; you shall merge in the Divine Light of the Lord, Har, Har, Har. ||1||

669.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰੀ ਹੋਹਿ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖੀ ॥
669.t: jap man naam haree hoh sarab sukhee ||
669.e: Chant the Name of the Lord, O my mind, and you shall be totally at peace.

669.g: ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਚ ਸਭਨਾ ਤੇ ਊਪਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਿ ਛਡਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
669.t: har jas uooch sabhanaa te uoopar har har har sev chhaddaiee || rahaau ||
669.e: The Lord's Praises are the most sublime, the most exalted; serving the Lord, Har, Har, Har, you shall be emancipated. ||Pause||

669.g: ਹਰਿ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਨਿਧਿ ਕੀਨੀ ਗੁਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਤਬ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਬਨਿ ਆਈ ॥
669.t: har kirapaa nidh keenee gur bhagat har dheenee tab har siau preet ban aaiee ||
669.e: The Lord, the treasure of mercy, blessed me, and so the Guru blessed me with the Lord's devotional worship; I have come to be in love with the Lord.

669.g: ਬਹੁ ਚਿੰਤ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਉਰਿ ਧਾਰੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਏ ਹੈ ਸਖਾਈ ॥੨॥੨॥੮॥
669.t: bahu chi(n)t visaaree har naam ur dhaaree naanak har bhe hai sakhaiee ||2||2||8||
669.e: I have forgotten my cares and anxieties, and enshrined the Lord's Name in my heart; O Nanak, the Lord has become my friend and companion. ||2||2||8||

669.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
669.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
669.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

669.g: ਹਰਿ ਪੜੁ ਹਰਿ ਲਿਖੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਉਜਲੁ ਪਾਰਿ ਉਤਾਰੀ ॥
669.t: har paR har likh har jap har gaau har bhaujal paar utaaree ||
669.e: Read about the Lord, write about the Lord, chant the Lord's Name, and sing the Lord's Praises; the Lord will carry you across the terrifying world-ocean.

669.g: ਮਨਿ ਬਚਨਿ ਰਿਦੈ ਧਿਆਇ ਹਰਿ ਹੋਇ ਸੰਤੁਸਟੁ ਇਵ ਭਣੁ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੀ ॥੧॥
669.t: man bachan ridhai dhiaai har hoi sa(n)tusaT iv bhan har naam muraaree ||1||
669.e: In your mind, by your words, and within your heart, meditate on the Lord, and He will be pleased. In this way, repeat the Name of the Lord. ||1||

669.g: ਮਨਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਹਰਿ ਜਗਦੀਸ ॥
669.t: man japeeaai har jagadhees ||
669.e: O mind, meditate on the Lord, the Lord of the World.

669.g: ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਮੀਤ ॥
669.t: mil sa(n)gat saadhoo meet ||
669.e: Join the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, O friend.

669.g: ਸਦਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਬਨਵਾਰੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
669.t: sadhaa ana(n)dh hovai dhin raatee har keerat kar banavaaree || rahaau ||
669.e: You shall be happy forever, day and night; sing the Praises of the Lord, the Lord of the world-forest. ||Pause||

669.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਰੀ ਦ੍ਰਿਸਟਿ ਤਬ ਭਇਓ ਮਨਿ ਉਦਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿਓ ਗਤਿ ਭਈ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
669.t: har har karee dhirasaT tab bhio man udham har har naam japio gat bhiee hamaaree ||
669.e: When the Lord, Har, Har, casts His Glance of Grace, then I made the effort in my mind; meditating on the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, I have been emancipated.

669.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਪਤਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਇ ਪਰਿਓ ਹੈ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੩॥੯॥
669.t: jan naanak kee pat raakh mere suaamee har aai pario hai saran tumaaree ||2||3||9||
669.e: Preserve the honor of servant Nanak, O my Lord and Master; I have come seeking Your Sanctuary. ||2||3||9||

669.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
669.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
669.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

669.g: ਚਉਰਾਸੀਹ ਸਿਧ ਬੁਧ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਕੋਟਿ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਸਭਿ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਉ ॥
669.t: chauraaseeh sidh budh tetees koT mun jan sabh chaaheh har jeeau tero naau ||
669.e: The eighty-four Siddhas, the spiritual masters, the Buddhas, the three hundred thirty million gods and the silent sages, all long for Your Name, O Dear Lord.

669.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਲਿਲਾਟਿ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਧੁਰਿ ਭਾਉ ॥੧॥
669.t: gur prasaadh ko viralaa paavai jin kau lilaaT likhiaa dhur bhaau ||1||
669.e: By Guru's Grace, a rare few obtain it; upon their foreheads, the pre-ordained destiny of loving devotion is written. ||1||

669.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਰਾਮੈ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮ ਕਾਮ ॥
669.t: jap man raamai naam har jas uootam kaam ||
669.e: O mind, chant the Name of the Lord; singing the Lord's Praises is the most exalted activity.

669.g: ਜੋ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਣਹਿ ਤੇਰਾ ਜਸੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਕੈ ਸਦ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ ਜਾਉ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
669.t: jo gaaveh suneh teraa jas suaamee hau tin kai sadh balihaarai jaau || rahaau ||
669.e: I am forever a sacrifice to those who sing, and hear Your Praises, O Lord and Master. ||Pause||

669.g: ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਤਿਪਾਲਕ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜੋ ਤੁਮ ਦੇਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਹਉ ਪਾਉ ॥
669.t: saranaagat pratipaalak har suaamee jo tum dheh soiee hau paau ||
669.e: I seek Your Sanctuary, O Cherisher God, my Lord and Master; whatever You give me, I accept.

669.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰਿ ਦੀਜੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਣ ਕਾ ਹੈ ਚਾਉ ॥੨॥੪॥੧੦॥
669.t: dheen dhiaal kirapaa kar dheejai naanak har simaran kaa hai chaau ||2||4||10||
669.e: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, give me this blessing; Nanak longs for the Lord's meditative remembrance. ||2||4||10||

669.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
669.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
669.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

669.g: ਸੇਵਕ ਸਿਖ ਪੂਜਣ ਸਭਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਸਭਿ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
669.t: sevak sikh poojan sabh aaveh sabh gaaveh har har uootam baanee ||
669.e: All the Sikhs and servants come to worship and adore You; they sing the sublime Bani of the Lord, Har, Har.

669.g: ਗਾਵਿਆ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਕਾ ਹਰਿ ਥਾਇ ਪਾਵੈ ਜਿਨ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਸਤਿ ਸਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
669.t: gaaviaa suniaa tin kaa har thai paavai jin satigur kee aagiaa sat sat kar maanee ||1||
669.e: Their singing and listening is approved by the Lord; they accept the Order of the True Guru as True, totally True. ||1||

669.g: ਬੋਲਹੁ ਭਾਈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਜਲ ਤੀਰਥਿ ॥
669.t: bolahu bhaiee har keerat har bhavajal teerath ||
669.e: Chant the Lord's Praises, O Siblings of Destiny; the Lord is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage in the terrifying world-ocean.

669.g: ਹਰਿ ਦਰਿ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਊਤਮ ਬਾਤ ਹੈ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਜਿਨ ਜਨਹੁ ਜਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
669.t: har dhar tin kee uootam baat hai sa(n)tahu har kathaa jin janahu jaanee || rahaau ||
669.e: They alone are praised in the Court of the Lord, O Saints, who know and understand the Lord's sermon. ||Pause||

669.g: ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੇ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਚੋਜ ਵਿਡਾਨੀ ॥
669.t: aape gur chelaa hai aape aape har prabh choj viddaanee ||
669.e: He Himself is the Guru, and He Himself is the disciple; the Lord God Himself plays His wondrous games.

669.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ਸੋਈ ਹਰਿ ਮਿਲਸੀ ਅਵਰ ਸਭ ਤਿਆਗਿ ਓਹਾ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਨੀ ॥੨॥੫॥੧੧॥
669.t: jan naanak aap milaae soiee har milasee avar sabh tiaag ohaa har bhaanee ||2||5||11||
669.e: O servant Nanak, he alone merges with the Lord, whom the Lord Himself merges; all the others are forsaken, but the Lord loves him. ||2||5||11||

669.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
669.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
669.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

669.g: ਇਛਾ ਪੂਰਕੁ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖਦਾਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਵਸਿ ਹੈ ਕਾਮਧੇਨਾ ॥
669.t: eichhaa poorak sarab sukhadhaataa har jaa kai vas hai kaamadhenaa ||
669.e: The Lord is the Fulfiller of desires, the Giver of total peace; the Kaamadhaynaa, the wish-fulfilling cow, is in His power.

669.g: ਸੋ ਐਸਾ ਹਰਿ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਮੇਰੇ ਜੀਅੜੇ ਤਾ ਸਰਬ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨਾ ॥੧॥
669.t: so aaisaa har dhiaaieeaai mere jeeaRe taa sarab sukh paaveh mere manaa ||1||
669.e: So meditate on such a Lord, O my soul. Then, you shall obtain total peace, O my mind. ||1||

670.g: ਜਪਿ ਮਨ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਦਾ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ॥
670.t: jap man sat naam sadhaa sat naam ||
670.e: Chant, O my mind, the True Name, Sat Naam, the True Name.

670.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਮੁਖ ਊਜਲ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਨਿਤ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਹਰਿ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
670.t: halat palat mukh uoojal hoiee hai nit dhiaaieeaai har purakh nira(n)janaa || rahaau ||
670.e: In this world, and in the world beyond, your face shall be radiant, by meditating continually on the immaculate Lord God. ||Pause||

670.g: ਜਹ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਭਇਆ ਤਹ ਉਪਾਧਿ ਗਤੁ ਕੀਨੀ ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਨਾ ॥
670.t: jeh har simaran bhiaa teh upaadh gat keenee vaddabhaagee har japanaa ||
670.e: Wherever anyone remembers the Lord in meditation, disaster runs away from that place. By great good fortune, we meditate on the Lord.

670.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਇਹ ਮਤਿ ਦੀਨੀ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਭਵਜਲੁ ਤਰਨਾ ॥੨॥੬॥੧੨॥
670.t: jan naanak kau gur ieh mat dheenee jap har bhavajal taranaa ||2||6||12||
670.e: The Guru has blessed servant Nanak with this understanding, that by meditating on the Lord, we cross over the terrifying world-ocean. ||2||6||12||

670.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
670.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ||
670.e: Dhanaasaree, Fourth Mehla:

670.g: ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਮੈ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨ ਸੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
670.t: mere saahaa mai har dharasan sukh hoi ||
670.e: O my King, beholding the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan, I am at peace.

670.g: ਹਮਰੀ ਬੇਦਨਿ ਤੂ ਜਾਨਤਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਅਵਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਨੈ ਕੋਇ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
670.t: hamaree bedhan too jaanataa saahaa avar kiaa jaanai koi || rahaau ||
670.e: You alone know my inner pain, O King; what can anyone else know? ||Pause||

670.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਚੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੀਆ ਸਚੁ ਸਭੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
670.t: saachaa saahib sach too mere saahaa teraa keeaa sach sabh hoi ||
670.e: O True Lord and Master, You are truly my King; whatever You do, all that is True.

670.g: ਝੂਠਾ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਆਖੀਐ ਸਾਹਾ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
670.t: jhooThaa kis kau aakheeaai saahaa dhoojaa naahee koi ||1||
670.e: Who should I call a liar? There is no other than You, O King. ||1||

670.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਵਿਚਿ ਤੂ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ॥
670.t: sabhanaa vich too varatadhaa saahaa sabh tujheh dhiaaveh dhin raat ||
670.e: You are pervading and permeating in all; O King, everyone meditates on You, day and night.

670.g: ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਥਾਵਹੁ ਮੰਗਦੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੂ ਸਭਨਾ ਕਰਹਿ ਇਕ ਦਾਤਿ ॥੨॥
670.t: sabh tujh hee thaavahu ma(n)gadhe mere saahaa too sabhanaa kareh ik dhaat ||2||
670.e: Everyone begs of You, O my King; You alone give gifts to all. ||2||

670.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਵਿਚਿ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਾਹਿ ॥
670.t: sabh ko tujh hee vich hai mere saahaa tujh te baahar koiee naeh ||
670.e: All are under Your Power, O my King; none at all are beyond You.

670.g: ਸਭਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂ ਸਭਸ ਦਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਾ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਹੀ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਹਿ ॥੩॥
670.t: sabh jeea tere too sabhas dhaa mere saahaa sabh tujh hee maeh samaeh ||3||
670.e: All beings are Yours-You belong to all, O my King. All shall merge and be absorbed in You. ||3||

670.g: ਸਭਨਾ ਕੀ ਤੂ ਆਸ ਹੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਧਿਆਵਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹ ॥
670.t: sabhanaa kee too aas hai mere piaare sabh tujheh dhiaaveh mere saeh ||
670.e: You are the hope of all, O my Beloved; all meditate on You, O my King.

670.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਖੁ ਤੂ ਮੇਰੇ ਪਿਆਰੇ ਸਚੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪਾਤਿਸਾਹ ॥੪॥੭॥੧੩॥
670.t: jiau bhaavai tiau rakh too mere piaare sach naanak ke paatisaeh ||4||7||13||
670.e: As it pleases You, protect and preserve me, O my Beloved; You are the True King of Nanak. ||4||7||13||

670.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
670.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
670.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

670.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
670.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
670.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

670.g: ਭਵ ਖੰਡਨ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਵਛਲ ਨਿਰੰਕਾਰੇ ॥
670.t: bhav kha(n)ddan dhukh bha(n)jan savaiaamee bhagat vachhal nira(n)kaare ||
670.e: O Destroyer of fear, Remover of suffering, Lord and Master, Lover of Your devotees, Formless Lord.

670.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਖਿਨ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਜਾਂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਮਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
670.t: koT paraadh miTe khin bheetar jaa(n) gurmukh naam samaare ||1||
670.e: Millions of sins are eradicated in an instant when, as Gurmukh, one contemplates the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||

670.g: ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਲਾਗਾ ਹੈ ਰਾਮ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
670.t: meraa man laagaa hai raam piaare ||
670.e: My mind is attached to my Beloved Lord.

670.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲਿ ਕਰੀ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਵਸਿ ਕੀਨੇ ਪੰਚ ਦੂਤਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
670.t: dheen dhiaal karee prabh kirapaa vas keene pa(n)ch dhootaare ||1|| rahaau ||
670.e: God, Merciful to the meek, granted His Grace, and placed the five enemies under my control. ||1||Pause||

670.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਰੂਪੁ ਸੁਹਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਬਾਰੇ ॥
670.t: teraa thaan suhaavaa roop suhaavaa tere bhagat soheh dharabaare ||
670.e: Your place is so beautiful; Your form is so beautiful; Your devotees look so beautiful in Your Court.

670.g: ਸਰਬ ਜੀਆ ਕੇ ਦਾਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਉਬਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
670.t: sarab jeeaa ke dhaate suaamee kar kirapaa leh ubaare ||2||
670.e: O Lord and Master, Giver of all beings, please, grant Your Grace, and save me. ||2||

670.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਵਰਨੁ ਨ ਜਾਪੈ ਰੂਪੁ ਨ ਲਖੀਐ ਤੇਰੀ ਕੁਦਰਤਿ ਕਉਨੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੇ ॥
670.t: teraa varan na jaapai roop na lakheeaai teree kudharat kaun beechaare ||
670.e: Your color is not known, and Your form is not seen; who can contemplate Your Almighty Creative Power?

670.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਰਵਿਆ ਸ੍ਰਬ ਠਾਈ ਅਗਮ ਰੂਪ ਗਿਰਧਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
670.t: jal thal maheeal raviaa srab Thaiee agam roop giradhaare ||3||
670.e: You are contained in the water, the land and the sky, everywhere, O Lord of unfathomable form, Holder of the mountain. ||3||

670.g: ਕੀਰਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਸਗਲ ਜਨ ਤੇਰੀ ਤੂ ਅਬਿਨਾਸੀ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
670.t: keerat kareh sagal jan teree too abinaasee purakh muraare ||
670.e: All beings sing Your Praises; You are the imperishable Primal Being, the Destroyer of ego.

670.g: ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਨਿ ਦੁਆਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
670.t: jiau bhaavai tiau raakhahu suaamee jan naanak saran dhuaare ||4||1||
670.e: As it pleases You, please protect and preserve me; servant Nanak seeks Sanctuary at Your Door. ||4||1||

670.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
670.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
670.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

670.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਜਲ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਤਜੇ ਹੈ ਮੀਨਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਲ ਸਿਉ ਹੇਤੁ ਬਢਾਇਓ ॥
670.t: bin jal praan taje hai meenaa jin jal siau het baddaio ||
670.e: The fish out of water loses its life; it is deeply in love with the water.

670.g: ਕਮਲ ਹੇਤਿ ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਹੈ ਭਵਰਾ ਉਨਿ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਨਿਕਸਿ ਨ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
670.t: kamal het binasio hai bhavaraa un maarag nikas na paio ||1||
670.e: The bumble bee, totally in love with the lotus flower, is lost in it; it cannot find the way to escape from it. ||1||

670.g: ਅਬ ਮਨ ਏਕਸ ਸਿਉ ਮੋਹੁ ਕੀਨਾ ॥
670.t: ab man ekas siau moh keenaa ||
670.e: Now, my mind has nurtured love for the One Lord.

670.g: ਮਰੈ ਨ ਜਾਵੈ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਸੰਗੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੀ ਚੀਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
670.t: marai na jaavai sadh hee sa(n)ge satigur sabadhee cheenaa ||1|| rahaau ||
670.e: He does not die, and is not born; He is always with me. Through the Word of the True Guru's Shabad, I know Him. ||1||Pause||

671.g: ਕਾਮ ਹੇਤਿ ਕੁੰਚਰੁ ਲੈ ਫਾਂਕਿਓ ਓਹੁ ਪਰ ਵਸਿ ਭਇਓ ਬਿਚਾਰਾ ॥
671.t: kaam het ku(n)char lai faa(n)kio oh par vas bhio bichaaraa ||
671.e: Lured by sexual desire, the elephant is trapped; the poor beast falls into the power of another.

671.g: ਨਾਦ ਹੇਤਿ ਸਿਰੁ ਡਾਰਿਓ ਕੁਰੰਕਾ ਉਸ ਹੀ ਹੇਤ ਬਿਦਾਰਾ ॥੨॥
671.t: naadh het sir ddaario kura(n)kaa us hee het bidhaaraa ||2||
671.e: Lured by the sound of the hunter's bell, the deer offers its head; because of this enticement, it is killed. ||2||

671.g: ਦੇਖਿ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਲੋਭਿ ਮੋਹਿਓ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
671.t: dhekh kuTa(n)b lobh mohio praanee maiaa kau lapaTaanaa ||
671.e: Gazing upon his family, the mortal is enticed by greed; he clings in attachment to Maya.

671.g: ਅਤਿ ਰਚਿਓ ਕਰਿ ਲੀਨੋ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਉਨਿ ਛੋਡਿ ਸਰਾਪਰ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
671.t: at rachio kar leeno apunaa un chhodd saraapar jaanaa ||3||
671.e: Totally engrossed in worldly things, he considers them to be his own; but in the end, he shall surely have to leave them behind. ||3||

671.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਅਵਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਨੇਹਾ ਓਹੁ ਜਾਣਹੁ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥
671.t: bin gobi(n)dh avar sa(n)g nehaa oh jaanahu sadhaa dhuhelaa ||
671.e: Know it well, that anyone who loves any other than God, shall be miserable forever.

671.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਇਹੈ ਬੁਝਾਇਓ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਸਦ ਕੇਲਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
671.t: kahu naanak gur ihai bujhaio preet prabhoo sadh kelaa ||4||2||
671.e: Says Nanak, the Guru has explained this to me, that love for God brings lasting bliss. ||4||2||

671.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
671.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
671.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

671.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਦੀਓ ਮੋਹਿ ਨਾਮਾ ਬੰਧਨ ਤੇ ਛੁਟਕਾਏ ॥
671.t: kar kirapaa dheeo moh naamaa ba(n)dhan te chhuTakaae ||
671.e: Granting His Grace, God has blessed me with His Name, and released me of my bonds.

671.g: ਮਨ ਤੇ ਬਿਸਰਿਓ ਸਗਲੋ ਧੰਧਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
671.t: man te bisario sagalo dha(n)dhaa gur kee charanee laae ||1||
671.e: I have forgotten all worldly entanglements, and I am attached to the Guru's feet. ||1||

671.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਚਿੰਤ ਬਿਰਾਨੀ ਛਾਡੀ ॥
671.t: saadhasa(n)g chi(n)t biraanee chhaaddee ||
671.e: In the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, I have renounced my other cares and anxieties.

671.g: ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮੋਹ ਮਨ ਬਾਸਨ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਗਡਹਾ ਗਾਡੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
671.t: aha(n)budh moh man baasan dhe kar gaddahaa gaaddee ||1|| rahaau ||
671.e: I dug a deep pit, and buried my egotistical pride, emotional attachment and the desires of my mind. ||1||Pause||

671.g: ਨਾ ਕੋ ਮੇਰਾ ਦੁਸਮਨੁ ਰਹਿਆ ਨਾ ਹਮ ਕਿਸ ਕੇ ਬੈਰਾਈ ॥
671.t: naa ko meraa dhusaman rahiaa naa ham kis ke bairaiee ||
671.e: No one is my enemy, and I am no one's enemy.

671.g: ਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਪਸਾਰੁ ਪਸਾਰਿਓ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਝੀ ਪਾਈ ॥੨॥
671.t: braham pasaar pasaario bheetar satigur te sojhee paiee ||2||
671.e: God, who expanded His expanse, is within all; I learned this from the True Guru. ||2||

671.g: ਸਭੁ ਕੋ ਮੀਤੁ ਹਮ ਆਪਨ ਕੀਨਾ ਹਮ ਸਭਨਾ ਕੇ ਸਾਜਨ ॥
671.t: sabh ko meet ham aapan keenaa ham sabhanaa ke saajan ||
671.e: I am a friend to all; I am everyone's friend.

671.g: ਦੂਰਿ ਪਰਾਇਓ ਮਨ ਕਾ ਬਿਰਹਾ ਤਾ ਮੇਲੁ ਕੀਓ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਾਜਨ ॥੩॥
671.t: dhoor paraio man kaa birahaa taa mel keeo merai raajan ||3||
671.e: When the sense of separation was removed from my mind, then I was united with the Lord, my King. ||3||

671.g: ਬਿਨਸਿਓ ਢੀਠਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਵੂਠਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਲਗੋ ਗੁਰ ਮੀਠਾ ॥
671.t: binasio ddeeThaa a(n)mrit vooThaa sabadh lago gur meeThaa ||
671.e: My stubbornness is gone, Ambrosial Nectar rains down, and the Word of the Guru's Shabad seems so sweet to me.

671.g: ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਨਾਨਕ ਰਮਈਆ ਡੀਠਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
671.t: jal thal maheeal sarab nivaasee naanak ramieeaa ddeeThaa ||4||3||
671.e: He is pervading everywhere, in the water, on the land and in the sky; Nanak beholds the all-pervading Lord. ||4||3||

671.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
671.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
671.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

671.g: ਜਬ ਤੇ ਦਰਸਨ ਭੇਟੇ ਸਾਧੂ ਭਲੇ ਦਿਨਸ ਓਇ ਆਏ ॥
671.t: jab te dharasan bheTe saadhoo bhale dhinas oi aae ||
671.e: Ever since I obtained the Blessed Vision of the Darshan of the Holy, my days have been blessed and prosperous.

671.g: ਮਹਾ ਅਨੰਦੁ ਸਦਾ ਕਰਿ ਕੀਰਤਨੁ ਪੁਰਖ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਾਏ ॥੧॥
671.t: mahaa ana(n)dh sadhaa kar keeratan purakh bidhaataa paae ||1||
671.e: I have found lasting bliss, singing the Kirtan of the Praises of the Primal Lord, the Architect of destiny. ||1||

671.g: ਅਬ ਮੋਹਿ ਰਾਮ ਜਸੋ ਮਨਿ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
671.t: ab moh raam jaso man gaio ||
671.e: Now, I sing the Praises of the Lord within my mind.

671.g: ਭਇਓ ਪ੍ਰਗਾਸੁ ਸਦਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਪਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
671.t: bhio pragaas sadhaa sukh man meh satigur pooraa paio ||1|| rahaau ||
671.e: My mind has been illumined and enlightened, and it is always at peace; I have found the Perfect True Guru. ||1||Pause||

671.g: ਗੁਣ ਨਿਧਾਨੁ ਰਿਦ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਤਾ ਦੂਖੁ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗਾ ॥
671.t: gun nidhaan ridh bheetar vasiaa taa dhookh bharam bhau bhaagaa ||
671.e: The Lord, the treasure of virtue, abides deep within the heart, and so pain, doubt and fear have been dispelled.

671.g: ਭਈ ਪਰਾਪਤਿ ਵਸਤੁ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥੨॥
671.t: bhiee paraapat vasat agochar raam naam ra(n)g laagaa ||2||
671.e: I have obtained the most incomprehensible thing, enshrining love for the Name of the Lord. ||2||

671.g: ਚਿੰਤ ਅਚਿੰਤਾ ਸੋਚ ਅਸੋਚਾ ਸੋਗੁ ਲੋਭੁ ਮੋਹੁ ਥਾਕਾ ॥
671.t: chi(n)t achi(n)taa soch asochaa sog lobh moh thaakaa ||
671.e: I was anxious, and now I am free of anxiety; I was worried, and now I am free of worry; my grief, greed and emotional attachments are gone.

671.g: ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗ ਮਿਟੇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਤੇ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਭਏ ਬਿਬਾਕਾ ॥੩॥
671.t: haumai rog miTe kirapaa te jam te bhe bibaakaa ||3||
671.e: By His Grace, I am cured of the disease of egotism, and the Messenger of Death no longer terrifies me. ||3||

671.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਟਹਲ ਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਆਗਿਆ ਭਾਣੀ ॥
671.t: gur kee Tahal guroo kee sevaa gur kee aagiaa bhaanee ||
671.e: Working for the Guru, serving the Guru and the Guru's Command, all are pleasing to me.

671.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਜਿਨਿ ਜਮ ਤੇ ਕਾਢੇ ਤਿਸੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਕੁਰਬਾਣੀ ॥੪॥੪॥
671.t: kahu naanak jin jam te kaadde tis gur kai kurabaanee ||4||4||
671.e: Says Nanak, He has released me from the clutches of Death; I am a sacrifice to that Guru. ||4||4||

671.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
671.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
671.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

671.g: ਜਿਸ ਕਾ ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਸੋਈ ਸੁਘੜੁ ਸੁਜਾਨੀ ॥
671.t: jis kaa tan man dhan sabh tis kaa soiee sughaR sujaanee ||
671.e: Body, mind, wealth and everything belong to Him; He alone is all-wise and all-knowing.

671.g: ਤਿਨ ਹੀ ਸੁਣਿਆ ਦੁਖੁ ਸੁਖੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਤਉ ਬਿਧਿ ਨੀਕੀ ਖਟਾਨੀ ॥੧॥
671.t: tin hee suniaa dhukh sukh meraa tau bidh neekee khaTaanee ||1||
671.e: He listens to my pains and pleasures, and then my condition improves. ||1||

671.g: ਜੀਅ ਕੀ ਏਕੈ ਹੀ ਪਹਿ ਮਾਨੀ ॥
671.t: jeea kee ekai hee peh maanee ||
671.e: My soul is satisfied with the One Lord alone.

671.g: ਅਵਰਿ ਜਤਨ ਕਰਿ ਰਹੇ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ ਤਿਨ ਤਿਲੁ ਨਹੀ ਕੀਮਤਿ ਜਾਨੀ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
671.t: avar jatan kar rahe bahutere tin til nahee keemat jaanee || rahaau ||
671.e: People make all sorts of other efforts, but they have no value at all. ||Pause||

671.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰਮੋਲਕੁ ਹੀਰਾ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਮੰਤਾਨੀ ॥
671.t: a(n)mirat naam niramolak heeraa gur dheeno ma(n)taanee ||
671.e: The Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the Lord, is a priceless jewel. The Guru has given me this advice.

671.g: ਡਿਗੈ ਨ ਡੋਲੈ ਦ੍ਰਿੜੁ ਕਰਿ ਰਹਿਓ ਪੂਰਨ ਹੋਇ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਾਨੀ ॥੨॥
671.t: ddigai na ddolai dhiraR kar rahio pooran hoi tirapataanee ||2||
671.e: It cannot be lost, and it cannot be shaken off; it remains steady, and I am perfectly satisfied with it. ||2||

671.g: ਓਇ ਜੁ ਬੀਚ ਹਮ ਤੁਮ ਕਛੁ ਹੋਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਬਾਤ ਬਿਲਾਨੀ ॥
671.t: oi ju beech ham tum kachh hote tin kee baat bilaanee ||
671.e: Those things which tore me away from You, Lord, are now gone.

672.g: ਅਲੰਕਾਰ ਮਿਲਿ ਥੈਲੀ ਹੋਈ ਹੈ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਕਨਿਕ ਵਖਾਨੀ ॥੩॥
672.t: ala(n)kaar mil thailee hoiee hai taa te kanik vakhaanee ||3||
672.e: When golden ornaments are melted down into a lump, they are still said to be gold. ||3||

672.g: ਪ੍ਰਗਟਿਓ ਜੋਤਿ ਸਹਜ ਸੁਖ ਸੋਭਾ ਬਾਜੇ ਅਨਹਤ ਬਾਨੀ ॥
672.t: pragaTio jot sahaj sukh sobhaa baaje anahat baanee ||
672.e: The Divine Light has illuminated me, and I am filled with celestial peace and glory; the unstruck melody of the Lord's Bani resounds within me.

672.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਿਹਚਲ ਘਰੁ ਬਾਧਿਓ ਗੁਰਿ ਕੀਓ ਬੰਧਾਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
672.t: kahu naanak nihachal ghar baadhio gur keeo ba(n)dhaanee ||4||5||
672.e: Says Nanak, I have built my eternal home; the Guru has constructed it for me. ||4||5||

672.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ॥
672.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
672.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

672.g: ਵਡੇ ਵਡੇ ਰਾਜਨ ਅਰੁ ਭੂਮਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਨ ਬੂਝੀ ॥
672.t: vadde vadde raajan ar bhooman taa kee tirasan na boojhee ||
672.e: The desires of the greatest of the great kings and landlords cannot be satisfied.

672.g: ਲਪਟਿ ਰਹੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੰਗ ਮਾਤੇ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੀ ॥੧॥
672.t: lapaT rahe maiaa ra(n)g maate lochan kachhoo na soojhee ||1||
672.e: They remain engrossed in Maya, intoxicated with the pleasures of their wealth; their eyes see nothing else at all. ||1||

672.g: ਬਿਖਿਆ ਮਹਿ ਕਿਨ ਹੀ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤਿ ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥
672.t: bikhiaa meh kin hee tirapat na paiee ||
672.e: No one has ever found satisfaction in sin and corruption.

672.g: ਜਿਉ ਪਾਵਕੁ ਈਧਨਿ ਨਹੀ ਧ੍ਰਾਪੈ ਬਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਹਾ ਅਘਾਈ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
672.t: jiau paavak ieedhan nahee dhraapai bin har kahaa aghaiee || rahaau ||
672.e: The flame is not satisfied by more fuel; how can one be satisfied without the Lord? ||Pause||

672.g: ਦਿਨੁ ਦਿਨੁ ਕਰਤ ਭੋਜਨ ਬਹੁ ਬਿੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਕੀ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਭੂਖਾ ॥
672.t: dhin dhin karat bhojan bahu bi(n)jan taa kee miTai na bhookhaa ||
672.e: Day after day, he eats his meals with many different foods, but his hunger is not eradicated.

672.g: ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੈ ਸੁਆਨ ਕੀ ਨਿਆਈ ਚਾਰੇ ਕੁੰਟਾ ਘੋਖਾ ॥੨॥
672.t: audham karai suaan kee niaaiee chaare ku(n)Taa ghokhaa ||2||
672.e: He runs around like a dog, searching in the four directions. ||2||

672.g: ਕਾਮਵੰਤ ਕਾਮੀ ਬਹੁ ਨਾਰੀ ਪਰ ਗ੍ਰਿਹ ਜੋਹ ਨ ਚੂਕੈ ॥
672.t: kaamava(n)t kaamee bahu naaree par gireh joh na chookai ||
672.e: The lustful, lecherous man desires many women, and he never stops peeking into the homes of others.

672.g: ਦਿਨ ਪ੍ਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਕਰੈ ਪਛੁਤਾਪੈ ਸੋਗ ਲੋਭ ਮਹਿ ਸੂਕੈ ॥੩॥
672.t: dhin prat karai karai pachhutaapai sog lobh meh sookai ||3||
672.e: Day after day, he commits adultery again and again, and then he regrets his actions; he wastes away in misery and greed. ||3||

672.g: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਪਾਰ ਅਮੋਲਾ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
672.t: har har naam apaar amolaa a(n)mrit ek nidhaanaa ||
672.e: The Name of the Lord, Har, Har, is incomparable and priceless; it is the treasure of Ambrosial Nectar.

672.g: ਸੂਖੁ ਸਹਜੁ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਸੰਤਨ ਕੈ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੬॥
672.t: sookh sahaj aana(n)dh sa(n)tan kai naanak gur te jaanaa ||4||6||
672.e: The Saints abide in peace, poise and bliss; O Nanak, through the Guru, this is known. ||4||6||

672.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਃ ੫ ॥
672.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ||
672.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

672.g: ਲਵੈ ਨ ਲਾਗਨ ਕਉ ਹੈ ਕਛੂਐ ਜਾ ਕਉ ਫਿਰਿ ਇਹੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
672.t: lavai na laagan kau hai kachhooaai jaa kau fir ih dhaavai ||
672.e: Nothing which this mortal being runs after, can compare to it.

672.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਗੁਰਿ ਦੀਨੋ ਇਹੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਤਿਸ ਹੀ ਕਉ ਬਨਿ ਆਵੈ ॥੧॥
672.t: jaa kau gur dheeno ih a(n)mrit tis hee kau ban aavai ||1||
672.e: He alone comes to have it, whom the Guru blesses with this Ambrosial Nectar. ||1||

672.g: ਜਾ ਕਉ ਆਇਓ ਏਕੁ ਰਸਾ ॥ ਖਾਨ ਪਾਨ ਆਨ ਨਹੀ ਖੁਧਿਆ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਬਸਾ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
672.t: jaa kau aaio ek rasaa || khaan paan aan nahee khudhiaa taa kai chit na basaa || rahaau ||
672.e: The desire to eat, to wear new clothes, and all other desires, do not abide in the mind of one who comes to know the subtle essence of the One Lord. ||Pause||

672.g: ਮਉਲਿਓ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਹੋਇਓ ਹਰਿਆ ਏਕ ਬੂੰਦ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
672.t: maulio man tan hoio hariaa ek boo(n)dh jin paiee ||
