683.e: I bow in reverence to the Lord, I bow in reverence. I sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord, my King. ||Pause||

683.g: ਵਡੈ ਭਾਗਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਗੁਰਦੇਵਾ ॥
683.t: vaddai bhaag bheTe gurdhevaa ||
683.e: By great good fortune, one meets the Divine Guru.

683.g: ਕੋਟਿ ਪਰਾਧ ਮਿਟੇ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਾ ॥੧॥
683.t: koT paraadh miTe har sevaa ||1||
683.e: Millions of sins are erased by serving the Lord. ||1||

684.g: ਚਰਨ ਕਮਲ ਜਾ ਕਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਪੈ ॥
684.t: charan kamal jaa kaa man raapai ||
684.e: One whose mind is imbued with the Lord's lotus feet

684.g: ਸੋਗ ਅਗਨਿ ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਨ ਬਿਆਪੈ ॥੨॥
684.t: sog agan tis jan na biaapai ||2||
684.e: is not afflicted by the fire of sorrow. ||2||
He crosses over the world-ocean in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.
He chants the Name of the Fearless Lord, and is imbued with the Lord's Love. ||3||

684.g: ਪਰ ਧਨ ਦੋਖ ਕਿਛੁ ਪਾਪ ਨ ਫੇੜੇ ॥
684.t: par dhan dhokh kichh paap na feRe ||
684.e: One who does not steal the wealth of others, who does not commit evil deeds or sinful acts
- the Messenger of Death does not even approach him. ||4||
God Himself quenches the fires of desire.
O Nanak, in God's Sanctuary, one is saved. ||5||1||55||
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:
I am satisfied and satiated, eating the food of Truth.
With my mind, body and tongue, I meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord. ||1||
Life, spiritual life, is in the Lord.
Spiritual life consists of chanting the Lord's Name in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy. ||1||Pause||
He is dressed in robes of all sorts,
if he sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Glorious Praises, day and night. ||2||
He rides upon elephants, chariots and horses,
if he sees the Lord's Path within his own heart. ||3||
Meditating on the Lord's Feet, deep within his mind and body,

684.g: ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖ ਨਿਧਾਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਦਾਸਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੪॥੨॥੫੬॥
684.t: har sukh nidhaan naanak dhaas paiaa ||4||2||56||
684.e: slave Nanak has found the Lord, the treasure of peace. ||4||2||56||
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

684.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਜੀਅ ਕਾ ਨਿਸਤਾਰਾ ॥
684.t: gur ke charan jeea kaa nisataaraa ||
684.e: The Guru's feet emancipate the soul.

684.g: ਸਮੁੰਦੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਜਿਨਿ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਤਾਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
684.t: samu(n)dh saagar jin khin meh taaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
684.e: They carry it across the world-ocean in an instant. ||1||Pause||

684.g: ਕੋਈ ਹੋਆ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਰਤੁ ਕੋਈ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਇਆ ॥
684.t: koiee hoaa karam rat koiee teerath naiaa ||
684.e: Some love rituals, and some bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage.
The Lord's slaves meditate on His Name. ||1||
The Lord Master is the Breaker of bonds.
Servant Nanak meditates in remembrance on the Lord, the Inner-knower, the Searcher of hearts. ||2||3||57||
Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla:

684.g: ਕਿਤੈ ਪ੍ਰਕਾਰਿ ਨ ਤੂਟਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ॥ ਦਾਸ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਨਿਰਮਲ ਰੀਤਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
684.t: kitai prakaar na tooTau preet || dhaas tere kee niramal reet ||1|| rahaau ||
684.e: The lifestyle of Your slave is so pure, that nothing can break his love for You. ||1||Pause||

684.g: ਜੀਅ ਪ੍ਰਾਨ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਤੇ ਪਿਆਰਾ ॥
684.t: jeea praan man dhan te piaaraa ||
684.e: He is more dear to me than my soul, my breath of life, my mind and my wealth.
The Lord is the Giver, the Restrainer of the ego. ||1||
I am in love with the Lord's lotus feet.
This alone is Nanak's prayer. ||2||4||58||
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehla:
Why do you go looking for Him in the forest?

684.g: ਸਰਬ ਨਿਵਾਸੀ ਸਦਾ ਅਲੇਪਾ ਤੋਹੀ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਮਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
684.t: sarab nivaasee sadhaa alepaa tohee sa(n)g samaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
684.e: Although he is unattached, he dwells everywhere. He is always with you as your companion. ||1||Pause||

684.g: ਪੁਹਪ ਮਧਿ ਜਿਉ ਬਾਸੁ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ ਮੁਕਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਛਾਈ ॥
684.t: puhap madh jiau baas basat hai mukar maeh jaise chhaiee ||
684.e: Like the fragrance which remains in the flower, and like the reflection in the mirror,

684.g: ਤੈਸੇ ਹੀ ਹਰਿ ਬਸੇ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ ਘਟ ਹੀ ਖੋਜਹੁ ਭਾਈ ॥੧॥
684.t: taise hee har base nira(n)tar ghaT hee khojahu bhaiee ||1||
684.e: the Lord dwells deep within; search for Him within your own heart, O Siblings of Destiny. ||1||

684.g: ਬਾਹਰਿ ਭੀਤਰਿ ਏਕੋ ਜਾਨਹੁ ਇਹੁ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਬਤਾਈ ॥
684.t: baahar bheetar eko jaanahu ih gur giaan bataiee ||
684.e: Outside and inside, know that there is only the One Lord; the Guru has imparted this wisdom to me.

684.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਬਿਨੁ ਆਪਾ ਚੀਨੈ ਮਿਟੈ ਨ ਭ੍ਰਮ ਕੀ ਕਾਈ ॥੨॥੧॥
684.t: jan naanak bin aapaa cheenai miTai na bhram kee kaiee ||2||1||
684.e: O servant Nanak, without knowing one's own self, the moss of doubt is not removed. ||2||1||
Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehla:
O Holy people, this world is deluded by doubt.

684.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਕਾ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਛੋਡਿਆ ਮਾਇਆ ਹਾਥਿ ਬਿਕਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
684.t: raam naam kaa simaran chhoddiaa maiaa haath bikaanaa ||1|| rahaau ||
684.e: It has forsaken the meditative remembrance of the Lord's Name, and sold itself out to Maya. ||1||Pause||

684.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਤਾ ਕੈ ਰਸਿ ਲਪਟਾਨਾ ॥
684.t: maat pitaa bhaiee sut banitaa taa kai ras lapaTaanaa ||
684.e: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse - he is entangled in their love.

685.g: ਜੋਬਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਪ੍ਰਭਤਾ ਕੈ ਮਦ ਮੈ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਵਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
685.t: joban dhan prabhataa kai madh mai ahinis rahai dhivaanaa ||1||
685.e: In the pride of youth, wealth and glory, day and night, he remains intoxicated. ||1||

685.g: ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨ ਤਾ ਸਿਉ ਮਨੁ ਨ ਲਗਾਨਾ ॥
685.t: dheen dhiaal sadhaa dhukh bha(n)jan taa siau man na lagaanaa ||
685.e: God is merciful to the meek, and forever the Destroyer of pain, but the mortal does not center his mind on Him.

685.g: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੋਟਨ ਮੈ ਕਿਨਹੂ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਇ ਪਛਾਨਾ ॥੨॥੨॥
685.t: jan naanak koTan mai kinahoo gurmukh hoi pachhaanaa ||2||2||
685.e: O servant Nanak, among millions, only a rare few, as Gurmukh, realize God. ||2||2||
Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehla:

685.g: ਤਿਹ ਜੋਗੀ ਕਉ ਜੁਗਤਿ ਨ ਜਾਨਉ ॥
685.t: teh jogee kau jugat na jaanau ||
685.e: That Yogi does not know the way.

685.g: ਲੋਭ ਮੋਹ ਮਾਇਆ ਮਮਤਾ ਫੁਨਿ ਜਿਹ ਘਟਿ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਛਾਨਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
685.t: lobh moh maiaa mamataa fun jeh ghaT maeh pachhaanau ||1|| rahaau ||
685.e: Understand that his heart is filled with greed, emotional attachment, Maya and egotism. ||1||Pause||

685.g: ਪਰ ਨਿੰਦਾ ਉਸਤਤਿ ਨਹ ਜਾ ਕੈ ਕੰਚਨ ਲੋਹ ਸਮਾਨੋ ॥
685.t: par ni(n)dhaa usatat neh jaa kai ka(n)chan loh samaano ||
685.e: One who does not slander or praise others, who looks upon gold and iron alike,

685.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਤੇ ਰਹੈ ਅਤੀਤਾ ਜੋਗੀ ਤਾਹਿ ਬਖਾਨੋ ॥੧॥
685.t: harakh sog te rahai ateetaa jogee taeh bakhaano ||1||
685.e: who is free from pleasure and pain - he alone is called a true Yogi. ||1||

685.g: ਚੰਚਲ ਮਨੁ ਦਹ ਦਿਸਿ ਕਉ ਧਾਵਤ ਅਚਲ ਜਾਹਿ ਠਹਰਾਨੋ ॥
685.t: cha(n)chal man dheh dhis kau dhaavat achal jaeh Thaharaano ||
685.e: The restless mind wanders in the ten directions - it needs to be pacified and restrained.

685.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਇਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੋ ਜੋ ਨਰੁ ਮੁਕਤਿ ਤਾਹਿ ਤੁਮ ਮਾਨੋ ॥੨॥੩॥
685.t: kahu naanak ieh bidh ko jo nar mukat taeh tum maano ||2||3||
685.e: Says Nanak, whoever knows this technique is judged to be liberated. ||2||3||
Dhanaasaree, Ninth Mehla:
Now, what efforts should I make?

685.g: ਜਿਹ ਬਿਧਿ ਮਨ ਕੋ ਸੰਸਾ ਚੂਕੈ ਭਉ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
685.t: jeh bidh man ko sa(n)saa chookai bhau nidh paar parau ||1|| rahaau ||
685.e: How can I dispel the anxieties of my mind? How can I cross over the terrifying world-ocean? ||1||Pause||

685.g: ਜਨਮੁ ਪਾਇ ਕਛੁ ਭਲੋ ਨ ਕੀਨੋ ਤਾ ਤੇ ਅਧਿਕ ਡਰਉ ॥
685.t: janam pai kachh bhalo na keeno taa te adhik ddarau ||
685.e: Obtaining this human incarnation, I have done no good deeds; this makes me very afraid!

685.g: ਮਨ ਬਚ ਕ੍ਰਮ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਨਹੀ ਗਾਏ ਯਹ ਜੀਅ ਸੋਚ ਧਰਉ ॥੧॥
685.t: man bach karam har gun nahee gaae yeh jeea soch dharau ||1||
685.e: In thought, word and deed, I have not sung the Lord's Praises; this thought worries my mind. ||1||

685.g: ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਸੁਨਿ ਕਛੁ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨ ਉਪਜਿਓ ਪਸੁ ਜਿਉ ਉਦਰੁ ਭਰਉ ॥
685.t: gurmat sun kachh giaan na upajio pas jiau udhar bharau ||
685.e: I listened to the Guru's Teachings, but spiritual wisdom did not well up within me; like a beast, I fill my belly.

685.g: ਕਹੁ ਨਾਨਕ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਪਛਾਨਉ ਤਬ ਹਉ ਪਤਿਤ ਤਰਉ ॥੨॥੪॥੯॥੯॥੧੩॥੫੮॥੪॥੯੩॥
685.t: kahu naanak prabh biradh pachhaanau tab hau patit tarau ||2||4||9||9||13||58||4||93||
685.e: Says Nanak, O God, please confirm Your Law of Grace; for only then can I, the sinner, be saved. ||2||4||9||9||13||58||4||93||

685.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ghar doojaa asaTapadheeaa
685.e: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla, Second House, Ashtpadheeyaa:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
The Guru is the ocean, filled with pearls.
The Saints gather in the Ambrosial Nectar; they do not go far away from there.

685.g: ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਚੋਗ ਚੁਗਹਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
685.t: har ras chog chugeh prabh bhaavai ||
685.e: They taste the subtle essence of the Lord; they are loved by God.
Within this pool, the swans find their Lord, the Lord of their souls. ||1||
What can the poor crane accomplish by bathing in the mud puddle?

685.g: ਕੀਚੜਿ ਡੂਬੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਨ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
685.t: keechaR ddoobai mail na jai ||1|| rahaau ||
685.e: It sinks into the mire, and its filth is not washed away. ||1||Pause||
After careful deliberation, the thoughtful person takes a step.
Forsaking duality, he becomes a devotee of the Formless Lord.
He obtains the treasure of liberation, and enjoys the sublime essence of the Lord.
His comings and goings end, and the Guru protects him. ||2||
The swan do not leave this pool.
In loving devotional worship, they merge in the Celestial Lord.

685.g: ਸਰਵਰ ਮਹਿ ਹੰਸੁ ਹੰਸ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰੁ ॥
685.t: saravar meh ha(n)s ha(n)s meh saagar ||
685.e: The swans are in the pool, and the pool is in the swans.
They speak the Unspoken Speech, and they honor and revere the Guru's Word. ||3||
The Yogi, the Primal Lord, sits within the celestial sphere of deepest Samaadhi.

685.g: ਨਾਰਿ ਨ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋਊ ਕੈਸੇ ॥
685.t: naar na purakh kahahu kouoo kaise ||
685.e: He is not male, and He is not female; how can anyone describe Him?
The three worlds continue to center their attention on His Light.
The silent sages and the Yogic masters seek the Sanctuary of the True Lord. ||4||
The Lord is the source of bliss, the support of the helpless.
The Gurmukhs worship and contemplate the Celestial Lord.
God is the Lover of His devotees, the Destroyer of fear.
Subduing ego, one meets the Lord, and places his feet on the Path. ||5||
He makes many efforts, but still, the Messenger of Death tortures him.
Destined only to die, he comes into the world.

686.e: He wastes this precious human life through duality.

686.g: ਆਪੁ ਨ ਚੀਨਸਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਰੋਵੈ ॥੬॥
686.t: aap na cheenas bhram bhram rovai ||6||
686.e: He does not know his own self, and trapped by doubts, he cries out in pain. ||6||
Speak, read and hear of the One Lord.
The Support of the earth shall bless you with courage, righteousness and protection.
Chastity, purity and self-restraint are infused into the heart,

686.g: ਚਉਥੇ ਪਦ ਕਉ ਜੇ ਮਨੁ ਪਤੀਆਏ ॥੭॥
686.t: chauthe padh kau je man pateeaae ||7||
686.e: when one centers his mind in the fourth state. ||7||
They are immaculate and true, and filth does not stick to them.

686.g: ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਭਰਮ ਭਉ ਭਾਗੈ ॥
686.t: gur kai sabadh bharam bhau bhaagai ||
686.e: Through the Word of the Guru's Shabad, their doubt and fear depart.
The form and personality of the Primal Lord are incomparably beautiful.
Nanak begs for the Lord, the Embodiment of Truth. ||8||1||
Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:
That union with the Lord is acceptable, which is united in intuitive poise.

686.g: ਨਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਮਰਣੁ ਨ ਆਵਣੁ ਜਾਣੁ ॥
686.t: naa tis maran na aavan jaan ||
686.e: Thereafter, one does not die, and does not come and go in reincarnation.

686.g: ਠਾਕੁਰ ਮਹਿ ਦਾਸੁ ਦਾਸ ਮਹਿ ਸੋਇ ॥
686.t: Thaakur meh dhaas dhaas meh soi ||
686.e: The Lord's slave is in the Lord, and the Lord is in His slave.

686.g: ਜਹ ਦੇਖਾ ਤਹ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
686.t: jeh dhekhaa teh avar na koi ||1||
686.e: Wherever I look, I see none other than the Lord. ||1||
The Gurmukhs worship the Lord, and find His celestial home.

686.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਭੇਟੇ ਮਰਿ ਆਈਐ ਜਾਈਐ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
686.t: bin gur bheTe mar aaieeaai jaieeaai ||1|| rahaau ||
686.e: Without meeting the Guru, they die, and come and go in reincarnation. ||1||Pause||

686.g: ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਕਰਉ ਜਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਵੈ ॥
686.t: so gur karau j saach dhiraRaavai ||
686.e: So make Him your Guru, who implants the Truth within you,
who leads you to speak the Unspoken Speech, and who merges you in the Word of the Shabad.

686.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਰਾ ॥
686.t: har ke log avar nahee kaaraa ||
686.e: God's people have no other work to do;
they love the True Lord and Master, and they love the Truth. ||2||

686.g: ਤਨ ਮਹਿ ਮਨੂਆ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚਾ ॥
686.t: tan meh manooaa man meh saachaa ||
686.e: The mind is in the body, and the True Lord is in the mind.
Merging into the True Lord, one is absorbed into Truth.
God's servant bows at His feet.
Meeting the True Guru, one meets with the Lord. ||3||
He Himself watches over us, and He Himself makes us see.

686.g: ਹਠਿ ਨ ਪਤੀਜੈ ਨਾ ਬਹੁ ਭੇਖੈ ॥
686.t: haTh na pateejai naa bahu bhekhai ||
686.e: He is not pleased by stubborn-mindedness, nor by various religious robes.
He fashioned the body-vessels, and infused the Ambrosial Nectar into them;
God's Mind is pleased only by loving devotional worship. ||4||
Reading and studying, one becomes confused, and suffers punishment.
By great cleverness, one is consigned to coming and going in reincarnation.
One who chants the Naam, the Name of the Lord, and eats the food of the Fear of God
becomes Gurmukh, the Lord's servant, and remains absorbed in the Lord. ||5||
He worships stones, dwells at sacred shrines of pilgrimage and in the jungles,
wanders, roams around and becomes a renunciate.
But his mind is still filthy - how can he become pure?
One who meets the True Lord obtains honor. ||6||
One who embodies good conduct and contemplative meditation,
his mind abides in intuitive poise and contentment, since the beginning of time, and throughout the ages.
In the twinkling of an eye, he saves millions.
Have mercy on me, O my Beloved, and let me meet the Guru. ||7||
Unto whom, O God, should I praise You?

686.g: ਤੁਧੁ ਬਿਨੁ ਦੂਜਾ ਮੈ ਕੋ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
686.t: tudh bin dhoojaa mai ko naahee ||
686.e: Without You, there is no other at all.

686.g: ਜਿਉ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਉ ਰਾਖੁ ਰਜਾਇ ॥
686.t: jiau tudh bhaavai tiau raakh rajai ||
686.e: As it pleases You, keep me under Your Will.
Nanak, with intuitive poise and natural love, sings Your Glorious Praises. ||8||2||

686.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa ghar chhayvaa asaTapadhee
686.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, Sixth House, Ashtapadee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

686.g: ਜੋ ਜੋ ਜੂਨੀ ਆਇਓ ਤਿਹ ਤਿਹ ਉਰਝਾਇਓ ਮਾਣਸ ਜਨਮੁ ਸੰਜੋਗਿ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
686.t: jo jo joonee aaio teh teh urajhaio maanas janam sa(n)jog paiaa ||
686.e: Whoever is born into the world, is entangled in it; human birth is obtained only by good destiny.

686.g: ਤਾਕੀ ਹੈ ਓਟ ਸਾਧ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਦੇ ਕਰਿ ਹਾਥ ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
686.t: taakee hai oT saadh raakhahu dhe kar haath kar kirapaa melahu har raiaa ||1||
686.e: I look to Your support, O Holy Saint; give me Your hand, and protect me. By Your Grace, let me meet the Lord, my King. ||1||

686.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਜਨਮ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਥਿਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਪਾਈ ॥
686.t: anik janam bhram thit nahee paiee ||
686.e: I wandered through countless incarnations, but I did not find stability anywhere.

686.g: ਕਰਉ ਸੇਵਾ ਗੁਰ ਲਾਗਉ ਚਰਨ ਗੋਵਿੰਦ ਜੀ ਕਾ ਮਾਰਗੁ ਦੇਹੁ ਜੀ ਬਤਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
686.t: karau sevaa gur laagau charan govi(n)dh jee kaa maarag dheh jee bataiee ||1|| rahaau ||
686.e: I serve the Guru, and I fall at His feet, praying, ""O Dear Lord of the Universe, please, show me the way.""||1||Pause||

686.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਕਰਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਕਉ ਬਚਿਤਿ ਧਰਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਸਦ ਹੀ ਵਿਹਾਵੈ ॥
686.t: anik upaav karau maiaa kau bachit dharau meree meree karat sadh hee vihaavai ||
686.e: I have tried so many things to acquire the wealth of Maya, and to cherish it in my mind; I have passed my life constantly crying out, ""Mine, mine!""

687.g: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭੇਟੈ ਸੰਤੁ ਮੇਰੀ ਲਾਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਚਿੰਤ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਮੇਰਾ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
687.t: koiee aaiso re bheTai sa(n)t meree laahai sagal chi(n)t Thaakur siau meraa ra(n)g laavai ||2||
687.e: Is there any such Saint, who would meet with me, take away my anxiety, and lead me to enshrine love for my Lord and Master. ||2||

687.g: ਪੜੇ ਰੇ ਸਗਲ ਬੇਦ ਨਹ ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨ ਭੇਦ ਇਕੁ ਖਿਨੁ ਨ ਧੀਰਹਿ ਮੇਰੇ ਘਰ ਕੇ ਪੰਚਾ ॥
687.t: paRe re sagal bedh neh chookai man bhedh ik khin na dheereh mere ghar ke pa(n)chaa ||
687.e: I have read all the Vedas, and yet the sense of separation in my mind still has not been removed; the five thieves of my house are not quieted, even for an instant.

687.g: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਭਗਤੁ ਜੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਤੇ ਰਹਤੁ ਇਕੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਨਾਮੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਰਿਦੈ ਸਿੰਚਾ ॥੩॥
687.t: koiee aaiso re bhagatu ju maiaa te rahat ik a(n)mirat naam merai ridhai si(n)chaa ||3||
687.e: Is there any devotee, who is unattached to Maya, who may irrigate my mind with the Ambrosial Naam, the Name of the One Lord? ||3||

687.g: ਜੇਤੇ ਰੇ ਤੀਰਥ ਨਾਏ ਅਹੰਬੁਧਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਏ ਘਰ ਕੋ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ ਇਕੁ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ॥
687.t: jete re teerath naae aha(n)budh mail laae ghar ko Thaakur ik til na maanai ||
687.e: In spite of the many places of pilgrimage for people to bathe in, their minds are still stained by their stubborn ego; the Lord Master is not pleased by this at all.

687.g: ਕਦਿ ਪਾਵਉ ਸਾਧਸੰਗੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਗਿਆਨ ਅੰਜਨਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਇਸਨਾਨੈ ॥੪॥
687.t: kadh paavau saadhasa(n)g har har sadhaa aana(n)dh giaan a(n)jan meraa man isanaanai ||4||
687.e: When will I find the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy? There, I shall be always in the ecstasy of the Lord, Har, Har, and my mind shall take its cleansing bath in the healing ointment of spiritual wisdom. ||4||

687.g: ਸਗਲ ਅਸ੍ਰਮ ਕੀਨੇ ਮਨੂਆ ਨਹ ਪਤੀਨੇ ਬਿਬੇਕਹੀਨ ਦੇਹੀ ਧੋਏ ॥
687.t: sagal asram keene manooaa neh pateene bibekaheen dhehee dhoe ||
687.e: I have followed the four stages of life, but my mind is not satisfied; I wash my body, but it is totally lacking in understanding.

687.g: ਕੋਈ ਪਾਈਐ ਰੇ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਬਿਧਾਤਾ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਕੀ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮਲੁ ਖੋਏ ॥੫॥
687.t: koiee paieeaai re purakh bidhaataa paarabraham kai ra(n)g raataa mere man kee dhuramat mal khoe ||5||
687.e: If only I could meet some devotee of the Supreme Lord God, imbued with the Lord's Love, who could eradicate the filthy evil-mindedness from my mind. ||5||

687.g: ਕਰਮ ਧਰਮ ਜੁਗਤਾ ਨਿਮਖ ਨ ਹੇਤੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਗਰਬਿ ਗਰਬਿ ਪੜੈ ਕਹੀ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ॥
687.t: karam dharam jugataa nimakh na het karataa garab garab paRai kahee na lekhai ||
687.e: One who is attached to religious rituals, does not love the Lord, even for an instant; he is filled with pride, and he is of no account.

687.g: ਜਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੀਐ ਸਫਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਕਰੈ ਸਦਾ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਗੁਰ ਪਰਸਾਦਿ ਕੋਊ ਨੇਤ੍ਰਹੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੬॥
687.t: jis bheTeeaai safal moorat karai sadhaa keerat gur parasaadh kouoo netrahu pekhai ||6||
687.e: One who meets with the rewarding personality of the Guru, continually sings the Kirtan of the Lord's Praises. By Guru's Grace, such a rare one beholds the Lord with his eyes. ||6||

687.g: ਮਨਹਠਿ ਜੋ ਕਮਾਵੈ ਤਿਲੁ ਨ ਲੇਖੈ ਪਾਵੈ ਬਗੁਲ ਜਿਉ ਧਿਆਨੁ ਲਾਵੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਰੇ ਧਾਰੀ ॥
687.t: manahaTh jo kamaavai til na lekhai paavai bagul jiau dhiaan laavai maiaa re dhaaree ||
687.e: One who acts through stubbornness is of no account at all; like a crane, he pretends to meditate, but he is still stuck in Maya.

687.g: ਕੋਈ ਐਸੋ ਰੇ ਸੁਖਹ ਦਾਈ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕੀ ਕਥਾ ਸੁਨਾਈ ਤਿਸੁ ਭੇਟੇ ਗਤਿ ਹੋਇ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥੭॥
687.t: koiee aaiso re sukheh dhaiee prabh kee kathaa sunaiee tis bheTe gat hoi hamaaree ||7||
687.e: Is there any such Giver of peace, who can recite to me the sermon of God? Meeting him, I would be emancipated. ||7||

687.g: ਸੁਪ੍ਰਸੰਨ ਗੋਪਾਲ ਰਾਇ ਕਾਟੈ ਰੇ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਮੇਰਾ ਮਨੁ ਰਾਤਾ ॥
687.t: suprasa(n)n gopaal rai kaaTai re ba(n)dhan mai gur kai sabadh meraa man raataa ||
687.e: When the Lord, my King, is totally pleased with me, He will break the bonds of Maya for me; my mind is imbued with the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

687.g: ਸਦਾ ਸਦਾ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਭੇਟਿਓ ਨਿਰਭੈ ਗੋਬਿੰਦੁ ਸੁਖ ਨਾਨਕ ਲਾਧੇ ਹਰਿ ਚਰਨ ਪਰਾਤਾ ॥੮॥
687.t: sadhaa sadhaa aana(n)dh bheTio nirabhai gobi(n)dh sukh naanak laadhe har charan paraataa ||8||
687.e: I am in ecstasy, forever and ever, meeting the Fearless Lord, the Lord of the Universe. Falling at the Lord's Feet, Nanak has found peace. ||8||

687.g: ਸਫਲ ਸਫਲ ਭਈ ਸਫਲ ਜਾਤ੍ਰਾ ॥
687.t: safal safal bhiee safal jaatraa ||
687.e: My Yatra, my life pilgrimage, has become fruitful, fruitful, fruitful.

687.g: ਆਵਣ ਜਾਣ ਰਹੇ ਮਿਲੇ ਸਾਧਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ਦੂਜਾ ॥੧॥੩॥
687.t: aavan jaan rahe mile saadhaa ||1|| rahaau dhoojaa ||1||3||
687.e: My comings and goings have ended, since I met the Holy Saint. ||1||Second Pause||1||3||

687.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ਛੰਤ
687.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa chha(n)t
687.e: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla, Chhant:

687.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
687.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
687.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

687.g: ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਣ ਜਾਉ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ॥
687.t: teerath naavan jaau teerath naam hai ||
687.e: Why should I bathe at sacred shrines of pilgrimage? The Naam, the Name of the Lord, is the sacred shrine of pilgrimage.

687.g: ਤੀਰਥੁ ਸਬਦ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਹੈ ॥
687.t: teerath sabadh beechaar a(n)tar giaan hai ||
687.e: My sacred shrine of pilgrimage is spiritual wisdom within, and contemplation on the Word of the Shabad.

687.g: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਥਾਨੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਦਸ ਪੁਰਬ ਸਦਾ ਦਸਾਹਰਾ ॥
687.t: gur giaan saachaa thaan teerath dhas purab sadhaa dhasaaharaa ||
687.e: The spiritual wisdom given by the Guru is the True sacred shrine of pilgrimage, where the ten festivals are always observed.

687.g: ਹਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਸਦਾ ਜਾਚਉ ਦੇਹੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਧਰਣੀਧਰਾ ॥
687.t: hau naam har kaa sadhaa jaachau dheh prabh dharaneedharaa ||
687.e: I constantly beg for the Name of the Lord; grant it to me, O God, Sustainer of the world.

687.g: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਰੋਗੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਦਾਰੂ ਮੈਲੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਚ ਬਿਨਾ ॥
687.t: sa(n)saar rogee naam dhaaroo mail laagai sach binaa ||
687.e: The world is sick, and the Naam is the medicine to cure it; without the True Lord, filth sticks to it.

687.g: ਗੁਰ ਵਾਕੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਸਦਾ ਚਾਨਣੁ ਨਿਤ ਸਾਚੁ ਤੀਰਥੁ ਮਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
687.t: gur vaak niramal sadhaa chaanan nit saach teerath majanaa ||1||
687.e: The Guru's Word is immaculate and pure; it radiates a steady Light. Constantly bathe in such a true shrine of pilgrimage. ||1||

687.g: ਸਾਚਿ ਨ ਲਾਗੈ ਮੈਲੁ ਕਿਆ ਮਲੁ ਧੋਈਐ ॥
687.t: saach na laagai mail kiaa mal dhoieeaai ||
687.e: Filth does not stick to the true ones; what filth do they have to wash off?

687.g: ਗੁਣਹਿ ਹਾਰੁ ਪਰੋਇ ਕਿਸ ਕਉ ਰੋਈਐ ॥
687.t: guneh haar paroi kis kau roieeaai ||
687.e: If one strings a garland of virtues for oneself, what is there to cry for?

687.g: ਵੀਚਾਰਿ ਮਾਰੈ ਤਰੈ ਤਾਰੈ ਉਲਟਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ॥
687.t: veechaar maarai tarai taarai ulaT jon na aave ||
687.e: One who conquers his own self through contemplation is saved, and saves others as well; he does not come to be born again.

687.g: ਆਪਿ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਪਰਮ ਧਿਆਨੀ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
687.t: aap paaras param dhiaanee saach saache bhaave ||
687.e: The supreme meditator is Himself the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold. The true man is pleasing to the True Lord.

687.g: ਆਨੰਦੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਖੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਦੂਖ ਕਿਲਵਿਖ ਪਰਹਰੇ ॥
687.t: aana(n)dh anadhin harakh saachaa dhookh kilavikh parahare ||
687.e: He is in ecstasy, truly happy, night and day; his sorrows and sins are taken away.

687.g: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਰਿ ਦਿਖਾਇਆ ਮੈਲੁ ਨਾਹੀ ਸਚ ਮਨੇ ॥੨॥
687.t: sach naam paiaa gur dhikhaiaa mail naahee sach mane ||2||
687.e: He finds the True Name, and beholds the Guru; with the True Name in his mind, no filth sticks to him. ||2||

687.g: ਸੰਗਤਿ ਮੀਤ ਮਿਲਾਪੁ ਪੂਰਾ ਨਾਵਣੋ ॥
687.t: sa(n)gat meet milaap pooraa naavano ||
687.e: O friend, association with the Holy is the perfect cleansing bath.

688.g: ਗਾਵੈ ਗਾਵਣਹਾਰੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਵਣੋ ॥
688.t: gaavai gaavanahaar sabadh suhaavano ||
688.e: The singer who sings the Lord's Praises is adorned with the Word of the Shabad.

688.g: ਸਾਲਾਹਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਮੰਨਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪੁੰਨ ਦਾਨ ਦਇਆ ਮਤੇ ॥
688.t: saalaeh saache ma(n)n satigur pu(n)n dhaan dhiaa mate ||
688.e: Worship the True Lord, and believe in the True Guru; this brings the merit of making donations to charity, kindness and compassion.

688.g: ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਾਵੈ ਬੇਣੀ ਤ ਸੰਗਮੁ ਸਤ ਸਤੇ ॥
688.t: pir sa(n)g bhaavai sahaj naavai benee ta sa(n)gam sat sate ||
688.e: The soul-bride who loves to be with her Husband Lord bathes at the true Triveni of the soul, which she regards as the sacred place where the Ganges, Jamuna and Saraswaati Rivers converge.

688.g: ਆਰਾਧਿ ਏਕੰਕਾਰੁ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਿਤ ਦੇਇ ਚੜੈ ਸਵਾਇਆ ॥
688.t: aaraadh eka(n)kaar saachaa nit dhei chaRai savaiaa ||
688.e: Worship and adore the One Creator, the True Lord, who constantly gives, whose gifts continually increase.

688.g: ਗਤਿ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੀਤਾ ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਨਦਰਿ ਮੇਲਿ ਮਿਲਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
688.t: gat sa(n)g meetaa sa(n)tasa(n)gat kar nadhar mel milaiaa ||3||
688.e: Salvation is attained by associating with the Society of the Saints, O friend; granting His Grace, God unites us in His Union. ||3||

688.g: ਕਹਣੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਇ ਕੇਵਡੁ ਆਖੀਐ ॥
688.t: kahan kahai sabh koi kevadd aakheeaai ||
688.e: Everyone speaks and talks; how great should I say He is?

688.g: ਹਉ ਮੂਰਖੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਜਾਣੁ ਸਮਝਾ ਸਾਖੀਐ ॥
688.t: hau moorakh neech ajaan samajhaa saakheeaai ||
688.e: I am foolish, lowly and ignorant; it is only through the Guru's Teachings that I understand.

688.g: ਸਚੁ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਸਾਖੀ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਭਾਖੀ ਤਿਤੁ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨਿਆ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
688.t: sach gur kee saakhee a(n)mirat bhaakhee tit man maaniaa meraa ||
688.e: True are the Teachings of the Guru. His Words are Ambrosial Nectar; my mind is pleased and appeased by them.

688.g: ਕੂਚੁ ਕਰਹਿ ਆਵਹਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੇ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਚੈ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥
688.t: kooch kareh aaveh bikh laadhe sabadh sachai gur meraa ||
688.e: Loaded down with corruption and sin, people depart, and then come back again; the True Shabad is found through my Guru.

688.g: ਆਖਣਿ ਤੋਟਿ ਨ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰੀ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸੋਈ ॥
688.t: aakhan toT na bhagat bha(n)ddaaree bharipur rahiaa soiee ||
688.e: There is no end to the treasure of devotion; the Lord is pervading everywhere.

688.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਕਹੈ ਬੇਨੰਤੀ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਂਜੈ ਸਚੁ ਸੋਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
688.t: naanak saach kahai bena(n)tee man maa(n)jai sach soiee ||4||1||
688.e: Nanak utters this true prayer; one who purifies his mind is True. ||4||1||

688.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
688.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa pehilaa ||
688.e: Dhanaasaree, First Mehla:

688.g: ਜੀਵਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਨਾਇ ਮਨਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
688.t: jeevaa terai nai man aana(n)dh hai jeeau ||
688.e: I live by Your Name; my mind is in ecstasy, Lord.

688.g: ਸਾਚੋ ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਉ ਗੁਣ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੁ ਹੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
688.t: saacho saachaa naau gun govi(n)dh hai jeeau ||
688.e: True is the Name of the True Lord. Glorious are the Praises of the Lord of the Universe.

688.g: ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਅਪਾਰਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ਜਿਨਿ ਸਿਰਜੀ ਤਿਨਿ ਗੋਈ ॥
688.t: gur giaan apaaraa sirajanahaaraa jin sirajee tin goiee ||
688.e: Infinite is the spiritual wisdom imparted by the Guru. The Creator Lord who created, shall also destroy.

688.g: ਪਰਵਾਣਾ ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਪਠਾਇਆ ਫੇਰਿ ਨ ਸਕੈ ਕੋਈ ॥
688.t: paravaanaa aaiaa hukam paThaiaa fer na sakai koiee ||
688.e: The call of death is sent out by the Lord's Command; no one can challenge it.

688.g: ਆਪੇ ਕਰਿ ਵੇਖੈ ਸਿਰਿ ਸਿਰਿ ਲੇਖੈ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਰਤਿ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥
688.t: aape kar vekhai sir sir lekhai aape surat bujhaiee ||
688.e: He Himself creates, and watches; His written command is above each and every head. He Himself imparts understanding and awareness.

688.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰੁ ਜੀਵਾ ਸਚੀ ਨਾਈ ॥੧॥
688.t: naanak saahib agam agochar jeevaa sachee naiee ||1||
688.e: O Nanak, the Lord Master is inaccessible and unfathomable; I live by His True Name. ||1||

688.g: ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਕੋਇ ਆਇਆ ਜਾਇਸੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
688.t: tum sar avar na koi aaiaa jaisee jeeau ||
688.e: No one can compare to You, Lord; all come and go.

688.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੋਇ ਨਿਬੇੜੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਇਸੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
688.t: hukamee hoi nibeR bharam chukaisee jeeau ||
688.e: By Your Command, the account is settled, and doubt is dispelled.

688.g: ਗੁਰੁ ਭਰਮੁ ਚੁਕਾਏ ਅਕਥੁ ਕਹਾਏ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਮਾਣਾ ॥
688.t: gur bharam chukaae akath kahaae sach meh saach samaanaa ||
688.e: The Guru dispels doubt, and makes us speak the Unspoken Speech; the true ones are absorbed into Truth.

688.g: ਆਪਿ ਉਪਾਏ ਆਪਿ ਸਮਾਏ ਹੁਕਮੀ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
688.t: aap upaae aap samaae hukamee hukam pachhaanaa ||
688.e: He Himself creates, and He Himself destroys; I accept the Command of the Commander Lord.

688.g: ਸਚੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ਤੂ ਮਨਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
688.t: sachee vaddiaaiee gur te paiee too man a(n)t sakhaiee ||
688.e: True greatness comes from the Guru; You alone are the mind's companion in the end.

688.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਅਵਰੁ ਨ ਦੂਜਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੨॥
688.t: naanak saahib avar na dhoojaa naam terai vaddiaaiee ||2||
688.e: O Nanak, there is no other than the Lord and Master; greatness comes from Your Name. ||2||

688.g: ਤੂ ਸਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰੁ ਅਲਖ ਸਿਰੰਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
688.t: too sachaa sirajanahaar alakh sira(n)dhiaa jeeau ||
688.e: You are the True Creator Lord, the unknowable Maker.

688.g: ਏਕੁ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਵਾਦ ਵਧੰਦਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
688.t: ek saahib dhui raeh vaadh vadha(n)dhiaa jeeau ||
688.e: There is only the One Lord and Master, but there are two paths, by which conflict increases.

688.g: ਦੁਇ ਰਾਹ ਚਲਾਏ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਬਾਏ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਆ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
688.t: dhui raeh chalaae hukam sabaae janam muaa sa(n)saaraa ||
688.e: All follow these two paths, by the Hukam of the Lord's Command; the world is born, only to die.

688.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਨਾਹੀ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ਬਿਖੁ ਲਾਦੀ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰਾ ॥
688.t: naam binaa naahee ko belee bikh laadhee sir bhaaraa ||
688.e: Without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, the mortal has no friend at all; he carries loads of sin on his head.

688.g: ਹੁਕਮੀ ਆਇਆ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਵਾਰਣਹਾਰਾ ॥
688.t: hukamee aaiaa hukam na boojhai hukam savaaranahaaraa ||
688.e: By the Hukam of the Lord's Command, he comes, but he does not understand this Hukam; the Lord's Hukam is the Embellisher.

688.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਿਞਾਪੈ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਿਰਜਣਹਾਰਾ ॥੩॥
688.t: naanak saahib sabadh sin(j)aapai saachaa sirajanahaaraa ||3||
688.e: O Nanak, through the Shabad, the Word of the Lord and Master, the True Creator Lord is realized. ||3||

688.g: ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਹਿ ਦਰਵਾਰਿ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
688.t: bhagat soheh dharavaar sabadh suhaiaa jeeau ||
688.e: Your devotees look beautiful in Your Court, embellished with the Shabad.

688.g: ਬੋਲਹਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣਿ ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
688.t: boleh a(n)mirat baan rasan rasaiaa jeeau ||
688.e: They chant the Ambrosial Word of His Bani, savoring it with their tongues.

688.g: ਰਸਨ ਰਸਾਏ ਨਾਮਿ ਤਿਸਾਏ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਕਾਣੇ ॥
688.t: rasan rasaae naam tisaae gur kai sabadh vikaane ||
688.e: Savoring it with their tongues, they thirst for the Naam; they are a sacrifice to the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

688.g: ਪਾਰਸਿ ਪਰਸਿਐ ਪਾਰਸੁ ਹੋਏ ਜਾ ਤੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਣੇ ॥
688.t: paaras parasiaai paaras hoe jaa terai man bhaane ||
688.e: Touching the philosopher's stone, they become the philosopher's stone, which transforms lead into gold; O Lord, they become pleasing to your mind.

688.g: ਅਮਰਾ ਪਦੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਆਪੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ਵਿਰਲਾ ਗਿਆਨ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ॥
688.t: amaraa padh paiaa aap gavaiaa viralaa giaan veechaaree ||
688.e: They attain the immortal status and eradicate their self-conceit; how rare is that person, who contemplates spiritual wisdom.

688.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਭਗਤ ਸੋਹਨਿ ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ ਸਾਚੇ ਕੇ ਵਾਪਾਰੀ ॥੪॥
688.t: naanak bhagat sohan dhar saachai saache ke vaapaaree ||4||
688.e: O Nanak, the devotees look beautiful in the Court of the True Lord; they are dealers in the Truth. ||4||

688.g: ਭੂਖ ਪਿਆਸੋ ਆਥਿ ਕਿਉ ਦਰਿ ਜਾਇਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
688.t: bhookh piaaso aath kiau dhar jaisaa jeeau ||
688.e: I am hungry and thirsty for wealth; how will I be able to go to the Lord's Court?

689.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪੂਛਉ ਜਾਇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਸਾ ਜੀਉ ॥
689.t: satigur poochhau jai naam dhiaaisaa jeeau ||
689.e: I shall go and ask the True Guru, and meditate on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

689.g: ਸਚੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈ ਸਾਚੁ ਚਵਾਈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਾਚੁ ਪਛਾਣਾ ॥
689.t: sach naam dhiaaiee saach chavaiee gurmukh saach pachhaanaa ||
689.e: I meditate on the True Name, chant the True Name, and as Gurmukh, I realize the True Name.

689.g: ਦੀਨਾ ਨਾਥੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੁ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਵਖਾਣਾ ॥
689.t: dheenaa naath dhiaal nira(n)jan anadhin naam vakhaanaa ||
689.e: Night and day, I chant the Name of the merciful, immaculate Lord, the Master of the poor.

689.g: ਕਰਣੀ ਕਾਰ ਧੁਰਹੁ ਫੁਰਮਾਈ ਆਪਿ ਮੁਆ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
689.t: karanee kaar dhurahu furamaiee aap muaa man maaree ||
689.e: The Primal Lord has ordained the tasks to be done; self-conceit is overcome, and the mind is subdued.

689.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਹਾ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਨਾਮਿ ਨਿਵਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੨॥
689.t: naanak naam mahaa ras meeThaa tirasanaa naam nivaaree ||5||2||
689.e: O Nanak, the Naam is the sweetest essence; through the Naam, thirst and desire are stilled. ||5||2||

689.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੧ ॥
689.t: dhanaasaree chha(n)t mahalaa pehilaa ||
689.e: Dhanaasaree, Chhant, First Mehla:

689.g: ਪਿਰ ਸੰਗਿ ਮੂਠੜੀਏ ਖਬਰਿ ਨ ਪਾਈਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
689.t: pir sa(n)g mooThaRe'e khabar na paieeaa jeeau ||
689.e: Your Husband Lord is with you, O deluded soul-bride, but you do are not aware of Him.

689.g: ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਿਅੜਾ ਲੇਖੁ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
689.t: masatak likhiaRaa lekh purab kamaiaa jeeau ||
689.e: Your destiny is written on your forehead, according to your past actions.

689.g: ਲੇਖੁ ਨ ਮਿਟਈ ਪੁਰਬਿ ਕਮਾਇਆ ਕਿਆ ਜਾਣਾ ਕਿਆ ਹੋਸੀ ॥
689.t: lekh na miTiee purab kamaiaa kiaa jaanaa kiaa hosee ||
689.e: This inscription of past deeds cannot be erased; what do I know about what will happen?

689.g: ਗੁਣੀ ਅਚਾਰਿ ਨਹੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ਅਵਗੁਣ ਬਹਿ ਬਹਿ ਰੋਸੀ ॥
689.t: gunee achaar nahee ra(n)g raatee avagun beh beh rosee ||
689.e: You have not adopted a virtuous lifestyle, and you are not attuned to the Lord's Love; you sit there, crying over your past misdeeds.

689.g: ਧਨੁ ਜੋਬਨੁ ਆਕ ਕੀ ਛਾਇਆ ਬਿਰਧਿ ਭਏ ਦਿਨ ਪੁੰਨਿਆ ॥
689.t: dhan joban aak kee chhaiaa biradh bhe dhin pu(n)niaa ||
689.e: Wealth and youth are like the shade of the bitter swallow-wort plant; you are growing old, and your days are coming to their end.

689.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਦੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਛੂਟੀ ਝੂਠਿ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ ॥੧॥
689.t: naanak naam binaa dhohaagan chhooTee jhooTh vichhu(n)niaa ||1||
689.e: O Nanak, without the Naam, the Name of the Lord, you shall end up as a discarded, divorced bride; your own falsehood shall separate you from the Lord. ||1||

689.g: ਬੂਡੀ ਘਰੁ ਘਾਲਿਓ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਭਾਇ ਚਲੋ ॥
689.t: booddee ghar ghaalio gur kai bhai chalo ||
689.e: You have drowned, and your house is ruined; walk in the Way of the Guru's Will.

689.g: ਸਾਚਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਸੁਖਿ ਮਹਲੋ ॥
689.t: saachaa naam dhiaai paaveh sukh mahalo ||
689.e: Meditate on the True Name, and you shall find peace in the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

689.g: ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ਪੇਈਅੜੈ ਦਿਨ ਚਾਰੇ ॥
689.t: har naam dhiaae taa sukh paae peieeaRai dhin chaare ||
689.e: Meditate on the Lord's Name, and you shall find peace; your stay in this world shall last only four days.

689.g: ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਜਾਇ ਬਹੈ ਸਚੁ ਪਾਏ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਨਾਲਿ ਪਿਆਰੇ ॥
689.t: nij ghar jai bahai sach paae anadhin naal piaare ||
689.e: Sit in the home of your own being, and you shall find Truth; night and day, be with your Beloved.

689.g: ਵਿਣੁ ਭਗਤੀ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸੁ ਨ ਹੋਵੀ ਸੁਣਿਅਹੁ ਲੋਕ ਸਬਾਏ ॥
689.t: vin bhagatee ghar vaas na hovee suniahu lok sabaae ||
689.e: Without loving devotion, you cannot dwell in your own home - listen, everyone!

689.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਰਸੀ ਤਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਪਾਏ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਾਚੈ ਨਾਏ ॥੨॥
689.t: naanak sarasee taa pir paae raatee saachai naae ||2||
689.e: O Nanak, she is happy, and she obtains her Husband Lord, if she is attuned to the True Name. ||2||

689.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਧਨ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵੈ ਨਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
689.t: pir dhan bhaavai taa pir bhaavai naaree jeeau ||
689.e: If the soul-bride is pleasing to her Husband Lord, then the Husband Lord will love His bride.

689.g: ਰੰਗਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਰਾਤੀ ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਜੀਉ ॥
689.t: ra(n)g preetam raatee gur kai sabadh veechaaree jeeau ||
689.e: Imbued with the love of her Beloved, she contemplates the Word of the Guru's Shabad.

689.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵੀਚਾਰੀ ਨਾਹ ਪਿਆਰੀ ਨਿਵਿ ਨਿਵਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
689.t: gur sabadh veechaaree naeh piaaree niv niv bhagat kareiee ||
689.e: She contemplates the Guru's Shabads, and her Husband Lord loves her; in deep humility, she worships Him in loving devotion.

689.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਜਲਾਏ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮੁ ਰਸ ਮਹਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਰੇਈ ॥
689.t: maiaa moh jalaae preetam ras meh ra(n)g kareiee ||
689.e: She burns away her emotional attachment to Maya, and in love, she loves her Beloved.

689.g: ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸਾਚੇ ਸੇਤੀ ਰੰਗਿ ਰੰਗੇਤੀ ਲਾਲ ਭਈ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਰੀ ॥
689.t: prabh saache setee ra(n)g ra(n)getee laal bhiee man maaree ||
689.e: She is imbued and drenched with the Love of the True Lord; she has become beautiful, by conquering her mind.

689.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚਿ ਵਸੀ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਪਿਰ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਪਿਆਰੀ ॥੩॥
689.t: naanak saach vasee sohaagan pir siau preet piaaree ||3||
689.e: O Nanak, the happy soul-bride abides in Truth; she loves to love her Husband Lord. ||3||

689.g: ਪਿਰ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਨਾਰਿ ਜੇ ਪਿਰ ਭਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
689.t: pir ghar sohai naar je pir bhaave jeeau ||
689.e: The soul-bride looks so beautiful in the home of her Husband Lord, if she is pleasing to Him.

689.g: ਝੂਠੇ ਵੈਣ ਚਵੇ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
689.t: jhooThe vain chave kaam na aave jeeau ||
689.e: It is of no use at all to speak false words.

689.g: ਝੂਠੁ ਅਲਾਵੈ ਕਾਮਿ ਨ ਆਵੈ ਨਾ ਪਿਰੁ ਦੇਖੈ ਨੈਣੀ ॥
689.t: jhooTh alaavai kaam na aavai naa pir dhekhai nainee ||
689.e: If she speaks false, it is of no use to her, and she does not see her Husband Lord with her eyes.

689.g: ਅਵਗੁਣਿਆਰੀ ਕੰਤਿ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਛੂਟੀ ਵਿਧਣ ਰੈਣੀ ॥
689.t: avaguniaaree ka(n)t visaaree chhooTee vidhan rainee ||
689.e: Worthless, forgotten and abandoned by her Husband Lord, she passes her life-night without her Lord and Master.

689.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦੁ ਨ ਮਾਨੈ ਫਾਹੀ ਫਾਥੀ ਸਾ ਧਨ ਮਹਲੁ ਨ ਪਾਏ ॥
689.t: gur sabadh na maanai faahee faathee saa dhan mahal na paae ||
689.e: Such a wife does not believe in the Word of the Guru's Shabad; she is caught in the net of the world, and does not obtain the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

689.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਆਪੇ ਆਪੁ ਪਛਾਣੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੪॥
689.t: naanak aape aap pachhaanai gurmukh sahaj samaae ||4||
689.e: O Nanak, if she understands her own self, then, as Gurmukh, she merges in celestial peace. ||4||

689.g: ਧਨ ਸੋਹਾਗਣਿ ਨਾਰਿ ਜਿਨਿ ਪਿਰੁ ਜਾਣਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
689.t: dhan sohaagan naar jin pir jaaniaa jeeau ||
689.e: Blessed is that soul-bride, who knows her Husband Lord.

689.g: ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨਾ ਕੂੜਿਆਰਿ ਕੂੜੁ ਕਮਾਣਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
689.t: naam binaa kooRiaar kooR kamaaniaa jeeau ||
689.e: Without the Naam, she is false, and her actions are false as well.

689.g: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਸੁਹਾਵੀ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵੀ ਭਾਇ ਭਗਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
689.t: har bhagat suhaavee saache bhaavee bhai bhagat prabh raatee ||
689.e: Devotional worship of the Lord is beautiful; the True Lord loves it. So immerse yourself in loving devotional worship of God.

689.g: ਪਿਰੁ ਰਲੀਆਲਾ ਜੋਬਨਿ ਬਾਲਾ ਤਿਸੁ ਰਾਵੇ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਾਤੀ ॥
689.t: pir raleeaalaa joban baalaa tis raave ra(n)g raatee ||
689.e: My Husband Lord is playful and innocent; imbued with His Love, I enjoy Him.

689.g: ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਵਿਗਾਸੀ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਾਸੀ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ ਗੁਣਕਾਰੀ ॥
689.t: gur sabadh vigaasee sahu raavaasee fal paiaa gunakaaree ||
689.e: She blossoms forth through the Word of the Guru's Shabad; she ravishes her Husband Lord, and obtains the most noble reward.

689.g: ਨਾਨਕ ਸਾਚੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਪਿਰ ਘਰਿ ਸੋਹੈ ਨਾਰੀ ॥੫॥੩॥
689.t: naanak saach milai vaddiaaiee pir ghar sohai naaree ||5||3||
689.e: O Nanak, in Truth, she obtains glory; in her Husband's home, the soul-bride looks beautiful. ||5||3||

690.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਛੰਤ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧
690.t: dhanaasaree chha(n)t mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa
690.e: Dhanaasaree, Chhant, Fourth Mehla, First House:

690.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
690.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
690.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

690.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
690.t: har jeeau kirapaa kare taa naam dhiaaieeaai jeeau ||
690.e: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, one meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

690.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮਿਲੈ ਸੁਭਾਇ ਸਹਜਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
690.t: satigur milai subhai sahaj gun gaieeaai jeeau ||
690.e: Meeting the True Guru, through loving faith and devotion, one intuitively sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

690.g: ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਵਿਗਸੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਾਚੇ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
690.t: gun gai vigasai sadhaa anadhin jaa aap saache bhaave ||
690.e: Singing His Glorious Praises continually, night and day, one blossoms forth, when it is pleasing to the True Lord.

690.g: ਅਹੰਕਾਰੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਤਜੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਸਹਜਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ॥
690.t: aha(n)kaar haumai tajai maiaa sahaj naam samaave ||
690.e: Egotism, self-conceit and Maya are forsaken, and he is intuitively absorbed into the Naam.

690.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋਈ ਆਪਿ ਦੇਇ ਤ ਪਾਈਐ ॥
690.t: aap karataa kare soiee aap dhei ta paieeaai ||
690.e: The Creator Himself acts; when He gives, then we receive.

690.g: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਈਐ ਜੀਉ ॥੧॥
690.t: har jeeau kirapaa kare taa naam dhiaaieeaai jeeau ||1||
690.e: When the Dear Lord grants His Grace, we meditate on the Naam. ||1||

690.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
690.t: a(n)dhar saachaa neh poore satigurai jeeau ||
690.e: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru.

690.g: ਹਉ ਤਿਸੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮੈ ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵੀਸਰੈ ਜੀਉ ॥
690.t: hau tis sevee dhin raat mai kadhe na veesarai jeeau ||
690.e: I serve Him day and night; I never forget Him.

690.g: ਕਦੇ ਨ ਵਿਸਾਰੀ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸਮੑਾਰੀ ਜਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਈ ਤਾ ਜੀਵਾ ॥
690.t: kadhe na visaaree anadhin sam(h)aaree jaa naam liee taa jeevaa ||
690.e: I never forget Him; I remember Him night and day. When I chant the Naam, then I live.

690.g: ਸ੍ਰਵਣੀ ਸੁਣੀ ਤ ਇਹੁ ਮਨੁ ਤ੍ਰਿਪਤੈ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਪੀਵਾ ॥
690.t: sravanee sunee ta ih man tirapatai gurmukh a(n)mrit peevaa ||
690.e: With my ears, I hear about Him, and my mind is satisfied. As Gurmukh, I drink in the Ambrosial Nectar.

690.g: ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ ਤਾ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਲੇ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਬਿਬੇਕ ਬੁਧਿ ਬਿਚਰੈ ॥
690.t: nadhar kare taa satigur mele anadhin bibek budh bicharai ||
690.e: If He bestows His Glance of Grace, then I shall meet the True Guru; my discriminating intellect would contemplate Him, night and day.

690.g: ਅੰਦਰਿ ਸਾਚਾ ਨੇਹੁ ਪੂਰੇ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੈ ॥੨॥
690.t: a(n)dhar saachaa neh poore satigurai ||2||
690.e: Deep within, I feel true love for the Perfect True Guru. ||2||

690.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
690.t: satasa(n)gat milai vaddabhaag taa har ras aave jeeau ||
690.e: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation; then, one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord.

690.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਰਹੈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਇ ਤ ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥
690.t: anadhin rahai liv lai ta sahaj samaave jeeau ||
690.e: Night and day, he remains lovingly focused on the Lord; he merges in celestial peace.

690.g: ਸਹਜਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਸਦਾ ਅਤੀਤੁ ਬੈਰਾਗੀ ॥
690.t: sahaj samaavai taa har man bhaavai sadhaa ateet bairaagee ||
690.e: Merging in celestial peace, he becomes pleasing to the Lord's Mind; he remains forever unattached and untouched.

690.g: ਹਲਤਿ ਪਲਤਿ ਸੋਭਾ ਜਗ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮਿ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
690.t: halat palat sobhaa jag a(n)tar raam naam liv laagee ||
690.e: He receives honor in this world and the next, lovingly focused on the Lord's Name.

690.g: ਹਰਖ ਸੋਗ ਦੁਹਾ ਤੇ ਮੁਕਤਾ ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
690.t: harakh sog dhuhaa te mukataa jo prabh kare su bhaave ||
690.e: He is liberated from both pleasure and pain; he is pleased by whatever God does.

690.g: ਸਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਮਿਲੈ ਵਡਭਾਗਿ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਆਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੩॥
690.t: satasa(n)gat milai vaddabhaag taa har ras aave jeeau ||3||
690.e: By great good fortune, one joins the Sat Sangat, the True Congregation, and then, one comes to savor the subtle essence of the Lord. ||3||

690.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
690.t: dhoojai bhai dhukh hoi manmukh jam johiaa jeeau ||
690.e: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs.

690.g: ਹਾਇ ਹਾਇ ਕਰੇ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
690.t: hai hai kare dhin raat maiaa dhukh mohiaa jeeau ||
690.e: They cry and howl, day and night, caught by the pain of Maya.

690.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਦੁਖਿ ਮੋਹਿਆ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਹਿਆ ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕਰਤ ਵਿਹਾਵਏ ॥
690.t: maiaa dhukh mohiaa haumai rohiaa meree meree karat vihaave ||
690.e: Caught by the pain of Maya, provoked by his ego, he passes his life crying out, ""Mine, mine!"".

690.g: ਜੋ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਦੇਇ ਤਿਸੁ ਚੇਤੈ ਨਾਹੀ ਅੰਤਿ ਗਇਆ ਪਛੁਤਾਵਏ ॥
690.t: jo prabh dhei tis chetai naahee a(n)t giaa pachhutaave ||
690.e: He does not remember God, the Giver, and in the end, he departs regretting and repenting.

690.g: ਬਿਨੁ ਨਾਵੈ ਕੋ ਸਾਥਿ ਨ ਚਾਲੈ ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਮਾਇਆ ਧੋਹਿਆ ॥
690.t: bin naavai ko saath na chaalai putr kalatr maiaa dhohiaa ||
690.e: Without the Name, nothing shall go along with him; not his children, spouse or the enticements of Maya.

690.g: ਦੂਜੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੁਖੁ ਹੋਇ ਮਨਮੁਖਿ ਜਮਿ ਜੋਹਿਆ ਜੀਉ ॥੪॥
690.t: dhoojai bhai dhukh hoi manmukh jam johiaa jeeau ||4||
690.e: In the love of duality, there is pain and suffering; the Messenger of Death eyes the self-willed manmukhs. ||4||

690.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
690.t: kar kirapaa leh milai mahal har paiaa jeeau ||
690.e: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence.

690.g: ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਕਰ ਜੋੜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਇਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
690.t: sadhaa rahai kar joR prabh man bhaiaa jeeau ||
690.e: I remain standing with my palms pressed together; I have become pleasing to God's Mind.

690.g: ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਾ ਹੁਕਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ਹੁਕਮੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
690.t: prabh man bhaavai taa hukam samaavai hukam ma(n)n sukh paiaa ||
690.e: When one is pleasing to God's Mind, then he merges in the Hukam of the Lord's Command; surrendering to His Hukam, he finds peace.

690.g: ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਪਤ ਰਹੈ ਦਿਨੁ ਰਾਤੀ ਸਹਜੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ॥
690.t: anadhin japat rahai dhin raatee sahaje naam dhiaaiaa ||
690.e: Night and day, he chants the Lord's Name, day and night; intuitively, naturally, he meditates on the Naam, the Name of the Lord.

690.g: ਨਾਮੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਿਲੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵਏ ॥
690.t: naamo naam milee vaddiaaiee naanak naam man bhaave ||
690.e: Through the Naam, the glorious greatness of the Naam is obtained; the Naam is pleasing to Nanak's mind.

690.g: ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਲੇਹੁ ਮਿਲਾਇ ਮਹਲੁ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਵਏ ਜੀਉ ॥੫॥੧॥
690.t: kar kirapaa leh milai mahal har paave jeeau ||5||1||
690.e: Granting His Grace, the Lord has merged me with Himself; I have found the Mansion of the Lord's Presence. ||5||1||

691.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੫ ਛੰਤ
691.t: dhanaasaree mahalaa panjavaa chha(n)t
691.e: Dhanaasaree, Fifth Mehla, Chhant:

691.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
691.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
691.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

691.g: ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਜਿਸੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਹਰਿ ਗਾਵੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
691.t: satigur dheen dhiaal jis sa(n)g har gaaveeaai jeeau ||
691.e: The True Guru is merciful to the meek; in His Presence, the Lord's Praises are sung.

691.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ ਰਾਵੀਐ ਜੀਉ ॥
691.t: a(n)mrit har kaa naam saadhasa(n)g raaveeaai jeeau ||
691.e: The Ambrosial Name of the Lord is chanted in the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy.

691.g: ਭਜੁ ਸੰਗਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਇਕੁ ਅਰਾਧੂ ਜਨਮ ਮਰਨ ਦੁਖ ਨਾਸਏ ॥
691.t: bhaj sa(n)g saadhoo ik araadhoo janam maran dhukh naase ||
691.e: Vibrating, and worshipping the One Lord in the Company of the Holy, the pains of birth and death are removed.

691.g: ਧੁਰਿ ਕਰਮੁ ਲਿਖਿਆ ਸਾਚੁ ਸਿਖਿਆ ਕਟੀ ਜਮ ਕੀ ਫਾਸਏ ॥
691.t: dhur karam likhiaa saach sikhiaa kaTee jam kee faase ||
691.e: Those who have such karma pre-ordained, study and learn the Truth; the noose of Death is removed from their necks.

691.g: ਭੈ ਭਰਮ ਨਾਠੇ ਛੁਟੀ ਗਾਠੇ ਜਮ ਪੰਥਿ ਮੂਲਿ ਨ ਆਵੀਐ ॥
691.t: bhai bharam naaThe chhuTee gaaThe jam pa(n)th mool na aaveeaai ||
691.e: Their fears and doubts are dispelled, the knot of death is untied, and they never have to walk on Death's path.

691.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧਾਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਸਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੀਐ ॥੧॥
691.t: binava(n)t naanak dhaar kirapaa sadhaa har gun gaaveeaai ||1||
691.e: Prays Nanak, shower me with Your Mercy, Lord; let me sing Your Glorious Praises forever. ||1||

691.g: ਨਿਧਰਿਆ ਧਰ ਏਕੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਰੰਜਨੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
691.t: nidhariaa dhar ek naam nira(n)jano jeeau ||
691.e: The Name of the One, Immaculate Lord is the Support of the unsupported.

691.g: ਤੂ ਦਾਤਾ ਦਾਤਾਰੁ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੰਜਨੋ ਜੀਉ ॥
691.t: too dhaataa dhaataar sarab dhukh bha(n)jano jeeau ||
691.e: You are the Giver, the Great Giver, the Dispeller of all sorrow.

691.g: ਦੁਖ ਹਰਤ ਕਰਤਾ ਸੁਖਹ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਰਣਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਆਇਆ ॥
691.t: dhukh harat karataa sukheh suaamee saran saadhoo aaiaa ||
691.e: O Destroyer of pain, Creator Lord, Master of peace and bliss, I have come seeking the Sanctuary of the Holy;

691.g: ਸੰਸਾਰੁ ਸਾਗਰੁ ਮਹਾ ਬਿਖੜਾ ਪਲ ਏਕ ਮਾਹਿ ਤਰਾਇਆ ॥
691.t: sa(n)saar saagar mahaa bikhaRaa pal ek maeh taraiaa ||
691.e: please, help me to cross over the terrifying and difficult world-ocean in an instant.

691.g: ਪੂਰਿ ਰਹਿਆ ਸਰਬ ਥਾਈ ਗੁਰ ਗਿਆਨੁ ਨੇਤ੍ਰੀ ਅੰਜਨੋ ॥
691.t: poor rahiaa sarab thaiee gur giaan netree a(n)jano ||
691.e: I saw the Lord pervading and permeating everywhere, when the healing ointment of the Guru's wisdom was applied to my eyes.

691.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਸਦਾ ਸਿਮਰੀ ਸਰਬ ਦੁਖ ਭੈ ਭੰਜਨੋ ॥੨॥
691.t: binava(n)t naanak sadhaa simaree sarab dhukh bhai bha(n)jano ||2||
691.e: Prays Nanak, remember Him forever in meditation, the Destroyer of all sorrow and fear. ||2||

691.g: ਆਪਿ ਲੀਏ ਲੜਿ ਲਾਇ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਧਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
691.t: aap le'ee laR lai kirapaa dhaareeaa jeeau ||
691.e: He Himself has attached me to the hem of His robe; He has showered me with His Mercy.

691.g: ਮੋਹਿ ਨਿਰਗੁਣੁ ਨੀਚੁ ਅਨਾਥੁ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅਗਮ ਅਪਾਰੀਆ ਜੀਉ ॥
691.t: moh niragun neech anaath prabh agam apaareeaa jeeau ||
691.e: I am worthless, lowly and helpless; God is unfathomable and infinite.

691.g: ਦਇਆਲ ਸਦਾ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਨੀਚ ਥਾਪਣਹਾਰਿਆ ॥
691.t: dhiaal sadhaa kirapaal suaamee neech thaapanahaariaa ||
691.e: My Lord and Master is always merciful, kind and compassionate; He uplifts and establishes the lowly.

691.g: ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਵਸਿ ਤੇਰੈ ਸਗਲ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਾਰਿਆ ॥
691.t: jeea ja(n)t sabh vas terai sagal teree saariaa ||
691.e: All beings and creatures are under Your power; You take care of all.

691.g: ਆਪਿ ਕਰਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਭੁਗਤਾ ਆਪਿ ਸਗਲ ਬੀਚਾਰੀਆ ॥
691.t: aap karataa aap bhugataa aap sagal beechaareeaa ||
691.e: He Himself is the Creator, and He Himself is the Enjoyer; He Himself is the Contemplator of all.

691.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤ ਨਾਨਕ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਇ ਜੀਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਜਪਉ ਬਨਵਾਰੀਆ ॥੩॥
691.t: binava(n)t naanak gun gai jeevaa har jap japau banavaareeaa ||3||
691.e: Prays Nanak, singing Your Glorious Praises, I live, chanting the Chant of the Lord, the Lord of the world-forest. ||3||

691.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਦਰਸੁ ਅਪਾਰੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਮੋਲਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
691.t: teraa dharas apaar naam amoliee jeeau ||
691.e: The Blessed Vision of Your Darshan is incomparable; Your Name is utterly priceless.

691.g: ਨਿਤਿ ਜਪਹਿ ਤੇਰੇ ਦਾਸ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਤੋਲਈ ਜੀਉ ॥
691.t: nit japeh tere dhaas purakh atoliee jeeau ||
691.e: O my Incomputable Lord, Your humble servants ever meditate on You.

691.g: ਸੰਤ ਰਸਨ ਵੂਠਾ ਆਪਿ ਤੂਠਾ ਹਰਿ ਰਸਹਿ ਸੇਈ ਮਾਤਿਆ ॥
691.t: sa(n)t rasan vooThaa aap tooThaa har raseh seiee maatiaa ||
691.e: You dwell on the tongues of the Saints, by Your own pleasure; they are intoxicated with Your sublime essence, O Lord.

691.g: ਗੁਰ ਚਰਨ ਲਾਗੇ ਮਹਾ ਭਾਗੇ ਸਦਾ ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਜਾਗਿਆ ॥
691.t: gur charan laage mahaa bhaage sadhaa anadhin jaagiaa ||
691.e: Those who are attached to Your feet are very blessed; night and day, they remain always awake and aware.

691.g: ਸਦ ਸਦਾ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਤਬੵ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਸਾਸਿ ਸਾਸਿ ਗੁਣ ਬੋਲਈ ॥
691.t: sadh sadhaa si(n)mratabaye suaamee saas saas gun boliee ||
691.e: Forever and ever, meditate in remembrance on the Lord and Master; with each and every breath, speak His Glorious Praises.

691.g: ਬਿਨਵੰਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਧੂਰਿ ਸਾਧੂ ਨਾਮੁ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਅਮੋਲਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
691.t: binava(n)t naanak dhoor saadhoo naam prabhoo amoliee ||4||1||
691.e: Prays Nanak, let me become the dust of the feet of the Saints. God's Name is invaluable. ||4||1||

691.g: ਰਾਗੁ ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀ ਕੀ
691.t: raag dhanaasaree baanee bhagat kabeer jee kee
691.e: Raag Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Kabeer Jee:

691.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
691.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
691.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

691.g: ਸਨਕ ਸਨੰਦ ਮਹੇਸ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਸੇਖਨਾਗਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਮਰਮੁ ਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੧॥
691.t: sanak sana(n)dh mahes samaanaa(n) || sekhanaag tero maram na jaanaa(n) ||1||
691.e: Beings like Sanak, Sanand, Shiva and Shaysh-naaga - none of them know Your mystery, Lord. ||1||

691.g: ਸੰਤਸੰਗਤਿ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਬਸਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
691.t: sa(n)tasa(n)gat raam ridhai basaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
691.e: In the Society of the Saints, the Lord dwells within the heart. ||1||Pause||

691.g: ਹਨੂਮਾਨ ਸਰਿ ਗਰੁੜ ਸਮਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਸੁਰਪਤਿ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਗੁਨ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੨॥
691.t: hanoomaan sar garuR samaanaa(n) || surapat narapat nahee gun jaanaa(n) ||2||
691.e: Beings like Hanumaan, Garura, Indra the King of the gods and the rulers of humans - none of them know Your Glories, Lord. ||2||

691.g: ਚਾਰਿ ਬੇਦ ਅਰੁ ਸਿੰਮ੍ਰਿਤਿ ਪੁਰਾਨਾਂ ॥ ਕਮਲਾਪਤਿ ਕਵਲਾ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਾਂ ॥੩॥
691.t: chaar bedh ar si(n)mirat puraanaa(n) || kamalaapat kavalaa nahee jaanaa(n) ||3||
691.e: The four Vedas, the Simritees and the Puraanas, Vishnu the Lord of Lakshmi and Lakshmi herself - none of them know the Lord. ||3||

691.g: ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੋ ਭਰਮੈ ਨਾਹੀ ॥ ਪਗ ਲਗਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਹੈ ਸਰਨਾਂਹੀ ॥੪॥੧॥
691.t: keh kabeer so bharamai naahee || pag lag raam rahai saranaa(n)hee ||4||1||
691.e: Says Kabeer, one who falls at the Lord's feet, and remains in His Sanctuary, does not wander around lost. ||4||1||

692.g: ਦਿਨ ਤੇ ਪਹਰ ਪਹਰ ਤੇ ਘਰੀਆਂ ਆਵ ਘਟੈ ਤਨੁ ਛੀਜੈ ॥
692.t: dhin te pahar pahar te ghareeaa(n) aav ghaTai tan chheejai ||
692.e: Day by day, hour by hour, life runs its course, and the body withers away.

692.g: ਕਾਲੁ ਅਹੇਰੀ ਫਿਰੈ ਬਧਿਕ ਜਿਉ ਕਹਹੁ ਕਵਨ ਬਿਧਿ ਕੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
692.t: kaal aheree firai badhik jiau kahahu kavan bidh keejai ||1||
692.e: Death, like a hunter, a butcher, is on the prowl; tell me, what can we do? ||1||

692.g: ਸੋ ਦਿਨੁ ਆਵਨ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
692.t: so dhin aavan laagaa ||
692.e: That day is rapidly approaching.

692.g: ਮਾਤ ਪਿਤਾ ਭਾਈ ਸੁਤ ਬਨਿਤਾ ਕਹਹੁ ਕੋਊ ਹੈ ਕਾ ਕਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
692.t: maat pitaa bhaiee sut banitaa kahahu kouoo hai kaa kaa ||1|| rahaau ||
692.e: Mother, father, siblings, children and spouse - tell me, who belongs to whom? ||1||Pause||

692.g: ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਜੋਤਿ ਕਾਇਆ ਮਹਿ ਬਰਤੈ ਆਪਾ ਪਸੂ ਨ ਬੂਝੈ ॥
692.t: jab lag jot kaiaa meh baratai aapaa pasoo na boojhai ||
692.e: As long as the light remains in the body, the beast does not understand himself.

692.g: ਲਾਲਚ ਕਰੈ ਜੀਵਨ ਪਦ ਕਾਰਨ ਲੋਚਨ ਕਛੂ ਨ ਸੂਝੈ ॥੨॥
692.t: laalach karai jeevan padh kaaran lochan kachhoo na soojhai ||2||
692.e: He acts in greed to maintain his life and status, and sees nothing with his eyes. ||2||

692.g: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਛੋਡਹੁ ਮਨ ਕੇ ਭਰਮਾ ॥
692.t: kahat kabeer sunahu re praanee chhoddahu man ke bharamaa ||
692.e: Says Kabeer, listen, O mortal: Renounce the doubts of your mind.

692.g: ਕੇਵਲ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਹੁ ਰੇ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਪਰਹੁ ਏਕ ਕੀ ਸਰਨਾਂ ॥੩॥੨॥
692.t: keval naam japahu re praanee parahu ek kee saranaa(n) ||3||2||
692.e: Chant only the One Naam, the Name of the Lord, O mortal, and seek the Sanctuary of the One Lord. ||3||2||

692.g: ਜੋ ਜਨੁ ਭਾਉ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਨੈ ਤਾ ਕਉ ਅਚਰਜੁ ਕਾਹੋ ॥
692.t: jo jan bhaau bhagat kachh jaanai taa kau acharaj kaaho ||
692.e: That humble being, who knows even a little about loving devotional worship - what surprises are there for him?

692.g: ਜਿਉ ਜਲੁ ਜਲ ਮਹਿ ਪੈਸਿ ਨ ਨਿਕਸੈ ਤਿਉ ਢੁਰਿ ਮਿਲਿਓ ਜੁਲਾਹੋ ॥੧॥
692.t: jiau jal jal meh pais na nikasai tiau ddur milio julaaho ||1||
692.e: Like water, dripping into water, which cannot be separated out again, so is the weaver Kabeer, with softened heart, merged into the Lord. ||1||

692.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ ਮੈ ਤਉ ਮਤਿ ਕਾ ਭੋਰਾ ॥
692.t: har ke logaa mai tau mat kaa bhoraa ||
692.e: O people of the Lord, I am just a simple-minded fool.

692.g: ਜਉ ਤਨੁ ਕਾਸੀ ਤਜਹਿ ਕਬੀਰਾ ਰਮਈਐ ਕਹਾ ਨਿਹੋਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
692.t: jau tan kaasee tajeh kabeeraa ramieeaai kahaa nihoraa ||1|| rahaau ||
692.e: If Kabeer were to leave his body at Benares, and so liberate himself, what obligation would he have to the Lord? ||1||Pause||

692.g: ਕਹਤੁ ਕਬੀਰੁ ਸੁਨਹੁ ਰੇ ਲੋਈ ਭਰਮਿ ਨ ਭੂਲਹੁ ਕੋਈ ॥
692.t: kahat kabeer sunahu re loiee bharam na bhoolahu koiee ||
692.e: Says Kabeer, listen, O people - do not be deluded by doubt.

692.g: ਕਿਆ ਕਾਸੀ ਕਿਆ ਊਖਰੁ ਮਗਹਰੁ ਰਾਮੁ ਰਿਦੈ ਜਉ ਹੋਈ ॥੨॥੩॥
692.t: kiaa kaasee kiaa uookhar magahar raam ridhai jau hoiee ||2||3||
692.e: What is the difference between Benares and the barren land of Maghar, if the Lord is within one's heart? ||2||3||

692.g: ਇੰਦ੍ਰ ਲੋਕ ਸਿਵ ਲੋਕਹਿ ਜੈਬੋ ॥
692.t: ei(n)dhr lok siv lokeh jaibo ||
692.e: Mortals may go to the Realm of Indra, or the Realm of Shiva,

692.g: ਓਛੇ ਤਪ ਕਰਿ ਬਾਹੁਰਿ ਐਬੋ ॥੧॥
692.t: ochhe tap kar baahur aaibo ||1||
692.e: but because of their hypocrisy and false prayers, they must leave again. ||1||

692.g: ਕਿਆ ਮਾਂਗਉ ਕਿਛੁ ਥਿਰੁ ਨਾਹੀ ॥
692.t: kiaa maa(n)gau kichh thir naahee ||
692.e: What should I ask for? Nothing lasts forever.

692.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਰਖੁ ਮਨ ਮਾਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
692.t: raam naam rakh man maahee ||1|| rahaau ||
692.e: Enshrine the Lord's Name within your mind. ||1||Pause||

692.g: ਸੋਭਾ ਰਾਜ ਬਿਭੈ ਬਡਿਆਈ ॥
692.t: sobhaa raaj bibhai baddiaaiee ||
692.e: Fame and glory, power, wealth and glorious greatness

692.g: ਅੰਤਿ ਨ ਕਾਹੂ ਸੰਗ ਸਹਾਈ ॥੨॥
692.t: a(n)t na kaahoo sa(n)g sahaiee ||2||
692.e: - none of these will go with you or help you in the end. ||2||

692.g: ਪੁਤ੍ਰ ਕਲਤ੍ਰ ਲਛਮੀ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
692.t: putr kalatr lachhamee maiaa ||
692.e: Children, spouse, wealth and Maya

692.g: ਇਨ ਤੇ ਕਹੁ ਕਵਨੈ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੩॥
692.t: ein te kahu kavanai sukh paiaa ||3||
692.e: - who has ever obtained peace from these? ||3||

692.g: ਕਹਤ ਕਬੀਰ ਅਵਰ ਨਹੀ ਕਾਮਾ ॥
692.t: kahat kabeer avar nahee kaamaa ||
692.e: Says Kabeer, nothing else is of any use.

692.g: ਹਮਰੈ ਮਨ ਧਨ ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
692.t: hamarai man dhan raam ko naamaa ||4||4||
692.e: Within my mind is the wealth of the Lord's Name. ||4||4||

692.g: ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਿ ਭਾਈ ॥
692.t: raam simar raam simar raam simar bhaiee ||
692.e: Remember the Lord, remember the Lord, remember the Lord in meditation, O Siblings of Destiny.

692.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਸਿਮਰਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੂਡਤੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
692.t: raam naam simaran bin booddate adhikaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
692.e: Without remembering the Lord's Name in meditation, a great many are drowned. ||1||Pause||

692.g: ਬਨਿਤਾ ਸੁਤ ਦੇਹ ਗ੍ਰੇਹ ਸੰਪਤਿ ਸੁਖਦਾਈ ॥
692.t: banitaa sut dheh greh sa(n)pat sukhadhaiee ||
692.e: Your spouse, children, body, house and possessions - you think these will give you peace.

692.g: ਇਨੑ ਮੈ ਕਛੁ ਨਾਹਿ ਤੇਰੋ ਕਾਲ ਅਵਧ ਆਈ ॥੧॥
692.t: ein(h) mai kachh naeh tero kaal avadh aaiee ||1||
692.e: But none of these shall be yours, when the time of death comes. ||1||

692.g: ਅਜਾਮਲ ਗਜ ਗਨਿਕਾ ਪਤਿਤ ਕਰਮ ਕੀਨੇ ॥
692.t: ajaamal gaj ganikaa patit karam keene ||
692.e: Ajaamal, the elephant, and the prostitute committed many sins,

692.g: ਤੇਊ ਉਤਰਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਲੀਨੇ ॥੨॥
692.t: teuoo utar paar pare raam naam leene ||2||
692.e: but still, they crossed over the world-ocean, by chanting the Lord's Name. ||2||

692.g: ਸੂਕਰ ਕੂਕਰ ਜੋਨਿ ਭ੍ਰਮੇ ਤਊ ਲਾਜ ਨ ਆਈ ॥
692.t: sookar kookar jon bhrame tuoo laaj na aaiee ||
692.e: You have wandered in reincarnation, as pigs and dogs - did you feel no shame?

692.g: ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਛਾਡਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਾਹੇ ਬਿਖੁ ਖਾਈ ॥੩॥
692.t: raam naam chhaadd a(n)mirat kaahe bikh khaiee ||3||
692.e: Forsaking the Ambrosial Name of the Lord, why do you eat poison? ||3||

692.g: ਤਜਿ ਭਰਮ ਕਰਮ ਬਿਧਿ ਨਿਖੇਧ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇਹੀ ॥
692.t: taj bharam karam bidh nikhedh raam naam lehee ||
692.e: Abandon your doubts about do's and dont's, and take to the Lord's Name.

692.g: ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ਜਨ ਕਬੀਰ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
692.t: gur prasaadh jan kabeer raam kar sanehee ||4||5||
692.e: By Guru's Grace, O servant Kabeer, love the Lord. ||4||5||

692.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਭਗਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਵ ਜੀ ਕੀ
692.t: dhanaasaree baanee bhagat naamadhev jee kee
692.e: Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Naam Dayv Jee:

692.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
692.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
692.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

692.g: ਗਹਰੀ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ ਨੀਵ ਖੁਦਾਈ ਊਪਰਿ ਮੰਡਪ ਛਾਏ ॥
692.t: gaharee kar kai neev khudhaiee uoopar ma(n)ddap chhaae ||
692.e: They dig deep foundations, and build lofty palaces.

692.g: ਮਾਰਕੰਡੇ ਤੇ ਕੋ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ਜਿਨਿ ਤ੍ਰਿਣ ਧਰਿ ਮੂੰਡ ਬਲਾਏ ॥੧॥
692.t: maaraka(n)dde te ko adhikaiee jin tiran dhar moo(n)dd balaae ||1||
692.e: Can anyone live longer than Markanda, who passed his days with only a handful of straw upon his head? ||1||

692.g: ਹਮਰੋ ਕਰਤਾ ਰਾਮੁ ਸਨੇਹੀ ॥
692.t: hamaro karataa raam sanehee ||
692.e: The Creator Lord is our only friend.

692.g: ਕਾਹੇ ਰੇ ਨਰ ਗਰਬੁ ਕਰਤ ਹਹੁ ਬਿਨਸਿ ਜਾਇ ਝੂਠੀ ਦੇਹੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
692.t: kaahe re nar garab karat hahu binas jai jhooThee dhehee ||1|| rahaau ||
692.e: O man, why are you so proud? This body is only temporary - it shall pass away. ||1||Pause||

693.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਮੇਰੀ ਕੈਰਉ ਕਰਤੇ ਦੁਰਜੋਧਨ ਸੇ ਭਾਈ ॥
693.t: meree meree kairau karate dhurajodhan se bhaiee ||
693.e: The Kaurvas, who had brothers like Duryodhan, used to proclaim, ""This is ours! This is ours!""

693.g: ਬਾਰਹ ਜੋਜਨ ਛਤ੍ਰੁ ਚਲੈ ਥਾ ਦੇਹੀ ਗਿਰਝਨ ਖਾਈ ॥੨॥
693.t: baareh jojan chhatr chalai thaa dhehee girajhan khaiee ||2||
693.e: Their royal procession extended over sixty miles, and yet their bodies were eaten by vultures. ||2||

693.g: ਸਰਬ ਸੋੁਇਨ ਕੀ ਲੰਕਾ ਹੋਤੀ ਰਾਵਨ ਸੇ ਅਧਿਕਾਈ ॥
693.t: sarab suoin kee la(n)kaa hotee raavan se adhikaiee ||
693.e: Sri Lanka was totally rich with gold; was anyone greater than its ruler Raavan?

693.g: ਕਹਾ ਭਇਓ ਦਰਿ ਬਾਂਧੇ ਹਾਥੀ ਖਿਨ ਮਹਿ ਭਈ ਪਰਾਈ ॥੩॥
693.t: kahaa bhio dhar baa(n)dhe haathee khin meh bhiee paraiee ||3||
693.e: What happened to the elephants, tethered at his gate? In an instant, it all belonged to someone else. ||3||

693.g: ਦੁਰਬਾਸਾ ਸਿਉ ਕਰਤ ਠਗਉਰੀ ਜਾਦਵ ਏ ਫਲ ਪਾਏ ॥
693.t: dhurabaasaa siau karat Thagauree jaadhav e fal paae ||
693.e: The Yaadvas deceived Durbaasaa, and received their rewards.

693.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਨ ਅਪੁਨੇ ਊਪਰ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ ॥੪॥੧॥
693.t: kirapaa karee jan apune uoopar naamadheau har gun gaae ||4||1||
693.e: The Lord has shown mercy to His humble servant, and now Naam Dayv sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord. ||4||1||

693.g: ਦਸ ਬੈਰਾਗਨਿ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਸਿ ਕੀਨੑੀ ਪੰਚਹੁ ਕਾ ਮਿਟ ਨਾਵਉ ॥
693.t: dhas bairaagan moh bas keen(h)ee pa(n)chahu kaa miT naavau ||
693.e: I have brought the ten sensory organs under my control, and erased every trace of the five thieves.

693.g: ਸਤਰਿ ਦੋਇ ਭਰੇ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਰਿ ਬਿਖੁ ਕਉ ਮਾਰਿ ਕਢਾਵਉ ॥੧॥
693.t: satar dhoi bhare a(n)mirat sar bikh kau maar kaddaavau ||1||
693.e: I have filled the seventy-two thousand nerve channels with Ambrosial Nectar, and drained out the poison. ||1||

693.g: ਪਾਛੈ ਬਹੁਰਿ ਨ ਆਵਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
693.t: paachhai bahur na aavan paavau ||
693.e: I shall not come into the world again.

693.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਬਾਣੀ ਘਟ ਤੇ ਉਚਰਉ ਆਤਮ ਕਉ ਸਮਝਾਵਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
693.t: a(n)mirat baanee ghaT te ucharau aatam kau samajhaavau ||1|| rahaau ||
693.e: I chant the Ambrosial Bani of the Word from the depths of my heart, and I have instructed my soul. ||1||Pause||

693.g: ਬਜਰ ਕੁਠਾਰੁ ਮੋਹਿ ਹੈ ਛੀਨਾਂ ਕਰਿ ਮਿੰਨਤਿ ਲਗਿ ਪਾਵਉ ॥
693.t: bajar kuThaar moh hai chheenaa(n) kar mi(n)nat lag paavau ||
693.e: I fell at the Guru's feet and begged of Him; with the mighty axe, I have chopped off emotional attachment.

693.g: ਸੰਤਨ ਕੇ ਹਮ ਉਲਟੇ ਸੇਵਕ ਭਗਤਨ ਤੇ ਡਰਪਾਵਉ ॥੨॥
693.t: sa(n)tan ke ham ulaTe sevak bhagatan te ddarapaavau ||2||
693.e: Turning away from the world, I have become the servant of the Saints; I fear no one except the Lord's devotees. ||2||

693.g: ਇਹ ਸੰਸਾਰ ਤੇ ਤਬ ਹੀ ਛੂਟਉ ਜਉ ਮਾਇਆ ਨਹ ਲਪਟਾਵਉ ॥
693.t: eeh sa(n)saar te tab hee chhooTau jau maiaa neh lapaTaavau ||
693.e: I shall be released from this world, when I stop clinging to Maya.

693.g: ਮਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਗਰਭ ਜੋਨਿ ਕਾ ਤਿਹ ਤਜਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਪਾਵਉ ॥੩॥
693.t: maiaa naam garabh jon kaa teh taj dharasan paavau ||3||
693.e: Maya is the name of the power which causes us to be born; renouncing it, we obtain the Blessed Vision of the Lord's Darshan. ||3||

693.g: ਇਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰਹਿ ਜੋ ਜਨ ਤਿਨ ਭਉ ਸਗਲ ਚੁਕਾਈਐ ॥
693.t: eit kar bhagat kareh jo jan tin bhau sagal chukaieeaai ||
693.e: That humble being, who performs devotional worship in this way, is rid of all fear.

693.g: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਮਦੇਉ ਬਾਹਰਿ ਕਿਆ ਭਰਮਹੁ ਇਹ ਸੰਜਮ ਹਰਿ ਪਾਈਐ ॥੪॥੨॥
693.t: kahat naamadheau baahar kiaa bharamahu ieh sa(n)jam har paieeaai ||4||2||
693.e: Says Naam Dayv, why are you wandering around out there? This is the way to find the Lord. ||4||2||

693.g: ਮਾਰਵਾੜਿ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਬੇਲਿ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਕਰਹਲਾ ॥
693.t: maaravaaR jaise neer baalahaa bel baalahaa karahalaa ||
693.e: As water is very precious in the desert, and the creeper weeds are dear to the camel,

693.g: ਜਿਉ ਕੁਰੰਕ ਨਿਸਿ ਨਾਦੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥
693.t: jiau kura(n)k nis naadh baalahaa tiau merai man raamieeaa ||1||
693.e: and the tune of the hunter's bell at night is enticing to the deer, so is the Lord to my mind. ||1||

693.g: ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਰੂੜੋ ਰੂਪੁ ਰੂੜੋ ਅਤਿ ਰੰਗ ਰੂੜੋ ਮੇਰੋ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
693.t: teraa naam rooRo roop rooRo at ra(n)g rooRo mero raamieeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
693.e: Your Name is so beautiful! Your form is so beautiful! Your Love is so very beautiful, O my Lord. ||1||Pause||

693.g: ਜਿਉ ਧਰਣੀ ਕਉ ਇੰਦ੍ਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਕੁਸਮ ਬਾਸੁ ਜੈਸੇ ਭਵਰਲਾ ॥
693.t: jiau dharanee kau i(n)dhr baalahaa kusam baas jaise bhavaralaa ||
693.e: As rain is dear to the earth, and the flower's fragrance is dear to the bumble bee,

693.g: ਜਿਉ ਕੋਕਿਲ ਕਉ ਅੰਬੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੨॥
693.t: jiau kokil kau a(n)b baalahaa tiau merai man raamieeaa ||2||
693.e: and the mango is dear to the cuckoo, so is the Lord to my mind. ||2||

693.g: ਚਕਵੀ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਸੂਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਮਾਨ ਸਰੋਵਰ ਹੰਸੁਲਾ ॥
693.t: chakavee kau jaise soor baalahaa maan sarovar ha(n)sulaa ||
693.e: As the sun is dear to the chakvi duck, and the lake of Man Sarovar is dear to the swan,

693.g: ਜਿਉ ਤਰੁਣੀ ਕਉ ਕੰਤੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੩॥
693.t: jiau tarunee kau ka(n)t baalahaa tiau merai man raamieeaa ||3||
693.e: and the husband is dear to his wife, so is the Lord to my mind. ||3||

693.g: ਬਾਰਿਕ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਖੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਚਾਤ੍ਰਿਕ ਮੁਖ ਜੈਸੇ ਜਲਧਰਾ ॥
693.t: baarik kau jaise kheer baalahaa chaatirak mukh jaise jaladharaa ||
693.e: As milk is dear to the baby, and the raindrop is dear to the mouth of the rainbird,

693.g: ਮਛੁਲੀ ਕਉ ਜੈਸੇ ਨੀਰੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਮੇਰੈ ਮਨਿ ਰਾਮਈਆ ॥੪॥
693.t: machhulee kau jaise neer baalahaa tiau merai man raamieeaa ||4||
693.e: and as water is dear to the fish, so is the Lord to my mind. ||4||

693.g: ਸਾਧਿਕ ਸਿਧ ਸਗਲ ਮੁਨਿ ਚਾਹਹਿ ਬਿਰਲੇ ਕਾਹੂ ਡੀਠੁਲਾ ॥
693.t: saadhik sidh sagal mun chaaheh birale kaahoo ddeeThulaa ||
693.e: All the seekers, Siddhas and silent sages seek Him, but only a rare few behold Him.

693.g: ਸਗਲ ਭਵਣ ਤੇਰੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਬਾਲਹਾ ਤਿਉ ਨਾਮੇ ਮਨਿ ਬੀਠੁਲਾ ॥੫॥੩॥
693.t: sagal bhavan tero naam baalahaa tiau naame man beeThulaa ||5||3||
693.e: Just as Your Name is dear to all the Universe, so is the Lord dear to Naam Dayv's mind. ||5||3||

693.g: ਪਹਿਲ ਪੁਰੀਏ ਪੁੰਡਰਕ ਵਨਾ ॥
693.t: pahil pure'e pu(n)ddarak vanaa ||
693.e: First of all, the lotuses bloomed in the woods;

693.g: ਤਾ ਚੇ ਹੰਸਾ ਸਗਲੇ ਜਨਾਂ ॥
693.t: taa che ha(n)saa sagale janaa(n) ||
693.e: from them, all the swan-souls came into being.

693.g: ਕ੍ਰਿਸ੍ਨਾ ਤੇ ਜਾਨਊ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਚੰਤੀ ਨਾਚਨਾ ॥੧॥
693.t: kirasanaa te jaanuoo har har naacha(n)tee naachanaa ||1||
693.e: Know that, through Krishna, the Lord, Har, Har, the dance of creation dances. ||1||

693.g: ਪਹਿਲ ਪੁਰਸਾਬਿਰਾ ॥
693.t: pahil purasaabiraa ||
693.e: First of all, there was only the Primal Being.

693.g: ਅਥੋਨ ਪੁਰਸਾਦਮਰਾ ॥
693.t: athon purasaadhamaraa ||
693.e: From that Primal Being, Maya was produced.

693.g: ਅਸਗਾ ਅਸ ਉਸਗਾ ॥
693.t: asagaa as usagaa ||
693.e: All that is, is His.

693.g: ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਬਾਗਰਾ ਨਾਚੈ ਪਿੰਧੀ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਗਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
693.t: har kaa baagaraa naachai pi(n)dhee meh saagaraa ||1|| rahaau ||
693.e: In this Garden of the Lord, we all dance, like water in the pots of the Persian wheel. ||1||Pause||

693.g: ਨਾਚੰਤੀ ਗੋਪੀ ਜੰਨਾ ॥
693.t: naacha(n)tee gopee ja(n)naa ||
693.e: Women and men both dance.

693.g: ਨਈਆ ਤੇ ਬੈਰੇ ਕੰਨਾ ॥
693.t: nieeaa te baire ka(n)naa ||
693.e: There is no other than the Lord.

693.g: ਤਰਕੁ ਨ ਚਾ ॥
693.t: tarak na chaa ||
693.e: Don't dispute this,

693.g: ਭ੍ਰਮੀਆ ਚਾ ॥
693.t: bhrameeaa chaa ||
693.e: and don't doubt this.

693.g: ਕੇਸਵਾ ਬਚਉਨੀ ਅਈਏ ਮਈਏ ਏਕ ਆਨ ਜੀਉ ॥੨॥
693.t: kesavaa bachaunee ie'ee mie'ee ek aan jeeau ||2||
693.e: The Lord says, ""This creation and I are one and the same.""||2||

694.g: ਪਿੰਧੀ ਉਭਕਲੇ ਸੰਸਾਰਾ ॥
694.t: pi(n)dhee ubhakale sa(n)saaraa ||
694.e: Like the pots on the Persian wheel, sometimes the world is high, and sometimes it is low.

694.g: ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਿ ਆਏ ਤੁਮ ਚੇ ਦੁਆਰਾ ॥
694.t: bhram bhram aae tum che dhuaaraa ||
694.e: Wandering and roaming around, I have come at last to Your Door.

694.g: ਤੂ ਕੁਨੁ ਰੇ ॥
694.t: too kun re ||
694.e: "Who are you?"

694.g: ਮੈ ਜੀ ॥ ਨਾਮਾ ॥ ਹੋ ਜੀ ॥
694.t: mai jee || naamaa || ho jee ||
694.e: "I am Naam Dayv, Sir."

694.g: ਆਲਾ ਤੇ ਨਿਵਾਰਣਾ ਜਮ ਕਾਰਣਾ ॥੩॥੪॥
694.t: aalaa te nivaaranaa jam kaaranaa ||3||4||
694.e: O Lord, please save me from Maya, the cause of death. ||3||4||

694.g: ਪਤਿਤ ਪਾਵਨ ਮਾਧਉ ਬਿਰਦੁ ਤੇਰਾ ॥
694.t: patit paavan maadhau biradh teraa ||
694.e: O Lord, You are the Purifier of sinners - this is Your innate nature.

694.g: ਧੰਨਿ ਤੇ ਵੈ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਜਿਨ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਹਰਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੧॥
694.t: dha(n)n te vai mun jan jin dhiaaio har prabh meraa ||1||
694.e: Blessed are those silent sages and humble beings, who meditate on my Lord God. ||1||

694.g: ਮੇਰੈ ਮਾਥੈ ਲਾਗੀ ਲੇ ਧੂਰਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਚਰਨਨ ਕੀ ॥
694.t: merai maathai laagee le dhoor gobi(n)dh charanan kee ||
694.e: I have applied to my forehead the dust of the feet of the Lord of the Universe.

694.g: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਮੁਨਿ ਜਨ ਤਿਨਹੂ ਤੇ ਦੂਰਿ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
694.t: sur nar mun jan tinahoo te dhoor ||1|| rahaau ||
694.e: This is something which is far away from the gods, mortal men and silent sages. ||1||Pause||

694.g: ਦੀਨ ਕਾ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਮਾਧੌ ਗਰਬ ਪਰਹਾਰੀ ॥
694.t: dheen kaa dhiaal maadhau garab parahaaree ||
694.e: O Lord, Merciful to the meek, Destroyer of pride

694.g: ਚਰਨ ਸਰਨ ਨਾਮਾ ਬਲਿ ਤਿਹਾਰੀ ॥੨॥੫॥
694.t: charan saran naamaa bal tihaaree ||2||5||
694.e: - Naam Dayv seeks the Sanctuary of Your feet; he is a sacrifice to You. ||2||5||

694.g: ਧਨਾਸਰੀ ਭਗਤ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀ ਕੀ
694.t: dhanaasaree bhagat ravidhaas jee kee
694.e: Dhanaasaree, Devotee Ravi Daas Jee:

694.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
694.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
694.e: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

694.g: ਹਮ ਸਰਿ ਦੀਨੁ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਨ ਤੁਮ ਸਰਿ ਅਬ ਪਤੀਆਰੁ ਕਿਆ ਕੀਜੈ ॥
694.t: ham sar dheen dhiaal na tum sar ab pateeaar kiaa keejai ||
694.e: There is none as forlorn as I am, and none as Compassionate as You; what need is there to test us now?

694.g: ਬਚਨੀ ਤੋਰ ਮੋਰ ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੈ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਪੂਰਨੁ ਦੀਜੈ ॥੧॥
694.t: bachanee tor mor man maanai jan kau pooran dheejai ||1||
694.e: May my mind surrender to Your Word; please, bless Your humble servant with this perfection. ||1||

694.g: ਹਉ ਬਲਿ ਬਲਿ ਜਾਉ ਰਮਈਆ ਕਾਰਨੇ ॥
694.t: hau bal bal jaau ramieeaa kaarane ||
694.e: I am a sacrifice, a sacrifice to the Lord.

694.g: ਕਾਰਨ ਕਵਨ ਅਬੋਲ ॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
694.t: kaaran kavan abol || rahaau ||
694.e: O Lord, why are You silent? ||Pause||

694.g: ਬਹੁਤ ਜਨਮ ਬਿਛੁਰੇ ਥੇ ਮਾਧਉ ਇਹੁ ਜਨਮੁ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੇ ਲੇਖੇ ॥
694.t: bahut janam bichhure the maadhau ih janam tum(h)aare lekhe ||
694.e: For so many incarnations, I have been separated from You, Lord; I dedicate this life to You.

694.g: ਕਹਿ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਆਸ ਲਗਿ ਜੀਵਉ ਚਿਰ ਭਇਓ ਦਰਸਨੁ ਦੇਖੇ ॥੨॥੧॥
694.t: keh ravidhaas aas lag jeevau chir bhio dharasan dhekhe ||2||1||
694.e: Says Ravi Daas: placing my hopes in You, I live; it is so long since I have gazed upon the Blessed Vision of Your Darshan. ||2||1||

694.g: ਚਿਤ ਸਿਮਰਨੁ ਕਰਉ ਨੈਨ ਅਵਿਲੋਕਨੋ ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਬਾਨੀ ਸੁਜਸੁ ਪੂਰਿ ਰਾਖਉ ॥
694.t: chit simaran karau nain avilokano sravan baanee sujas poor raakhau ||
694.e: In my consciousness, I remember You in meditation; with my eyes, I behold You; I fill my ears with the Word of Your Bani, and Your Sublime Praise.

694.g: ਮਨੁ ਸੁ ਮਧੁਕਰੁ ਕਰਉ ਚਰਨ ਹਿਰਦੇ ਧਰਉ ਰਸਨ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਭਾਖਉ ॥੧॥
694.t: manu su madhukar karau charan hiradhe dharau rasan a(n)mirat raam naam bhaakhau ||1||
694.e: My mind is the bumble bee; I enshrine Your feet within my heart, and with my tongue, I chant the Ambrosial Name of the Lord. ||1||

694.g: ਮੇਰੀ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਗੋਬਿੰਦ ਸਿਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਘਟੈ ॥
694.t: meree preet gobi(n)dh siau jin ghaTai ||
694.e: My love for the Lord of the Universe does not decrease.

694.g: ਮੈ ਤਉ ਮੋਲਿ ਮਹਗੀ ਲਈ ਜੀਅ ਸਟੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
694.t: mai tau mol mahagee liee jeea saTai ||1|| rahaau ||
694.e: I paid for it dearly, in exchange for my soul. ||1||Pause||

694.g: ਸਾਧਸੰਗਤਿ ਬਿਨਾ ਭਾਉ ਨਹੀ ਊਪਜੈ ਭਾਵ ਬਿਨੁ ਭਗਤਿ ਨਹੀ ਹੋਇ ਤੇਰੀ ॥
694.t: saadhasa(n)gat binaa bhaau nahee uoopajai bhaav bin bhagat nahee hoi teree ||
694.e: Without the Saadh Sangat, the Company of the Holy, love for the Lord does not well up; without this love, Your devotional worship cannot be performed.

694.g: ਕਹੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਇਕ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਹਰਿ ਸਿਉ ਪੈਜ ਰਾਖਹੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੨॥੨॥
694.t: kahai ravidhaas ik benatee har siau paij raakhahu raajaa raam meree ||2||2||
694.e: Ravi Daas offers this one prayer unto the Lord: please preserve and protect my honor, O Lord, my King. ||2||2||

694.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਆਰਤੀ ਮਜਨੁ ਮੁਰਾਰੇ ॥
694.t: naam tero aaratee majan muraare ||
694.e: Your Name, Lord, is my adoration and cleansing bath.

694.g: ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਨਾਮ ਬਿਨੁ ਝੂਠੇ ਸਗਲ ਪਾਸਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
694.t: har ke naam bin jhooThe sagal paasaare ||1|| rahaau ||
694.e: Without the Name of the Lord, all ostentatious displays are useless. ||1||Pause||

694.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਆਸਨੋ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਉਰਸਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਕੇਸਰੋ ਲੇ ਛਿਟਕਾਰੇ ॥
694.t: naam tero aasano naam tero urasaa naam teraa kesaro le chhiTakaare ||
694.e: Your Name is my prayer mat, and Your Name is the stone to grind the sandalwood. Your Name is the saffron which I take and sprinkle in offering to You.

694.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਭੁਲਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਚੰਦਨੋ ਘਸਿ ਜਪੇ ਨਾਮੁ ਲੇ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕਉ ਚਾਰੇ ॥੧॥
694.t: naam teraa a(n)bhulaa naam tero cha(n)dhano ghas jape naam le tujheh kau chaare ||1||
694.e: Your Name is the water, and Your Name is the sandalwood. The chanting of Your Name is the grinding of the sandalwood. I take it and offer all this to You. ||1||

694.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਦੀਵਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਬਾਤੀ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਤੇਲੁ ਲੇ ਮਾਹਿ ਪਸਾਰੇ ॥
694.t: naam teraa dheevaa naam tero baatee naam tero tel le maeh pasaare ||
694.e: Your Name is the lamp, and Your Name is the wick. Your Name is the oil I pour into it.

694.g: ਨਾਮ ਤੇਰੇ ਕੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਲਗਾਈ ਭਇਓ ਉਜਿਆਰੋ ਭਵਨ ਸਗਲਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
694.t: naam tere kee jot lagaiee bhio ujiaaro bhavan sagalaare ||2||
694.e: Your Name is the light applied to this lamp, which enlightens and illuminates the entire world. ||2||

694.g: ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਤਾਗਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਫੂਲ ਮਾਲਾ ਭਾਰ ਅਠਾਰਹ ਸਗਲ ਜੂਠਾਰੇ ॥
694.t: naam tero taagaa naam fool maalaa bhaar aThaareh sagal jooThaare ||
694.e: Your Name is the thread, and Your Name is the garland of flowers. The eighteen loads of vegetation are all too impure to offer to You.

694.g: ਤੇਰੋ ਕੀਆ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਕਿਆ ਅਰਪਉ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਤੁਹੀ ਚਵਰ ਢੋਲਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
694.t: tero keeaa tujheh kiaa arapau naam teraa tuhee chavar ddolaare ||3||
694.e: Why should I offer to You, that which You Yourself created? Your Name is the fan, which I wave over You. ||3||

694.g: ਦਸ ਅਠਾ ਅਠਸਠੇ ਚਾਰੇ ਖਾਣੀ ਇਹੈ ਵਰਤਣਿ ਹੈ ਸਗਲ ਸੰਸਾਰੇ ॥
694.t: dhas aThaa aThasaThe chaare khaanee ihai varatan hai sagal sa(n)saare ||
694.e: The whole world is engrossed in the eighteen Puraanas, the sixty-eight sacred shrines of pilgrimage, and the four sources of creation.

694.g: ਕਹੈ ਰਵਿਦਾਸੁ ਨਾਮੁ ਤੇਰੋ ਆਰਤੀ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਭੋਗ ਤੁਹਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੩॥
694.t: kahai ravidhaas naam tero aaratee sat naam hai har bhog tuhaare ||4||3||
694.e: Says Ravi Daas, Your Name is my Aartee, my lamp-lit worship-service. The True Name, Sat Naam, is the food which I offer to You. ||4||3||

695.e: Dhanaasaree, The Word Of Devotee Trilochan Jee:
One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:
Why do you slander the Lord? You are ignorant and deluded.

695.g: ਦੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਸੁਕ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਥਾਰੋ ਕਰਮੁ ਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
695.t: dhukirat sukirat thaaro karam ree ||1|| rahaau ||
695.e: Pain and pleasure are the result of your own actions. ||1||Pause||

695.g: ਸੰਕਰਾ ਮਸਤਕਿ ਬਸਤਾ ਸੁਰਸਰੀ ਇਸਨਾਨ ਰੇ ॥
695.t: sa(n)karaa masatak basataa surasaree isanaan re ||
695.e: The moon dwells in Shiva's forehead; it takes its cleansing bath in the Ganges.

695.g: ਕੁਲ ਜਨ ਮਧੇ ਮਿਲੵਿੋ ਸਾਰਗ ਪਾਨ ਰੇ ॥
695.t: kul jan madhe miliyeo saarag paan re ||
695.e: Among the men of the moon's family, Krishna was born;
even so, the stains from its past actions remain on the moon's face. ||1||

695.g: ਬਿਸ੍ਵ ਕਾ ਦੀਪਕੁ ਸ੍ਵਾਮੀ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਰੇ ਸੁਆਰਥੀ ਪੰਖੀ ਰਾਇ ਗਰੁੜ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਬਾਧਵਾ ॥
695.t: bisavai kaa dheepak savaiaamee taa che re suaarathee pa(n)khee rai garuR taa che baadhavaa ||
695.e: Aruna was a charioteer; his master was the sun, the lamp of the world. His brother was Garuda, the king of birds;
and yet, Aruna was made a cripple, because of the karma of his past actions. ||2||

695.g: ਅਨਿਕ ਪਾਤਿਕ ਹਰਤਾ ਤ੍ਰਿਭਵਣ ਨਾਥੁ ਰੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਭ੍ਰਮਤਾ ਲਹੈ ਨ ਪਾਰੁ ਰੀ ॥
695.t: anik paatik harataa tirabhavan naath ree teerath teerath bhramataa lahai na paar ree ||
695.e: Shiva, the destroyer of countless sins, the Lord and Master of the three worlds, wandered from sacred shrine to sacred shrine; he never found an end to them.
And yet, he could not erase the karma of cutting off Brahma's head. ||3||

695.g: ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤ ਸਸੀਅ ਧੇਨ ਲਛਿਮੀ ਕਲਪਤਰ ਸਿਖਰਿ ਸੁਨਾਗਰ ਨਦੀ ਚੇ ਨਾਥੰ ॥
695.t: a(n)mirat saseea dhen lachhimee kalapatar sikhar sunaagar nadhee che naatha(n) ||
695.e: Through the nectar, the moon, the wish-fulfilling cow, Lakshmi, the miraculous tree of life, Sikhar the sun's horse, and Dhanavantar the wise physician - all arose from the ocean, the lord of rivers;
and yet, because of its karma, its saltiness has not left it. ||4||

695.g: ਦਾਧੀਲੇ ਲੰਕਾ ਗੜੁ ਉਪਾੜੀਲੇ ਰਾਵਣ ਬਣੁ ਸਲਿ ਬਿਸਲਿ ਆਣਿ ਤੋਖੀਲੇ ਹਰੀ ॥
695.t: dhaadheele la(n)kaa gaR upaaReele raavan ban sal bisal aan tokheele haree ||
695.e: Hanuman burnt the fortress of Sri Lanka, uprooted the garden of Raawan, and brought healing herbs for the wounds of Lachhman, pleasing Lord Raamaa;
and yet, because of his karma, he could not be rid of his loin cloth. ||5||

695.g: ਪੂਰਬਲੋ ਕ੍ਰਿਤ ਕਰਮੁ ਨ ਮਿਟੈ ਰੀ ਘਰ ਗੇਹਣਿ ਤਾ ਚੇ ਮੋਹਿ ਜਾਪੀਅਲੇ ਰਾਮ ਚੇ ਨਾਮੰ ॥
695.t: poorabalo kirat karam na miTai ree ghar gehan taa che moh jaapeeale raam che naama(n) ||
695.e: The karma of past actions cannot be erased, O wife of my house; this is why I chant the Name of the Lord.
So prays Trilochan, Dear Lord. ||6||1||
Sri Sain:
With incense, lamps and ghee, I offer this lamp-lit worship service.
I am a sacrifice to the Lord of Lakshmi. ||1||

695.g: ਮੰਗਲਾ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਗਲਾ ॥ ਨਿਤ ਮੰਗਲੁ ਰਾਜਾ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੋ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
695.t: ma(n)galaa har ma(n)galaa || nit ma(n)gal raajaa raam rai ko ||1|| rahaau ||
695.e: Hail to You, Lord, hail to You! Again and again, hail to You, Lord King, Ruler of all! ||1||Pause||
Sublime is the lamp, and pure is the wick.
You are immaculate and pure, O Brilliant Lord of Wealth! ||2||
Raamaanand knows the devotional worship of the Lord.
He says that the Lord is all-pervading, the embodiment of supreme joy. ||3||
The Lord of the world, of wondrous form, has carried me across the terrifying world-ocean.
Says Sain, remember the Lord, the embodiment of supreme joy! ||4||2||
Peepaa:

695.g: ਕਾਯਉ ਦੇਵਾ ਕਾਇਅਉ ਦੇਵਲ ਕਾਇਅਉ ਜੰਗਮ ਜਾਤੀ ॥
695.t: kaayau dhevaa kaiaau dheval kaiaau ja(n)gam jaatee ||
695.e: Within the body, the Divine Lord is embodied. The body is the temple, the place of pilgrimage, and the pilgrim.

695.g: ਕਾਇਅਉ ਧੂਪ ਦੀਪ ਨਈਬੇਦਾ ਕਾਇਅਉ ਪੂਜਉ ਪਾਤੀ ॥੧॥
695.t: kaiaau dhoop dheep nieebedhaa kaiaau poojau paatee ||1||
695.e: Within the body are incense, lamps and offerings. Within the body are the flower offerings. ||1||

695.g: ਕਾਇਆ ਬਹੁ ਖੰਡ ਖੋਜਤੇ ਨਵ ਨਿਧਿ ਪਾਈ ॥
695.t: kaiaa bahu kha(n)dd khojate nav nidh paiee ||
695.e: I searched throughout many realms, but I found the nine treasures within the body.

695.g: ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਆਇਬੋ ਨਾ ਕਛੁ ਜਾਇਬੋ ਰਾਮ ਕੀ ਦੁਹਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
695.t: naa kachh aaibo naa kachh jaibo raam kee dhuhaiee ||1|| rahaau ||
695.e: Nothing comes, and nothing goes; I pray to the Lord for Mercy. ||1||Pause||

695.g: ਜੋ ਬ੍ਰਹਮੰਡੇ ਸੋਈ ਪਿੰਡੇ ਜੋ ਖੋਜੈ ਸੋ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
695.t: jo brahama(n)dde soiee pi(n)dde jo khojai so paavai ||
695.e: The One who pervades the Universe also dwells in the body; whoever seeks Him, finds Him there.

695.g: ਪੀਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਣਵੈ ਪਰਮ ਤਤੁ ਹੈ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਹੋਇ ਲਖਾਵੈ ॥੨॥੩॥
695.t: peepaa pranavai param tat hai satigur hoi lakhaavai ||2||3||
695.e: Peepaa prays, the Lord is the supreme essence; He reveals Himself through the True Guru. ||2||3||
Dhannaa:
O Lord of the world, this is Your lamp-lit worship service.

695.g: ਜੋ ਜਨ ਤੁਮਰੀ ਭਗਤਿ ਕਰੰਤੇ ਤਿਨ ਕੇ ਕਾਜ ਸਵਾਰਤਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
695.t: jo jan tumaree bhagat kara(n)te tin ke kaaj savaarataa ||1|| rahaau ||
695.e: You are the Arranger of the affairs of those humble beings who perform Your devotional worship service. ||1||Pause||
Lentils, flour and ghee - these things, I beg of You.
My mind shall ever be pleased.

695.g: ਪਨੑੀਆ ਛਾਦਨੁ ਨੀਕਾ ॥ ਅਨਾਜੁ ਮਗਉ ਸਤ ਸੀ ਕਾ ॥੧॥
695.t: pan(h)eeaa chhaadhan neekaa || anaaj magau sat see kaa ||1||
695.e: Shoes, fine clothes, and grain of seven kinds - I beg of You. ||1||
A milk cow, and a water buffalo, I beg of You,
and a fine Turkestani horse.
A good wife to care for my home
- Your humble servant Dhanna begs for these things, Lord. ||2||4||

696.g: ਜੈਤਸਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਚਉਪਦੇ
696.t: jaitasaree mahalaa chauthhaa ghar pehilaa chaupadhe
696.e: Jaitsree, Fourth Mehla, First House, Chau-Padhay:

696.g: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
696.t: ikOankaar satigur prasaadh ||
